Easy Class, must go to class (he takes attendence), always finished my work under 45 mins and left class) easy homeworks and very clear/forward projects
This is an extremely easy class.  Just a lot of typing.  Tests are easy and straight from the notes.  He is very nice and helpful.  He was a former UMBC student himself.

Harsh grader on HW assignments with are extremely length, time consuming, & have strange rubrics. Doesn't post a letter grade during the semester. No consistency with attendance tracking 
4/10

Dr. Starkey is a good professor when it comes to lectures but the assignments she gives are very long and complicated for a 100 level course. Do not procrastinate her class. She doesn't post notes or lectures on blackboard so you need to go to class. For some reason, the textbook is the only one that I have to actually pay for.

Dr. Starkey is extremely knowledgeable and the class is fairly lecture heavy. After the first assignment or two, you'll get the hang of how she grades and what she expects to see. You'll find she is quite literal when it comes to her grading criteria. Use the examples she uses in class even if another example may work and take good notes.

Dr. Starkey is a fairly good lecturer with a relaxed vibe online and in person (class was hybrid). Lectures could tend to drone a bit, especially online, but resources were always provided on BB and she was very supportive and helpful if you asked for one on one help. The readings were light and assignments were simple, but the tests were tough.

I don't know where all of these bad reviews are coming from. I have taken four classes with Dr. E and she is by far the most organized Professor I have had. I usually get a B in her class, but I strongly believe these are the courses where I learn the most. All in all, don't take her if you want an easy A, come ready to participate and read.

The class is not hard! It is very lecture heavy and requires some reading. The lectures are not very engaging since they consist mostly of reading off of slides which are already posted for students online. Time management was a little rough, and lectures would be rushed many times so that's when reading the textbook can be helpful

Dr. Etopio was great. Lots of work outside of class and it is IMPARITIVE that you do it ON TIME if you want any chance at passing. The work isn't necessarily hard, it's just time consuming so start as early as possible for everything. Overall, really nice professor, she's really understanding and is genuinely a nice person to talk to.

She's a very good professor. She really keeps track of participation so it is very much necessary. She makes it engaging, and enjoyable. She's also very nice
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I was really worried about the participation since it counts for points and she really keeps track of it but honestly, it was fine and kept me engaged. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

I especially appreciated her humor and personality. I left the class feeling that I truly learned something meaningful.

Dr. Etopio was an outstanding professor and far exceeded my expectations. reviews.comment: She is so organized and caring. She literally put a suggested schedule for homework/reading/exams on her syllabus (the syllabus is helpful). reviews.comment: The way some of these reviews sound you'd think Dr. Etopio will break into your house and eat your puppy. maybe it's bc I had her for psych100 but she's pretty good! she goes over lectures pretty clearly and is open to questions (even if they're stupid questions :P), sometimes she skips a few slides that show up on exams but they're posted on bb

DONT TAKE HER CLASS. dont do it. I wish I had listened to my friend. Learned nothing, all this professor cares about are grades. Because I can never see the results
Honestly the worst professor at UMBC. If you are an ineffective teacher you are an ineffective member of a university faculty. I might as well have thrown my money down a well.

Honestly, this professor's teaching really held me back. She's super strict for no good reason and not very friendly. This "professor" is a roadblock to education. She actively undermines the learning process by denying access to quiz reviews and previous unit material, making it impossible to learn from mistakes. Refusing to hand back test results is either incompetence or pure academic sabotage. If you are serious about your education, run. She is also rude.
She is NOT a good professor. That'sall im gonna say. 67

I enjoy her lectures but she spends too much time glazing topics that she likes and rushes some lectures. clear bias of topics, completely tossed the neuroscience/biological crap out to take up 2 lectures talking about social psych because its her fav... tests include stuff not taught that I only knew cuz its my major, attendance policy is horrible and unforgiving, how is it my fault if the wifi is bad? most people ik failed consistently on tests
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Would be better if she didn't use inquisitive for homework.

Overall, Etopio was a great professor. She taught the material well and wants you to the understand concepts. She gives lots of extra credit too. Attendance AND participation is very mandatory. I truly believe that whoever doesn't like Dr. E just doesn't like to participate in class. Classes are incredibly engaging and she truly cares about your learning. Her syllabus and assignment instructions are very straight forward. If you go to class and do the readings and assignments you won't need to study extra for anything. She is great!

Dr. Etopio might be the worst professor I've ever had. Gave me 50% on multiple homeworks where we had to pick a concept from the chapter and made me come to office hours just to tell me she was looking for me to pick a definition and explain it (which were different instructions). Also marks off 4.7% of your grade for each class missed. Insanity!

I'd run as far away from this professor. She's extremely arrogant and gets off on being a control freak. There has to be an internal and underlying issue as to why she acts the way she acts. If you're a quiet student, she will publicly shame you for being shy and mask it as her trying to “help you build a skill”. I guess it's free exposure therapy.

She always comes off as condescending to the class and backs it up by saying “I'm not trying to be rude”. She does this so often that it goes against the fact that she supposedly isn't trying to be rude. Watches like a hawk to take down participation and will complain over mundane things. Her teaching style overall is buns and would not recommend.

The lectures were very interesting and the course schedule was very straightforward. Lectures are based on the readings so be ready to read. The average chapter length is 20 pages so pace yourself. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Etopio teaches extremely interesting classes and has clear grading criteria. Though she can be inflexible about participation, it really is easy to simply show up and participate twice during class (not required to do this every day). What you get out of this class is what you put in, and I promise if you actively engage you will get an easy A.

Dr. E is one of (if not) the most unexciting and unapproachable professors. She excessively prioritizes participation, attendance, and writing, despite not being a writing intensive course. I have never been more frustrated after a class than in her's. I learned nothing of importance from these classes. I highly recommend not taking her classes.

Class is based on showing up and participating. If you are a student who has any health or conflicting schedules, I suggest you DO NOT take this because SHE WILL MAKE IT DIFFICULT FOR YOU. Grades HARSH, though she seems more critical of your writing skills than your ACTUAL assignment. I'm confused, Is this a focused PSYC course or an ENGL course???

Attendance over knowledge of crucial psychological principles misrepresents who truly understands the material.

Professor Etopio includes useless rubrics, even when followed, so pay attention to her instructions.

I was looking forward to taking psych of motivation this semester, but it's been one of the most unmotivating experiences in my life.

Prioritization of participation over assignments shows a disregard for her students' genuine understanding of content. She is extremely inflexible and expects assignments to be completed in a manner that only she would produce and not by her students' own minds. She has disregarded her own grading criteria when grading assignments.

Overall this class is okay, however things are graded pretty harshly in general. Participation its mandatory to earn points which is a bit pressuring for students who have a hard time participating in class. She is also a pretty harsh grader for reflections, but the learning content is very valuable. The professor she is always smiling and nice.

Barely passed b/c I refused to give in to her participation requirements - they are? Speak 2x every class + points deducted for being late. This type of part. shouldn't matter at this level especially when I aced the material. Easy class but she takes herself way too seriously. I'm proof you can pass despite her saying you won't without speaking.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I would like to start out by saying Dr. E is a caring person and makes herself very accessible for help outside of class. However, she is a very tough grader with standards that are difficult to understand. Although I enjoyed her class, I don't think I would take her again because I felt more focused on meeting her homework standards than learning.

The grading criteria is excessively stringent and unnecessary, implying a seemingly deliberate intention to harm students. The classes lack engagement and are limited to mere textbook reading. I do not encourage this instructure.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This was one of my favorite classes! No textbook but there are outside readings that are necessary. There are no long papers to turn in and participation is a big part of your grade. reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. E is an amazing professor! She has clear grading criteria, offers great feedback, and is very helpful even outside of class. Her lectures are actually engaging, and they don't feel as heavy or boring as the other lecture classes I have taken. She is so caring and understanding as long as you communicate with her!

Dr. E sets very clear expectations at the beginning of the semester. If you are willing to meet these, the class will be very easy. Most weeks consisted of one or two readings, typically around 10 pages each, and a quiz. The two "big" projects in the class took a maximum of an hour to complete and these take the place of the final exam!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Fun class! No textbook or exams, simply read the assigned readings, summarize it before class, take a short quiz, and then talk about what you learned in class. Participation matters and counts towards your grade. There were a few other assignments but they were all simple enough and she was always willing to help outside of class.

Loved having Dr. E as my professor this fall! Other people who have comments to say about her teaching and how she grades things clearly don't understand how college works. Every professor is different! She gives you points just for asking questions, she is accessible outside of class, and she is very helpful. She is passionate about what she does

Dr. Aubrey Etopio is a good instructor, but an unnecessarily tough grader.  It is difficult to grasp what she wants which seems very subjective. Would-be simple assignments are tougher than necessary.  I would definitely not select this instructor for future classes. There is definitely an underlying issue with control with this individual.

Passionate about the subject. Participation is mandatory and you can get it by raising your hand or going to office hours. Grading criteria very clear. No standard midterm or final, instead you have lots of smaller assignments. Flexible if you communicate with her in a timely way. Keeps things engaging with Kahoots and group discussions.

I loved working with Dr. E! She encouraged group discussion and would give great feedback to students on assignments. I felt I really understood the content more so than I would in just a lecture heavy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

she is not a good professor

nice lady, boring lectures, skipped a lot of the classes because you could do everything online. there was one or two classes i had to show up to for attendance/participation credit. calm class just disengaging
Easiest A of my life, i took it as a filler class and set aside on average 15 minutes max per week to get HW/exams done. Don't bother going to class, its too easy to waste your time like that.
attendance isnt mandatory; her class is so easy its just homework with 3 exams and ur done.

3 online exams with no lockdown browser each 27% (no final), 1 in class activity 3%, 10 homeworks 16% (drops lowest 2).

Prof Ma is great professor. Class was not mandatory I showed up for 2 lectures since I was retaking the course. There was one class a week on Tuesdays, 10 hws online, and 3 exams online no final. Prof Ma was definitely a better professor then my other one highly recommend for econ 101.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She was very sweet, and very passionate which made lectures easy to follow. Gave a bunch of examples, and all the homework, quizzes, and exams were online. When asked a question, she'd answer very clearly. Definitely would take her again for another econ course.

Easy A. We had class once a week and attendance was optional. Exams were online, no FINAL. Homeworks were so easy and almost everything was online. If you're looking for an easy A gen ed, take this class.

Took her for ECON 101. Attending lectures will benefit you greatly. Understanding her is a bit hard because she doesn't speak as loud even with a mic on but will answer questions when asked. One BIG problem is she does not give any exceptions, even if there is a system error or you're sick which caused me to get a B

The class was easy. Do the weekly hw (multiple attempts) and then three exams. Redoing the hw will help you prepare for the exams. Easy 100% on hw and low B average for exams.

Professor Ma is a highly engaging professor. Lectures are based on the textbook and clarify the concepts wonderfully. Weekly homework assignments are useful as they allow infinite attempts, which helps with understanding. 3 exams with no final. Exams are fair, consisting of multiple choice and graphing problems. Wonderful intro micro course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Bing Ma is an easy A. All exams are online. Attendance is not mandatory. I would recommend her.

Professor Bing Ma is an alright  Professor, it seems like she only read off the slides and didn't really teach. I didn't really learn anything due to that. Some of her explanations weren't clear in my view, they were a bit hard to understand. Exams are extremely weighted.
The only interaction with the professor was emails from her. The course was online, everything was online, literally everything. Easiest A ever.

Took her online and easy A! She gives 3 exams and weekly homework. She provides you with all the notes and powerpoints for each chapter. Only downside to her is that she doesn't post grades on blackboard so you pretty much have to keep track of your grades on your own.

reviews.comment: Great prof. COVID season was especially easy. Lectures were clear. Take this class if you want the credit.

Really easy class with this professor, especially asynch/online. She posts lectures and TA notes, which explained the material well. She also gives exam study guides/reviews before tests. for online classes it was not synchronized classes and it was an easy A if you read the textbook. However, if youre looking for an engaging econ class that will challenge you, this is not the class for you.
