Just take notes on the video lectures, about 5 pages of notes in 2-3 hours is enough to basically ace each quiz (there's 5 of them). Good winter/summer class choice.
I actually find music theory relatively difficult but online it's pretty doable

As expected of an online class, it's easy and easy to navigate however, I feel like the lectures and the textbooks weren't as much help in understanding the hw. Thankfully, the exams looked exactly like the HW so it wasn't as bad but I felt as if I didn't learn as much. The professor was chill though and engaging enough!

Super easy A&H upper-level credit. Took it over the summer. Dr. Crossland is so chill and fun, and you learn so much about the Beatles. Good amount of reading, but it has the material covered on the quizzes. 4 quizzes (easy), 4 discussion posts, 2 song analysis (5 min presentation over a Beatles song). Totally worth taking!
Fun class. Culturally relevant. Chill teacher. The quizzes were super specific, so be sure to read the textbook.
Very easy winter AH credit. You get to talk about some music you like and quizzes are right from the asynchronous lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class--Respected

reviews.comment: Nice dude. Easy going guy teaching an easy class. He's kinda boring though. The other reviews lead me to believe it would have been a fun class. Lets you out early.

Easiest class I've taken at UMBC. 4 weeks all online and only about 5 hours of work a week. I know all about The Beatles know and had a blast taking the class with him. If you put in the slightest bit of effort you'll get an A. He's also super cool and shares personal stories which are really interesting. Overall happiest a class has ever made me.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: One of the nicest professors I had. He is an easy grader, and wants you to get a good grade. The exams had a word box and had a lot of extra credit. You do need to at least skim the text/attend class to know the exam material. It would help if you are familiar with the music. One partner project, which was an easy A. Would recommend.

He is so hilarious because he has such a dry sense of humor. If you aren't familiar with anything music related and would like to learn, this is the class for you. You may feel a bit overwhelmed during class but overall this class teaches you a lot. Tests are veryyyyyy fair. DO THE HOMEWORK. Fun project at the end of the semester. Attend class!
Very easy going.
Easy A. Do the easy few assignments and keep up with the discussion board posts and live chats and you can get an A easily. 100% take to boost GPA.

Very nice guy, kind of passive. If you don't have previous experience with music, class attendance is a must. A few pages of hw every class, nothing terrible. Fair/ easy grader. Easy A if you put the effort in. Easy B without any effort.

Doesn't ever post anything on blackboard but he does give back exams. As long as you memorize the songs and get all the extra credit you will get at least a B. He seems like a nice guy. take this class if you want an A
Abysmal.  Just don't do it.
Just don't take him.

In all my years as a student, I have never rated a professor. No matter how bad things got, I didnt come here. Unless you have a group of people you know are going to be taking his class, and youre willing to cheat on tests and homework, do not ever take a class with Dr. Chang. He will not teach you, and you will not learn.

Very hard to understand because of accent. No clear teaching method  and didn't seem to understand the information himself. I felt bad because he seemed like a nice guy but no one in the class understood anything. The average for our final exam was a 35%. I'd avoid him if you want to avoid a semester full of extra stress and conufsion.

At UMBC this is almost a freshman level course,  he constantly compared us to his grad students when ever we got something wrong.  Our first test had an average of 7 out of 25 points, our second test had an average of 7.5 out of 30 points. He is the absolute worse teacher I have ever had.  Avoid him at all costs!!!

Easily the worst professor I have ever had. Homeworks don't prepare you for the exam and he is not clear at all. During exams, people have to ask so many questions about the questions and he will change what he wants several times when attempting to explain.
I took this class last year, and would definitely recommend it to anyone that wants to learn about energy, and fusion specially.

I took the thermo class with Prof. Romero over a year ago and enjoyed it. There is a lot to keep up with, but it got me ready for my first internship, and now on my way to my first job. I wish I could have taken the energy course as well.

I took this class last year and really enjoyed it. Some of the concepts were a bit hard to get, but really enjoyed learning about nuclear energy. Knowing about the topics discussed in class helped me get my first job.
The class was a lot of work but Prof. Talamas was fine teaching it.
I loved this class and totally recommend it to anyone that wants to learn about nuclear energy. The visit to the nuclear reactors was awesome!

I loved taking the energy class with Prof. Talamas, particularly the discussions of nuclear fission and fusion. I would recommend this class to anyone who wants to learn about different types of energy, in particular nuclear fusion. I applied to graduate school after taking this class.

I recently took this class and is one of the best classes I've ever taken. Prof. Talamas was very good at explaining the material, and I was always able to meet with him after class. I'm hoping to take the more advanced classes he teaches, and would recommend this professor to anyone that really wants to learn.

This professor is awful. He doesn't answer emails, grades harshly, and takes off points for anything. He rambles in lectures instead of teaching and doesn't tell you what you need to know for exams. Anyone praising has to get an internship with him. You will literally be teaching yourself thermodynamics. Most of the class was unsatisfied

As a whole, this professor wasn't that good at administering information. He does not follow the syllabus and would be chapters ahead of students during class, leaving them perplexed. His exams themselves weren't hard, but grading was very tough. He would give out pop quizzes which we were not forewarned about at the beginning of the semester.

Lectures can be confusing, but he more than makes up for it with how friendly the exams are. Questions are usually more conceptual. Although the syllabus said we had pop quizzes in class, that never happened, and you could realistically skip all the lectures and be just fine. The textbook will be your best friend for learning the material anyway.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr.  Romero-Talamas has been the most difficult professor I've had at UMBC. His grading was extremely harsh, and the expectations for assignments and exams were unclear. The graduate TA often came off as rude and dismissive when students asked questions. Overall, the course felt more like an obstacle than a learning experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The class is fine and the prof is understanding. He helped me find my first internship. More than other professors for sure!

Dr. Romero is not a good professor. He attacks the character of his students if they come to him for help or with concerns about the class. He is not very accessible outside of class and will not answer his emails. He rushes through all of the content.. He is not good about answering questions in class and will not look up from his tablet.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very ~okay~ professor. Weekly homework that isn't too hard and pretty short. Decent amount of studying. Exams and final make up 85% of your grade. Lectures are pretty easy to follow but get boring, consist of him answering problems or covering concepts from textbook, but does't upload notes. Gives lots of real world examples of content
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was super interesting and has helped me a lot, including during my first job interview (and helped me get a foot in the door!) I wish I could take it again, as I know the discussions are always updated. I definitely recommend it!

I would not recommend taking Dr. Romero. He is not very accessible outside of class and won't respond to emails. He is only here for his research and teaching seems to take a backseat for him. Doesn't provide resources whether that be lecture notes or other important resources. All example problems are from the answer key that he copies exactly.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He does give partial credit in exams. The class and homework are pretty doable if you follow from the beginning. Going to office hours is always helpful if you're stuck.

This class is what I always thought a university level class should be. With proper lectures and assignments that actually teach something useful. If all you want is to get an easy grade without actually putting time in this class, then you should wait for someone else to teach the class.

The discussion lectures and extra sessions have been very helpful. They almost gave away the first two exams, which were easy, yet Prof. Talamas and the teaching assistants keep the class interesting and are always willing to help.

This prof was understanding when I needed a break due to a medical condition. I've enjoyed the lectures and have been to his office plenty of times. He's always very patient explaining the material. Those who complain about the lectures are usually the ones that never even attend the lectures or care to follow the material!

He's clearly not happy to be teaching, that's for sure. As a student who only really needs the bare minimum out of a teacher to learn effectively: clear instruction and explanation of the material, as well as correlation to the tests, he struggles to even do that. His passion for the subject lies within research, and he should've stuck to that.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is actually pretty easy if you actually go to class and follow the material. The exams and assignment are also pretty easy if you spend a normal amount of time on them. The prof knows the material well. You just need to keep up and you'll be fine.

WORST PROFESSOR EVER!!! Gives no partial credit whatsoever on exams, even if there is one miniscule mistake. He doesn't know how to teach. Doesn't go into any detail while teaching and just assumes that the class knows everything. He has no respect for his students and doesn't care for their success. You have to learn from outside sources.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This professor was understanding when I was not able to attend the first exam. So far the lectures have been interesting, and he's accessible after class to answer questions.

This is one of the worst professors I have ever had. He does not know how to teach. He is not organized whatsoever. He does not go into any detail with any of his lectures. He comes late to class every day. I haven't been able to learn anything from him, all of what I have learned has been from youtube. No one in the class has learned anything.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: If you really want to learn thermodynamics, you definitely want to take this class. Makes class interesting and has plenty of real examples to use in the class.

I enjoyed this class and the discussions we had every day. I had to be absent for several days because of health reasons. The prof helped me catch up with the class and gave me the chance to submit overdue homework. He was always available to meet and he was very patient with me. I recommend this class to anyone that wants to learn about energy.

I enjoyed taking this elective with Prof. Talamas. We had to read and discuss articles everyday, and we covered a lot of material of different energy sources. The assignments were constant but not too hard. Nuclear energy was new for me, but I feel that I learned a lot about the issues and the technology.
Best class in my senior year! Classes are super interesting. I wish I had taken more classes with this prof!
A lot of material covered in this class, and sometimes hard to keep up with it. Much better to meet in person with this prof if you have questions, he knows his stuff.
Talamas is always willing to help inside and outside the classroom. You just need to reach out for help. Lots of assignments and quizzes, but not hard.

If you really want to learn thermo, take the class with Prof. Romero. If you do all the assignments and go to all discussion sessions, you will be fine. The exams are actually pretty easy if you did all the problems in class and discussion sessions. The quizzes sometimes are pretty random but they're not worth much.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I've enjoyed this class from the beginning. If you keep up with the reading and homework you'll be fine with this class. If you ask the prof. about thermo problems outside class, he'll work out the problems with you even if they are not the assigned problems (ask him about spacecraft!). The teaching assistants have also been super helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Inspirational

reviews.comment: This is the best engineering class I've taken. Prof. Talamas really knows the material, and shows real life applications and examples. Grading is fair, but tons of reading and quizzes.
I mean he is a good person but suck at teaching. Just take Maria whenever you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Better to talk to 1-on-1 and is very nice, but during lectures he seems to read and draw diagrams word for word directly out of the book. If you write down the examples and study from that, you should be fine. He enjoys telling real life applications of concepts which is interesting but makes a hard class even harder reading directly from the book.
The lectures definitely need improvement, this teacher is a research guy and that is probably what he loves. Overall not horrible but without a curve you won't pass

Dr. Talamas is very accessible, you just need to ask for help! If you keep up with the class and assignments, the exams are pretty fair. There are quizzes every class but they're easy and not worth much, so if you miss one is not a big deal.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: One line, Don't do it gang. Take Sanchez, Carlos does a quiz everyday of class with no definitive understanding of what on, no study guides for quizzes or exams, structure of the lecture is clear but he USED CHALK in a lecture hall in 2022 so most of the class walks out after the mandatory test at the begin, that should tell you all for real.
if you ask him questions about your exams he will literally deduct points from questions you got correct.
Thermo is a required course and Prof. Romero-Talamas was great teaching it. Will definitely take another class with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Energetic, articulate lecturer. Demonstrated concepts and common misunderstandings in a Python REPL. High-quality, in-depth slides that can be used in place of the lecture if necessary. Built an alternate submission platform to save his students from the borderline-unusable "GL" server -- initially blocked by the dept (Fall '26) but now in use.
shoutout dr donahue, he's so nice and clearly passionate about comp sci. only comp lecture at this school i feel like actually helped me in the subject. i wish i attended more often tbh

Class is in Python as of 2025 fall

Homework is almost weekly, you have to solve 5 coding problems for homeworks
every 2 weeks or so you will have a project due instead of homework, projects obviously take a bit longer
Exams are kind of annoying but they are fair (final is 20% of the grade)

Shane himself is a great teacher, 100% recommend

Amazing professor for CS. All his lectures are fun and engaging and really makes coding easy to get into if you've never coded before or are new to Python. Coding on paper on exams sucks, but it's not his decision to do this.

This class is pretty easy. Shane wants to help students outside of class. Lectures are confusing + fast if you're new to CS though. Attendance not mandatory so I'd suggest watching youtube to learn. Exams are very similar to practice. Go to tutoring for help if needed, they can help you out. Easy class overall

Professor Donahue is really funny and his lectures can be engaging because of that. However, his teaching style wasn't for me - he goes through things REALLY quickly. All of the grading is done by TA's, along with the discussion period, which can be hit or miss (my TA was not good).

At first I only swapped to his class because it fit my schedule better, but I think that was the best decision I made for taking 201. His lectures were so easy to listen to, and he made the concepts fun by referencing video games and writing funny code to explain concepts. He was very approachable as well after class. Overall, great professor.
Such a cool professor!!! Writes code live time and asks questions to make sure we know how to actually make stuff. plus he is funny and knowledgeable and very helpful even outside the lectures :)))

Some people read power points, others truly show their passion to others and inspire, Shane is the latter. An inspiration for myself and in my eyes the ideal of what it means to be an educator. Puts in time, uncalled for to revamp old material and provides clear instruction and support for all students.  He is a cornerstone for UMBC's CS department

Mr. Donahue is a chill guy who knows his stuff when it comes to computer science. Some of the lectures went by fast, but the slides are accessible and have the coding examples from class. Mr. Donahue often asked if people had any questions about the material and would explain concepts clearly. I would 100% recommend taking this class.

Donahue is passionate about comp sci and presents the material in an easily understandable style. He links his slides on Blackboard and always encourages students to ask questions. He responds to emails quickly and is friendly, funny, and polite. He actually cares about his students. You're doing yourself a favor if you take this class with him!

Shane is awesome. He clearly understands the content and can teach it very well. He is not PowerPoint reader, he shows examples and asks the class many questions throughout his demonstrations. He makes every class interactive and fun. Just paying attention and putting the work in outside of class is enough for 201. Shane just makes it easier.

Professor Donahue was excellent! The lectures were engaging and he would always try to link the content to the real world. He was easy to access and provided amazing help with whatever topics I was struggling with. In addition, he would sprinkle amazing advice and sources in his lectures that go beyond the classroom.

He's a safe bet. Shane is a pretty good lecturer. Nerdy best describes him. Approachable, pretty nice, explains things in a way you can understand. Beginner friendly: There's no embarrassment from asking what something means. Responded to emails in good time. TA's do most of the grading. Explains by live-coding, uploads his "slides" online.

Shane definitely cares about his students. Don't be afraid to ask him questions about project/homework (didn't have time to go to office hours, but was still very helpful through email). He might go too fast in lectures for some people, but free feel to speak up and ask questions.

He is very funny. He does seem to go by fast so sometimes it was hard for me to keep up but he is willing to answer questions. In fact, after explaining a concept, he always asks everyone if they have any questions. Hamilton is a bit more thorough in terms of explaining but Shane does a great job too.

He's a morally good person who sincerely cares about his students. He's more than willing to answer questions about the material or the homework during his office hours or through email. There will be a lot of live coding in his lecture which is necessary to understand the lesson if experience in coding is not established prior to the course.

His lectures were very good. and you can tell he actually cared about what he was teaching. Hamiliton is the professor who created all the exams and assignments, so he had little to do with that. I took this class with Hamiliton before and got a C but retaking it with Shane was much better. Also, he responds to his emails very quickly.
Cool guy. highly recommend especially as an elective course
Absolutely hilarious, and the content was always so interesting. Every lecture was like a podcast, and I learned so many cool things throughout the semester.

Terrific teacher and class, he cares very much about what he teaches as he follows a presentation with no words. Knocking knowledge off his dome and not missing a beat. A 2hr 30min class once a week and a dim lit theatre room made perfect for relaxation and chill time. It was wonderful, 3 papers is all this class grades, and they'll be A's.
Easiest class ever. Attendance is mandatory and graded along with only 3 papers that consisted of 1000 words each. His lectures were interesting and the films he showed felt like fever dreams.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the most amazing professors I've had! Super knowledgeable and engaging in lectures- never boring. Workload was also super minimal, and he was a very easy grader. I'd say it's an easy A and a super interesting class. Lectures can be long, but he is respectful of students' time. Loved ART215!
Such a nice professor! Graded by attendance and 3 easy papers. Really passionate about art. Would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's nice, knows what he's talking about, and is genuinely enthusiastic about the subjects. His grading is simple as well; he takes attendance but does not use it to determine the final grade. His course only has three big papers, and it was rather simple and achievable if you took your time.

Lectures were incredible, I learned a lot from his course without any stress. Lectures are long but interesting--great time to draw and introduces many artists that he is very knowledgeable about. Only had three essays, all of which were graded very easily. Highly recommend to anyone needing an art credit or a chill class :)
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The easiest class you could possibly take. Graded by 3 papers, no exams whatsoever. Class is just him showing us movies and videos while passionately lecturing on some other cool art stuff. He can be funny depending on your sense of humor. Really easy grader as well, follow the prompts & you'll be fine. Show up to class though he marks attendance

Easy class! You can tell he is passionate about what he teaches. The lectures are long, so I highly recommend bringing a sketchbook with you and sitting next to a friend. Don't bother bringing a laptop since he will call you out. I received A's for all three papers. Not easy assignments, but they could be done in a single night.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great class- interesting and super easy!

This class was super easy. There are no exams. The class is graded on attendance and 3 essays, which were only around 1000 words each. You can easily sign in for other people. We mainly just watched movies and looked at artwork during class, but participation doesn't matter so you can go to sleep or go on your phone.
Was really nice and understanding. We basically watched a lot of movies and there were a total of three papers and no final. This was a class that I looked forward to.

Definitely an easy A class. Would've liked some warning about content of some videos- some of us have migraines triggered by flashing lights -but otherwise pretty solid. Mostly just hid in the back and played minecraft when the movies were too much for my head. Tip for papers- he likes big words only if you use them right. You should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Took ART215 and ART329 with Mark - very caring and kind professor! Always understanding and genuinely wants to get to know students. Extremely knowledgable and passionate about photography and art in general. Shows a lot of movies and film clips in class and always leads great discussions afterward. Highly recommend!
Easy Art class. Show up for attendance and do the three papers and you'll pass the class, no problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He's honestly awesome. The grade is dependent on 3 papers and attendance. The lectures don't have much to do with what you write about most of the time, but either way, its a really interesting class (and I'm a STEM major, highly recommend). If you need an art GEP covered, take this
east A class. come to the class and submit 3 papers to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Mark Durant cares deeply about the subjects, and gives amazing lectures.  Most of the content is exclusive, attending lecture is a treat.  The only downside is that the class is very long, but if you pay attention it's more like entertainment than class.  The only grades other than attendance are 3 papers, which are short and easy to complete.

Art 215 is a great sampler of contemporary art, and a very easy class! You have 4 essays, but there are no tests or quizzes based on the lectures. Just show upit's mandatoryand enjoy yourself! You're sure to see some new stuff, and it's mandatory for most of ya'll anyway. (P.s. non art majors looking for an easy, interesting classthis is it.)

Class was VERY interesting- I loved all the topics he discussed in this class. The only killer is that the lecture is 2 1/2 hours.....you can get away with falling asleep. Lectures are great to listen to, but not completely mandatory to pay attention. Essays are easy and have nothing to do with the lectures. Pretty easy A class.

Pretty easy class to begin with, but he's fun to listen to. It's hard to lecture on intro to art stuff, and intro to photography, but I think he does it better than anyone else could.  He's enthusiastic about it too.

Wonderful teacher! He's very passionate about the subject. If you're an art major the content is interesting and his personality makes it even better. He does take attendance even though it's a lecture hall class, so it's important to go, but since it's a fun class, that's not hard! The only down side is that it's such a long class at 2 1/2 hours.

This class was incredibly boring, but he at least seemed interested in it. It was annoying that he taught in a bigger than usual lecture hall and refused to use a microphone, and because his voice is soft, it was hard to hear him. He's not very good at grading papers, and it seems his top priority is focusing on how many words it has. Average.

Best professor EVER. The man is funny, relatable, approachable, helpful, and if you take a few classes with him, he certainly becomes a friend. His grading method is awesome. If you try, you will get an A, no doubt about it. Despite knowing I'd get an A in his classes, I actually did the most work in them. I couldn't recommend this professor more!!

There's really nothing to lecture about in intro to art and media studies. There are many photos to look at and many videos to watch, most will put you to sleep. I really don't know if I can say much about the class. Attendance isn't mandatory. Just do the three essays and you're basically in the clear. Reading the graphic novels is fun though.

Not a very good teacher...actually, he doesn't teach much at all, he just shows movies and such most of the time.  The essays appear to be graded purely on whether he likes them or not, so if he doesn't like how you write, you're sunk.

Truly fantastic professor. Has become a mentor and friend. Don't be afraid to speak to him after class, he is very relaxed and humorous, and just wants people to discuss during his classes. If you're not interested in the material you're probably not listening well enough. Take advantage of an interested professor!
His upper level classes are not a breeze like the intro class talked about below, but he is still a fun, and very intelligent.

Really easy class... all you do is watch movies--seriously. He is really easy but doesn't do a very good job introducing or explaining the films we watch. Either way, there's practically no way you can fail. The textbooks are comic books.

really easy class, all you have to do is go and watch movies, read a couple of comic books and write short (3page) papers about them. he's really nice and very into everything covered in the class. guest speakers are also pretty interesting.

Loved his Intro to Art and Media class. He's smart and sharp and has good taste, and the class is more of a viewing session with a couple of papers (I got all A's) than a lecture. It was a great break from schedule, even though it's 3 hours. Cool teacher, and his wife, Bea Bufrahi, is also an awesome teacher at the Baltimore School for the Arts.

He was awesome and fair. Just know beforehand that if you want an A on a paper he wants "original thinking". I made a B on the first paper because I was expecting him to be like all other teachers who just want to hear what's been said before. His class was very good and I learned a lot.

Mark is the best! He is the only teacher that has both feet on the ground. He honestly critiques everyone fairly but doesn't beat around the bush he will tell you that you are doing well or not. Show up for his class everyday and do the work and show progress and he will give you an A. Some of his stories he tells in class are so worth the trip.
Extremely easy. Guaranteed A if you attempt everything. I even skipped a lot of classes.

this class was very boring, ur grade is base on 3 papers. we had a sign up sheet, so if u were taking this class w/ a bunch of ppl u could take turns going to class just to get ur named signed. the 1st 2 papers were base off 2 books and the last is about some an artist, so basical u don't need to go to class. No notes, no tests.

very opinionated and doesn't hesitate to snap at ur comments during open discussions.  this class was a waste. all we did was watch videos and write 3 papers. when disagreeing w/ him he will simply brush u off.

He's a good professor, assigns a lot of worksheets and sometimes his answer key's answers don't make sense but it's ok. 4 exams + a final and they're all in person so people who loves online stuff, maybe reconsider taking him?
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Schultz is honestly a really cool professor and the class is enjoyable. Get ready to read multiple things a week for this class, submit like 2-3 documents and some discussion boards. The content is really interesting in the readings and lectures and there is a TON of extra credit. 4 exams + a final exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Very time consuming--all the course content is in the readings given for the 50something assignments given throughout the week. However, the content is quite interesting. Exams were closed note and a little difficult, but graded on a curve. Videos shown in class are often on the exams. Would take again.

A lot of hmwk assignments answering questions after reading/watching various mediums. Books & a lot of studies/videos are old. Small group exercises; no presentations, papers, research assignments. Exams are based on learning objectives. Attend class before & after the exams & take notes! Prof is light-hearted, funny, good guy. Good 4 SW/PSYC peeps

Dr. Schultz is my MAN. not only did he make this class super fun & interesting, but he is very kind & always available to help you via email. We had worksheets due (tue/fri) by 8 pm for completion. Don't wait until the last second b/c some worksheets can be long, but they're helpful for studying for the exam. I've enjoyed this class so much. 100/10

With the online structure, we had a once a week class, and then we had work due every Thursday, Saturday, and Monday at 8pm. Having it due at 8pm was rough because it's rather "early", but the work wasn't necessarily hard. It was a lot of homework, BUT the homework was very helpful and we could study all the homeworkswe did for a unit for exams.

It was disappointing since I had heard great things about this professor but after switching the class online, the exams changed. There's not a lot of workload in the class overall but he seems to be nitpicky on exam responses after going from multiple choices to free responses.

Lots of worksheets but based off of completion and answer keys posted after the due date. You make your own study guide by doing the worksheets. Overall great professor! Exams are not bad at all as long as you at least review worksheet material
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Lectures were interesting, but attendance isn't mandatory if you don't feel like going. The only thing is that example questions from class would show up on exams. Exams were very easy if you memorize all the wksts and he gives a generous curve along with extra credit for the class. He does give a lot of worksheets for homework, though.

Overall great teacher. Material is interesting and the worksheets are graded mainly on completion. He also cares a lot about students and encourages discussion. My one qualm is that the exams could have very specific questions based off lectures, so take very thorough notes and go to every lecture or else you won't do well on exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Amazing teacher!! For is class Child Development, There's a lot of online work you have to do, it's not hard just very time consuming. there are 4 exams in the semester plus the final. The tests are easy if you show up to class and take notes and if you study the worksheets from the videos. He also provides practice quizzes for the exams. No paper
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: His assignments are due at 8 pm like why. I hated this class it was so stressful.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. For a 200 level course it is extremely hard. He assigns multiple online worksheets (with 50 questions) worth only 1 point. He is not accessible outside of class or by email. He makes the TA do everything. You don't learn in class. You just watch pointless videos. You put in so much work and effort for nothing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The homework assignments ARE the exams. Studied for exams an hour or 2 before it the entire semester and am finishing with an A. Interesting class, but everything you learn is really from the homework reading and videos, not so much Professor Schultz. Many chances for easy extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is a pretty good professor and the class offers a lot of discussions. Gives study guides for exams and everything just needs to be memorized. Lots of worksheets needed to be done and sometimes can be time-consuming. Not a hard class but be sure to do the discussion board and you can get extra credit. Also a cute/goofy professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: The class is a hybrid course, so all of the work is done online. Coming to class ins't necessary. There is absolutely no way you can fail this class if you do the homework. The exam is literally questions pulled from the homework and video worksheets. He also gives us a study guide of EXACTLY what is going to be on the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Schultz is a great guy and a great professor. I had him for a winter course so there was a lot of required work that needed to be done in a short time frame, however, with some planning it was manageable. The tests are based on both the readings and what ever he focuses on in class will be what is emphasized on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Had him for winter class. But he was a good teacher but gave so much work that most of us couldnt even finish it. So much reading and bought a book and read three chapters in it. His test are based off readings and what he says in class so you have to attend. I wouldnt take him again honestly, but gave extra credit but it was only worth one point
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He comes off at times as frazzled. There are things on the test that were not in the million and ten worksheets. This class was all taught via the worksheets and very little was said in lecture. When reviewing after the test the entire class had to prove that we hadn't covered the material for him to consider making it extra credit. take @ own risk

Took this class over the summer. Worksheets are graded for completion and gives us the information through his lectures so don't miss class. He makes his lectures fun and loves what he teaches. Easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Schultz is very friendly. The exams are fair; you  basically make your own study guide by doing hw. Enjoyed the class
Very good professor and interesting topics. I loved this class. Getting A is not hard at all

Class was easy enough until you get to the tests. Tests are unbelievably picky. Many questions tested whether you could remember the smallest detail, for example the year of a court course. He is a nice enough professor but his tests are impossible.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Gives exact details about information found on tests.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This course was a hybrid so get ready to answer a bunch of question sheets that include thousands of questions about the chapter or videos. Going to class was basically pointless and you learn nothing new. Basically you learn all of the content online.

This class is all book work 48 -65 q's with videos. You can't do other class work bc of his class. Only takes questions of those students  that are right in front. He will circumvent a question or out right ignore it if he feels its not worth answering. Neither the prof. or the teachers aid Lisa will answer course content questions. DON'T TAKE!!!!

Get ready to read.  I have studied hard for his tests but you have to make sure you read everything in those chapters because some of the answers from the book are apparently wrong.  He can also be hard to understand at times and jumps from one subject to another. He is all over the place.  Not good at going over the questions in the worksheets.

Really great teacher. Had him for 200 and 342 and he was great with both. Very passionate about the classes and makes sure everyone understands everything. Tests are just what he says and he is very understanding. Worth taking his class!

I took this class over the summer, once a week for 6 weeks. It was fun, lecture can be kind of boring. Textbook was easy to read. Alt of videos to watch at home but the worksheets were easy. Tests were not to bad, but you still need to study for them. I would recommend the class

This section happened to be a hybrid course. It was great only meeting once a week and he makes it very clear what will be on the test and what will not. The lectures required to watch on your own can be somewhat lengthy though.
Easy A, make sure to go to class, and at least skim the readings.

Definitely a good speaker, very interested in class material. There are lots of extra credit opportunities, usually for participating in grad students' psych studies. Online quizzes for every two chapters, open book and you get to retake one exam at the end of the semester. Really generous in those aspects I think, great class!

Dr. Schultz is a good professor.  He expects you to read the book in great detail, no nook or cranny should be missed.  He is incredibly knowledgeable and you can tell his desire to see his students succeed is genuine. He doesn't hold your hand but gives plenty of extra credit chances. Read the book, go to class and study hard; that's how you pass.

He expects you to know what you are talking about in class. You do this by reading the book, taking notes from his lectures, and preparing well for quizzes. He cares, and will consistently ask you for feedback. If you don't do well in his class, it is because you didn't study.

This course was a bit challenging. The exams are hard but you can retake one at the end of the semester. The class was boring, I had a hard time staying awake. It is possible to pass this class, but you have to work for it. Not your typical easy course.

He may be a nice person, but that has nothing to do with class.  You really have to read everything and go to class.  You won't learn anything, except for details you will never need to know for later in life.  There is a GROUP PAPER, that counts for about 25% of your grade, and he picks your groups!  So be smart and take this class with Anderson.

Schultz is the man.  He always helps out his students and is an all around good dude.  I would recommend him to anyone.  Im a engineering major and I still enjoyed the class.  Just read the book and you will be fine.

Definitely one of my favorite professors!  He does his best to keep class interesting, and speaks from experience.  His quizzes check for whether you've read the book rather than testing subject material, but the exams are purely on what you need to know.  He's a totally relaxed guy and does his best to help you without making class stupidly easy.

Professor Schultz is a good professor with a very slight sense of humor.  His lectures are pretty boring at times but they are worth going to because some of the test questions come from them.  Read the book and take the easy points on the reading quizzes.

Dr. Schultz rocks! He's funny and keeps class interesting. Quizzes once a week on chapters but only on the superficial stuff, nothing that would be on the real test. Tests are multiple choice and he drops questions or makes the extra credit if they seem confusing. Take this class for gen. reqs, you wont regret it.
Funny. Very fair and will knock exam questions off as extra credit if they were confusing or if he didn't teach the material well enough.

Dr. Schultz is a pretty good teacher.He is definitly not the easiest, but his quizes are straight out of the book..it's amazing how easy his quizes are.i got a C on every exam because i slept or didn't go to class but read the book, the girl nxt to me got a c without reading the book but going to class. cool guy, played basketball with him too

Prof Schultz is a practicing clinician and his stories are based on his experience, so take him seriously. The class isnt made to be easy,you do have to study. Attend the lectures and keep up on the work and it will do you good in the long run if your a psych major.

Great professor. Very funny and interesting. As long as you go to class, read the chapters, and study you should get an A. Weekly quizzes based on textbook readings; very easy though. Exams not easy, not you will do okay as long as you study.

Somewhat helpful, however, if U R late to class for 10-15 mins on an exam day (and not your fault due to traffic), he will not let you take the test, unless you look dangerously enough so that he thinks u'll kick his ass right there and then. A bit annoying and HE WILL MAKE YOU READ THE ENTIRE BOOK! TRUST ME!  AVOID THIS GUY! Worst teacher I've had

He is a good professor, class is never really boring, he likes to tell jokes when hes waiting for the projector to warm up. He seems to be dedicated to his field. Quizes and exams are easy, and tons of extra credit!! he also, gives you a list of topics and sections in the book that will be covered in the exams. awesome!
watch out for this guy.. he'll make empty threats for no reason whatsoever.
Would reccommend him highly.

So easy to get an A in this class if you read and come to class ready to participate. Group paper that is annoying but oh well. Easy quizzes. Tells us exactly what will be on the exams. Have to read a lot though, but interesting stuff.

whoever said he is a horrible professor has not had dr. provine. schultz is the man! he gives tons of extra credit and is so easy to talk to. he'll keep you interested (usually) and occasionally make jokes or tell funny stories. he's awesome!

Definitely recommend Dr. Schultz. There are quizzes every Monday on the reading but they are easy and if you read it is impossible to fail. The exams are not bad, mostly from the book and a few things from class. One big group paper but if you have a decent group it's not hard. Changes what things are worth to help grades go up. Easy to talk to.

As a physics major taking 14 credits of difficult classes, this class was a great part of my week. Just by reading the chapters and listening in class you can easily get an A. Didn't have to study or take notes at all. Somehow, though, the class tended to average like 25% lower than I did on exams, which is strange.

Nice guy, blah professor. Quiz every Monday on the reading but not actually about Psychology. Exams cover actual knowledge but questions tend to be vague and unclear. They make you assume a lot but he wont explain futher if you ask him. Tends to go off of tangents and stories. Material comes from the text so attendance is pretty pointless.

I thought this calss was beyond easy.  The quizzes are a nothing, i got 100s on all of them and the tests are on a lot of material but they are usually 50 questions for four chapters so its never real in depth questions and he gives a review that tells you wether or not each section of the book will be on the test.  gives occassional in class E.C.

A nice guy, but a HORRIBLE professor. Quizzes are easy, tests not so much but still doable. Attendance is pointless because all the test material comes from the book. Many questions on irrelevant info. Does NOT like to help students. I decided against adding psych as a double major because of this man. Try to avoid.

I feel as though he's a good person but an OK teacher, DO NOT be fooled by the easiness of his quizzes- his tests are WAY harder!! Tells you exactly whats on each test but questions are obscure...I'm in his class now we have one test left and I can honestly say I've read all 15 chapters of the textbook... and his final will cover ALL 15 :(

i did well in all my classes except for this one. the quizes every monday were easy, but they weren't worth anything. the exams are 4 chapters for each and are EXTREMELY hard. the questions are tricky and unclear. the final is on 15 chapters! i approached him for help on my grade and he was no help.

Easy class. Just pay attention for the most part in lectures and read the book. He gives quizzes most Mondays to check if you read, which are easy, they refer to examples. And the tests aren't bad at all if you read the sections before.

HE GIVES OUT QUIZZES WHICH ARE WORTH 10% OF UR GRADE EVERY MONDAY WHICH ARE EASY.  HE GIVES OUT 4 EXAMS THAT ARE HARD AFTER EVERY 4 CHAPTERS YOU COVER.  HE IS NOT LEANENT FOR****!! AND DOES NOT WORK W/ STUDENTS.  NO, I DO NOT RECOMMEND HIM.-CHILD DEV. CLASS

This class is mindlessly easy. If you do badly on a test don't worry, he'll curve it. Unless you do really badly, then you didn't read or study. Just read the book for the quizzes (every Monday) and study the review pages online. I stayed for a full class maybe 7 times the whole semester, didn't listen at all, and got an A.
Great professor! Class is easy if you read the book and pay attention to his powerpoint slides. He's really nice and gives extra credit throughout the semester. I would take him again!
He is great! He makes the class get interactive, and grades fairly.

Was my easiest class this semester-easier than my pass/fail class.  All you have to do is go to class and read the book.  No extra studying required.  Dr. Schultz is really nice, but sometimes can be boring.

super cute and fun to listen to. really loves what hes teaching. quizes easy if you read tests easy if you read and go to class 50% of the time. most comes out of book probably only 5 questions from class. but he makes it a lot of fun!

A wonderful teacher. If you read the text and study for the exams a little bit (he gives you a handout of EVERY section in the textbook and whether or not it will be on the exam) you should do fine. He will discount exam questions if more than 50% of the class gets it wrong. He's fair and passionate about the subject.  Take his class!

I loved Dr. Schultz. The quizzes were definatley easy, if you read the book. The exams were easy, if you read the book and came to class. I just made notecards for everything and pulled at 98% on the final. He is super nice, recommend this guy!

Quizzes every week, read ALL of the text . Read 50% of it grade = 50% read 90% grade=90%. His class is really 2 classes. One is the Lecture where you can discuss the lecture, the other is the text book, which he WONT go over except as a quiz question.You will need to study both for the exams, IMO this should be a 5 credit course not 3, or fire him.
Don't expect an easy 'A'.  weekly quizzes are easy but exams are difficult.  He won't round your 89.9 to an A.  But he is a cutie in that akward professor way.
Really easy quizes, but EXTREMLY hard tests.  Dont take him unless you want to study for hours and be disappointed with your grades.

Probably the worst prof for this class. EVER.  I thought it would be really interesting, and somehow he found a way to make something cool - violence - into a boring developmental account.  He also expected you to know irrelevent details and percentages on exams.  Do NOT take this class unless you take it with Anderson.

He is really nice and he has a great attitude when teaching.  Yes his quizes are easy but, his tests are hard. He does curve the tests a little because of questions know one got right. He really tests a lot on the material in the book. So the class requires a lot of reading.

Very friendly, but his final was absolutely impossible. He expected you to know exact details of certain things, that were not easily recalled. Study hard and do the reading...you'll be fine. If you're not a psych major, don't take him. I was really interested in the class before, and it wasn't anything like I expected.
I thought he was very fair. Weekly quizzes were extremely easy. If you keep up with the readings, go to class, and do the study guide, it should be an A, atleast a B.

Ok, you guys are all wrong.  Schultz is not easy and does not curve, I was very excited about taking his class and I am doing poorly even though I spend hours studying and reading! Questions are obscure. . .be careful when taking Schultz
Easy, just read, he tells you what sections to study for the exams
Not an easy class..if you get a 89.99 you get a B...This guy doesn curve at all and questions are sometimes obscure...Take someone else if you dont want your feelings hurt at the end of the semester.

BEST psych teacher ever!! he is the nicest and teaches very easily.  really easy to understand what he's saying and answers everyone's Q clearly.  weekly easy easy quizzes on chapter readings and 4 exams + final which are pretty easy too.  he lets u know exactly what to study.  TAKE HIS CLASS!
very cool guy. he's helpful and makes the class interesting but its not an easy A. be prepared to read and study but its enjoyable
Dr. Schultz is definitely the coolest prof I've had so far! He hands out what you need to study and he is always using himself as an example. He is the best psych professor ever!!

whoever put that Dr. S is hard must have never attended class or read anything at all. I did the minimum amount of reading and managed A's and B's on all of the tests- If you go to class and just do some reading youll be fine- an awesome guy!

This person who said that this course is hard is wrong... I have a high A with not too much effort. Dr. Schultz curves all tests A LOT just read what he tells you to read.. Dr. Schultz is AWESOME and very nice and helpful.. Plus he's really hot!! Take it!

He's a new teacher,so he might have been easier last sem, this sem hes not. He is a very nice teacher, but hes very hard. Be prepared to study and read ALOT,because his exam questions are not always easy to read, but only some Q's gets dropped.NOT EASY A!
He may be new to UMBC but he's an excellent professor.  Very nice and helpful.  Just wish he taught more classes so I could have him again.
he's such a great teacher (aka Dr. Smily)- take his class, its fun, interesting, and he's willing to help anyone about anything- he makes ME want to be a professor!
yo she taxes points for the smallest things.
holy she is so boring in her lectures. Then shes a really tough grader on essays, she doesnt even say what u did wrong.

If you ever encounter situations or difficulties just reach out! Dr. Dunn-Gallier is super understanding if you explain your situation, and is willing to accommodate if needed. She reached out to me regarding my disability accommodations early on in the semester so she could better understand and accommodate my needs, not just what was on paper.

I don't know why she has low ratings; this class is such an easy A. She is a great professor, communicates well, and is very understanding. You just have to attend class and do the assignments, you don't even really need to read the entire textbook. Lock in guys!!

She's a good professor! Her lectures can be a bit boring sometimes, and some of her lecture points are personalized as we watched a Destiny Child's music video and a scene from Wicked, I know for some it might not be enjoyable in their interests (for me it was great!). She has strict deadlines, homework each week, three papers, and a final project
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Do not take her unless you wanna be failed over the wrong citation format 😒
She'll fail you for the littlest mistake in your essay

DO NOT TAKE!!!
She's a tough grader she WILL fail your paper if you miss one of the littlest requirements (like the formatting even if you did everything else right), she takes her job way too seriously.

Overall, Dr. Dunn-Gallier is a really great professor. However, her strict deadlines, and weekly assignments serve little motivation to actually do work in the class. There are weekly group work assignments assigned in class that take about 20 minutes to complete, but a lot of the time we would have five or ten minutes as lecture ran over.
Such a nice professor! I loved this class, she is super understanding about missing class if you have a valid excuse.

If you're a senior STEM major like I am, don't take this class. Mandatory attendance and lots of busy work. This class is clearly for freshmen. Her lectures are also very boring, and chalked lack of participation up to “you guys must be stressed with the current political climate”, instead of recognizing none of us want to watch Wicked in class.

The assignment load is very manageable and she is very understanding if you give her a heads up. Class is reading heavy and its hard to follow along without reading before hand. She puts you into groups that don't change the whole semester. Final project was easy and open ended.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class was a great take and she's really awesome to talk to. Theres a decent amount of reading and you will be put in a group. The final was really open ended and the assignments could be pretty flexible. High recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Idk why she is rated poorly, this class is a easy A. Async assignments every week and 3 papers/1 final project (no late assignments). She is also so interesting to talk to! go to her office hours. Downside is that lectures are kinda boring/mandatory but is just an hour ONCE a week so it isn't that bad. Overall easy A take her!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class would be sm better if the attendance wasn't mandatory and you didn't have to come in and waste your life away during an unnecessarily long lecture about perhaps the most boring subjects imaginable, while she slips in her own political agenda throughout. Other then that, easy A class. If you dont mind sitting in some lectures, take it!

She knows her stuff and is kind one-on-one. However, I didn't like her class for a few reasons. She assigned groups for us to sit + complete assignments with, which seemed silly b/c it was a large lecture hall. Her lectures were boring. Also, she accepts no late work. This can hurt you later on, especially b/c papers are a large part of the grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Dunn-Gallier is a fantastic teacher. She is well read and knows her stuff. She is engaging and knows how to give lectures without them feeling boring. She uses a flipped classroom model, so be sure to do your reading before class. She is a stickler about no late work though, so make sure you do all your assignments on time.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's nice and friendly, but the teaching style can be a bit hands-off. Evident when her class, her exam averages were around 85%+, no one knew what they were doing when she would quiz them. She likes being a teacher. If you care, you will get something out of the course.

Good prof. Very supportive of my struggles outside of school. Prof is very funny and made class fun. However, exam 2 and final exam were kind of difficult and I did poorly on both of them which dropped my grade down to a C.

Professor Davenport is knowledgeable and fair, and offers extra credit throughout the semester. Understands that we may have other tougher classes to worry about, she keeps class simple, interesting, and engaging. I got a C due to personal circumstances, but she is a great professor and the class is not difficult.

Definitely one of the best professors I have very taken. Accounting can be a difficult subject, but she gives an easy understanding to each chapter's content. Read and do the homework before class and compare your answers to hers and ask questions about any differences.

There is little that I need to say that hasn't already been said about professor Davenport; she has undoubtedly earned her 5.0 rating. Her classes are very hands on, and she is very clear on which topics she expects you to understand and which she doesn't. Her class made this econ major very interested in further pursuit of accounting.

Professor Davenport was one of the best teachers I've ever had at my time at UMBC. She is very understand and you can tell she's very passionate about her class and she loves her job. The workload is not difficult at all and there are no exams. GREAT TEACHER AND GREAT CLASS! YOU WONT REGRET TAKING THIS CLASS!

Davenport is a great accounting professor! If you have any questions, she answers them well! Homeworks are due every class but are easy, and for the projects, they are super easy if you ask her any questions! NO EXAMS! Easy A and you learn a lot; she tells funny stories that help you remember concepts!

Go to class. Take some notes. Do the pretty easy HW she assigns. No tests, just 3-4 projects. Projects are excel based and allow beginners in excel to gain necessary skills and those who are proficient to breeze through parts. If you are doing the Accounting Certificate, make sure to take Davenport whenever you have the chance.
I just want to protect this prof from any other hardships in this world. Don't hurt her but just attend classes well. Don't skip them and study hard with her. She will make you succeed.
Extremely chill teacher, and not only that but she is pretty funny too. I took her for FINC150 one of the objectively easier courses, just do the classwork and you'll be okay.
BEST PROFESSOR. She made Econ easier for me to understand and her tips and tricks are so helpful in accounting Econ !

Mrs. Davenport humor adds a lot to the class. She puts a lot of effort into teaching, and she's clearly very knowledgeable about accounting. The class is easy, and straightforward. Don't take this class if you don't have enough time to put in some effort.

OUTSTANDING PROFESSOR, BY FAR MY FAVORITE! take her! she is caring, will make sure you have a good understanding of the material, extremely helpful, and very funny! i would be having a bad day and she would make my day better. easy A , just ask questions in class, less work to do outside of class.  made accounting very easy to understand.

Davenport's lectures were super clear and made learning accounting more manageable. Lectures consist of practice problems on excel, and exams are online which are a plus. She encourages questions and participation. SI pass was also super helpful for this class, shoutout to Shriya!

This class was amazing. I learned a lot by paying attention to the lecture so I didn't need to study much outside of class or take excessive amounts of notes. She breaks down concepts and is more than willing to answer any questions. The class consists of easy solo projects, HW and exams. Attend class and do the assignments you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Very kind, good at presentation and answering questions. Superb professor overall. That said, I wish there was slightly more HW to make me learn material better

Hands down, amazing professor. I actually had her for financial literacy, and she was amazing. So nice and will explain anything. Lectures are funny and engaging, and she knows what shes talking about. You will love her.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: An effective professor that is very nice, some people will say she is strict but you have to be a pretty lousy student to get that treatment. Attendance was mandatory so my participation grade was pretty bad but shes very understanding if you cannot come in. Her hw is based around teaching you instead of testing you which I appreciate a lot.

I literally love her. That's really all that needs to be said, but if you want something more in depth, her teaching was very helpful and she's really nice. She has office hours that are very helpful. I came out of Accounting I very confused, but she was able to catch me up within a couple of days, making Accounting II a breeze.

Absolute legend. She was efficient in teaching everything you need to know. Even though we were online, she clearly was invested in each individual student. Class was engaging, homework and tests were straightforward.

She was an amazing professor, did her best to help us understand each concept and made the class super interactive. Tests were kind of difficult and this class requires a lot of practice and reading the textbook along with participating in class.

Even online she did her best to make each class interesting and help us learn as much as possible. Can honestly say this is one of the more enjoyable classes I've taken just because of her enthusiasm about accounting

Really nice and caring professor. Always willing to help and explains everything in a very clear way. She is a really effective teacher and is really informative. I learned a lot from the class. Would definitely recommend taking her for accounting courses.
Super easy class, teaches the material well and wants all her students to succeed. Best prof Ive had in a long time.
She is very nice and care about her students. She always tries to make accounting interesting. She reviews and gives study guides before exams which is very helpful.

Professor Davenport genuinely wants to connect with students and makes the course enjoyable. She is more than willing to help students get to where they want to be. Everything she teaches is straight forward and her exams are very fair. Overall an amazing professor!
Attend lectures , do homework and you will receive an A. exams are not hard.

She has an amazing attitude, she will work with you to make sure you understand the material. if you need help just ask her she is more then willing to help, she came very close to making me switch my major. she explain everything and uses examples, she shows you where the Debits and Credits go.. she is AMAZING!

AI generated assignments, they made no sense and emailing her did not help. non-stop QR codes and google forms. Class time added NOTHING to the course. Easy class but painful and redundant assignments. only had 15 mins to do group work
Dr. Alonso is not just a top quality professor; she is gentle, kind , and very beautiful indeed! Almost impossible not to like her and her class.
No Comments

I love her. She is a little disorganized but does everything in her. power to explain the material. The tests are not too difficult, and she gives a lot of extra credit and simple assignments to boost grades.

Her PPTs are sufficient for exams. Attendance is important because she teaches Excel skills in class that are not covered elsewhere. Group HW is a significant part of the course, though grading criteria can sometimes be unclear so pay attention closely.

She's alright and I see the potential of it being a great class but she does not do a good job promoting discussion in a dicussion-based class. The room often goes silent, waiting for somebody to say something, where most of the time I had to speak up just so we weren't sitting there all day. I quite liked her; she's all-around tough but fair.

Lectures are kind of disengaging as she just writes on a whiteboard. She gives a test bank with exact questions from the exam so study this well and you will pass. She also gives extra credit from in class participation so try and answer every question in class. It's not hard to pass this class, but as a professor she isn't the best.

The material itself isn't difficult, but she makes it seem harder than it is. Bad lectures that are convoluted and boring. Refuses to provide any practice problems or study guides for exams. Does not tell us what will be on exams and will include things outside the chapters she said we were testing on. Take this class with someone else if you can.

Took Professor Dasgupta for Econ 320 and Stat 351. She is very intelligent and has a deep understanding of the material. She provides Power-point slides that are very helpful when studying for exams. Exams make up most of the grades but she provides extra credit just for participation in class. Lectures are very informative as well. Great Professor
