reviews.comment: Oh my lord, I was literally paying tuition for a standup comedy 3x a week for a semester. This class was the greatest class i ever took, it was so funny and easy. No homework, quizzes were redo-able extremely easy (like meme answers) exams could be answered straight from the lecture, notes needed. A lot of points are him asking for your opinion.

Anyone who's taken his class before knows, that he is both funny and insightful. I took his class for PHIL100 and guess what? I came back for more. Just because. Easily one of the best profs at the school. 10/10 Would take again, so I did

honestly, he is ok. i would not say he's the best prof i had so far. He kind of grades the exam harshly. I really hope to get an A at the end. I did not really like this class maybe it was the subject i hated idk. online class was fine since it was not met at a time, but lectures would sometimes get too long
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Fantastic professor! Explains things in a very funny manner and is such a great guy to hear talk. Despite the classes being online, Professor Thomas handled it like a champ and made even online classes just a pleasure to participate in! I'm taking him again for Phil 152 this winter.
The best professor I ever had at UMBC. There's a reason he has so many good reviews. You MUST take PHIL100 if you get the chance! Hilarious, caring, engaging... the list goes on and on.

He spends a lot of the class telling jokes, and it is sometimes hard to wake up early just to hear him ramble on about random things. It feels like his classes are about 25% philosophy content and 75% jokes about random things. He isn't hard, but he expects you to be able to explain yourself very well. Your whole grade is based off a few papers
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: As long as you go to UMBC, you absolutely need to take at least Phil100 with Jim because it will be the best course you ever take. He puts up notes on the board, which will be on the exam but he also gives a review sheet before which is exactly the same as the exam. HIS STORIES are SO FUNNY and you will literally want to go to class just to laugh.

Jim is the most amazing professor I've ever taken at UMBC, he is so funny and his lecture are so interesting. I never minded waking up at 8 am just to attend his lecture because I just sit there and listen and it is like attending a stand-up while also learning tons. You never have to read anything just show up take notes it and you will get an A!

One of the best professors I've had at UMBC! Knew nothing about philosophy before this class & now I feel like I've learned so much. Loved coming to class not only because his lectures are great and funny, but because it makes studying for the exams much easier. Come to class and take good notes, and you'll never have to read the texts he provides.

Try to take atleast one class with him. His teaching is unique and funny. Even as a person, he's a little odd but he's one of the best profs I had. Tests are based on the things he talks about so write that down. He's an easy grader, if you can prove you know what you're talking about and why. Easy A class with a great experience!

Jim is an absolute gem and one of the most down to earth professors you will ever meet. The discussions he has in lecture pretty much give you everything you need to know for the exams, plus they are very entertaining. I plan to take him again in the future for my Upper-Level Elective requirement!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The best professor at UMBC w/o a doubt. Loved coming to class just for his lectures.

Not only was Jim Thomas engaging and hysterical, quirky and in-touch, he also taught me things in such a relatable way, that I've managed to retain and apply his lessons 10 years later. As a Biochemistry major, I was interested in philosophy but didn't need it, but it quickly became my favorite class and I wish I had taken more classes with him.
He is an absolutely amazing teacher and his lectures always made my day since they were so good! 10/10 would recommend again!
Jim Thomas is a energetic and very fun teacher.  His lectures really improved my mornings and i strongly suggest this professor.
10/10 would hear his rants again, only class I would wake up at 8:00 to take

Took PHIL399 - Philosophy of Humor. Do anything you can to take this class, it was by far the most enjoyable class I've ever taken. Thomas is literally hilarious (he could easily do stand up) so you'll actually WANT to go to class. The exams and papers are easy if you have well-informed opinions on things. He also seems to care about students.
Professor Thomas is fantastic. If you show up to class he is both funny and gives you all the information you need to do well on your exam.
easily the best prof i've ever had. took a pretty boring subject and made it amazing! i would take any class if he was teaching it

First class with him today. Non-stop jokes, had the whole class LAUGHING hard. Too early to discuss the course, but according to friends that had him, great discussions and lectures. If you follow the material and come to class (optional), you will do fine.

Here's a great professor. His lectures really make you want to engage in his class. He gives study guides which are basically his exams(essay format). There's a final paper and he gives time and feedback. Easy A if you enjoy the subject.

He's a really great guy and a great teacher. Sometimes he can get a little too silly and derpy and takes a few minutes to get back on topic, but he's really very good at what he does and you can tell.
Professor Thomas is so funny and entertaining. His lectures were never boring and he always had a story to tell. Additionally, he does a great job of explaining the subject of Philosophy.

He is my favorite professor by far! Definitely take this class with him! The lectures are entertaining and he explains everything in detail and very clear! By far one of my favorite classes! He gives wonderful feedback on exams and the one essay at the end of the semester! He is very willing to help his students and answer any questions.

HE IS THE BEST PROFESSOR EVER. PLEASE TAKE HIM. WOULD RECOMMEND. He explains everything in a way where you don't think you're learning and every piece of information sticks with you. He makes you laugh and keeps you awake. Attendance is not mandatory, but he makes you want to come to class.

I love this professor! Going to class is like going to a comedy show, absolutely brightens your day. You will actually learn the material through his lectures, he has endless examples to really make you think about philosophy. Go to class and take notes and you will get at least a B. AWESOME PROFESSOR!

Best professor at UMBC. His lectures are basically stand up comedy, and his philosophy of humor class is hilarious. Have taken two classes with him and taking a third before I graduate because he is great.
He is hilarious while still being extremely informative. He knows his stuff and really makes you think about the big philosophical questions.

Absolutely my favorite professor at UMBC. You will have a hard time controlling your laughter some days, his stories are insanely funny. There's 3 exams and a paper. If you show up and actively listen (which isn't hard) you should get at least a B. Take a class with him even if you don't need to because it just brightens your day. Dude is the best.

His hilariousness is only matched by his respect for dedicated students. Beyond his exceptional ability to teach, he really cares for students who love the course material and strive to learn more. Show up to class and participate, and you won't even care about the grade. His presence truly is a present to us all!

Jim Thomas is the best professor that UMBC has. He easily takes dense material like Epistemological theories and breaks it down to where the entire class understands it. I am purposely taking a class of his every semester so I can have at least one class that brings me joy. More professors need to be like him.

Taking PHIl100 with Jim was the best decision I made at UMBC. He makes gloomy days turn into brighter days with his lectures. I did not read any of the outside material however I attended every class. If you show up to class and participate I don't see why you couldn't get an A or a B.

If you go to UMBC, you have to take a class with Jim Thomas. I only took this class as an AH credit, I had no interest in Philosophy, but he really made the topic fun and interesting. The material isn't boring or dry at all and he tells many stories to go along with it. Exams are written so you have to study. But not hard. DEFINITELY TAKE!
Amazing professor. He is hilarious and will make you look forward to going to class. Must take before you graduate.
one of the best I have so far.  Easy class with lone final essay.

The lectures are hilarious if you have any sort of humour. There is no textbooks or books required to read, although if you want to understand what is on the in class papers (the only thing graded in the class) you have to show up.

Probably the best teacher I've ever had. He's funny, interesting, thought provoking, and an absolute genius. If I could have him teach all my classes i would. Absolutely take him if you can even if you don't have to.

No one should graduate UMBC without taking at least one course from Jim. Every single comment here is true: he's smart, helpful, and most of all funny, with a self-deprecating sense of humor. His stories and tangents are hilarious, but somehow end up being related to the material. Best professor I've ever had. You WILL look forward to his class!

This is my favorite class. I loved each and every moment in this class! He is so funny, kind, and thought-provoking. To simply put it: the best three hours of my week! I have never laughed and learned so much at the same time. I am so glad I had the opportunity to be in this class! I hope that everyone at UMBC gets a chance to take this class.
The class is always worth waking up for, even when I only get a few hours of sleep.

Everything everyone says about Jim Thomas is true.  Not only is it impossible to dislike this man, but the way he teaches provokes a lot of thought whether or not you are interested in the material. I learned way more than I expected to.  This class is worth taking even if you don't need it.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER! He somehow gets everyone to learn the material while incorporating stories that really don't have anything to do with the class but are highly entertaining.  He is hilarious and is very smart.  He remembers all of the material he wants to teach and does not need a book at hand. It is really spectacular.

JIM THOMAS=AMAZING. He is super funny and you will enjoy every moment of his class. We have random students show up to his lectures because he is such a great professor. I have no idea why he isn't top rated overall on this website! Take his class!

Seriously the best and funniest teacher out there. No lie. I took PHIL 100 during the Winter session. The way he teaches by  making use of a lot of humor but you still understand everything. He seriously made it fun to learn. I guarantee that if you talk his class you will never stop laughing and you will leave with a wealth of knowledge

One of the best professor at UMBC, got me interested in the subject that i absolutely hated. He has an amazing sense of humor and keeps his lectures extraordinarily interesting. All you have to do to be successful is to show up in class, pay attention, participate, take notes, and study the notes for exams, and work on a project which was easy.

Best professor, no contest. Took his 100 level class and loved it so much i decided to take 373. The material is more serious and pretty confusing. He is still funny as hell but certain days will be more dry simply because the material requires it. Phil 100 was straight forward and easy. This will require a little more work, though it is worth it.
Amazing.

Thomas rules. I'm currently taking his Philosophy of Law class and it is the highlight of my school week. He does not require attendance but I go to class anyway, despite his being my last class of the day! Highly highly recommended!
Hilarious...Simply the best part of my classes all week. I plan to do a minor in philosophy (after having his class) and take as many class as possible with him.
BEST PROFESSOR EASY MUST TAKE BEFORE YOU GRADUATE

Has to be the best professor I have ever had. He makes every class worth your time and makes it enjoyable. If he taught all my classes, college would be so much more enjoyable. He has been the only teacher who makes me want to come to class. He makes the material relatable to anyone and anything. Take any of his classes if you can.
GREATEST PROFESSOR EVER!
JUST TAKE THIS CLASS.YOU WILL NOT REGRET IT BEST PROFESSOR I HAVE EVER HAD.
Best professor at UMBC. You are not a true UMBC student until you have taken one of  his classes.

This is the BEST Professor I have EVER taken. If you do not find is class interesting, I will personally give you your money back. The material is pretty straight forward. The exams make you think: not difficult, but not something you should take lightly. (I took the first exam lightly and ended up with a B in the class because of it.) TAKE IT!

Amazing teacher, hilarious in class. Will keep you interested in the material, and it will be your favorite class of all time. You will want to go to every lecture and actually look forward to taking the tests and writing the paper. His skills are crazy.

people! jim is a beast! mellow accent + hilarious stories that relate to what we're learning = best professor ever! but beware, he's not as easy as people say! i got a B- on my first exam (short answer/essay format) when i expected an A... actually pay attention in class! you might as well anyway: every class is like watching a comedian teach us :D
Professor Thomas has been by far my favorite teacher this semester. Great guy. He doesn't allow laptops in class, but with the way he does the job, you REALLY wanna pay attention.

WOW! Professor Thomas is a great Professor! He keeps the class entertained through his humorous nature and is VERY knowledgeable. I spoke to him after class numerous times and it were as if I was talking to my best friend. Relates to real-life examples and his readings that he assigns are actually genuinely interesting! TAKE HIS EVERY CLASS!
Great Professor! Others should take notes. Awesome class discussions.

You have to take this class before you graduate!  He is the best professor at UMBC! He portrays the philosophy topics in a way that students can relate and understand. I never missed a class. Each lecture was pretty much a stand up comedy performance!  Exams are in essay form, and there is one 3-5 paper. Easy A.

Best prof i have ever had. i took this class over 4 years ago and i still remember his name. he is seriously an amazing professor and you havent experienced the best UMBC has to offer until you take his class!

The first impression I had was Jim Thomas looks very unusual, but through out the semester he proves to be entertaining and humorous, both qualities which made the class not only interesting but made the material comprehensible to many students including myself. I strongly recommend students to take his class before they take any other.
Best class i ever took. Most fun i ever had getting up so early! I am so glad im not the only one that thinks hes good lookin idk what it is but theres something about him!

Jim is a fabulous Professor!   Don't leave UMBC until you've taken his class.  Hands down, best professor.   UMBC should hire him to teach some of the not so good Professors.   They could learn a lot from his style/methods.   Must take any of his classes!

The most interesting and entertaining class i have ever take. I attend a different school now but i will always remember what a great experience i had in jims' class. He made the material so understandable and interesting and i have never found anything to compete. The best professor i have ever had

Jim Thomas is the best professor ive ever had hands down. He makes class very entertaining and you would not think he would be a college professor. He is HILARIOUS and teaches very well while making you so interested in the topic. Exams are very easy, and class is very easy. You won't even want to skip his class, it is too fun!
GREATEST Professor I've ever had in my life. No joke. This guy is hilarious and makes everything fun and interesting. Take him before you graduate!

Jim is hilarious and easiest class I've ever taken. His exams are extremely easy as long as you look over the study guide he pass out. Exam reflects 99.9% of what the study guide shows. Just listen in class & get notes and you can get solid A without any issue. Not much effort necessary for this class and MUST take class before graduating from UMBC

Thomas is HILARIOUS. Every class is like a stand up comedy routine, the professor is very approachable, and the assignments given are relatively easy. A little too easy, and therein lies my only complaint. Thomas is an amazing teacher, but he doesn't goes as in depth into the material as I would have liked, nor is there much class discussion.

He's an amazing teacher. Not only is he hilarious, but you'll actually WANT to learn from Jim. He doesn't care if you come to class, but every seat is usually filled because it's an entertaining, thought-provoking class. I'm a biology major, but this class is by far the best class ever. Definitely recommend it!

He's ridiculously funny, but he panders to the lowest common denominator.  He knows this, but does not seem to care.  Take him if you want easy credits, but do not expect to learn much if you're serious about philosophy.  I took a 300-level class with him and didn't learn anything that wouldn't be covered in a decent intro class.

Phenomenal instructor, best in the philosophy department. Hands down. Every day is a standup comedy routine. This is the third class I've taken with him and a fourth one is coming up in the spring. He cuts down on the dry material and presents it in a fun and memorable way. He cares about his students success. It's a shame that he isn't tenured.

Professor Thomas is one of the best teachers I've ever had.  Thank god I took his class in my senior year as I would have probably changed my major to Philosophy had I taken his class early on.  Every class is like a stand-up comedy routine.  He keeps the entire class engaged while at the same time posing interesting questions. Thanks Jim.
very good teacher

Jim redefines what it means to be a "teacher" at a "university." An outsider might see him as lazy. In reality, he's nonchalant but über caring about his student's success and, more importantly, understanding of the material. He cuts through a lot of BS and presents material in a funny, highly-memorable way. (Note: I also took his 100 level class)

Prof Thomas is the BEST!  Seriously, before graduating, you MUST take his class!   UMBC should ask him to do a Teaching 101 for all Professors on campus to incorporate some of his style in their teaching.   I looked forward to this class, each & every time!   So fun & you learn a lot!  Enroll in it!

really phenomenal professor. I can hardly believe the amount that I learned without even intending to. Redefines teacher. Honestly, I didn't even take the class for credit, just for a break from my other courses
Best class ever. I actually felt like I was missing out not going to class. You'll learn a lot. Go to class, and you'll get an A. This is one class you won't mind going to.

When I read the reviews I had to see for myself if this teacher was as good as everyone said. He was! He can engage his students for the entire class. The class seems like it is 15 minutes instead of 75. Jim Thomas is one of the best teachers I have ever had.
Best professor ever. No matter how bad is the day he lightens up the day with all the real funny jokes which are related to the subject. Highly recommended:)
One of the best professors at UMBC. His style of teaching is utterly honest and humorous. He is one of the few professors that actually makes you THINK. Take this course.

Best and most hilarious professor I've ever had. Has a very natural humor and wit and even though most of the class is spent joking around, he manages to tie all of it back to the subject, which makes the material that much more interesting and easy to understand.
This guy is awesome, you have to take at least one class with him at UMBC. Easy on the eyes too :)

Amazing teacher. Every class was like going to a stand-up comedy show. Laughed so hard it hurt. Tests are easy if you come to class. Makes phil easy to understand, and everything is memorable. Don't buy textbook, everything you need to know is stated in class.

Best professor I've ever had, hilarious and will remember you forever. Don't buy the textbook--not worth it. He's just amazing. If he taught all my classes, college would be a breeze and I'd be set for life. We need more professors like Jim here.

hands down, greatest teacher/prof...
sweet

MUST HAVE TEACHER!!!! You should totally take this class before you graduate!!!!

He is one of the best professors I've e ever had.  Going to his class is like going to a comedy show, he get's the material across in a funny way, and in way that will not put you to sleep.  He is very helpful and understanding.
BEST TEACHER I HAVE EVER HAD! Hands down. Going to class is a pleasure; you learn a lot and have fun the whole time.

Number one teacher. He should be teaching other Professor how to teach. I think nobody should leave UMBC without taking at least one class with him. His appearance on the first page of ratemyprofessor.com as the top ten professor should tell you guys that this guy got something.  AWESOME***
Great professor. Explains everything that needs to be on the exam. Hilarious! Attendance wasn't mandatory but I never missed a class!
a brilliant man and a sensible professor. very understanding and comprehensive. extremely lucid and thoughtful.
The coolest guy ever. Jim is not only a great teacher, but truly an estimable role model.

Had him for Philosophy of Humor, Moral Theory, and Intro to Philosophy. Jim is a fantastic teacher whose hilarious stories will make you want to come to class. Lectures are well-prepared. Easy grader; helpful if you need it. You MUST take at least one class with Jim in your lifetime! It will be a joy. One of my favorite teachers of all time.

WOW! Best class I've taken since I started at UMBC!!! (I'm a junior) Love going to class. From the moment he walks in on the first day, he's got the class laughing. There was a point during the semester where I was having a really bad time and all I wanted to do was just go to his class.  I'm not kidding you, he's that funny and awesome.  I really learned a lot.  You can tell he really does take the material seriously and is passionate about it.  Don't bother getting the book, just go to class :-)
He is the greatest philosophy teacher I have had.

Wow, I signed up on here just tell you people to take Jim's class. He is the coolest, nicest dude ever. You can be yourself in class, pop a joke, call him out on BS(he wants you to). Best learning experience at UMBC. I would have loved college if more professors were like him. Most are dull and elites. He rules.
You are not paying for a class...You are going to a stand up comedy show. Dude is hilarious. If you get less than a B, drop out.

this man is amazing. take this class. seriously.

folks i f u ever think to take a philosophy class in umbc. do not miss jim thomas.. he rocks..ver approachable and funny..just listen to what he says n read his notes u will get definite "A". trust me

the best prof in school ever. he's little crazy but he's cool.

Haha, great professor. He's really funny and a good teacher as well; you'll get plenty of good discussion in his class as well as relevant material. However, if you're truly interested in philosophy, you'll have to read the book without anyone telling you to, because he doesn't pressure at all.

Hands down, Jim is one of the best professors I've ever had!!! He makes his class so much fun to go to. I don't think I ever left his class without laughing so much until my stomach hurt. DO try to take a class with him. Your UMBC experience is not complete until you take a Jim Thomas class!
The best teacher i've had at my six years at UMBC

Jim (dont call him Dr. or Mr. Thomas) was a very good teacher. You get study sheets right before the exam that contain everything thats gonna be on the exam. Very confrontable and a very nice guy. Only one paper, which is very easy as well. Go to class and you wont even have to read the book.
Jim is a southern hick as he calls himself, that makes him cool.  Take the class and enjoy!
Best teacher I have ever had at UMBC. Hillarious but brilliant! the material is interesting and the way he presents it makes it even better...def take this class!

Great teacher. Makes class interesting but is still able to teach you. Found myself getting pissed when missing his class. Very funny and approachable. Tests and paper are laughable. Take any class you can with him. If he only taught bio courses.
Best teacher I've ever had. Im thinking about changing my major because of him. He was funny and interesting, I never wanted to miss a class.

so funny!  Had so much fun in the class, but learned a lot.  would love to take another class with him.  He made the topics interesting with his crazy stories and you didn't really have to spend much time studying for his exams if you went to class.
Great teacher and HILLARIOUS.  Probably, missed his true calling as a stand-up comic, but that works out for us.  Tests can be a little difficult b/c you have to think, which I hate doing.
Great teacher. Crazy as a loon (but it is a good thing).  Funny.  Helpful.  If you can get into one of his classes, take it.
Jim is totally awesome... If you're looking for an AH GFR to take, this is it... Really easy, but I still loved going to class every day. I definitely did learn, but had fun doing it. He's great.
Fantastically funny
I found out why I was lucky to get into his class.  He makes a boring class very interesting.  Although he's a little abstract he might be the funniest guy I've ever met.
Jim is like Chris Rock, VERY FUNNY AND INTERESTING. This class offered me a lot of things to understand in ETHICAL PERSPECTIVE OF philsophy
Very entertaining:)A class i didnt mind going to.
Fun and easygoing teacher. You will laugh so hard that your sides will hurt. PLUS, the humor is unlike anything you have ever heard before!
Jim kicks ass.  He's a great professor: whether you want a class to goof off in or whether you're looking to really learn some philosophy.  He knows his stuff and is funny as hell.
Best prof on campus!  Talks about eating peeps and sleeping with an X-men comforter all class...
If every teacher was like Jim, we'd all be playin GTA3 & drink'n Guiness, Go Jim
No Comments
Jim is the man.  The class you don't mind going to sick.  It changed my life.
JUST PLAIN AWESOME!!!
he's very funny. if you go to class you don't have to read the text at all.
Very funny!
funny, don't buy the book, he'll go over everything
He's great. He's funny, and makes it easy to understand. You'll like him
tells jokes, class is fun, offbeat examples
You will love this class, no final and only 3 tests with an easy paper.

Joeg can teach! Doesn't just read the slides but works out example problems on the board, and will answer all your questions. ATTEND CLASS, start the weekly hw early, test prep with the slides. I found the textbook necessary for figuring out the tougher hw problems. Dropped lowest-scored question on tests, dropped lowest-scored quiz, test, and hw.
Kind professor who cares about his students. Knows his stuff and exams were fairly straightforwards. Lectures are boring.

Attendance mandatory. Prof. Joeg knows the content by heart. passionate about his work and will ans. each Ques. if asked. Course itself is extremely hard but he makes sure he responds back and help in any way possible. Writes on board using a chalk and shows ex. to problems. Has a discord channel which is helpful. 

Quiz grades are lower in class

Lectures are tough to absorb. His live coding in class is pre-written, so you can hardly call it live; other profs do it from scratch. When I'd ask questions about CS (ex. about stack/heap) somewhat outside of class' scope, he'd say "you'll learn about that in 3XX/4XX." vs entertain the question. He types slow. Not for the lecture-oriented learner.

Fantastic professor. His lectures can be a bit dry, but very informative. You can tell he cares for his students and wants them to succeed. Very responsive out of class and on discord, he also drops the lowest question from the 4 question quizzes. I'd highly recommend him for 441, know the material and it's an easy A.

This class has tough material but Prof Joeg makes it easy to understand. The last few weeks of content were more difficult than the rest (Turing Machines and onward). He is very lenient on quiz/exam grading and wants students to focus on learning rather than grades. Just show up to class and do (and understand) the homework and you'll do well.

Be prepared for his thick accent and a few boring lectures, but Prof. Joeg is a great instructor who gives clear expectations on projects, is always around to answer questions, and uses curves to help through such a draining class. My low grade was from struggling with the course material itself and not from Joeg, so I HIGHLY recommend him for 441.

Nothing comes off as a surprise in this class. The quizzes and exams are very straightforward. He usually gives students the topics the quiz covers a week in advance. Papers (projects) are straightforward as well. But more importantly, He's always there to explain concepts thoroughly and cares for students.

I skipped 201 with a test credit so I was worried I would be behind in this class, but Joeg explained topics straightforward and the live coding activities were helpful. The projects aren't too difficult because the rubric shows you exactly how they will be graded and you have plenty of time. Easy A if you don't slack off and do the extra credit!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This isn't an easy class and there were times where I understood absolutely nothing from his lectures, however he is very accessible outside of class. I personally don't think I would've gotten an A in his class had I not been going to his office hours weekly so make good use of that!

Professor Joeg is a qualified teacher with experience that he often relates to the content of the course. He takes Dixon's large content presentations and reads directly off them (often skipping parts he deems unimportant). In-class examples are a great way to understand the material. Labs were pretty easy if you practiced the night before.

Joeg reads off of the slides, but he is a very knowledgeable and experienced, and will gladly answer your questions. I appreciate the energy he brings to the classroom even though his lectures can be boring. Also, do not prioritize the sample exam they give you when studying for exams.
He's the best 202 Prof. make things easy to understand

Professor Joeg is definitely a good lecturer. Concepts are explained very clearly and he gives many examples. Do not be afraid to ask questions, he will be happy to address them. The tests are tough however so watch out for that! Overall, I feel that Joeg's lectures supplemented the course well in addition to labs and projects.
Hes rude and doesnt give extensions for severe injuries or sickness no matter how bad.

Took this class spring 2022. Speeds through 30+ slides with very few practice questions to help retain the content. Reads directly from the slides that he presents. Homework and Quizzes are similar question wise, but the final exam is totally unpredictable. I'm sure there are other professors that could teach this content better.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The best way to keep up with Prof. Joeg's fast lectures is to take a lot of notes, communicate with your peers, and read the textbook. Do the weekly homework, practice the concepts for the quizzes, and the final is just a wild card. Also, don't be afraid to ask questions as this isn't an easy class for many Pre Comp Sci/Eng majors.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment:
- Rushes through entire chapters' worth of textbook material by only reading off of slides.
- Throws information at you like the information is "fast-food."
- Homework problems that are given are extremely particularized problems that require extremely distinctive solutions.
- Just gives out the bare minimum study material for quizzes and exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Joeg is a very knowledgeable and respectful mean. He knows his stuff when it comes to C++. He is very approachable compared to his counter part.  One thing is I wish he stepped his foot down more do during lecture. This one guy with long hair asks alot of questions and it drives me insane. Quite annoying when he takes up alot of time.

Professor Joeg is the best CMSC202 instructor out there. He takes out time and answers all of your questions. If you were to ask Dixon about a deadline on a project, he would get mad and tell you to check the syllabus. But, if you ask Joeg, he would go to the syllabus and tell you the due date. I would highly urge you to take Joeg

Look, I know you're prob reading a lot of people roasting Joeg, but honestly he's great. He really takes the time to answer your questions. He could run his classroom a little more tightly as sometimes chatter gets loud and he speaks softly. But compared to Dixon's childish pettiness, ie. bullying students, Joeg is a saint. Great guy, cares about u

There are waaaaay better professors to take this class with . Dont expect to learn much from him since all his lectures are basically just him reading slides really fast and hardly explains what any of it means . The review session we had in this class was basically pointless as he went over things that never even showed up on exams .
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Joeg is truly caring and kind. He was always available in office hours and would adjust grading if there were too many kids not passing. Most students did not take advantage of his availability but if you do you will easily pass. He is incredibly kind and reasonable.

If you have to take 203, DO NOT TAKE IT WITH JOEG . This guy does not teach at all , dont expect to learn anything from his class or even be well prepared for his quizzes or exams . Hardly any of the questions from the textbook or homeworks were even close to what even was on the final . The review sessions were a waste of time . USELESS !!

Prof. Joeg really cares about his students learning the material so they can use it when they enter the field. The lectures can be hard to sit through, but there's no need for a textbook if you do. It is important to get all your work in before the last deadline, he rarely accepts late work. He would drop an assignment before he takes a late assign
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I can say with confidence that he is the worst professor I have taken at UMBC. He rushes through 50 slide PowerPoints and expects everyone to understand the material with ease. Grades very harshly on quizzes and exams and responds rudely to emails. You have to read the textbook exclusively to pass. He makes the class 10x harder than it needs to be.

reviews.comment: He will give you a review guide that doesnt relate to the exam at all and on top of that all the coursework he gives doesnt even relate to what you get on quizzes at all , his lectures are boring as he only just reads off slides and doesnt actually explain what we are looking at
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Worst professor I have ever had. Lectures are nothing but textbook slides which he reads out of. Harsh grader and you don't have access to your answers or corrections7. If you have a question, ask him directly. If you chose to email him, you are going to be surprised by his inconsiderate replies

Professor doesn't know how to teach lectures. He reads off of textbook and thinks everyone understood the material. Replies to emails rudely and inconsiderately. Grades very hard and doesn't curve any quizzes or exams even if you are a point away from a letter grade. Class and the material isn't hard but he somehow makes everything so much harder.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Horrible professor. Doesn't care about his lectures, he just reads off the textbook. Doesn't seem to care about his students. Quizzes and exams are taken using Respondus Lockdown Browser, which is extremely unnecessary and causes a lot of problems. Please do not take it with this professor. 50% of your grade is based on the final and midterm
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this class online during quarantine. This man legit just posted a power point with pictures of the textbook and read directly what was on the slide. The most useless way to lecture. Quickly stopped watching his lectures and just read the textbook. I was literally paying just to be able to take the exams. Don't know how I got an A.

The lectures are not the greatest or most engaging, but far from the worst, I've had. Although he speaks very monotone and his accent can be difficult to understand for some, he does a good job of explaining everything. The quizzes and exams are also very fair and he makes sure to let everyone know what's going to be covered in them.

He sent the lectures (PowerPoints) out early, and his TA's were open to answer any questions. Other than that, you're pretty much on your own to learn the material. The grading for the class is clear (one homework a week, 4 quizzes, midterm + final), and he drops the lowest quiz and lowest two hw. Overall, he didn't interact with students much.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: he was terrible at answering emails and i learned more from youtube videos than the class. he didn't know how to open my quiz after i took it so i couldn't see my answers i put. not sure if he is bad with tech or just lazy. probably lazy since he's a comp sci prof but who knows. i wouldn't recommend his class

Lectures were PowerPoints with him narrating. Narration was almost never necessary as he read straight from the slides with little to no deviation. That aside grading policy is lax with you getting most if not all credit on assignments and quizzes if you can demonstrate most of the process behind your answer.
I probably learned more from self-study rather than from the lectures. His slides/notes are more vague than they need to be. Definitely not an easy course under this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: In an online structure, Joeg reads directly off of slides. He is absolutely clueless when it comes to using Blackboard, which makes an online course challenging. I don't understand what is going on because of this format. Others have said he is very helpful outside of class. I can't speak on it though.

For algorithms: I have learned virtually nothing since starting this class over a month ago. He reads directly off the slides, and the slides are horrifically done and way over-complicated. He does not do any meaningful examples, so the homework is an absolute tragedy to get through. This is the worst time in a class I've ever had. Do. Not. Take.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: All in all a good professor and person. Drops 1 quiz and 2 homeworks, the only other grades are the midterm and final. Lectures can feel a little dry and based solely off of slides. He's very understanding and will keep explaining the material until you understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I personally did not do well in the class itself, not because of the professor. In class he was alright, read from the slides and used the board for examples but he didn't come up with or grade tests or projects. When we went online the course coordinator took over and if you have programming experience you'll be better off, I struggled to keep up.

The class itself isn't too bad, a lot of topics but none are hard to understand, just have to remember them. He just reads off the slides for class but if you have questions will work out problems and examples more. He is always willing to meet outside of class to help out students more. There were 4 quizzes, 10 homeworks, and 2 tests, overall easy

Spent almost 20 hours of studying questions from each section before every quiz just to get one question wrong on quiz that only 2-3 questions on it. Our class was constantly flunking tests because of him. His whole lectures are just reading slides word or word with no explanation. No chance for extracredit because the only grades are HW/quizes

Professor Joeg was very helpful during the semester. While the class moved quickly, he was willing to spend time outside of class to really help you if you were stuck. Would absolutely recommend. Quizzes and exams were entirely from the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The slides he uses for his lectures are directly from the textbook and aren't explained in a way that you'll understand it well. The final and midterm will make or break you. The questions are from the textbook so make sure you practice the problems at the end of each section and some of the examples. Be prepared to teach yourself.

reviews.comment: Joeg clearly knows the material but struggled to convey it in simple manner during lecture. Speaking of- lecture is very fast paced- flips through stock textbook slides back+forth. His TA was a tough grader at first but then started grading future HW and quizzes extremely leniently after they found out that half the class failed the midterm.

His class was quite fast-paced. Rushes thru the material and expects the student to learn on their own. His quizzes were straight from the HW or Powerpoints. The MidTerm and Final is very hard tho, it counts up to 55% of your total grade and I won't mess up on these two exams for sure. Had to learn and solve everything by myself.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Quizzes are 3 questions, not difficult if you understand the material. Above average lectures, you can learn something new. Very friendly and accessible out of class. Grading can be generous at times but his TAs don't make life easy. HW can be turned in up to one class after the due date for full credit. Not easy A, but easier than other classes.
He grades so fast. I literally took the exam this morning, and got the grade back the same day. He's also really laid back and funny, so you should take him.

Professor Leips was very straight forward about what would be on his exams. He clearly explained everything and was easy to access outside of class. Overall great professor, I really recommend taking him.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: really good professor! He makes everything so easy and the lectures are fun. His exams are also straight forward. His office hours are also very helpful.I would recommend him for BIOL 142!!!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Single handedly brought my grade from a C (thanks to Bernie Lohr) to an A. Very knowledgeable, great lecturer. Take notes at lectures and you should be good. He tends to go a little fast but do not be afraid to ask him to wait a minute or go back and explain something or so you can finish note taking on a slide. Office hours are also very helpful

Prof. Leips was knowledgeable on the subject of Ecology, but I struggled to stay interested in his lectures. The transition from Dr. Omland to him was quite difficult, as he ran the course quite differently than we were used to compared to the first two months of the class. Tests were difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Pretty nice guy, but his lectured tend to be kinda boring. I appreciated that he really did seem to care about the class, and was willing to carefully explain things to students. The final for the class wasn't too bad (MAKE SURE TO STUDY ALL THE DIAGRAMS FOR ECOLOGY AND TAKE ALL THE PRACTICE EXAMS--SOMETIMES THEY REUSE OLD EXAM QUESTIONS!)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: DO NOT BE AFRAID TO SAY "can you give us a min to copy that down?" If you dont he'll zoom past. He wants people to call out as I found out in office hours, but people are too afraid of "holding up the lecture for others" FoodForThot: if u think its fast I guarentee that AT LEAST your entire section thinks its fast. If u r confused, someone else is.

Very nice and the tests are much easier than bio141 and also bit easier than omlands. He curved the final (5%) which helped a lot of people. Textbook isn't 100% necessary, just good for back up / clarification. He also offered a little extra credit throughout the course so pay attention to that.

At the end of the semester, people were begging for a curve because that's how bad a lot of students did on the final. Becareful when you take him. But he knows how to explain the material good though if you go to his office hours.

Leips is awesome! When I took this class, he covered the ecology portion of the class and had very easy exams. I got 100% on both of his exams. If you're a Bio major you have to take him anyways but don't worry he's great. He's a really nice guy and is really interested in his field.

I liked this professor but his lectures are kind of confusing. He often made us do group work in the lecture hall which was weird but were easy grade points for the day. Exams were moderately difficult - he gave a lot of extra credit exam points. He's a cool guy but make sure to thoroughly review the book because the lectures slides were unhelpful.

Dr. Leips teaches the second half of BIOL 142 which is the ecology topic. He makes a topic which has a potential to be very boring, to be quite interesting. Sometimes is bad on posting things to Bb a little late. Other than that he is always willing to help you outside of lecture.
Dr. Leips is a fantastic teacher... he breaks down difficult material into concise and understandable concepts, is passionate about ecology & evolution, and cares about his students.

Definitely overrated. He is not very helpful. He's likeable alright, but as a professor you will not learn much. There's so much math and he only goes over things once. He's very bad about posting the power points and he goes so fast!

I'm taking a writing intensive course with him and Omland. I'm rating Leips right now because I just love him so much. His class is hard but if you talk to him more for help or just in general, you're more likely to get a better grade. He's a golden brown fox if I've ever seen one. He is not a silver fox bc his hair isn't grey and he's not that old

He co-taught this class with Dr. Omland.  Dr. Leips taught the ecology portion of this course, which involved a lot of math.  His exams were fairly difficult and I thought they were a bit difficult to study for.  He's a nice guy though and also uses a lot of real life examples.  He also puts funny stuff on his exams.

I don't even remember what this guy taught. I probably missed most of his classes. Still got an A in the course, so w/e. But that says a lot, when you teach 1/3 of a course and I can't even say what your lecture topic was! Something about marsupials, that's all I remember. lol
entertaining and funny, managed to make even the most boring subjects somewhat interesting. very difficult tests.

Dr.Leips is the 3rd Eco/Evo prof. and he covers ecology. His lectures are very clear, and he is among the most approachable profs. I have ever had. However, he moves through lectures at lightening speeds, so RECORD them. His tests are fair, but difficult. Study hard for his half of the final; there is a lot of math(growth rates and such).

His portion of the class' exam [5] is SO hard. I recommend that one be the one you drop, because Mendelson and Omland's exams are easier. To reiterate, drop Leips' exam and don't put in the effort to study for it; wait to learn all the content for this exam for the final. Leips is a cool chill guy though. Attendance isnt mandatory- skips CPS a lot.
2 descriptions: difficult exams and boring lectures.
No comment. Good, learned what I was supposed to and he was funny.

He knew the material well but I sometimes found it hard to know what he wanted us to know. His exams were slightly difficult but not unexpected or unfair. He seemed willing to help those who asked. Used CPS and groupwork to get students in class.

I thought he was the most boring out of the three profs for this course. Lectures are clear, but for some reason I had trouble staying awake in his class. Do the reading and listen to lecture audios before the exam in case you missed something. His tests were pretty hard, but the guy knows his stuff. Good looking, too.
This guy can be judgmental and intimidating if you dont know as much as him. Really play favorites towards those who are on his "level". Overall knowledgeable but subjective.
He was the 3rd teacher of the class, exams were not too bad, just a lot of math, but he provided the formulas.
Really boring lectures & hard to stay awake in class...he was the 3rd professor of the class. Exams were hard.
He's my favorite professor! :)
The 3rd teacher of the class , Ridiculus Exams avoid
Great guy. good lectures but tests are kind of hard if you have no clue what's going on.
Best prof ever! highly recommended and not bad to look at!
one of 3 professors, hes ok, his presentations are online, material is simple but you have to study! go to class for participation! go over practice exams!

Nice guy but tests are very hard. Grades completely based on tests. The lectures (material, not the instructor) are rather boring, however he only teaches 1/3 of the semester. Other teachers are more interesting. He DOES offer a curve.

Very good teacher, clear in what he teaches and doesn't complicate things in the exam. Very professional, good sense of humor and excellent knowledge in the subject. May not attractive the class with different accent or joles, but his way of teaching is very clear and understandable. Recommended!!
Yeah, this is exactly what you want in a biology prof - very knowledgable, good sense of humor, approachable and very helpful.
Awesome teacher.  Very passionate about what he does, and really cares about his students.  Very helpful to students, but why don't they change the class time already?

He loves teaching ecology, but teaches so slow that it gets really boring (especially at 8:30). Very passionate and always willing to give help when you need it. Nice guy. Exams are pretty hard. Teaches class with Freeland (Freeland teaches evolution part of class).

He is suuuuuuuuch as nice guy and a great teacher!  He really cares about what he teaches and understands the students so well.  Overall very very friendly guy and great teacher.  Really cares about the environment and is dedicated to breaking society's misconceptions about it. TAKE IT!

Good teaching, and though some people found him boring i was engaged.  Possibly because he's a member of the tag team duo of freeland and leips, the hottest bio 301 teaching team on the planet :)  seriously though he's good. take his classes.
Seemed willing to help a lot. Very interested in what he teaches so it can be interesting at times, but definitely has his boring moments.

Teaches the Ecology portion of Ecology/Evolution.  Possibly the most boring prof, but at least he tries so hard.  Willing to help if you can stay awake for his explanation.  Easy, passionate about his work and occasionally funny.

I took this class as a general education credit and it was my easiest class. It is a little work heavy, but everyone saying that she's a nitpicky grader - I didn't really see that. She is very understanding and I definitely get the feeling from her that she wants you to succeed. As long as you care and try you do well.
She is a nice and sweet professor. But she is also a tough grader which makes the class a little bit difficult.

I had Professor Kutner many times. She is very nice, but the other ratings are true. She does grade a little too tough in my opinion. This class felt especially tough on grading, compared to my other classes with her. However, the content of her classes is very fascinating, and she is one reason why I became a history minor. Consider taking her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Can be a tough grader on quizzes and exams if you don't study. You must use the information she gives out during lecture or you lose points on quizzes and exams. Barely any homework or reading to do. She records all her lectures and makes them available online. Overall fun class and a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: overall a nice person, but she's pretty nitpicky when it comes to grading. she said that she grades lower on purpose as a sort of warning to look at her comments and suggestions, which i think is a bit evil, considering u can still look at her comments regardless of whether she gave u a good grade or not, so long as she tells u to check them

she is a very nice and kind person. however, her class relies a lot on participation and group work, where i feel like most of the in-class assignments are just a lot of guessing. she doesn't upload grades at all really so its unclear ur letter grade until the end of semester. also bware that she cold calls on students sometimes. very kind though

She seems nice but this class is really difficult for a 200 level general education requirement. I took it for my culture credit and despite taking notes, paying attention in class, and studying, I still received bad grades on tests. She's really nitpicky about grading. Wouldn't recommend if you're just taking it for fun
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: nice lady in general. but DO NOT take this class if u are a stem major and have to dedicate hours of studying to more important classes. This class is very strictly graded and requires hours of studying for no reason.

Overall, nice lady, but only thing is took forever to post our final grades. Also grades kind of harsh, but if you do bad on the exams, but you do well on the writing assignment (some assignment where she makes you go to a museum, but if you can't, it's fine, you get an alternative assignment), you can get at least a B in the class.

Very tough grader for a culture class, also an assignment where you literally have to go out your way to go to a museum. Would feel different if this was a major focused class, but again wildly difficult and challenging for a culture class honestly wouldn't recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nice women but hard class for me. Her lectures are hard to follow since she uses words that are out of most people's vocabulary. She tries to give group work to break up the lecture but I feel like the group work is harder than it should be and its a lot of guessing.

I honestly really enjoyed Professor Kutner's class! I do agree with other reviews, she is big on tests & lectures are extremely important, but if you make sure to write down specifically what she says, it's easy to get good grades. Asking her for lecture recordings was VERY helpful, it was something I did a lot- and something that helped a ton!

Virtually no homework. Gives out very generous study guides that tell you exactly what will be on the exams and quizzes. Respects opinions. Exams do have multiple essays but calling them essays is an exaggeration, it's just a page. Pay attention in lecture, study, ask questions and you'll do fine.

Dr. Kutner is one of the best professors I have had at UMBC. Exams are essay based but don't let that scare you away. She does this to allow students to obtain more points than a multiple-choice exam. There is only 1 homework and 1 writing assignment. The workload is very manageable and Dr. Kutner is good at giving clarity or help when needed.
She's nice and all but she doesn't grade in class assignments and your grade is heavily dependent on exams and quizzes.

reviews.comment: Dr. Kutner is a tough grader and expects a lot of details in the test essays, which are 60% of the overall grade. Lecture heavy with scattered group work. If you have a bad memory and don't feel like studying for hours on end just to get your culture credit, don't take this class.

reviews.comment: I took this class because I love learning about Ancient Egypt but it wasnt as fun as I thought it was going to be. I figured it would be more easy going considering its a 200 level class but I guess not.

Dr. Kutner is a nice professor but her lectures are a bit dry but full of info. Her test are a lot to study for and remember. She is a stickler for dates and providing tons of facts. I would recommend her test change a bit but all in all she is a great person and educator.

reviews.comment: Kutner is a really good professor, and genuinely cares about archaeology. reviews.comment: Prof. Kutner is one of my favorite teachers so far. Her 201 class is simple as long as you attend class. Attendance is marked and you are allowed three absences. reviews.comment: Dr. Kutner is a great professor. reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Exams are 60% of your grade so if you don't do well on those you're basically doomed. reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Your final grade is based off of Attendance, Quizzes, Exams and 1 Paper. She takes attendance daily. reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: 100%, best class I've taken in a while. Dr. Kutner is caring and hilarious in class. Her lectures are interesting and if you go to class, you really don't need to read the book. Just follow her study guide and you'll get As on every exam. Easy as pie.

reviews.comment: Dr. Kutner is really sweet, definitely knows what she's talking about. Only one homework assignment in this class. 3 exams + a final and a take home essay. reviews.comment: Dr. Kutner is incredibly passionate about her subject and it shows. I really enjoyed the class and learned a lot. Beware though, she will call on people during lecture so make sure you are paying attention!

Professor Kein is a wonderful professor. The class is tough and there's a lot of difficult readings, but she is very helpful. If you're struggling in the class I highly suggest meeting with her during her office hours.
