Literally the nicest person on the planet. I love Ray Terhorst. He is a fairly easy grader but he invests himself into those papers! Mine always had all sorts of genuinely useful notes on it, and he frames his critique very politely. Not every professor can be this beautiful inside and out, but it was a breath of fresh air. Take him if you can!

He's really nice and really funny, but I didn't feel like I really learned anything. He lets you resubmit but it takes a while to get it back. Hard to reach sometimes. You don't need the textbook, just find the readings on Google. Final paper is due at the end of the semester, so I didn't get any feedback on it - I would have liked that.

Ray was one of the nicest teachers I've ever had. He is very helpful, and a great teacher. Don't be fooled by how nice he is though, he's a tough (but fair) grader. Pay attention to his comments on your papers and do revisions!

Professor Terhorst is AMAZING. By far the nicest, most approachable, most understanding professor I've had at UMBC. His assignments are very clear and he has no problem giving extensions to those who need it. Yes you write a lot of papers but he tries not to assign work that is boring. Take this class!!!!
Really enthusiastic about English and makes the class easier. Very helpful! A lot of papers, but gives students the ability to revise for a better grade! Great teacher and all around nice guy.

Fantastic professor. Eager to help, has great stories, not hard and the nicest person ever. There was a lot of writing but not much was graded beyond having it completed. Also has no strict deadlines for papers and is really understanding.

Had him Spring 2010, yes he does let you out early, quizzes were based on readings(mostly online, easy questions if you read). You get in class time to work on essays, MUCH EASIER THAN OTHER ENGLISH100 professors. Coolest most laid back guy ever, never used the UMBC summer book(and thus, I never read that POS!). Take this guy, outstanding professor

it's really not an easy A but his class was very enjoyable. he's very laid back and very passionate with his job. he also likes giving "free days" for us to write our papers. so most of the time you get out an hour early and sometimes you don't even have class at all. he's a tough grader but he lets you re-write them.

He was honestly one of the best teachers i've ever had. There are no tests, quizes are at the beginning of class and are mostly just telling him what u did on the weekend. I had him on mondays from 7:10-9:40 but he let us out of class everytime about an hour and a half early. There are 4 big essays and you get to write on whatever u want. TAKE THIS
very good teacher

I had no problem getting an A in the class, but I am a strong writer. If you know how to write essays, getting an A is not difficult (5 short-ish papers). To those who say it's impossible: many people who target the class are weak writers, and would struggle in any other entry English class. It was enjoyable, and I learned. He's EXTREMELY helpful.
this professor is over-rated. if by fun you mean writing multiple essays for an entire semester then go for it. He's nice yes, but so what? it's a ton of work and nearly impossible to get an A.

I agree that saying this class is "easy" is deceptive. I enjoy english and am a strong writer, but if you want an easy A for this 100 level english class better not to take it with him. You put in a ton of work with multiple re-writes only for a B.If you have a lot of time on your hands you might be lucky and get an A. I suggest you look elsewhere.

The previous ratings are deceptive. This is not an "easy A" class, if that's what you were thinking. I suppose it is hard to get below a B, but Ray gives B's to what should be A papers in basic comp. If you're already a strong writer and you just want to get this course out of the way with an easy A, look elsewhere.

Take this class if you can!! Ray is an amazing person and (believe it or not) makes English 100 and enjoyable class. Also, you have be a complete moron to get anything under a B in the course. He's very relaxed, always lets you out about an hour early, and lets you resubmit papers as many times as you want. Take this guy, you won't regret it.
This is the best class i have taken in college.  He really makes english enjoyable.  I recommned him for everyone.

He's very helpful and understanding. Always the first to give himself as an example and make fun of himself. He makes english fun to be in even though i have it as a 2 1/2 hour night class (always lets you out extra early)!
very easy class....very nice and laid back guy.  I would definately recommend him
he is an awesome professor! if you have the chance to take him you should.  class is interesting and he is very understanding.  no exams-just papers.
easy as a sunday pie
The best professor ever! Honestly, the best class I've taken. Engaging, clear, and actually makes you think. Not an easy A, but 100% worth it.

I have taken Dr. Rosenthal for JDST321 and JDST323. She makes assignments very clear. You must read in order to pass this class. Majority of presenting is done through PowerPoint and the use of YouTube vids. She will respond to emails, and she does NOT accept any late work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback
EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Rosenthal is amazing! I took 3 courses with her. Her passion for the subjects shines through in every lecture, making even the most complex concepts accessible and engaging. Students are encouraged to ask her questions. I love her sense of humor too! Take her courses, trust me, you won't find a better professor out there!

Amazing and so sweet. Roni requires a couple discussions, but our homework was watching Netflix. Finals were all papers so pay attention to vocab and grammar (no Google Translate) as well as start early and you'll be fine. She had fun in-class games as well as exercises. No need to ask for Jewish holidays off since class will be cancelled anyway.

Do not skip her class. Roni makes everything looks clear. Homework assignments are optional bonus points and are great practice! You'd never a find another amazing professor like her. Roni you're the best :)
She's funny and respect her students! Although I don't have much background about the Jewish world, she made everything make sense. I've learned a lot from her lectures. Best Professor ever!
No.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Roni is excellent. There are weekly quizzes, 4 Writing Assignments, a Midterm presentation, and a Final Exam. Even if you don't have a Jewish Day School background, you'll still be able to keep up with the class. She makes Hebrew very accessible and understandable. The class atmosphere is very laid-back and comfortable. She recognizes hard work.

An excellent online class, not too hard and yet you do need to read the stories and participate in the weekly online assignments. She's an amazing professor and I'd love to take more elective/culture classes with her.
She is the best teacher. Clear assignments and is a very easy grader.
That's my 4th class with Roni. She's amazing and the lectures were interesting. It's a hybrid class so reading short stories at home and only Thursdays on campus.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: YES! She's just great! She cares about her students.  Only take home quiz :-)
Great class! I Wish I could take more classes with her
I wouldn't take this class with this teacher. Far better instructors are out there.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is very helpful. You can ask her any question. She has TONS of patience
LOVE HER! She is just 100% AMAZING. Would take all her Hebrew classes again!
Don't recommend unless this is required.
Not available. Not worth the time. Not helpful. I would not take again.

Our class was a melting pot of people of all backgrounds, all gathered eagerly to learn from this amazing person. This semester I worked very hard, but not hard enough That's my fault, not hers'. She is an amazing teacher, and if you work hard you can do very well. Her tests are a little tricky, but she works with you to succeed. I highly recommend
Amazing Professor ever! The class is not easy, but Roni is making it so much better. She is just perfect!!! We all loved her very much!
Not a challenging course. Teacher has know-it-all quality, not recommended.
LOVE HER! Best Professor ever!

Unbelievably nice teacher, she is very patient and accommodating. If you're interested in learning the Hebrew language in a great environment, I highly recommend this class. Especially if you have a great class, including a jokester ;)
Roni is very patient and funny! Buy the book, make flashcards and get a studybudy since she isn't around too much on campus to help you.
A waste of time.

Best Professor! She explains things very well and will help you as much as she can. If you study at all, you can expect to get an A with her. Only 2 quizzes and you're allowed one makeup quiz if you wish. Make sure you buy the book though, she uses it every class.

Few weeks left in the semester, but she has been amazing. SUPER understanding if you don't do well on quizzes and exams. She provides extra credit and she is always available to help, she genuinely wants her students to do well. Even with such a long early class she makes it not seem so bad. Currently taking PSYC390 with her. Use her study guides!!
She is very sweet and understanding. this class was online and self paced, quizzes and exams were very easy and lecture materials cover all you need to know. highly reccomend her

Amazing lectures,but the Professor always seemed tired and bland. Which made me tired throughout the lectures. Overall easyish course to take. We have weekly worksheets, 3 quizzes, 3 exams, and a research paper(topic/abstract, outline, and final draft). With many extra credit opportunities! Would take again,even if the professor was tired and bland

very good prof! slides have all the info you need and she records lectures. read the textbook if you can't find smth in the slides ! one assignment per week, there are a few quizzes and the exams arent too bad -- you can reanswer the q's you got wrong to get partial credit back ! also gives other opportunities for extra credit! overall good prof!

he's genuinely so funny, always cracking jokes during class and is great to be around. when asking questions he's very receptive and explains it so that you get a good understanding of course material. would 100% take again and totally recommend.

Professor Brown was actually very easy going and cracked jokes throughout the class. He always told a very little story before starting class and was honestly such an easy class to take. Just do your ALEKS and practice quizzes and you'll be fine. I would 100% take his class again. I appreciate him because his class gave me little to no stress.

Professor Brown is the best! He explains everything so clear so it makes learning easier. As someone who's TERRIBLE at math I've learned a lot from professor Brown. He is very helpful and I'm thankful that I took his class. I would 100% recommend taking his class!

Professor Brown was one of the best- so supportive and had a great sense of humor I laughed myself into an A all math teachers are NOT the same.. I appreciated his efforts to help me succeed in a subject I struggle with

Ronnie is a really good professor, as someone who struggles with math, he teaches everything very well and breaks everything down to where it is comprehendible. His quizzes, exams, and homework are all very easy and relate back to the lectures. He is also hilarious and makes lectures engaging.

he is a chill guy, I finally wasn't completely horrible at math cuz he actually covered the topics, only complaint is that when he cancelled a class he didn't change the timeline to fit so the Aleks assignments were quizzing me on stuff I hadn't learned yet,  bummer, so maybe he is a bit of an airhead

Professor Ronnie is such a great professor for Math 104. One of my favorite. His lectures are clear, easy to follow. He's funny and keeps the class engaging. The workload is reasonable with 7 quizzes (you can drop two) the quizzes are very easy if you attend lectures. Two exams and final. There will be homework but it's online. Highly recommend!

I had professor Brown for math 104 and he was great. Very straight going while still having fun and being humorous and cared for his students. His quizzes are easy if you pay attention in class and hardly ever gives out homework.
Susan is the best!

She's literally an angel. Dramatic Lit is very reading heavy. Her work isn't easy but its fair and she will give you everything you need to figure it out. Shes an amazing director and educator, she made me like reading plays.

I took professor stroupe's intro to dramatic literature. I will warn that you have to read a lot for the class but thats basically it. No major assignments, easy class group projects. She emphasises on class group discussions but doesn't call you out. Overall, a very knowledge able, enthusiastic and kind person. She clearly loves her subject.

Ah, where do I even began. The lectures and slides are understandable, but the exams feel much harder than what is covered in class. So going over the slides itself it not enough for this class. I feel very confident always coming to the exam, but every time I see my grade after I go into isolation. I would  recommend not taking Bio with him.

Ah, where do I began with this professor. The lectures and slides are understandable, but the exams feel much harder than what is covered in class. A lot of the questions require details or application beyond the slide material. I recommend not taking Bio with this professor.

It would be in your best interest to take this class with Feeser instead. This class does not have a textbook and the exams are harder than any other Bio professor at UMBC. The exams are also have free response which weighs heavy on your grade. Do not take Bio with this professor.

This professor has no idea how to teach. He brought a ta to teach a class of 300 while he sat in the back and relaxed. He hasn't even introduced himself to us and when I asked for redos or anything for some extra credit he denied me. You also have to pay for the materials in the course since he can't help fund them. It's simple dont take this class
You can def tell he cares about his students.
He's a really kind soul and if you make an effort to participate in class and attend office hours he's a great resource. You can tell he really cares about his students.

For an upper-lvl bio writing intensive, it's a fairly easy class if you put in effort. Although you'll read many scientific articles, i liked the way he formatted the class. Participation matters. 6-7 quizzes on the articles and 2 scientific papers. The final and midterm can be challenging but it's expected.  Would recommend if you like genetics!

Good human but not at teaching. Content isn't hard but the book is surface-level; Use other resources to go deeper. Teach yourself read in-depth, take detailed notes, draw all diagrams, talk to TAs/classmates, analyze HW/study guides. It was hard to grasp you must grind but it can be done. reviews.comment: You will be teaching yourself almost this entire class. He's kind, but his exam qs are difficult and material heavy. I read every single chapter and that helped get details down. Do not recommend if you have a job or other responsibilities outside of school because of the amount of readings and pre-lecture material you have to spend time on on your own. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He is a chill prof but kinda bad teacher, you need to study for yourself in this class for sure, you cannot learn just from his classes and you will fall behind if you don't study like 2 hours a day. more is better, anyways don't be scared hes good just do your work and study, its a hard but fair class

The textbook is not reliable for this course. Only touches on the general idea and is very redundant. This professor relies heavily on the textbook which does not elaborate on the concepts that are needed for the exams, homework, and discussion worksheets. reviews.comment: This is the worst professor I've had at UMBC yet, I took this in the spring of 22, and the only reason I got through this class with an understanding and a good grade was because of my great TAs who were available outside of class for help. The textbook was very useless, it scratched the surface and was filled with unrequired information. Compared to the other professor that teaches Bio take Miller. Miller was simply not a good professor, the class is lecture heavy but the assignments given typically require outside resources. The test averages were always low and yet he never curved any. The class was just unfair, no matter how much work I put into it, the quizzes just never went well. Take another professor if you are able.

The class was largely run by the LAs, essentially a bunch of "know it all" sad kids that will try their best to kill your spirit when it comes to science. Professor Miller was very thorough and descriptive in his lectures, all though a little boring. This class is extremely difficult but Dr. Miller is understanding and nice, he really tries to help. The average in the class was a C. The exams are no joke!

Don't listen to these other posts. And DO NOT take team based Genetics. You will regret it. No lectures. Tests are insanely specific. Really tough graders. There are no ans keys. This is a VERY difficult and heartbreaking class. The tests were excruciatingly tough. But Dr. Miller and his wife Prof. Wagner really tried their best to reach out to students and to help them do their best. I can say i feel they are some of the few science professors at UMBC who truly care about students. He is very approachable and helpful.
Have to work hard in this class, but A is definitely possible, read the book and do study Qs, he is a. Great lecturer, really enthusiastic

Very nice, helpful. Moves through slides fast, so not everything is covered in the lecture. It is up to the individual to read before coming to class or after. Go to every class. Refer to the book as a guide. STUDY for the exams, use old exams, use study groups. Do everything they tell you to.
Prof. Miller is a great professor, and went over most topics covered in great detail. I would definitely recommend a class with him.

He's impressed me more than any other UMBC professor. He's smart and knows his stuff cold. His exams aren't straightforward and definitely try to make you think. We had three professors and he was the best, by far. I'd rather have a challenging test than spoonfed easy tests by the other two professors. Plus, he's a nice guy which is always a plus.
His exams weren't that hard. You'll do fine as long as you spend time learning the concepts. He explained everything in great detail, which helped me understand the material.
Challenging class. Very helpfull. Go to class, do study questions, read text book and you will do fine on his exam.

He's HARD to understand.  Too conceptual.  His tests are crazy hard.   Average Exam scores are 61 and 55!   Over HALF his class is FAILING.   Over 60 ppl had to Drop this class.  The TAs are nice, but the professor is out there in his teaching

This guy knows his stuff but him teaching an intro bio course is not good.  He makes simple concepts difficult and will deviate to talk about it in grave detail. Great Guy!  He knows his stuff...However, make sure you go to class if you are weak in molecular genetics, and developmental physiology to clarify his notes.  CPS is used and are a great way to predict what kind of questions will be on his exams.  He curves but does not drop any exams so do well in all to avoid worries of cutoffs

his exams are killer, dosent use the textbook at all which requires you to go to class and write down every word that comes out of his mouth. avg was a 56 on the last exam. HARD. dont fall behind in the class, there is too much to learn.
No Comments

This man is AWESOME. He just knows the secrets to teaching and learning. If he was my father I would have grown up to be a freaking super-genius. Plant molecular biology is potentially boring, but he makes it adventurous. They should make him the recruiter for the Society of Plant Biologists.

Very fun professor and reliable during office hours. He's very creative and gives good stories, and his exams are open-book and open-notes. If you come to class, you'll succeed, and he's an excellent professor for a lot of psych classes.

Anderson's classes are engaging and entertaining. He's a really cool guy and it's really interesting to hear what he has to say. Exams are lecture based
He is outgoing and easygoing.  Lecture-heavy and appreciates participation.  He's also goofy, personable, and available outside of class.  Great professor overall.
Dr. Anderson is a great professor; he is caring and makes himself available for students outside of the classroom.
He's really goofy + chill. Quizzes are open book :)

Professor Anderson is really laid-back. He doesn't grade exams or assignments on time, so don't be surprised if you don't know your grade throughout the semester. Lecture heavy but exams are open book/open notes. Alot of discussion board assignments.

he's really easygoing

reviews.comment: His lectures are interesting. All the exams were open book and open note. This class is overall an easy A. There's one group project you need to complete at the end but it's super chill. Highly recommend. The course content is also very interesting, and no homework.

Professor Anderson is hilarious and overall a nice person. But he is extremely disorganized and all your grades will not be in until the last minute. The class is an easy A, all tests are online and open book, and the final was just taking notes on a movie we watched in class. If you're okay with not knowing your grade then take his class!

Extremely disorganized. The syllabus wasn't posted until after the drop period, which was a huge red flag. Discussions were assigned late and never graded, including a random “final discussion” due after finals ended. Lectures were mostly rambling, and exams made up almost the entire grade. Frustrating experience—proceed with caution.

Great, engaging lectures. A bit disorganized and a little unclear on grades-- we didn't get a syllabus until approximately 2 weeks into the semester. Also said we would have discussion posts throughout the semester but we only had 1. Overall, in terms of learning the material itself, great professor albeit a little disorganized.

I understand why Dr. Anderson has high ratings—his classes are easy and interesting—but there are several issues that seem to get overlooked. He is unreliable, physically touchy, disorganized, repetitive, irresponsible, etc. We didn't even have a course syllabus for the first week of class.

Dr. Anderson is such a nice and chill professor; I 100% recommend taking him! This class is lecture-heavy, so participate and write down notes on what he says (it'll help you for the exams). There are a few discussion posts (I believe at max 5), and the exams are open-note on Blackboard; you can take them anywhere.

This class is truly phenomenal. The professor makes the material as straightforward as possible. His lectures are clear, and the exams reflect what is taught almost word for word. He is not only an exceptional instructor but also an inspiring individual. He is clearly knowledgeable, personable, and with a great sense of humor. Amazing professor!!!

An amazing professor who goes above and beyond to make the course as simple and understandable as possible, so everyone has the opportunity to succeed. Grading is clear & straightforward always respectful and professional. His advanced knowledge makes the course engaging, and his teaching style shows his expertise. Truly an outstanding professor!

He is one of the best professors in the Psychology department. He is very caring and understands that things happen. He had 4-5 discussion posts and 3 midterms. Attendance was mandatory, but his lectures were fun to go to. He is also a great mentor to ask about psychology. Highly recommended!!!

I passed this class with flying colors and rarely ever showed up. All he does is lecture, and it's hard to follow because it isn't entertaining. No assignments, quizzes, projects, there wasn't even a syllabus. Can also be a bit touchy physically which is super weird...

Professor Anderson makes lectures enjoyable which is helpful. There are a few discussion posts throughout the semester, and he keeps track of attendance. But other than that, the grade is based on exams, but the exams aren't too hard! And they are open note/ open textbook. Professor Anderson was great!

Anderson is a wonderful professor with a rare and valuable attitude about teaching. No content on blackboard throughout the semester, nor any grades but the only thing you really need to worry about is showing up to class, which is very doable because his lectures are truly worth coming to. I highly recommend everyone take a class with him!

Only thing I would say that is a downfall for him is that he is a slow grader and does not post his slides, so make sure to take good notes! Other than that great professor that is funny and caring! I recommend everyone take one of his classes

very lecture heavy, strict to following the slides. although professor anderson is strictly attached to the slides, the lecture does not feel clear, as he likes to ramble a little. he is very caring and will allow lots of wiggle room. makes personal relationships with students and tries to improve.

Dr. Anderson is a great psych professor! He is lecture-heavy, but extremely in touch with his students in a way that is engaging, and teaches me more than any other class.
I truly feel Dr. Anderson is setting me up for success in the field of psychology. Definitely would take again.

Professor Anderson is so awesome. He is one of the best Professors I've taken at UMBC so far. Intense but fascinating class with Prof. Anderson. Take diligent notes and use resources like Unstuck ai for exam prep - the wording can be tricky. Engaging lectures, but be ready to participate actively.

I love Dr. Anderson, one of my favorite professors I have ever had. He is so knowledgeable in the field and will do everything he can to help you reach your goals. I've taken multiple classes w/ him I enjoyed his teaching so much. Hes very knowledgeable in the field and has lots of experience that help explain course concepts. Inspirational and very understanding as long as you put in effort. Make sure you pay attention in class. If you love to learn and want diverse takes on psychopathology, take him.

Intense and informative, probably one of the best psychology professors I've ever had. I took Dr. Anderson's summer course and honestly, the best way to pass this course was to actively participate (or else he'll call on you). I'd love to take another course with him tbh.

*Summer class* Professor Anderson was a good professor. He would get a bit annoyed at ppl for not participating. There were 4 exams, a final exam, 6 discussion board posts, and a participation grade. So disorganized, which was annoying. Prof. Anderson himself seems very interesting. Physically reminded me of Dr. House, but much nicer, but not as fit. If you're into older and intelligent, slightly off men you'll enjoy this class (;

Good professor that's passionate about the topics he teaches. Comes from a metacognitive perspective, and tells you like it is in real life. Not always the most organized, but if you attend class then you should be fine. Wants his students to succeed and learn.
Easy class. Good and clear instructor; if you attend class you'll always do fine on the tests. As others have said, kind of disorganized and showed up late pretty often.

Dr. Anderson never uploaded BlackBoard or a syllabus. If you are the kind of person that likes professors that are organized, this is NOT the professor for you. He is overall a decent professor, except for his disorganization.

Grades are usually based off of a few exams and attendance. Exams are by the book and lecture. He has issues with grading the exams and posting grades. He is generally an okay guy but seems to take on too much.

The best psych professor I've had at UMBC. It's a shame it's my last semester or I'd take more classes with him. Great professor!

late for class,didn't have test papers for test,waited half hour.study guide isn't posted until day before exam.Projector is hard to see. occasionally goes fast.He is entertaining and the subject is very interesting.Recommend reading the book for better details.Not much extra credit.Doesn't give tests back until after you already took the next one.

One of the best teacher at UMBC. Puts his heart into teaching. Late sometimes for a few minutes, but still manages very well to cover everything on time . I would rather have a professor who is a few mins late but gives great/interesting lectures than to have a prof. whose always on time but gives boring, worthless lectures. He is amazing.
Really engaging professor, encourages critical thinking.  I looked forward to going to class because the lectures were so much fun.
great teacher.. very helpful and he always makes his class interesting.. never used blackboard but just read the chapter before class, write the papers, participate in class and you got an A

FIVE STARS!!! Professor Anderson  is a superb teacher and a wonderful man. I plan to take every course he teaches. Simply the best!
Awesome professor. Funny and keeps the class interesting!

Always late, does not give you test results, no bb, exams are sometimes not what was covered in lecture or book, gives incorrect chapters for book, terrible communicator- no email responses. stalk him to get what you need. beware

Wonderful professor! He is very passionate about the course. Half of the stuff is from his lecture notes and half is from the book. Make sure you read the book. So exams are fair game once you attend the class and read book.

My absolute favorite professor thus far at UMBC. He really cares about his students, and is very approachable about any questions concerning the class or psychology in general. His exams were fairly easy- just a combo of class notes and things from the book. Go to class! It'll be worth it.

he's the best teacher if you really want to know about psychology. he always gives you the correct answers at the end of the exams so stick up at the end with your answer sheet. It is incredibly annoying and insulting to show up for a class, and the professor does not show up until 15 minutes after class starts, and this happens every time including exams. Fantastic instructor in regards to teaching the criteria of Abnormal Psychology. I got an A easily and never knew my grade until finding out I got an A when official grades were released.  TRUE!

He was some what interesting at times he is NOT a teacher I recommend.
