Definitely one of the BEST professors I've had--the guy is GREAT! He has a very large knowledge base and seems to know a lot about everything--meaning, you can learn a lot from him. This class did not require much studying and exams were moderately easy. I HIGHLY recommend taking any course taught by Anderson!

THis teacher is awesome. He is totally passionate about his classes and will go out of his way to help you out. His classes are not hard you just have to pay attention and take good notes. He will have items from lecture on the test. I will def be taking him again.

Very engaging professor, I'm an engineer auditing the class because my wife is in it. He is very interested in his topic and has a lot of clinical experience. He's very interested in training students to go out and fix the problems of society. Easy to get in touch with if you just drop by his office. Very considerate of students' situations.

I have taken PSYC 342, 385, 380 with him. Great Professor! He is very enthusiastic and a great lecturer. He really cares about what he does! I am trying to take another class he teaches next semester!
You should take all is classes if you are interested in psychology.

he is a creeper, nice though.  his tests are pretty easy and the 1 page papers are just give away points. he isnt that good about getting grades back for exams, but i would suggest this class for an easy A. the subject is pretty interesting too
Will definetely hit on you if you are at least a semi-attractive female. Very Sleezy

I had him for psychology of aggression and antisocial behavior, he is really animated and interested in what he teaches, so it is a great class to take.  He also tries to involve everyone, and has a lot of real life stories and is really funny too, I highly recommend him.

His classes are VERY interesting and  fun.It is sufficient to only study the notes. But PLEASE make sure you check your grades and keep track of it. I got an A in the class, but he gave me an F. He was a big procastinator in changing it (it took him 9 months).And I wasn't the first person to experience this

Lots of experience teaching and practicing psychology, he's definitely worth taking.  The material is very interesting, and the tests aren't difficult if you paid attention in class.  However, he often teaches out of the textbook, and you won't see your grade until grade reports are out.  He's also sometimes disorganized, but overall good.
good

Dr. Anderson is the best! I had no interest in PSYC prior to attending this course and now I plan on minoring in it! Contrary to other's comments, I never felt like he talked down to the class. He really brings the subject matter to life and is a genuine and courteous person.  Do the online labs, take good notes, read the book and you'll get an A.

Lectures were fun, but the tests are ridiculoulsy hard! does not curve the grade at all. i actually read the bookk and barely made C's. but the online labs help boost your grade. pay attention during lectures and take good notes. thats the key.
Very easy teacher, all you have to do is take the online quizzes show up for class and take your exams. I barely went to the class and still got a B.

Exams were fair and relatively easy, as long as you take good notes and briefly scan the chapters.  However, he's rather bad with telling you what grade you have in class.  Still, I enjoy him enough that I will be taking his aggression class next semester.

Irresponsible in terms of giving back papers, always seems to be talking about sex no matter *what* class he's teaching. How does sex relate to our aggression class? Heard you have to flirt to get an A- not sure what I'll end up with then, since I haven't even talked to the guy. Mandatory attendence, avoid if you like to keep track of grades.
Anderson is a Really good teacher. Class was fun and notes that he gives you in class ARE seen and used in his exams. He is also cute ..you know ..for his age and being a professor.

Online exams are easy. Doesn't grade you're exams until the very end of semester so you won't know your grade until it shows on your transcript. Makes attendance mandatory and covers everything the book does.

Anderson is funny and interesting. Class Attendance is counted as part of the grade. His labs and quizes are all on Blackboard, very easy to do. His tests are somewhat hard, most importantly he put stuff that he talked about or graphs that he drew in class on the test. So go to class! Besides that it was a fun class!
Ok professor...told me I had one of the best grades in the class but i ended up with a C. Fun lectures though!

Great professor--keeps it interesting and engages you which you'll like if you're a psyc major. However he feeds off the classes energy so a boring class can make it less fun. Speak up in his class!! Took abnormal with him too and it was great.
He is a very intelligent man and quite capable teacher.  I really enjoyed his class and his fun sense of humor.

Nice, funny occasionally. Gave "pop" quizzes randomly. They were 3 questions, you could use your notes and even if you got them wrong you still got points for being in class. Going to class is worth it.

No matter what the lecture is about he always finds a way to come back to the point that size doesn't matter b/c of blah blah blah...  This dude really needs quit speaking about how he's anatomically challenged!

Good professor. Sometimes really boring. Came late to every class. I did really bad on some of the exams but got a B in the class. Passes around a sign in sheet but you really don't need to be there. As long as you read the book your set. Online exams are EASY.

attendence is mandatory but easy class and boring lectures. exams are somewhat hard. prof arrives late to almost every class and is not helpful he didn't even posted anything on blackboard until end of the semester and doesn't reply to e-mails

Nice teacher. Lectures didn't really help with the exams. Exams weren't very hard. Class was not really mandatory, passed around a sign in sheet. Understanding and not difficult person. I missed the online tests, and he let me take them after the due date. I thought I got a D on most of the exams, but I got a B in the class...didn't really make sen

Good teacher, nice guy. Class attendance is not mandatory, but he does send around a sign in sheet. Funny, down to earth, answers each and every hand. There are three-four exams (including final), all go over basic stuff.

Ha, cannot believe this guy. He thinks everyone he is teaching is an idiot, and goes over the most basic things. Secondly, there are blaring gaps in scientific logic in his lectures. A specially shocking moment was when he acutually suggested that the conscience might be located on the shoulder (seriously). He also promoted Jungian theories. Omg...

really really really interesting teacher.  he kept the class awake even later in the evening.  i have taken 2 classes with him and i plan on taking another before i graduate because he can make any class interesting.

good teacher. i took abnormal psych with this guy and he knows what he's talking about and he makes the class very fun, interactive, and interesting. he might be little bit hard to get in touch with but he's very kind and nice.

Attendence was required and he was always late to class even though the class use to start at 2:30. Does not response to e-mails. His teaching style was okay but the tests were really hard. If you are taking psycology for the first time i would suggest avoid him. Take someone else
Would not help when you need it.  Does not respond back to emails if they require him to do any work at all. Does not do his own grading and will not review when asked. Not a good instructor.

If you read the chapters and show up to class half of the time, you'd have to be brain dead to get less than a C. I barely put any time into this class, and I got an easy A. Also the professor is interesting, uses his experience to guide lecture, and he lets the discussion take tangents if people show an interest.
No Comments

This was honestly the biggest waste of time in my life. He takes attendence which is the only reason I even came to class. Seriously, bring a book. You'll learn more from the computer labs and text than you will from him. Just write down what he puts on the board and study. His tests aren't too easy, but easy enough.
No Comments

Science majors: don't take his classes, they are boring as heck. By brain was about to melt, I wouldn't have survived if I didn't have novels to secretly read during class. Takes attendance so have to come to class. No one found out ANYTHING about their grade till the report card. I think he never grades anything, just rolls a dice.

I've taken Anderson twice now, and both times he has been nothing short of amazing. He's brings his experience to the course and shares stories instead of blindly reading from the text. It is important to go to class because the lecture info is featured on the test, but it is usually worth your while since he is interesting.

This is the best professor I ever had!! Lots of fun, lectures are very interesting and his exam are not that hard!  Make sure you go to his lectures and take notes.  One downside is he is always late to class.  But thats the only one.

Easier than a middle school health class. He is unknowledgeable, and tells you stuff you knew since age 2 (in fancy words). ALWAYS LATE TO CLASS (at least 15 mins daily). The class is at 1 pm, so I have no idea what makes him so late. Bring work from other classes, and take him if you have a heavy load, because you can ignore his class easily.

Most people on this page right, tests not extremely easy with short answers you must study some, but it is by far my easiest class. Dr. Anderson very nice but where are our grades and why he always late?

This class is obscenely easy. He hasn't told us any of our grades so far this year, and he's always really really late to class, especially on exam days (15- 20 mins late). But the exams are easy, and even if you barely read the book you should get an A. Take him if you have a heavy course load.

He basically reads the book to you so most of the time you don't have to listen. He is terrible on giving back grades. It is almost the end of the semester now and he hasn't told us our grades yet. He's nice as a person, but as a professor he's not so hot. He needs to get with Blackboard.

i loved taking Dr. Anderson's class! the material is very interesting and he lectures really well. just take notes and read the text a bit before exams and you'll do fine. if you ever need any help with the material, he is very helpful and approachable. overall a great class and great prof!! * he has been really late with exam grades this semester.

He's a terrific teacher. He interacts with students well and always asks for student input. He does his best to make the material understandable and does it well. He knows what he is talking about and is quite funny. If you go to lectures, you should be fine, and the readings are not that bad. Negative? Giving grades back on time, but good overall.

I actually mean to give him a poor rating, but he saitsfies the criteria for this website. If you want to take his class, REMEBER TO BRING WORK FROM OTHER CLASSES. Class is worthless and easy. It's like kindergarten. I felt like my brain was going to melt in that class. Once we learnt what the word "affect" meant, and he spent 15 mintes on it.
No Comments
he's one of the good ones. take a class of his if you can. make sure you go attendance is a must but you won't mind sitting through his lectures. plus if he knows your name and face your good.
No Comments
No Comments
Cool guy, good teacher, a bit picky on attendance but attendance helps get better grades.  Flexible with handing in assignments late, but DO NOT forget to sign in each day.

Dr. Anderson is a excellent teacher.  He makes lectures interesting.  His tests are mostly multiple choice and straight from the lecture and partly from the book.  I took two classes with him and had no complaints.

I would not take another class with him. He is funny and nice however his tests are hard and a good portion of your grade counts on your test scores. He is not leanent and is also picky on attendance.

Dr. Anderson is a great professor.  He brings his job as a clinician into the classroom while describing mental disorders.  His tests are very straight-forward from book and lecture.  Must take notes during lecture and go to class in order to pass test, and also because he takes attendance.  Overall, easy A if you go to class and read.
i loved his class. its a must for anyone even if your not a psych major. ill be taking more from him i enjoyed it so much.

I took psych 285 as a gfr, therefore I am a non-majour attempting to finish the elective to graduate.  He makes the material clear and interesting.  His exams are not overly difficult, usually quite fair, however make sure you read the text.  Overall one of the better professors that I have had.
You have to take a class with him, he is fun and laid back and straight to the point. All you need is class notes and he gives examples from his work that help out a lot. Easy on the eyes too ;-)
Dr. Anderson is the best professor I have ever had! Very understanding, laid back. Exams are straight-forward as long as you go to class.. definately would recommend! :)

If you must take PSYC 100, take it with Dr. Anderson.  He's a fun guy, but is very disorganized.  We went most of the semester without syllabi.  Exams are usually straight forward, but expect to put in a tiny bit more than minimal amount of studying.  Good class.
Great teacher. He's what got me into psych. Really easy to follow, and knows what he's talking about.
great teacher, loved him!!

Dr. Anderson is the best psyc teacher I have taken.  His lectures are interesting and he makes class fun.  If you take notes and skim the book you should have no problem.  The only thing bad is he replies to emails very slow if not at all.

He is not an easy teacher, you need to take notes in class and pay attention as well as read the book in order to do well on the exams. But he's got a good humour and most of the time, interresting lectures. He takes atendance every day (10% of grade)

Great lectures! Make sure you do the readings for the exams though. He sometimes asks specific questions from the readings- but overall, if you do the reading and go to class you can learn a lot and do well in the class.

awesome guy!!practicing clinician that brings his street smartness into the class.sometimes a talking Hallmark card, but you leave the classroom with the feeling that you learnt something about human psychology + stays with you after taking the class

The absolute BEST teacher every.  He can make even boring things interesting.  I've had him 3 semesters now (200, 285, 380) and I'm going to miss him next semester.  If you can take any class with him, DO IT!
No Comments
No Comments
Great teacher!! He gives interesting and informative lectures.
He's done it all. He teaches, he practices, and he used to teach kindergarten!!

He is such an amazing teacher. I've had two classes with him and he's very kind. You can tell he loves his job. I'd recommend taking him, truly my favorite professor at UMBC. Also if you don't understand something don't be afraid to ask. He literally wants to help you.

Dr. Caruso definitely comes off as a little intimidating to approach at first. He's pretty blunt with his input, but all of his advice was invaluable when there was a problem with our experiment and he was very encouraging as well! Exams weren't too hard, but don't underestimate them! There's only two and can make or break an A or B.

Can't tell who I hated more - this class or the professor. This man is so grumpy and the class is so difficult. Makes you do pointless presentations every week, completely useful and angry, and the exams are so difficult they don't even cover what he teaches during lecture. He's gives such bad explanation, and prep for exams

The instructor was funny in the lecture and helpful in the lab. The phage class was a lot of work, but most of the class got an A and almost everyone else got a B, so I don't think he's a tough grader. It was fun doing experiments, so if you want to do that kind of thing, it's a good choice. If you don't like research at all, maybe not for you.

Very passive aggressive both talking to him in person and via email, professor was funny during lecture, but was very rude in one on one conversations. Class was taught with Tracy Smith: There were no clear grading criteria on lab reports, exams were extremely difficult, and lab reports made up the most of the grade and were graded extremely late.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good class to take if you like wet lab type of stuff. Professor gets grumpy sometimes and comes off as rude. Tough grader but not the worst professor ever. I recommend the course and the prof isn't terrible. I took him again for the spring semester and it was fine. Attendance is mandatory. Participation in art is also mandatory, but that's expected
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He's a good professor and very accommodating but he has a short temper. DO NOT take phage hunters (unless you're good with lab) as it's very disorganized & takes a lot of work outside class. 1 TA is extremely helpful. Exams are based on lecture slides & paper but u need to remember details. I highly recommended taking regular lab
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I do not like this professor at all. He is very micro aggressive and rude. I barely even passed this course and the whole phage format was hell on earth. Please take the spring version of the lab but just not with this prof

I would not retake a class with this professor. He is rude and I do have a weird micro aggressive exchanges with him. The exams are tough and detailed so make sure you don't study at the last minute. Too much reading and the lectures aren't helpful one bit

I had a terrible time taking this class. TA's were awful and no help at all. The professor was nice but hard to reach out to sometimes. The exams were very difficult and had no idea how to prepare for them. Also need to take a bunch of outside time in class to prepare for things. Very work heavy and should be higher than 2 credits.

Labs required LOTS of outside scheduled lab time so be prepared for that. Quizzes are easy and I love my TA's! It was draining at first because my phage keeps failing but eventually it got better. Midterm was not bad at all, but the final exam is something else so be prepared for that also! Lots of T/F questions, questions about readings, etc.

I thought he was pretty okay. In comparison to other professors in bio, 10/10. He can be a little rude though. the class has a lot of paper you have to read and KNOW. Our midterm and final were mainly about the papers we read in INCREDIBLE DETAIL. it kicked our behinds. The TAs grade most of the stuff but for exams its hard to be fully prepared
I do not like this professor. I can't ask him anything he's so unapproachable and rude. The tests are hard and his grading is annoying. He barely also curves

The class is all over the place and he does not prepare you for exams at all. I didn't even know what to study and the study guide he gives is only somewhat useful. He forced  weekly presentations and forces you to come outside lab. He's unapproachable and the ta are useless  so you're pretty much screwed if you need help

This professor made the lab so engaging and enjoyable! The exams required real understanding, not memorization, and TAs did the gradings. The presentations, though kind of made me anxious, built my confidence and made me feel like a scientist. Stay on top of tasks, and an A is achievable!
There are plenty of ways to earn points, just get them done!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The ta does all the grading which tends to be pretty easy grader. You must look over syllabus for the quizzes which aren't easy and exams are VERY difficult so you have to use the study guide and memorize every topic. He is in fact unapproachable and has an attitude from time to time but generally is a nice guy.

Exams were harder than predicted. Cares a lot and is passionate about this topic. Can be sassy sometimes. Overall funny guy, but can go on and on during lectures. Most of the grading is done by TA. Prepare to come into lab outside of scheduled time OFTEN.

This class has sparked genuine scientific curiosity, thanks to Dr, Caruso's chill vibe and infectious enthusiasm. 

Lab is online via Labster. Take this class instead of the water class!!

Great professor. He might seem tough at first, but if you talk to him, he's pretty understanding and sensible.  The class was really interesting, though his lectures go on a little long.  There's a lot of major deadlines in and out of lab, but if you pay attention in lecture, you'll be fine.  Be prepared to come to lab outside of scheduled time.
His lectures were honestly very interesting and he was always very helpful during the labs.

Prof.Caruso restored my faith in UMBC's Biology department. After taking BIOL141 w/ Feeser, I was ready to drop Biology as my major. He was helpful & clear when answering questions, lectures were organized and easy to follow. He cares about individual students and wants everyone to succeed. He's passionate about the topic & grades work quickly.

The professor was friendly and approachable to help students. Whoever said his exams were fair they definitely were not. They are very tough and hard to study for. You need to pay very close attention to details in lectures and labs to get a good grade. Quizzes although tough are easier than the exams
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Caruso is a professor who is very passionate about his work, which in turn made you feel passionate about the class. This class was adjusted into a bioinformatics format (more like 316L) for the pandemic. As long as you went to class, you would be fine. A lot of work outside of class though. The final was difficult, but it was curved.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: The lab was adjusted so it is more bioinformatics. I understand the pandemic made labs different, but at least let us know before signing up for a bioinformatics lab instead of genetics. Final was the absolute worst. I had an A all semester and caruso tested us on the SMALLEST details of the semester. TAKE AFTER THE PANDEMIC ENDS, NOT WORTH IT.

He has a very different personality in class and during his office hours. He's very engaging and clear in class. If your the type of student who plans on coming to his office, do not take any of his classes. He is very disrespectful and annoyed when students come in for help.

He's a good guy. Taking BIOL 109 as a winter course is definitely more fun than Science of Water, but the content can be a bit more difficult if you're not STEM-oriented/experienced. The class content isn't hard and he makes things easy to understand. Bonus points if you're into bears I guess.

Dr. Caruso is a good Professor. In this class, he teaches students how to do scientific research independently. To me, this was amazing because I could work at my own pace and be responsible for my own experiments. Also, be prepared to write a scientific research paper over the entire semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Would take again

reviews.comment: Dr. Caruso makes this class as close to a real life lab experience as it can get. You do have to come to class outside of regular class hours, but its likely you wont have to stay the whole time during your class. You also have to buy a poster at the end of the class, but you don't have to buy a text book. One of the best classes I've taken.

Dr. Caruso gives very engaging lectures for lead-offs. He is very funny! However, he can do a better job at explaining the rationale behind protocols in lab. His exams are tough! Make sure you know EVERYTHING. Although hes overall a nice guy, he can have his moments where he isnt too friendly and is intimidating to approach for questions.

Really nice, hilarious and knowledgable. Labs weren't bad and you often leave early. Have to come into lab outside of lab time to check on plates.  It's imperative you read the articles he assigns-key points will appear on quizzes and exams. Exams are all free response and T/F based on data analysis, protocol rationale, and the assigned readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Caruso is an awesome professor and he even gave us the PDF for the lab manual. Yes, you have to come in outside of lab time to succeed, but he doesn't ask you to spend an unreasonable amount of time there. He is a fair grader, funny man, and very knowledgable about any errors you may run into!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr Caruso is very helpful and organized . He is very clear on what you have to do . He is willing to answer your question . I think he is on of the best instructor in the Bio department at umbc

Dr. Caruso is very clear and informative. If you want to pass, you should attend every lecture and lab and TAKE LOTS OF NOTES. His lectures are engaging- he answers student questions & will re-explain if you don't understand a concept. Overall, an excellent professor! (he also has a sense of humor- he made a Game of Thrones reference in our final)

Show up to lecture and pay attention and you may not even have to read the book. I slacked off towards the end of the course but Still got a B. Reading the book helps clarify and reinforce whats said in lecture or vice versa. Easiest Bio class ive taken at umbc hands down

Dr. Caruso makes you earn your grade. His tests are hard, but not unreasonable. If you understand all the labs really well, either by reading them before lecture, or going into office hours, and not skipping labs, you will get a B for sure. Monday lab couldn't get as much help as the other labs, because lecture is Friday.

Dr. Caruso is a nice guy and is pretty approachable.  If you need help from him, it's your responsibility to get it.  His exams were difficult but fair.  The lab (Phage Hunters) requires you to make time outside of class to come in but it's pretty rewarding to see one experiment come to fruition.  I got an A, but I didn't skimp at all.
Great lecturer but writes frustrating tests like the others said. He told us there would be no curve so people dropped but THEN gave a 7% curve! Take his class but be prepared to fight on his tests.

He is seriously one of the best biology professor at UMBC. He actually teaches and you learn a lot from him. I admire him a lot and I know i would of gotten a better grade if I had studied a little better for the exams.

WARNING!let me tell you, he was ridiculous.If you want to play logic games,I recommend you take his class.his tests get harder each time like different levels in a game. they are extremely tricky and he wasn't very helpful.I have a name for him "trick master".on the exam, all his options are the same but if you pick the wrong answer, its GAME OVER.
Approachable and helpful. Difficult material, but uses an inexpensive lab manual (~$7) instead of an expensive textbook.

Not helpful when I visited him in his office plus he is disrespectful. I guess you do not have any choice since he is the only 302L teacher at UMBC. He made 302L hard. Ask TA questions that you don't understand, but not him. Do not seek help from him.
Great teacher! First biology teacher I've had at umbc that was willing to teach and chat during class. He lectured from powerpoint slides that he posted and he was as clear as could be.
I should have known better, you should know better also. Run away.

A full-time lecturer, and it shows! The best professor I've ever had. Actually enjoys answering questions. Take advantage of his helpfulness, especially if you have him in your actual lab section (usually Monday). A midterm and final are the only exams, but there are weekly quizzes, which are not hard. Make sure to prepare for lab ahead of time.

The "textbook" is a cheap lab manual that has crucial information for how to do the labs. It's also available as a pdf. A lot of the stuff is very intuitive. The Arabinose lab is extremely complicated. Out of the 6 or so you do, that's the hardest. The fruit fly simulations are all theory--and done with pen, paper and computer. Very stimulating.

I took a couple of classes from him for Bio. He is very helpful, fair and nice. I think he is better as a higher level class teacher though, because he wants you to ask informed questions, of course, as freshmen, we always expect the teacher to say what we want to know before looking in the book :) He is a good person who loves what he does.

Good professor but didnt like the teaching technique with the team based learning. It was hard  though. Have to work hard over all and do alot on your own. Exams were also very hard after the first one.

He's very cheerful and really knows his stuff. He's helpful and intelligent and presents everything you need to know very clearly. I only did poorly because I got a stomach virus and missed a key section of the class. So, when you get into the gene sequencing, don't miss any related classes or labs at any cost!

I had him for bio109 and we learned pointless crap and did pointless labs the class reminded me once again why non major lab science classes were pointless to take... Half the class hated him half got along with him he i personally hated him

Very good teacher. Respects students that come to learn and put effort forward. Was always willing to help during his office hours, never made you feel bad for misunderstanding material. Overall A grade teacher!
Upstandish when I visited in office hours last year. Not very clear either.
His interest in the subject makes him a really great lecturer.

Good lecturer. Poor exam maker. Ask questions if there is a problem on the exam that confuses you, and he'll try to steer you to the right answer. The book was useless so I wouldn't buy it. Overall the class was fine and there was a really nice curve.

Professor over simplifies lecture material and then asks complicated exam questions. Asks questions like 'one of the above, two of the above, all, none'. The tests increase in difficulty after each time. THe book is completely useless. Overall, I got a C, but I really had to struggle and study hard!

the class is very difficult. memorize the lecture slides because a lot of his questions are straight recall. Read the book as it will have info on his exams that arentfrom lecture notes. Stressful but there is a nice curve at the end. 84 for an A, 71 for a b, 54 for a C in my year. Each exam is harder than the one before so do well in the beginning

He is a very funny lecturer and does his best to keep the class's interest because it is 2 hours long. Approachable and has videos/pictures to demonstrate difficult concepts. Only downside is the exams get harder every  single time and quite tricky.
He's ok. Decent lecturer but his tests are really difficult. You need to study your ass off just to get a B or C.

really great professor. his exams are difficult, but if you argue your point, he sometimes changes the answer key. very helpful, and very funny, i would highly suggest taking him.  dont need the book, just memorize his slides and you'll do good on his exams...

AMAZING professor! very clear and has a good sense of humor. Shows old exams which helps alot. Only thing is, that he one time went on a rant about how there was so much evidence against intelligent design. It was apparent what his opinion was about creation vs. evolution and i think that it shouldnt have been brought up at all.

he explains things clearly. He know's how to teach very well and knows the material extremely well. I had a good learning experience in his class. I'd take him again. I think he's better than most of the biology professors here.

Dr. Caruso is very arrogant.  He takes pride of having his Phd in Genetics.  He thinks that he knows everything.  His tests are very hard, he called his test "Lecture Test," that means you dont have to read the text but in actuality you do.  His lectures are extremely boring.  He writes his notes for 2 hours everday. He makes Genetics boring.
Ugh.

Very good professor! Made genetics fun and interesting. Don't need to read the book at all, just go to his lectures and take good notes and you will pass. All exams are based on what he says in class! Def. take Genetics with Caruso!

Okay teacher. Can get off topic.  At the beginning of the semester was very helpful, but towards the end wasn't as helpful. He never answered my emails, or if he did, it is a week or two later. He doesn't thoroughly explain what course material is going to be on the exams.

Took a 30-45 min lecture and made it last 75 mins every week. He knows no matter how many times he says something people will still mess it up so he repeats things again and again, which is lousy for the people who get it the first time. Other than that the labs are straightforward and easy. Take the quizzes seriously - you'll really help yourself

I dont know what the first two people are talking about. I am AWFUL when it comes to science and I was so nervous about taking a science class but I ended up getting a B in the class and that too after I slacked off for a bit. My exam grades weren't all that but I did well in the EASY labs. TAKE THIS CLASS FOR YOUR GFR
Good teacher. Much better than the Water course.

Bad teacher. Me and my roomate honestly had everything we ever did in lecture totally covered and got C's on the exam. His exam did not belong in our class. My TA even told me they thought the exam was "BS" thankfully the TA did their best to make up for his unfairness with kind lab grades. Caruso you are a JOKE.

Its a fair amount of material covered in a short period of time but he does it well. I can handle science courses fairly well so I may be bias to the other non-majors. This class is a good pick but dont expect an easy A. Show up, and for your own sake study a little every week for the quizes. The exams are pretty tough but you'll manage.
hilarious guy and friendly.  easy teaching style and is comprehensive.  MUCH friendlier and easier to talk to, and overall, a better teacher than Sandoz.  definitely a high priority guy to take

Before taking this class, I heard great things about Caruso. Naturally, the class got increasingly more difficult, but at an insane extent. We were doing 300 level work (cloning) even though we weren't bio majors. Despite being a 100 level course, the class avg was 57% on the final. Take sci 100. Your graed will thank you.

Caruso is a professor I would take again. He has a sense of humor, is laid back, doesn't kill on exams, and makes lectures bearable, if not enjoyable. My only critique is that sometimes he talked as though he was talking down to us. A professor worth taking! You'll probably enjoy him!

Very good teacher. Does a good job explaining hard concepts. Makes lectures engaging and interesting. Very approachable, and always willing to help. You should take him instead of Sandoz for lab, because he is a better teacher, even though his class is harder and you do twice as much.
Great teacher, tough grader.

Funny, engaging in lectures, and made difficult concepts seem simple. A bit hard to approach one on one, as he seemed always busy with so many people in his class. I actually found the labs confusing, but this had more to do with the incoherency of the TA

Very good teacher! Very helpful when I had questions outside of class. Also gave very good lectures that made genetics a lot easier to understand. Also ver interested about subject and knows a lot. Very easy to get in touch with (around alot) and leniant.
funny guy, tries his hardest to make concepts clear. willing to help at all times, but sometimes can get a little moody. still very approachable. says hi to me on campus outside of lab

material was easy enough, sometimes quizzes were kind of tough. easy labs and he gave interesting lectures. he could be kind of abrupt when you asked questions one on one. great for nonmajors needing a lab.
Good teacher, interesting class.
The material is somewhat hard but he makes a good effort.  Very student Oriented
Cool guy.  Material is kinda hard but he's a good teacher.
uggggggggggg this class broke me
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Guitierrez is helpful and patient. Taking a new language, these were the 2 requirements I needed from a teacher. He gives constructive feedback, he is accessible outside of class, and he enjoys teaching his language. This was my first time learning Spanish and I can converse properly. I am glad I took this class. All in all, A1 prof.

Easily the best Spanish professor for 101. Attendance is mandatory and he expects you to participate in class, but he's super understanding. He will work with you to get an A. Weekly online study plans/quizzes, 5 conversifi sessions, couple of writing journals/exams. Take him!

Not good at communicating about homework due dates. You can check MySpanishLab at the start of the week and see that nothing's due, then check back two days later and see that you missed an assignment. Very frustrating.
A native speaker with sympathy for his students. He definitely tried to relate to us about learning a second language, and was overall very understanding and patient. 10/10

Condescending, arrogant.  Midterm was 40% of total grade, 2 questions. The photocopied exam had a mark that looked like a neg sign, asked him about it during the test and he wouldn't clarify.  I copied it and carried through my work.  He laughed at me when I got my test back with a 50% because my answer was off by that negative sign.  Said "tough"

He seemed kind of mean at first when we had the lectures, but when we started working on the project, he opened up and actually had a great sense of humor.  The project is pretty straightforward, but you need to work hard on the lab reports.  There are no exams at all, so lab reports make up 100% of the grade.
Best Engineering Professor. Tip: Don't play games with him.

Dr. Tasch is very intimidating and comes off as very mean, but in reality he is a fantastic professor. He explains everything very well and will help you if you need it. He has a funny side to him that he shows occasionally. Attendance is mandatory and he does not tolerate lateness or lip. He is extremely smart as well.

Comes off arrogant and mean initially however on a personal level he is a great teacher. Always available for help and has a genuine intest not only in the subject but also in teaching it well so student can succeed.

Great Teacher, He really helped the class with everything, he saw that we were having problems, and he helped us through the bad times, he even gave up a very simple and short final on the problems that he told us to study

"Im not yelling at you Im speaking in a yelling manner"  He honestly wants to see you do well, and is always available, always.  Homework isnt too bad, so long as you actually put a little effort into it.
an odd little man with a funny accent. will occasionally say something funny. Can be condescending at times, but seems willing to help with any difficulties you may have with the material.
He explained it 1 way, and that is it. I did not like him
HARD class + foreign teacher = bad combination

She is an awesome professor! Her stories were very interesting. You need the textbook for the class, but you can buy an used copy. If you put in the effort and try, she will really try to help you out. Do the homework for the class! It has all the answers to everything in her class. I would definitely take her class again!

Professor Uma Saini is a very good professor. I had her for 101, 102, and 201 and got an A every time. She will help you when you are struggling, and she is very sweet. If you take your time and study then you will do great in the class. Its a 4 credit class so you have to put the work in it.
Save your self the effort and time and do not take her class. Take your language credit at a CC or even take a non difficult language.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She is something, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS AS AN EASY CLASS. Her grading is very arbitrary, so please save yourself some time and your GPA and do not take this class with her. Even if you know other Indian Languages, she makes the subject herder than it needs to be. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I love Umaji. She is an amazing professor who really cares about her students learning and passing. The textbook is a workbook, so you absolutely need a new copy. She went out of her way to teach her students, and I loved her class so much. Even though I was not very good at the language, she spend to much time trying to help me learn the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: What a great teacher
Best teacher ever

Not sure what all the fuss is about. Ghosh is a nice guy and a fine teacher. Read the textbook and make sure you know how to do the homework. HW Solutions are posted after it is due. If you do the above, you'll do fine on the exams.

Your grade depends on 3 exams and a final and a book report in a chem e class. The first exam average was a 47%, which he intentionally made exceedingly difficult. His lectures are nothing more than reading the textbook, and his homework solutions are usually wrong.  His only interest is in his research, he could not care less about his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: The material is not hard, the one grading it is. He does not grade fairly. He seems to make rudimentary choices on who he gives credit to and why. He also did not come to some of his own exams. He was not always in his own office hours and never sent an email to indicate otherwise. If he was in his office, he was on the phone. Poor professionalism.

Dr. Ghosh is not like any of the other professors that most students have had in chemE. He does not bother to learn our names and only cares about his research and not teaching us the actual content of the class. That being said, the topics in the class are very interesting, I just wish I knew/could apply them.
Ummm, she gives way to much homework than is acceptable for full time students.

She talks down to the students as if she is better than us. She can be rude. If you have a question that she doesn't know the answer to, she will ask one of the students in the class for help. WAY too many homework assignments that are repetitive to the classwork. Homework is worth more than tests -__- Attendance plays a huge part in your grade.

She gives WAY too many in class projects and crazy amounts of HW. Very hard to reach and works during the days. Is a very tough grader and doesn't really help very much!!! ACTUALLY GIVES IN CLASS EXAMS. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND AT ALL.
A personable, and helpful teacher.  Will help if you ask.  Tries to connect material to actual, real life application.  Whichever school has her as a professor will be lucky, students will be lucky.

Would I take it again? Heck no. Unnecessary workload, don't even know why my major (HAPP) need me to take this class. Busy work TEXTBOOK IS YOUR FRIEND in this class, honestly. Follow the book and you'll be fine. The prof can be a pain when it comes late assignments (hypocritical). She can be 2weeks behind in grading, but won't accept late hw...

She was a very nice teacher, everything is on the syllabus and books. Her teaching style can be controversial- if you ask for her help and she doesn't know it, you are on your own. Turn your assignments in! period. She is hypocritically strict, she can be late in grading our hw, but will not accept late assignments, EVEN if it was 1 minute late...
No Test or Exam Just weekly projects inform of homework easy though just follow the textbook steps. Shes really good and fair with gradding. Talk to her if you have any problem she will help
Great class!  Jay always keeps it interesting and he's a great teacher.  Highly recommend.

Had low expectations coming out of HB1 in terms of staying interested and alert but Jay made it really great.  Very smart and had a lot of knowledge to share and did so in an interesting, informative way.  Included videos which were illustrative.  Love love love his self-depricating sense of humor, its funny w/o being pathetic.  Great Prof recommen
Great teacher!  loved his class despite low interest in topic. already signed up with him next semester.
Intelligent and organized presentation of material. On top that, great sense of humor. He also gives interesting examples to hammer home concepts.  He's basically the man.

J is hilarious! He curses a lot and makes research kinda fun. He is aware of how boring it can be but attempts to make a fun activity.  Grades based on a midterm, a final, and a research paper that you write in sections starting the 3rd wk of class. He is very approachable. Exams are a lil tough but you can def get A if u pay attn and go to class

Very intelligent and knowledgeable about the subject.  Teaches all chapters thoroughly via powerpoints and is very clear about what he will test on.  One paper that is done in four sections, fairly easy grader.  Would recommend this professor.

Good luck trying to contact her or get her to read your emails. She cancelled our meeting, said she'd read my email, and never replied. She also has graded 1 project of 5 projects and the last day of class is in 2 weeks.

Very saddening! Often fails to grade assignments on time. Some of the assignments were ungraded well after the semester ended. Barely replies to the emails, even though the course is completely online. The course is poorly designed. She blamed the wrong grade being displayed throughout the semester due to a Blackboard error, and did not fix it.

Ms. Caitlin is a caring and supportive instructor. While the Bio 233 textbook is a necessary requirement, the course itself is manageable for students who stay on top of their assignments and deadlines.

This is my first time taking this professor and had a great experience. The class is a 400 level hybrid 6 week course on antibiotics. Despite the quick session the class was extremely easy. Prof. Varisco is an easy grader as long as you follow the syllabus. She does give extra credit opportunities and makeup assignments with proper documentation.

BIOL 101 not 233. Not sure what the other reviews are getting at—Professor Varisco is one of the best professors I've had at UMBC. She's incredibly kind, supportive, and genuinely cares about her students' success. She provides lots of extra credit opportunities and she's always willing to meet outside of class if you're struggling.

She made students purchase a $75-$110 textboook and assigned only like 10 pages through the ENTIRE semester. Although it was first time teaching nutrition, I feel like I was forced to memorize her slides instead of actually learning. Quizzes and exams were often pulled straight from her slides where she did not explain it in her lecture vids.

Varisco relied on dense slides-reading directly from them with little explanation&made class feel overwhelming, w/ quiz/exam based on irrelevant info. Nutrition should be engaging,but wasn't.The course felt unproductive, with memorization over understanding.The groupproject was also weird-analyzing students' eating habits.

This professor is horrible; she doesn't care about the class or her students. Additionally, she takes forever to grade assignments. It's the end of the semester, and she has only graded one assignment (our first lab). However, the class is so easy that it doesn't really matter, and she barely interferes with any of the labs.
Very caring and lenient, not a lot of work outside of class and doesn't mind your pronunciation. I'd take her for all my Spanish courses if possible!
Took for SPAN101, she creates a really friendly learning environment for writing and especially speaking. Easy to understand and little homework outside of class compared to the other professors.

Took her for spanish 101, goated professor, attendance is mandatory. She expects you to read the textbook but other then that shes a great teacher and is good at understanding. I don't like spanish myself but if i had to take this class again id take her 100%

She's amazing. If you're doing 101 take her. Conversations may make you nervous but i promise you i absolutely did horrible on a couple and still got either an A or B on them. She just wants you to understand what she's saying, not looking for perfection. Participate, I missed an evaluation and she extended it, cause I participated.

She's really good, I'm unsure why she doesn't have many ratings. She was a good professor. The course can be intense at times. The conversations can be intimidating but overall the class was fine. There are just times she can get frustrated kind of easily.

I'm surprised there are no reviews for her! She's a very understanding professor. Although she's a native Spanish speaker, she doesn't make you feel bad for mistakes. She has no control over the curriculum and assignments, but she keeps it as light as possible. Stay on top of assignments, and you'll pass. If you take Span 101, I recommend her!

I can tell the professor is a kind, compassionate person and is passionate about her lectures. She encourages critical thinking and ties what we're learning to real world events. Minimal work and clear instructions on assignments and projects.
She must have improved since these ratings because this class may have been the easiest class I have taken. A LOT of homework, but I would suggest you use "outside" help and you will be fine.

The course is easy but arduous. There is a lot of busy work. She asks that you watch documentaries and read the textbook and articles. The class isn't hard, but Prof Valencia makes it hard and hard to attend. Lectures are boring and confusing; there is no clarity on what we need to take notes on and what we don't.

Middle of the semester, she randomly implemented a participation grade that wasn't in the syllabus previously. Not sure if she's allowed to do that. The assignments and exams are easy, but they're kinda common sense if you've ever taken human geo classes in HS, so people didnt rly go to her lectures
Great professor! Very nice and would recommend her
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Honestly, I don't know why some of y'all complained about open book tests. She was very nice, and was very accommodating towards people.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: BEWARE IF YOU HAVE ACCOMMODATIONS. I wish I never enrolled in this class. She ignored both of my accommodation letters from the school and fought with me when I would try to use them. She would also make mean and backhanded comments about how I needed accommodations, not only to me via email, but to the whole class every time I had an issue.
dont even try to take her, avoid at all costs

She seems like a nice person but takes forever to get back grades and she makes exams worth a lot of points which isn't helpful because her multiple choice qs are worth 5 points each and her short answer qs are worth 15 points each. Just a few mess ups and that's it for your grade
Lecture heavy, nice person but tough professor
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Very sweet person and does care a lot about her students. She is a tough grader when it comes to papers and having the correct responses to questions that she may ask you. Overall I do recommend taking her and you will not be disappointed.

Dr. Valencia is a great professor who actually challenges you. I probably got more out of the one class I took with her than I did from every other class GES class I took combined. That said, the class did involve a lot of readings (probably 100+ pages per week) and she had high expectations. If you are in college to LEARN - take her class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: She is a very tough person to please. I'm not happy with how the class is organized. She is all over the place and changes her mind after assignments are graded. She is a very hard grader and expects way too much out of undergrad students. She only wants Grad level material and unfortunately for me that causes a lot of stress to do that.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She expects too much for her students. Not easy to please. She asigns way too much reading for her class. Not happy how she changes her criteria on what she expects for her students to do. She will tell you that your assignment's should include a reading or some sort of article after you have completed the assignment and turned it in for a grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Overall she is a very nice person and does care about her students. Unfortunately I gave her a low rating because she is grading as if we are in Grad school. Very difficult to receive a good grade on any work you get unless you have Grad school knowledge. She is a very tough grader and gives a ton of reading. So be prepared for intimidation.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: ONE OF THE BEST PROFESSORS OF ALL TIME. ONLY TAKE 411 WITH THIS MAN. IF YOU HAVE TO DELAY IT A SEMESTER, THEN DO IT. IF YOU COME TO CLASS AND DO THE WORK YOU WILL GET AN A. best professor of all time. also he is super passionate abt his work.
I can count with one hand all the good comp sci professors at umbc, and he's one of them!!!

Best class I have ever taken. All I had to do was to show up to class and follow the lectures. The HW are really easy if you follow the lectures and even if you don't you can just look at the slides. The midterm and the final were both take home and we had 2 weeks to do it.

One of the best teachers I've had at umbc. He cares about student learning and tries to get everyone to participate. Slides are informative and exams where entirely online and open book. Great class, great professor 10/10 would take again.

One of the best professors I had at UMBC. He is extremely caring and friendly.
His course is innovative. Beautiful slides. He is an amazing speaker with humor.
He cares about student learning. He treats everyone with respect.
Attendance is mandatory. Exams and Homeworks test classroom learning. 
Overall, great learning and great experience.

He is the most likeable professor I've had at UMBC so far. He's extremely lenient but at the same time he wants each specific student to be retaining the content being taught in class. He is very knowledgeable about the field and has good experience with his own labs. If CS 411 with him is available, he is the best option.

truly the most caring prof. i accidentally missed a 100 point assignment, making my final grade a B, but she let me turn in the assignment a month after the semester ended, and changed my final grade to an A. because you have to take prac 096 with this course, she doesnt give too many assignments, with the most difficult being a presentation.

attendance is graded but classes are hybrid. we used class time to learn about education in baltimore & work on group projects. class always finished early & i usually used the time as a free period. she's a rlly easy grader, super easy to get an A.
She is so amazing and was really understanding I am definitely going to sign up for one of her other classes in the future.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Williams, is an outstanding professor. She wants 's you to succeed in her classes. She does grade work late sometimes, and is very accommodating towards the students who missed the previous lectures! The course load can be very light depending on how you manage your time. Quizzes aren't complicated as long as you do the readings before class.

Professor Williams is amazing! I really enjoyed her FYS class and the assignments were not difficult as long as you do them ahead of time. There is a mandatory service requirement and another assignment where you have to attend one social justice event, but Dr. Williams provides you good resources to finish the assignments. She is also super sweet!

I took her in the Fall semester, she was amazing. You are graded by very few easy assignments. She gives a lot of extra credit. She would end class early, a lot. She's understanding, grades efficiently, and just overall very easy class to pass.

She is a wonderful professor. She does not give much homework and class goes by fast. She also likes to split the class into groups for small things, but it is never too challenging. Overall the class is one of the easiest classes I have taken, as long as you pay attention. You will be fine. She is accommodating and can help you if you need it.
Dr. Vickie Williams is very accommodating and caring.

The best professor i've ever had at UMBC. Dr. Williams is one of the most caring and kind professors that I have ever had. I've learned so much about child and education psychology. Our assignments were mostly discussion posts, the midterm was an easy MC test, and the final was a fun paper! TAKE HER!!! YOU'LL LOVE HER!!!

Wonderful Professor. She is everything one could look for in a good teacher. She groomed us to be sound professionals & made working w/her interesting & memorable experience. I will always be grateful for her support & kindness. She opened my eyes to new stages of opportunity & strength, & appreciate and treasure everything she taught me.

Her class was one of the easiest Ive ever taken. She almost is never clear with what you have to do but if you email or talk to her shes super understanding. The work is super easy and shes extremely sweet
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Williams is a very respectable and reasonable prof. She acknowledges not every student does well on tests and offers many extra credit opportunities. Syllabus is AWESOME! Explains everything clearly and includes syllabi for all assignments.

Professor Williams is very caring and responds to emails fast. Her exams are very fair and the homework is relatively easy. The content itself isn't very difficult. Tons of extra credit opportunities and ways to boost your grade. Attendance for online lectures are not mandatory and she records them so you can watch later. Definitely a good prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Gives so much extra credit it is hard not to get an A+

easiest class I've taken at UMBC. She's such a sweetheart and she tells adorable stories about her grandkids and her husband and otherwise we do nothing. I got 100% on every assignment even though half were turned in late. Class meets once every other week and always ends early.

She is my favorite person in this world. She has helped me with so many things in and outside of class and she is very understanding about missed assignments, etc. I took a class with her before and like this one, it was easy, engaging, and really gets me excited about becoming a teacher. I love her so much.
Excellent teacher who cares about her students! Accepts late work and does not make attendance mandatory. I would highly recommend this teacher if you're taking a FYS at UMBC.
nice
SHE IS AMAZING! ALSO MY ADVISOR! i turned into more than 5 assignments late and still received an A you'll also learn alot! I WISH SHE TAUGHT ALL EDUCATION COURSES

Dr. Williams is by far the most qualified member of UMBC's entire education department. Not only is she a great professor, she answered all of my questions when my clown of an advisor refused to email me back. She lays out crystal clear guidelines for her class, provides a fun environment and earning an A is quite easy. Take her!

Dr. Williams is a very sweet lady. She tries to make the course as easy and clear as possible and is one of the fairest and most lenient graders out there. My only two gripes is that EDUC 311 is basically a rehash of PSYC 100, and the weekly online modules are frustrating: though easy, take hours to do (with essays!) but only worth 35 points each.

Partially online. Went to class once a week. Very easy, but attend every class! Dr. Williams is all to forgiving and lets you turn in assignments late. If you attend class, you will receive at least a B.
Very nice teacher, reasonable guidelines. Final project was a group Powerpoint. As long as you try, you will get a good grade

She's friendly, knowledgeable about the subject and a very easy grader... but I personally found it kind of hard to be super interested in the class and sort of felt like it was a waste of my time and stuff I already learned. To be fair the education program is kind of like that in general; overall I would recommend her
Great teacher! Very kind and helpful. She cares about her students, and it shows!

EDUC412 was an extremely easy class. Half of the class was online/blackboard so you rarely had to come to campus. Assignments were in-depth, but she is a very generous grader. The course was very informative.  Vickie is great!

Excellent teacher who practices great teaching techniques in her classroom!  She cares about students' learning and wants to produce high quality teachers.  She is always available when students need her.  Would take her class again!

Oh Vickie! She is so taken advantage of and she knows it but she loves everyone. I loved this teacher she is such a spacey teacher. You can get away with not doing anything in her class and she will deliver an A. Totally a good class to take if you need to finish the dumb upper level requirements. Her laugh is very Fran Dresher.

Very easy teacher. Pretty much a review of PSYC 100 but with an education twist. If you take the night section, like I did, you get out of class by 6 usually and you have at least 3 classes that you do online instead of in class.

Dr. Williams is incredibly easy to get along with & makes it difficult to get anything other than an "A". My only complaint is that after putting effort into papers, etc., not much (if any) feedback is given.  Usually just "great job" or something similar.  Constructive criticism would be great (even on an A+ paper)

Dr. Williams puts everything you need to know for tests on powerpoints that she hands out to you.  Projects are easy, lots of groupwork. A good portion of the class is online, so you end up not going to class half the time.
Easy A...

Dr. Williams, formally a practicing psychologist, understands the process of education from the inside out. Learning does not have to be a difficult process, and I am sure that we all learn in her classes. Besides, much of her class time is filled with our presentations, so if we don't learn from one another, what's that say about us as teachers?

VERY easy.  Actually told us that "you have to try very hard not to get an 'A' in my class."  A couple powerpoint presentations, but nothing too difficult.  Almost all work done in groups.  DEF a GPA booster
She is VERY nice, very easy (A's all through) and very interested in diverse points of view. Great progessor and if you have a hard semester, take her class(es) just to be able to chill.

EASY A!  Reads straight from power points.  Not too time spent in class.  No surprises about what you are being graded on.  Don't stress over her work...its not hard.  Annoying laugh & is a little obsessed with equality in the classroom between boys and girls.

If you want to learn something about Educational Psychology do not take this class.  If you want an easy A or B do. She seems very nice but her (very rare) lectures are directly read from PP.  She gives out clear rubrics but almost no other guidance for the projects, which are 100% of your grade.

She is definitely an easy teacher, and has a great personality- but don't expect to get much else from the class. I hate to say it, but I felt like it was a waste of my time and money. I have taken two classes with her and walked away feeling cheated. If your looking for an easy class this is it.
She is a good teacher.She uses the principles she teaches.

nice teacher, annoying laugh, but really nice. cares about her students and love what she does. you work in groups a lot and write a few easy papers. class does not always meet, but she always tells you in advance and gives online assignments instead.

80 students $100 k of tuition collectively. Classroom next to the dining hall at noon - DJ's frequently blasted loud music.  Professor had access to advanced technology but she used 75% of the class  administering and reviewing quizzes.  Only 10 of the 18 chapt covered; I just don't think she knew how to manage the technology, a lot of mistakes.

In my opinion she was not fit to teach a difficult class like 311. She was disorganized at times and caused a lot of confusion throughout the semester with both course material and things like HW due dates. Also it was hard to take notes in some lectures because she rushed through the slides. Her office hours were helpful though.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor isn't bad the class is just tough. Go to office hours and you will get the help you need. Many people rate bad because of the jump on difficulty.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She's just disorganized and confusing. Sometimes I wish she would just put a youtube video and shut up. She's a sweet person but she struggles to teach and plan a class properly. The entire class is clueless and people chatgpt pop quizes (never enough time btw). The homework modules are helpful but are soooo long and homework is never extended.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Took online. Way more demanding than any summer class I had taken. I didnt feel like some of the stuff learned reflected on final or midterm. Had to 360 scan for exams
AVOID THIS PROFESSOR AT ALL COSTS. DOES NOT KNOW HOW TO TEACH AT ALL. VERY HARSH GRADING AND NOT MUCH TEACHING. I HIGHLY ADVISE YOU TO CHOSE ANOTHER PROFESSOR.

DO NOT TAKE. Easily the worst teacher I've taken at UMBC. Even when you need the extra help and you go to office hours, she might kick you out with the lackluster help she gave you because she isnt prepared for class. On quizzes she'll take off points for the most trivial things. She just reads off the slides and still isnt clear.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Syllabus stated that she would provide lectures and presentations. She didn't post lectures until a week and half before the class ended because a student emailed her about it. I did not have any problems with Prof. Webb, although the class was very easy for me and I do know some people who struggled. You have a quiz each week but she builds extra points into her quizzes and exams! She also is available for office hours each week! Very nice and understanding!

His 301 lectures are okay, but his 302 lectures are great.

If he asks you a question and you're lost, say that you don't know or you might end up awkwardly waiting 3 min for him to realize you don't know. Don't assume that he's being condescending; I think he's just socially awkward so he can def come off that way, but he's actually quite nice.

Not the worst, not the best. You're gonna have to do a lot of work outside of class to actually learn material. Exams were rough and too long but there was a big curve to compensate. He does his job, he's just mediocre at it.

This was the hardest math class I have ever taken. Mr. Kang's lectures were pretty much word-for-word from the textbook. He is a nice guy, but his teaching style is probably ineffective for most people. The exams were very difficult and VERY different from the homeworks. If you have to take this class, make sure you go to office hours or tutoring.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: People hate on this professor and say he's bad but he's probably the best math professor for this class trust. He has a crazy curve too I LOVE U KANG

Had him for 301; this class is much easier and focused on learning, rather than 301 being the "bad student filter". Lectures were not well organized; however, listening to what he says makes it followable, and he answers questions very well; super smart guy
HWs were tough (but easy grading), but completing them will prepare for exam (graded hard)

He never slows down, writes incredibly small, and is really good at answering questions without actually answering them. He does his lecture line by line from the given textbook. When I was taking the class I learned more from just reading the sections over and over again and practicing every homework question. I recommend going to office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: 301 is a tough class; lots of HW, test heavy, brutal grading. However, he was a better teacher than most people say - good, articulate speaker, just messy whiteboard. Lectures definitely provided great baseline for doing HW, with some supplementary reading in the textbook. WORK HARD ON HW, because using this to study for exams is smart

Lectures are not clear/helpful for understanding the content, is an incredibly harsh grader on exams and does not give feedback. He is known to curve, but regardless does not teach well. Skips a lot of crucial content for 301. Exam/quiz averages were regularly below 60%, but he blamed that on us rather than himself. 
Overall not a good professor.

He just reads off the textbook in a super thick accent and then condescendingly asks if you understand. The topics are not very difficult when you actually finally learn them yourselves so it just makes to so much more frustrating to know how bad he is. Harshest Grader I have ever taken test scores on the final being sub 60 is pretty much average.

After getting above average on all of the exams (given the averages were horrible, at around 50% on all of them), and getting an A average on the homework, The final exam was THE WORST thing ever imaginable. He does not teach well, you will learn EVERYTHING outside of class. I would rather drop out than take 301 with Kang again. Nice guy, but jeez.

he is not a helpful professor, very condescending when u ask him a question during lecture. he would ask the other students if they understood it n he pretended the answer was obvious. exam was harder than the hw problems, started to skip cuz lectures were boring. if there is another professor, take him. NEVER TAKE KANG IF YOU DONT HAVE TO!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are boring. There were questions on exams that were only briefly mentioned one time and weren't in the textbook. Homework is useless and too much. It weights 30% of the grade and it can take up to 12 hours every week to complete all of it, yet the professor only grades like 5 random questions out of 50, making your grade dependent on luck.

Lectures were too fast paced, and impossible to take notes on because of regular board erasure. When he received complaints, he did attempt to accommodate students by printing and distributing needed notes himself, but they were illegible due to low quality printing and small font.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. Exams are heavy in this class and grading criteria for them are not clear. Bad feedback from exams and if you mess up it's very hard to salvage your grade. Reads off the textbook word for word, he writes on the chalkboard with very small handwriting and doesn't upload notes to Blackboard. Not worth it, take someone else

The worst prof I've had at UMBC. He just writes word for word from the textbook on the chalkboard in illegible handwriting and copies sample questions.  Doesn't give ANY feedback on homework and assigns 30 questions and only grades 5.  He knew the class was struggling and did not curve.  Does not listen to student feedback on how to improve.
Hard grader and never gives exams back.

Not too bad if and only if you are so good at math. The class is hard to understand. Homework was ok, you have a week too but it takes a lot of time. Exams are multiple parts and are pretty hard it doesn't come from HW or lectures, not that I felt. This class is about memorizing the material through the book.

This class was ridiculous. He doesn't divert from the textbook at all. All of the theorems and definitions are quoted word for word then not elaborated upon, same with examples. Homework was ok but you're never given any valuable feedback. Tests are worth the bulk of your grade and only consist of five questions. Read the text and skip the lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly not too bad, we do get a whole ton of homework though but you have a week to complete it (so don't wait last minute). Exams are typically 4-5 questions with some having multiple parts. They arent too hard pretty similar to homework problems. Most of it is teaching yourself the material thought.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Teaches word for word the textbook, just read the book a few times and skip class. Plus his handwriting for online is terrible. Provides absolutely 0 feedback for wrong answers on homework on tests . Also seems to be very difficult to contact outside of class time via email, and even if you can contact him his explanations are not good.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: AVOID HIM AT ANY COST!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Not helpful at all. His lectures only consisted of copying theorems and examples from the textbook. He admitted himself that we were way ahead of schedule, but didn't choose to slow down the pace of his class. This is not a course that should have been held asynchronously.

One of the worst Professors I've had at UMBC. Online lectures are just a direct copy of the textbook and had distracting sounds. The pacing was way too fast compared to the other Lin Alg classes that I found myself struggling to keep up and no time to study previous material. Take this class In another semester, do not take it with this guy.

Doesn't post notes or exam/quiz solutions online. Expect problems on quizzes and exams to be somewhat irrelevant (if exam is on chapter 1,2,3,4,5 sometimes only 4 and 5 would be on exam). Good enough if you understand and are proficient enough in math, but those who struggle if not given materials this class can be tricky. Doesn't respond to emails

I am currently taking his summer course and the class is honestly not that bad, but i get why some people may not like him. He has a bit of an accent and there are times where he can explain things clearly, and other times where he doesn't. I would suggest reading the textbook, as he picks problems from the homework on the exams a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: I took this class during the summer session. The class was practically useless, he just went over the book examples and book explanations; but the book is useless in the first place. No supporting material to study from was given, and he was very, very harsh with grading. Gave a lot of lengthy homework. Teach yourself or you wont pass.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Required weekly written HW for 30% of grade. 3/10 are graded for accuracy (randomly picked)  Can be understood without a problem (accent-wise)  Kinda funny  Goes through things slowly and clearly  Class gets exponentially harder as you go on. Get an A on the first exam, you won't on the final.  Most linalg profs here are bad. He's fine.

Dr. Kang is an amazing professor. If you attend office hours regularly there is no reason you should not get an A.  Although he is a tough grader he understands the subject so well that his proofs are clear and in depth. I could be bias since he is my master thesis advisor
Good course and great professor!  Explained concepts well.  Proved many important results on stochastic processes.  Proofs were in depth enough, but didn't waste time on obvious details.
I would give him a 0 if i had the chance. Absolutely worst professor ever. DO. NOT. TAKE. HIS. CLASS.

He is literally. Without a doubt. the WORST math professor at UMBC. His expectations are incredibly unclear and the class has a terrible structure. I have so many things to say, but if it boils down to this. If your schedule is full, and your only option is to take his class, wait a semester. All you will do is suffer if you stay in his class.

No point in going to lecture, other than to turn in homework. Homework assignments are challenging, much more extensive than the lecture. Lecture is a very condensed summary of the text, with examples straight from the text (none original). You will never know what to expect on the exams - they're formatted differently than lecture and HW examples.

I often found lectures to be useless in helping me successfully complete the homework and in helping me study for exams. I never knew what was expected of me. Tests on subjects that cannot be found in the book and for which there are no other outside resources.

Fair grading and always lectured on material needed for homework and exams. No quizzes. Grade was mostly based on exams. All the exam questions were based off of questions from the book. Loved this class!

Absolutely awful professor. Difficult to understand, very condescending, and gets upset when students ask questions. Exams did not test material that was lectured; lectures came right from the book, which was otherwise useless. Exam questions written in a very convoluted and confusing manner. Avoid this professor, no matter the class.
Worst class of my life.  Was lucky to get a C, and I am usually an A student.  Avoid at all costs.

Math modeling was very straightforward. Lectures were logical and concepts were explained clearly. Homework and tests are representative of the expectations. I got an A, and I didn't spend a ton of time on the class. One exception: the final was a lot more difficult than the other tests. FYI.
