His tests are much harder than the homework assignments, which are also hard. I like math, but disliked this class. Lectures were long and hard to follow. He would only do 3 problems a class, hardly covering what was on the homework. Really harsh on grading. I learned the topics well through the book, but still hard to prepare for his exams.
Good Professor, I did a review on this professor and he turned out to be pretty good. Just gets a bit dry at times. Hard to find a good Calc 3 teacher.... Recommend.

I took STAT 121 with William Slowikowski and had a great experience. He was clear, organized, and approachable, with helpful examples. Exams were fair and the workload manageable. Phones were allowed as graphing calculators, and charts were provided, which made tests easier. He spoke very clearly using the mic, and the lectures were organized.

He is very old and talks a bit slow but is nice. His lectures are ok, but you can skip a lot and still pass. Laptops in class were used during exams to look at charts, which he didn't mind. The discussion portion was not helpful at all, but attendance is not graded. Your grade comes from hw assignments, quizzes every unit, and midterm/final.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The professor was hit-or-miss. His lectures were fast-paced, but the TAs and ASC tutors were super helpful. unstuckstudy saved me with prepping for exams - way better than struggling with the textbook alone.

His explanations weren't as clear, which had me doing lots of self-study. Due to his age, he also did not speak clearly which did not help the situation. Thankfully the material wasn't difficult. However, the grading criteria were clear: 6/8 quizzes graded, 2 big homework, midterm & final. Just put in the effort to study and/or try to pay attention

I had a great experience with Professor Slowikowski! The four week course had clear grading criteria with four quizzes and a final. No homework, but recordings were available for review. Studying outside class was crucial. He's very nice and approachable, though sometimes slow to answer emails, adding a fun twist. Highly recommend!

Even though attendance is not mandatory I would highly recommend going, as long as you pay attention TRUST ME you will pass this class easily. Understand what is going on the first week and everything will become easy from there.

You should take Prof. S for MA215. He explains material well, and what's in lecture is exactly what's on quizzes and tests. Quiz just about every week, and 2 of 8 are dropped. Lecture normally ends early. Overall, the class was a 10/10 experience.

Prof Slowikowski is a really nice professor but his lectures weren't really helpful to me. He was always going so fast which makes it harder to take notes and learn the material at the same time. You are required to use tophat as it is where your hw assignments will be.

He's honestly a sub-par lecturer. His lectures didn't really help me, so I didn't go. My TA's quiz corrections are also messy and confusing. Some of the concepts are difficult, but not impossible. The ASC tutors for this class were extremely helpful and are helping me survive this class. Also make sure you sit in the front, he talks really low.

Professor Slowikowski is one of the best professors I have taken. He explained his lecture clearly so everybody could understand what he was doing. If you take good notes in his class, you will pass the class. His notes is the exact same thing as the quizzes. He doesn't change it.
Best math professor I've had at UMBC. Very old school with his ways but explains the content well. Highly recommend
Though attendance isn't mandatory I would highly recommend going so next class you wont be lost. Quizzes are exactly like the questions he goes over sometimes its the same one from the book.

Professor Slowikowski is pretty much your average professor. Quizzes are easy, just pay attention in class and do the homework and reading assignments that he assigns on TopHat. Definitely ask questions in class if you have them because he will go more in depth. The TAs are nice and easy to reach outside of class.

He is older then my great grandparents. He doesn't know how to add grades into blackboard so you don't know your course grade the entire time. He doesn't grade any papers and leaves that to his TA's. The TA I had didn't know English and graded awfully. I am already preparing to retake this course.

Not much to say really. He is fair. You get what you put into this class, he makes the material very digestible and doesn't bog you down with too many assignments. Pay attention, take notes and follow along in lecture and you'll do well. Skip class and you'll miss a lot of valuable info though. Assignments are all old school paper style.

Professor Slowikowski is a very patient person. He always took his time to explain things, and he was excited when we asked questions if we got confused, I am terrible at math and have hated every math professor I have ever had, but he made the class somewhat enjoyable. The way points are broken down, it is pretty easy to pass the class.

Stat isn't easy for me, but Prof. Slowikowski is pretty good at explaining. Lectures could be a bit dry, but really he goes through each problem step by step. Exams weren't that bad. Writing down the problems as he went through them really helped me.

He was a good teacher and explained the material very clearly. Math is not a strong suit for me but he made these concept fairly easy to understand. I would have rated him higher but he made so many mistakes when making the exams and quizzes that made it impossible to get the right answers. He did fix his mistakes as well our grades in the end.

I can tell Professor Slowikowski would be a good professor in person, but online was not his strong suit. As for work we only needed to complete the online homework and the weekly quizzes. You need to read the textbook to understand anything, which I find is better than trying to understand his lectures. Finding outside tutoring is recommended.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof Slowikowski is HiLaRiOuS!!! He makes difficult statistic concepts easy to understand. You can hardly fail his class unless you dont do practice problems after class. His quizzes are not hard. As long as you do your part go to class, study, do practice problems you will get an A.
He made all the quizzes and exams but if you work as a class it wasn't hard to pass it.

Reviews mislead me, didn't really like him. IRL lectures i did well, good at teaching but after covid very hard. lectures did not relate to test or quizzes and made it very hard. It a fairly ok class but you do need to work for it, very hard after going online. TA's are no help and are terrible. No extra credit or curves, but he does his job.
He is a really nice guy. Its a hard class but if you pay attention, ask questions, and stay in top of the homework you should be fine. He is funny and super sweet.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: Attend class, write down everything he writes, and you will be fine. Read the syllabus CAREFULLY. The class is quite boring but his lectures are easy to follow. He also held multiple review days for the final which will help you.

He's dry, but his lectures are straightforward and reflect very well on the quizzes and exams. I would advise taking detailed notes(basically everything he writes) in a notebook for every class, and study them. I received a 95% overall, and the final exam was straightforward but long! he has a pretty funny sense of humor.

Super nice guy. You need to keep up on the reading for each class, but he's very good at explaining and simplifying so we understand. Tests every week, so make sure you're always prepared. Lenient grader.
Grade is made up only of quizzes + tests. Hw is bonus points. Lenient grader. Great lecturer, teaches everything you need to know for the exams. One of the few profs at UMBC that teach

l will say this professor is very dedicated to his work. his lectures are pretty clear and concise. His quizzes and exams are pretty straightforward and come right from your lecture notes so there really isn't any surprises. i use the textbook for extra practice to supplement my studying and do each book problem.

I took MATH215 in the winter with him and the experience was well worth it. I learned a lot despite retaking the same course and did better on my quizzes than in my previous class with that other guy -_- Slowikowski knows how to teach and review for exams. He will answer questions and help you understand the material.
Professor Slowikowski is a great professor period. Get your work done and youll do great.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Coming from someone who is terrified of math, Slowikowski made statistics palatable. Though it got really difficult around halfway through the course, as long as you attend class and maybe look through the textbook when you need more information on a topic, you should be fine. Very accessible, hangs around after class in case anyone needs to chat.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Slowikowski gives good and thorough lectures that require note-taking. He's also really approachable and will help you outside of class/in his office hours!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Gives a quiz a week on Fridays, but they are graded fairly easy and it is a nice way to review for future tests. He is a really nice old man and teaches the content really well(as math teachers go). 3 Tests overall and they are hard, but he lets you make and use a formula sheet.

Im generally an A/B student, got the IB diploma with no Cs even, but I know Im going to get a C. The exams have wording thats confusing, the TA doesnt help, the teacher talks too softly and doesnt go over things as much as he should. My advice? Go to class and read the book. If you dont teach yourself, you wont pass. AND BE IN A STUDY GROUP!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Friendly old man. Loves kraft mayo and ford trucks. I took AP stat senior year so I already knew everything so the class was super easy. I didn't pay attention in lectures and did fine.
Awesome professor! Explains material very well but there is a quiz almost every Wednesday so going to the lectures on Monday are essential although technically not mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class is terrible. There is a lot of material that is covered very quickly. We have class every Monday and Wednesday. There are quizzes nearly every Wednesday, leaving little time to breathe. Discussion sessions w/the TA are worthless because he and the TAs barely communicate at all and my discussion is on Wednesdays right AFTER the quiz.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He teaches old school with a blackboard and chalk, but it's effective. Most people skip his class and can maintain B's but the class is pretty worthwhile so just go. His exams are fine. His quizzes are easy, but they're worth about 25-26 points with 4 questions, so if you don't mess up then you're good.
he is a great professor . he is old school. You will have to do with paper and pen. essay grader all you need to do is to take note and review it for the quizzes and the exams.

One of the worse professors I've ever had. He's very old school, chalk board, type. This wouldn't be so bad if he actually was more organized w/ his "notes" on the board. He's hard to follow & understand. His notes aren't clear enough to follow for studying after class. We also had nothing else to help our grade but quizzes/tests. Avoid if you can
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: "Old-school" chalkboard lectures and homework assignments out of the textbook. A nice change from everything being online. I still don't know how to pronounce his name, but I know the MA215 material.  He seems like a genuinely nice guy. Speak up if you have questions, he's hard of hearing.

He's such a sweet professor! Attendance is not technically mandatory, but going to class helps! He sometimes does math magic tricks during class and it always makes my day! If you do the homework and attend discussion you will pass the weekly quizzes with ease, the two lowest quiz scores are dropped! The exams are worth a lot of points so study!

Prof. Slowkowski is a super clear, easy to follow professor. He does not overcomplicate the content.I recommend reading the textbook because if you understand the material from there you really don't have to go to his lectures. However, if you are unclear on anything the lectures will help. Do well on quizzes and exams bc they're the only grades!
Great teacher! I took 215 with him and I really enjoyed his class. He lectures clearly. His tests and quizzes covered all topics said in class. He grades fairly as well. Take 215 with him if you can
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: I have taken this class with another professor and was failing. This professor is absolutely amazing. He makes the content so easy to understand.  I was really worried about this class, but I'm glad I took it with him. Quizzes and exams are right from the lecture material. Don't bother with the book. No surprises. Final is a departmental exam.

While not a bad professor, the classes are often enormous, and he is a quiet speaker.  I could hardly hear him half the time.  I've had him in two math courses and I've struggled to get Cs in both ( and I'm usually straight As.)  Be prepared to teach all the material to yourself, and only show up when there are quizzes by the end.
Boring, unclear lectures with quizzes and tests every week.

Professor S, was amazing. He explained everything out very well if you didn't understand. I don't like math AT ALL. He made it clear and gave a short problem after every example he wrote on the board to make sure you UNDERSTOOD IT. Just do the practice pages he give you and you're good!
Nice guy, jokes around with the class. Tries to make statistic interesting. Lectures are long and boring.

Loved this professor. He is a hilarious guy with many jokes. Statistics is not a difficult class to understand so the material, quizzes and tests are very easy. If youre not a math major  but not a math credit, this is the class for you

Everything but the exams and lectures were done online. He has a completely different teaching style than what you're taught online which makes his exams very difficult. He briefly reviews formulas in class but expects you to already know them. Overall, he is not helpful. Good luck if math is not your strong point. I wouldn't take him again.

This class was fairly easy. Don't get me wrong the material is not that simple. You do have to study and sometimes for a couple of hours especially if you do not know anything about statistics coming into the class like me.  Overall, I recommend the taking the class with him. He's fair and the exams and quizzes are easy if you study.

OMG so easy. Hes a really good teacher. Some of the stuff might be confusing, but when you go up and talk to him about it he is really helpful. HW online thats not checked for accuracy. Quizzes every week are nice so that you know if youre getting it or not. 3 exams, lenient on partial credit. Yea, Id recommend him

MAKE SURE YOU HAVE A STUDY GROUP, and at least a couple of smart people in it, and review 45 minutes before every quiz. I got C's and D's on my quizzes before I did that, then I started to get all B's & up. He's a chill guy, but he's hard to understand when he just lectures. He curves pretty generously as well ;D

Very hard to understand, roundabout lectures, unclear expectations. The material itself is easy but what's in the book, what's taught in class, and what's on the quizzes/tests are all completely different.

Horrible lectures, TA's never taught what the professor mentioned, Unorganized, non supportive. The department is not worth it ( at least for lower levels) and most people cheat in this class anyway. I say go to a different school or branch to get a better chance to pass and graduate.

This class was fairly ez & this is coming from sum1 who is terrible @ math. I do advise you sit near the front, he has a soft voice which made staying awake a bit hard. The TA i had was awesome, what i didnt understand in lecture, i learned in discussion. The quizes were ez, as well as the midterm. The final was very difficult so study a lot!!

He is an excellent teacher for this class. Despite what one of the people on here said, the TAs were incredibly helpful. They covered exactly what would be on quizzes and exams in discussion, it's just that people never went. As for the cheating that was mentioned on here, the TAs were well aware that it was going on and wrote down names...

If you need the STAT121 class, look no further. The man is very helpful, and his exams and quizzes weren't even hard. Make notes of the terms, and any examples he gives in class. Also, keep a list of the formulas, as most of them will be on the cumulative final. TL;DR: TAKE HIS CLASS!

He's so sweet!  Very charming and engaging.  He's just a cool, laid-back dude. The exams are challenging if you don't know exactly what you should be studying.  If you have the concepts down though, you should be good.  His personality makes the class enjoyable.

I signed up for his class because none of the Math 151 classes fit my schedule, and I was really surprised by how great a teacher he is. He's a really nice guy, and explains everything in detail. He can be a bit quiet, so sit close to the front. I feel like he doesn't get the respect that he deserves; he uses jokes to make math more interesting.

He is always at least 7 minutes late to every lecture. His quizzes are fairly easy but he makes test much more difficult. During his lecture, he goes over problems straight out of the book. He tries to keep students engage by telling drinking jokes. If the class is ready to leave, everyone stands up and leaves, and he doesn't say anything.He's okay

He's really slow. Homework is always assigned chapter ahead of his lectures, which is annoying. Quizzes are easy, exams are a bit tougher. He's way to quiet though, very hard to hear him. He never answers his emails and is often off his schedule. A very nice old man, but not a very good professor.

Old guy, but is slightly funny. Should at least skim the book a bit if you want to get an A in the class. Not too hard, and a lot easier than Ms Tighe but you don't learn as intensely as in Ms Tighe's class. I took calc AB in highschool so not too hard but there are new materials learned in class. I feel as if my class is a little behind...

I HATE Math but needed it for general requirement. Prof. Slowikowski made a boring subject very interesting. Likes to make jokes and tries to engage his students. Doesn't really say anything when people talk over him, which is annoying because he deserves respect and it's usually the same people that ask questions he just answered.

He is very straightforward, and his quizzes are easy. Tests are not bad, either, but you need to prepare more on your own because he does not cover topics in class with very much depth. The final exam is a killer, though (b/c he's not the only one writing it). All my classmates' had expressions of panic when we first saw it. It was gruesome.

I really love this man! He such a good professor. He is very witty and a little sarcastic. But for the most part he explains everything so that when its time for an exam or quiz you will be okay! Wish more teachers taught as well as him!

You definitely want to take him if you dont want to put too much effort in the class, you are guaranteed a B in the class if you do very well on the exams and quizzes. although you may be a lil disappointed on the final exam because tighe is very hard. He is quite easy but not as hard as tighe. But goodluck staying awake in class.
Decent professor that takes a lot of time returning material and is hard to reach. Useful and effective when teaching and tests are pretty good. may sometimes fall asleep.
Bad teacher, does not give any help. Talks to the board and doesn't explain anything. If you haven't taken calculus before take professor Tighe.
Slowikowski is really nice, easy going professor. He tests on exactly what he teaches in classes and is straight forward. This is an easy class, and doesn't require too much work.
Easy Prof

Slowikowski is a really good teacher... if you can stay awake in his class. He tries to make class interesting with jokes, but his voice will put many to sleep. Thankfully his exams are easy if you study and he grades easily. The final is not made by him and many have trouble with it. I think he curves a bit even though he says he does not.
Definitely try to get him as a calc teacher. Tests are straightforward :).. He's a really good teacher.

Calculus isn't fun or easy but it comes very close with this professor. He's very nice, very clear and easy to understand in his lectures. He lets you know exactly what to expect on exams, so there aren't any surprises. Definitely recommended.

If you are not a math person, take this guy. He is extremely nice and his tests are extremely easy. You have to study, but the tests are straightforward. No tricks. Take notes in class, sometimes he asks the same problems on the test that he went over in class. Drops some quizzes and HW's. There is no excuse for getting at least a B.
Great professor! His lectures are very clear. The exams and quizzes are very much doable which goes hand in hand with his lectures. Recommended!

This is one professor to try to get. He's super nice and friendly. He goes over the material very succinctly and tells exactly what is going to be on the tests. His class is easy because he lets you know exactly what material is going on.
Definitely try to take this class.  It is not hard because tests come straight from what he goes over in class.  He is really nice and friendly.
BEST prof. in the math department. This guy is crystal clear on what you expect to see on the test. Basically tells you what's on it before each tests. Highly RECOMMEND!

I didn't pass this class. I am really bad at calc and just gave up after doing horribly on the tests. I don't know how everyone else finds it so easy because I just couldn't get it. He is a really nice guy though, I just don't understand calc.

Mr.Slowikowski is an awesome guy. He is as friendly as anyone can be, and he teaches well. I would recommend that everyone sign up for this class. I just cannot emphasize how great this guy is in all ways... he is an extraordinary teacher. You will not regret taking this class, unless you are the kind of person who regrets taking amazing courses.
awesome teacher. straightforward class. only reason it was EASY is because there was never any question as to what you had to know. great professor.

Eh. If this is your last math class then go on and take him because he is easy, but if this isn't your last math class then you will have troubles later on. Honestly, the only time I really ever learned was in discussion. His class is straight from the text.
Very simple class if you understand all the tests you have to use and when to use them.  No homework, drops a test or two.  Go to discussion, it helps.
Wonderful teaacher.  Learned alot.  Quizzes and test straight forward.  Very easy.  ALways there to help even when not office hours.

Class is easy, lectures are clear (he simplifies the textbook), and funny.  Often uses spare time to show interesting math concepts.  Drops 2 lowest quizzes, 3 exams plus final.  Exams are somewhat tricky, just do a lot of practice problems to get an A. If you suck at math or just want a straightforward professor, take this guy for precalc and calc

he was a good teacher. his examples were clear but he would only do about 1 to 2 examples. the reason why i got a b was because i didnt do the hw problems. since it wasnt required i didnt have the patience to attempt the problems.
Attendance is important, his notes are neat and clear. HW counts as part of the grade, quizes every monday(mostly). I did not take the final and still got a B, so not that bad.

Awesome teacher! We did 10 quizzes, he drops the 2 lowest. Questions on them were basic, he didn't try and mix you up with numbers, he tests you on your knowledge of the procedure. Three exams, a lot of the exam questions were almost identical to questions from the past 2 quizzes. Final exam was made by another teacher, was difficult.
He really goes above and beyond to help students

best teacher ive had. easy to understand and very helpful. the math department is doing away with not taking the final but it used to be that if you had a 95 you were exempt from the final. im taking him for calc also. homework is not mandatory in pre but is helpful in understanding material
Very good instructor.  One of the better one's I've had at UMBC.  Throws some curves on the exams so you need to know the information, but the way he teaches the material that was never a problem.

Level headed teacher, focuses on key concepts.  He's never too stringent.  Tests and quizzes are just right difficulty.  Homework is a bit annoying, you have put alot of time into it.  Watch out for chapter 4 "Optimization problems" and chapter 6 "Shells and disks."  Those are a bit of a killer. ;)

If you have a choice, def. pick Slowikowski for calc 1. His tests and quizzes are extremely easy and how does not assign much homework. He is a great professor and if he was teaching calc 2 i would def. pick him again! If you have a 94 at the end of the semester then you dont have to take the final! overall, great professor and easy class!

I wish everyone could have him as their math prof. Very helpful, patient and nice, even when I had this very stupid girl in my class who asked the MOST redundant questions. Willing to stay after classes, etc. Easygoing, and always level-headed. Wierd sense of humor but then he's a math PhD

AWESOME GUY!  Not a typical math professor at all; he's more like your grandfather.  Likes to talk about sports and non-math related things to ease up the class.  You'll love his class, it's really clear and he actually breaks down the material for you.  Grading is very fair; the final is brutal but there seems to be a curve.  Highly reccomended.
Very easy going. goes over information slowly. class is very fair

best teacher ive had.....his 152 class in my opinion is a little bit easier than 151 but his explanations are very clear and the tests are fair.. too bad he doesnt teach calc 3 becuase i would probably take it with him

This professor is completely fair.  Homework completely relates to examples given in class, quizzes are based off of examples or homework problems, and the tests well, if you study a good amount for them you'll be fine.  (Prepare to take a quiz every week for the entire semester btw.)  Very kind man who is willing to help you.

I wish he taught calc 3!! Great teacher, especially for people who are not majoring in math. Taught in a very practical way. Tests are straightforward. Some quizzes have problems that were assigned for homework, so if you've figured it out by quiz time you're in luck. Attended every class because his explanations are better than the book.

This class is intended for people who do not really want to be in it, and that is how he taught it.  He took the time to make sure everyone understood and was incredibly helpful.  He slowed down at many points because we just weren't getting the material instead of blazing through and not caring.  Overall, and awesome professor.

Had Doc Slowikowski a few semesters ago for Calc I, and he was ultimately the BEST math teacher I ever had the pleasure of having.  Explains stuff well so it's easy to understand without any of the mathematics gobbly gook, and is ALWAYS happy to answer questions no matter how trivial.  Great guy and hilarious.  He will crush you in poker btw.  :)

Slowikowski is one of the easiest teachers I've had at UMBC. The class was at 8:45 so everyone was dragging but he would start off with some dry humor. Very easy, grading wise. Study the in class problems for the quizzes and study a little for the tests. I NEVER did any of the homework problems and got a 100% in the class. Plus, no final!

Best calc teacher ever.  He's just an all around good guy, all his quizzes and tests are straightforward.  If you can keep an A average during the year you can get exempted from the final.  I'm taking Calc 2 now just because of him.

Really wants you to do well.  His final was incredibly hard, I think I answered half the questions, and still I managed a B with a C going into the final.  Excellent teacher who cares if you understand the material and if you are doing well.  He slowed down our class at times so that we could spend more time on tough topics.  Great teacher.
Took the calculus class. Attendance is not mandatory. Quizzes every friday. Exams are pretty much based on quizzes. No Curve.HW can be a pain. But not as bad as tighe. Take him.

Slowikowski is a funny guy.  He loves math, is very sarcastic and humorous.  He teaches you what you need to know, and prepares you for his quizzes.  Quizzes are straight from the homeworks.  Tests are harder, but he works with you.  Final was hard, but I somehow managed to end up with a B in class.  I would definatly take him again for math!

funny guy. course is hard to begin with so dont expect it to be an easy class unless ur willin to learn. he's a good teacher but uses most of his examples from da book so sometimes u dont even need to go to class. great teacher, he even lets us go leave early
Love the professor. I HATE THE COURSE

Really cool teacher. Extremely clear in his expectations. Tests can be challenging but afterall it is a somewhat challenging subject in my opinion to begin with. If you want you can only go to class on friday when he has all tests/quizzes. Incredibly knowledgable for being a football coach. He also grades easy and curves tests sometimes.

This class starts off easy, but get really hard really fast.  You better get A's on the first exam and the first few quizzes to balance out your grade at the end of the semester.  He is a good teacher, but he always puts tricky questions on the exams and quizzes.  Watch for those...

Precalc was so easy with him.  He explains things clearly and thoroughly prepares you for calc.  No final if you have a 95%!  Also counts homeworks toward your grade so exams aren't worth as much.  go to class and it's an easy b, if not a.

Totally amazing professor! He simplifies the material so it's understandable, his quizes aren't that bad, his tests are very fair. Pay attention in class, take notes, study the notes. Definitely one of the best professors I've had, very approachable :-)
Slowikowski was a good teacher. Very clear in what he was explaining. No suprises. The quizzes are quite difficult, but the test are not so hard. The final...study a lot.

Great teacher for both Math 150 and 151.  Quizzes tend to be a little difficult, and tests are fairly difficult too.  Funny and good at teaching.  Don't come to class sleepy - attend classes and pay attention.
Lets you skip the final if you have a 94 by then, which is well worth the effort.  Easier if you have prior knowledge of calc, but not impossible.  Gets off topic, and entertaining.
good guy, funny at times yet very monotone.  quizes are tough but tests are easy if you study, relativly easy B, hard A unless you study a good bit or are very good at math

Slowikowski is a great teacher.  I took him for math150 and he made the subject very clear.  I'm taking him for math151 and he is awesome. makes some jokes which arent too funny, but he is an easy going guy.  i recommend u take him for both math150 and 151.

cool teacher! tells u whats important and does not waste time on small details. very easygoing, and always happy. he makes college math sooo much easier than it is. i had him for 150, and am taking his night class right now. sooo worth it! take his class if possible/needed :)

This is an excellent professor. The class (calculus) is by nature very difficult but if you are having trouble GO TO HIS OFFICE HOURS. If he sees that you are having difficulty but are trying really hard and you talk to him a lot (so he knows who u r) he will bump your borderline grade up
I have had Mr. Slowikowski every semester since I have come to this school, and I'm taking STAT 351 with him this semester also. Awesome teacher! Very clear and very helpful!
Definitley the teacher you want for math.  Easy, nice person who will always be there to help.  I enjoyed his class and never seen math so easy! TAKE HIM!!!

Mr. Slowikowski was an awesome teacher!!! His quizzes are pretty hard, but the tests are easy, and don't change much from the previous semesters. If you have a 94% or higher, you don't have to take the final. He explains things really well, and is very flexible.

This guy is a great teacher. He's clear, takes his time, and tells you everything you need to know before tests and quizzes. Go the class before Thanksgiving, he gives you bonus points. He is likes football and baseball and is very funny too. Take him.
nice guy, the class material is pretty easy and he goes over it and explains it well.  he lets people exempt from the final and the quiz/test policy is nice.

Great teacher, goes at a good speed and has very in depth notes. Going to class will definitely help to get a good grade. Quizzes are only on about 2-3 sections so its pretty easy. Tests aren't too bad and he usually lets you omit one. Definitely a great teacher!

AWESOME TEACHER!! class is fun and he cracks jokes a lot which helps make 2 hour period go faster! Tests are reasonable and pertain to what he taught.  Very flexible in helping students, and is known to occasionally push back due dates for homework!

Had him for 150 and have him now for 151.  he NEVER ceases to amaze me in that he is everything a good professor should be.  The best math teacher I ever had and damn funny too.  Makes a lot of jokes in class
Wonderful teacher, theres not much else to say.  Very personable, easy to go up to and ask for help.  Loves what he does, and loves to help you learn.  GREAT TEACHER!

He's lowkey a good human being but when it comes to Calculus he breaks apart specifically due to his thick accent and he js reads word for word the slides. You gotta come into class knowing the concept or ur doomed. Your grade basically depends on quizzes and exams, study hard and you should get a B. Wisely choose your TA, connect with Anson
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: honestly a great guy and has a good personality just not very well at teaching. Has a thick accent and would get lost during his lectures. be prepared to do a lot of practice and studying on your own. lectures were always a week ahead of the quizzes. Oliver (TA) provided helpful videos, if you have the indian guy, good luck because he did nothing.

I genuinely believe that Professor Xuan is a cool guy. His personality is friendly, engaging, and he takes class participation in lectures seriously. However, where he completely falls apart is his teaching style. This man can not teach Calculus to save his life, and you will be completely lost if you do not already come in knowing every concept.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Do not take his class, test averages are bad every time 56% average, nobody shows up to lecture because you cannot understand a word he says.

Lectures are useless but the quizzes and exams were not hard at all. The practice sets and practice exams were almost identical to the quizzes and exams. Just take like 2 hours a week to do practice problems and there is no reason you shouldn't get a high B or A. If you have that indian guy as your TA he is useless for any help.

pls save yourself. dont take his class 😭 he says attendance isn't mandatory but takes attendance. i stopped attending the lectures because they were just a big waste of time, i could never understand the topic he was trying to teach, his slides were kinda confusing too. Oliver is a great TA def reach out to him if you're struggling HES great.

Writing this review 2/3rds through the semester. 75% of the class skips lectures because they are impossible to understand (heavy accent) and not useful. Class average for Test 1 was ~56%. If you're gonna transfer to UMD, don't waste your time and GPA, because Math155 doesn't even transfer there. This class/prof is terrible!
Pick a god and start praying, you're cooked if you take him.
Pay attention & ask questions during lecture it will save you.
Prepare to do alot of practice on your own. Do all your homework, participate and seek tutoring, and you will be fine.

Lectures were a little confusing, homeworks didn't align with the tests and quizzes. I didn't perform well on a couple tests and the homework grade is what saved me. Make sure to pay attention and ask your TA questions during the discussion. Study and do all your work and you will be fine.

Absolute unit. The glare from his shiny forehead was a bright as the sun. The way he holds the marker and wrote on the board was just so tuff. He just so tuff! Thick accent. Can't always understand him. Good at math, cant really teach it. You have to be prepared to study hours and hours extra by yourself. Organic Chemistry Teacher gon be clutch.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS. Lectures are useless but he still checks for attendence even tho the syllabus says its not mandatory. Talks too fast. He doesn't post the lecture on BB until after its been given in class. It never matches the note shells posted BEFORE class. Hw/quizzes will never align w/ the most recent lecture. TA's are your best bet.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly he's not as bad as ppl make it seem. His accent may make it harder to understand but he's a really nice guy and unintentionally funny. Just do your hw on time and use the hw to study. Also study for the quizzes cus they're pretty easy. Also, use the lecture slides/textbook on your own time and you'll be good.

mr. xuan is a great person and he's unironically funny but he's not the best teacher. he doesn't go over everything we need to learn for the tests and quizes so you'd have to learn a lot of the material on your own using external sources. test reviews don't come with answers either which basically makes them useless for studying.

My lord and savior Xuan was always there when i needed him. His thick chinese accent sent shivers to my spine and made me ecstatic whenever I was in his lectures. Every time he wrote on the board, I was thrilled and memorized by his genius mind. He's an amazing person and even better professor. Truly a specimen.

this class is like a fever dream i swear. don't get me wrong he's a great guy but he jumps all over the place and will only really go over one problem per topic and you need to figure out the rest. you also have like 20-30 long problems for homework each week. he's funny and loves his students but he just can't teach math. love him tho he's my goat

I saw a post before taking his class about how cute he is. Thats not why I took his class but I realize exactly what that person meant. Professor Xuan is very funny and caring. He could sense when I was stuck and helped right away. He gave time in class to start on the hw and answered any question I had very well. 10/10 professor. i love him sm

Oh where would I be without my sweet loving Xuan. Such a kind soul and every lecture made me want to get up and have a one on one tutoring moment iykwim ;). His soft voices calms down the tightness of my soul and gives me shivers down my spine when he writes on the board. He graps the attention of every student by his voice that's as smooth as silk

Anson Xuan, my love, my life. What keeps me sane in this cruel corporeal realm is his sweet, soothing voice hidden behind a thick accent which puts me to sleep every night. I attend his office hours to see his cute face and smile. When he writes on the whiteboard in the massive lecture hall, his hands a beautiful representation of his masculinity.

Don't take him. you can't understand anything during the lecture. he is condescending. Not helpful. HW is easy, but the tests look completely different. absolute worst class I have ever taken, and the professor is terrible at teaching.

Good teacher imo. Knows what hes teaching and students just have issues with his accent. Pretty easy grade and rounded up my high B to an A after the final. Just follow the lectures to know what hes teaching even if you dont understand and work a little outside of class for the quizzes and exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Mr. Xuan is a very good professor overall. Lectures were relatively clear and easy to understand. The only issue was that Xuan lectured to his tests but the final is made by a committee so some things were new. If you understand the prerequisites this class should be easy
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He was an OK teacher. I didn't struggle with the course because I took calc in high school + math is my strong suit. However, he's not helpful to students who are weak at math. He doesn't also cover some topics in class that are on the quizzes and exams. He was funny though. I recommend doing more practice outside of class time and you'll be fine.

Prof.Xuan was... well I can't really speak on him because I stopped going to his lectures the second week into school. I would pop in occasionally and each time it was the same, I just couldn't follow what he was teaching and he's a little hard to understand, so I would just leave 5 minutes after popping in. Studying on your own time will help.

Would not recommend. Professor doesn't really explain topics thoroughly, just flips through slides as if we're in a English class or something. If it wasn't for an amazing TA I would've did worse. prof was nice, but being nice won't help my grade.

He's an ok professor but a nice person and is genuinely passionate about math. Lectures were boring at times and weekly quizzes were difficult. People give him poor ratings because of calc being their first "real" math class and expecting to pass without actually studying. If you have taken calc before or are willing to study you should be fine.
This professor is hilarious, he knows how to teach on a real note, I understand the content and he is good with grading which allows students to take opportunities to raise their grade

He can barely teach and the lecture mostly consist of him talking the whole time without any real engagement of the math that we are suppose to be doing in class. The whole time I was very confused and when asking for help he gets mad over the smallest things that aren't really important to how one may solve the problem

He is very hard to understand in most of his lectures. The course in and of itself is relatively easy if you stick to what information is provided in the online textbooks. 

He will rant about a mathematical concept for the majority of his lecture and then breeze over the rest of the lesson in the last 20 minutes.

Everyone is collectively lost and barely able to scrap by each quiz. He goes over quiz content the day of and rambles a lot during lecture. Concepts aren't explained very well, self studying is needed.

Professor Xuan is eh Professor, you will not learn anything from this class at all! He only read off slides and you will not have time to take notes, you are best to watch some topics on YouTube. Sometime he is very diffcult to listen to because of his accents. But, professor Xuan is the most cutest person ever, I have 5 posters in my room of him!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Do not take this class if you don't have any knowledge otherwise you will struggle in this class. He goes way too fast and teaches sections an hour before a quiz. Some people don't show up because of how difficult it is to learn from him. I've learned more from my TA than him and that says a lot. No help at all.

Good luck to anyone whom had the displeasure to take him. He is a nice person and can be ironically funny, however, if you have never taken calculus before, or have done prep before hand, you are doing yourself a disservice. Doesn't prepare for quizzes, not really accessible, god help you
DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR, HE DOESN'T PROPERLY TEACH, AND NEVER PREPARES YOU FOR THE QUIZZES OR EXAMS.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Terrible professor

Guys, Do NOT take this class with him. He has a very thick accent and does not explain concepts very well. Get ready to learn material of the quiz on the day of. Good luck to any who take this class with this professor

Seeing Prof. Xuan's bright face as soon I walk in every class always gives me butterflies. He always has this charming way of making me giggle like when he calls denominators "feet". I watch his video lectures before I go to bed just because his sweet voice puts me to sleep. Definitely take this class if you want to take math with some excitement.
if you want a good cry, this is the class to take :)

Honestly, this class is the easiest I've ever taken. The bad reviews are all trolls who don't listen to his lectures. They just don't understand calculus as he does; he is a phenomenal professor with a beautiful voice and an understanding of calculus. His voice is one of divine beauty and it gives me such ecstasy when hearing him talk.

I did very well in this class and I usually hate math. Lectures are easy to follow and he gives us time to take good notes. The people that wrote bad reviews were honestly people that didn't show up to class or just talked the entire lecture. If you want an A in math definitely take his class.

Honestly easiest A+ I have ever gotten. There was this one time where I had a detrimental question on one of the homework's and he enlightened me by instilling his intellect upon me by informing me, and I quote, "to find the pattern". These wise words have been engraved into my soul as UMBC student. Thank you Anson Xuan for THIS EZYYY A+!!!!!!

In most lectures, it is a miracle if Anson manages to not have a technological issue in which he requires help from a student. After 15 minutes of waiting, he begins. Mr. Xuan's first language was not English, and therefore he is not easy to understand behind his thick accent. All problems he does are on a white board on which nobody can see.
He does not know how to teach and is impossible to learn from. That being said I am just so brilliant that I get A's on all of the exams.

This professor is the worst to everr exist, if you want to learn math and you take him, just letting you know that you're failing. He's very hard to communicate with and is not willing to help you at all. I had so much difficulty listening to him. questions that show up on the exam are things we haven't even covered so avoid taking him.

Mr. Xuan is an amazing professor. At times, slightly hard to understand but he is very good at answering questions and explaining the reasons behind the math. If you pay attention and complete homework assignments the class is so easy
bad with technology, hard to communicate, kind of a silly goose
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: he is bad professor

In my opinion, not the greatest professor. She expects you to be almost fluent in the language which is really asking for a lot. I felt like she took the fun out of learning the language because she is quite strict. She would get mad at me a lot because I was late but I lived an hour away from campus and cannot fly over other cars.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Prof. Wolff is a pretty decent professor. She is good at explaining things through and is funny. Participation, exams, and projects make you grade. Projects were probably the most annoying part. You have to film a video project and act with a group. You have to study and try hard to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: A solid choice (if not one of the few professors who teach German) for any German class. She grades and lectures clearly. You will have to work for the grade, so do not slack off. Although she seems strict, she's actually friendly outside of the classroom environment. Grading is also evenly distributed, so it's not heavy on one thing.

Wolff was a solid professor. Makes you work for your grade, no doubt, but she will make sure you understand the language. Runs a tight ship in her classroom, she's a no-nonsense type of professor who gets straight to the point and doesn't mess around.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Very strict, Condescending, very particular.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Pretty good German professor. Can be slightly condescending at times, but discussions are interesting and you should learn a good amount of German. Non-negligible amount of homework, and she took off points on my research paper which was supposed to be over 1250 words, and was over 1250 words, for being too short. Would recommend overall.

Frau Wolff is very straight-forward with her expectations. The work-load isn't too bad if you stay on top of everything. Expect vocab quizzes almost every class period. Make sure you pay attention in class and participate. I have found Frau Wolff to be a great teacher, and i really like all the exercises we do in class.  they aer very helpful.

This class is structured poorly and feels like a highschool class, the tests include speaking portions about the most random readings in the book and are worth a large percentage of the grade, and if she decides she doesn't like you, you're basically screwed. I had high A's in GERM 101 and 102, and will probably barely pass this class. Ridiculous.

She's alright. She has these cold dead eyes that kind of stare straight through your soul. It looks like she's the only professor that teaches 201 so good luck if you don't click with her (which is what happened with me). We just didn't get along. Not a bad professor, just not the kind of lady I would want to like get lunch with or anything.

Great professor, but understand that just like any other foreign language, the coursework is intense and time consuming.  The textbook is used heavily and class participation is mandatory. You will have a short, non-scripted presentation at the end of the semester. Exams included a private conversation with her, auf Deutsch.

She is clear, fair, and will go out of her way to help you if you need it. Her expectations are high but she makes it very obvious what you need to do to meet them. If you don't put an effort in, though, she will see that in a heartbeat and it will show in your grade.
VERY nice and a phenomenal teacher.  DO the work and stay on top of everything and ull do great. One of the best German teachers I've had.

Had her for 102 and 201..once you get to know the class structure, you can actually enjoy her classes.  Vocabulary quizzes everyday are easy and have built in extra credit, online homework is a grade booster, very helpful, presents grammar effectively, and is generous with grading.  Exams are tough though, so you have to study!!

Wow. Frau Wolff is an excellent professor and be prepared to learn a lot! Although that definitely doesnt mean this class is easy. Make sure you attend class with daily vocab quizzes. Her tests are beyond ridiculous but shes always willing to answer any questions you have. DONT TAKE FOR AN EASY A. By the end of the semester 1/3 of my class dropped.

I'm kind of biased considering I hadn't taken german for 2 years before taking this course. That being said, it is a VERY difficult course, but she knows what shes doing. I found her tests to be difficult, and the amount of online homework was wayyy to much.

Probably the best German professor that I've ever had! Yeah, it's difficult but she really wants you to learn and understand. As long as you do your homework, and study for those daily vocab quizzes you'll do just fine!

Great prof, best German teacher I've ever had.  Hard class, but if all outside work is done, an A is attainable.  She tries to work with you and is very understanding.  Writing intensive, but very lenient in grading.  A prof you'll want to have.

Great prof, the best german teacher i've had.  A hard class, but if you listen, take notes, and do the homework, you should get a B.  Writing intensive, but she grades leniently.  A prof you'll want to have.  She is extremely accommodating and friendly.
class is a lot of fun and she is very helpful. the time flew by every day. the work is hard, especially the vocabulary and the grammar. great professor!

Frau Wolff makes German interesting.  There is a quiz every class, so if you plan on slacking off and not studying your vocabulary, I don't suggest this class.  She is endearing, but in a kinda-strict-stepmother-kind-of-way.  She grows on you.  Just make sure that your cell phone doesn't go off in class.
The class is difficult but the professor is very helpful
Great teacher! A lot of fun! She is great to talk to and joke around with the class is not always so serious you have loads of fun.
awesome prof
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Sometimes the material seems rushed (only because there is so much of it), but if you visit her during office hours, she will clarify everything.  She made Calculus bearable for me.  I though I would do poorly, but after working with her, I earned an A!!

Xinxuan Li tends to rush through concepts (only because there is a lot of material to learn) but will explain things to you if you raise you ask or she'll offer to explain it after class. BIGGEST ADVICE: go to your TA's office hours!! (or hers!!) I was averaging a B/C on quizzes but after office hours I now avg A/B (and A's on exams!)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: She teaches calc as though everyone has already taken the course. She rushes through new concepts, but will spend 5 extra minutes reminding you how to find X and Y intercepts. The way she illustrates concepts often makes them more confusing. At one point she became irritated because people were asking her to go over something step-by-step.

She was a caring person, but not the best teacher for Calc. It was hard to understand her due to her accent, bad hand-writing, and speedy lectures. However, if you do the practice quizzes and exams provided you should be okay in her classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Her class is easy if you study. She has lecture notes that you could print out which are very handy. She also give sometimes hints during the lecture of what questions will come up on the quizzes or exams. She is very nice and answers student questions. Her exams might be longer than the others but hers are way easier.

Shes a new prof, but she was okay overall. She sped through lectures, so if you don't have a Calculus background, you would probably have a hard time following her. Her handwriting isn't the best and her accent is a little heavy. Tests are long. But she is easily accessible outside of class. The discussion sections/ my TA saved me in this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Cannot recommend Yang enough. I had him for 203 a few semesters ago and he was incredibly caring, friendly, and willing to work with me outside of class. I hated 203 lol but Yang really is a good guy, passionate, and always willing to help!

As of my current semester, I think I can say Prof. Yang is my favorite professor I have had for Computer Science. The exams are quite balanced as he gives you great practice exams to prepare you. Also very approachable and understanding. Overall, plenty of resources for you. If you have the option to, please try to get a spot in his class.

Professor Yang was awesome. It was very easy to tell that he cared that students actually understood the material, he frequently asked for feedback and made sure to answer every question. Homework was assigned once a week and was never too difficult. Final exam isn't cumulative. As long as you pay attention and take decent notes, you should be fine

Honestly one of the best Prof if not teachers I have had. He really cares about students and want everything for them to succeed. He gives big dad energy if you know what I mean. He's open to questions of any kind and will answer with sincerity and without condescension. As long as you do the work and practice you'll be good.

I believe Dr. Yang only teaches CMSC-203 and he is simply the best professor for CMSC-203. The class is weighed Homework 30%, Attendance 10%, Exam 1 20%, Exam 2 20% and the final exam 20%. The final isn't cumulative. Passing CMSC 203 with a B and above really depends on the professor and getting a B in Dr. Yang's class is doable.

Very caring about his students and thereby always asked for feedback to make the class better, incorporated recordings , ec , and very active office hours. He always was eager for class participation so don't be afraid to ask or answer questions during lecture.  Show up to class , do the HW on time, practice the study guide, and you will be fine !

Clearly one of the best profs ever at UMBC, he is not a tough grader, very open to student feedback, the only reason I did better on the second midterm was because he was recording the lectures, which were very helpful. If you go to him in office hours, he even allows students to work on the homework in the office hrs.

3 tests a semester, final not cumulative, graded leniently. Open to questions/helping, provides resources for learning, and seems to care about students. Only setbacks are his accent which becomes understandable as you go to class, and his lectures which can be tedious. Will call on you if he learns your name.

Strong teacher, albeit a bit dry at times. As long as you go to class, ask questions, and do your work you'll be fine. If you go to office hours he'll even help you with the homework. Even allows late homework submissions if you have a good track record. Couldn't ask for a better professor.
Not prepared when attends his lectures and very confusing. Better to read a textbook then come to class. Exams are terrible
Excellent professor.  Only a few times in the semester was he unclear.  Tough, good at getting students to participate.  You will learn a lot.

Wang's class consists of him reciting the book and if you're lucky, a few exercises not already worked out.  There is a significant disconnect between the weekly problem sets and the book/notes.  His exams are the sort where you think you know everything going in and then are frustrated when you get a C.  Has a very heavy accent.

well versed. He teaches exactly what you need to know and is willing to work with you. Stat 453 is a hard subject, but if you are willing to work and show him that you are working hard, you will get the grade you need.

I took Dr. Wang for Stat 451 & 453.  I would say that 451 is much harder than 453 (because there's going to be less students for 453).  He is very helpful.  However, you have to study really really hard for this class.  His homeworks and test are extremely hard! My advice is better know his office hours for help!
ok
He is good, nice,professional
i agree. the tests are also far from straightforward.
his english is not great, he reads off of slides which are taken straight from the book, and doesnt explain the concepts.

I liked his teaching style and it's clear he has a lot of experience in photography. There is a lot of homework, but not an impossible amount. It will be somewhat harder if you live on campus, since there's only so much you can photograph. As long as you don't procrastinate (seriously don't.) you will be okay!

the critiques. i genuinely cried during like 3 of them. he gives a lot of criticism that usually outweighs positive feedback. the assignments were long and torturous (between 100-1000) due every 2 weeks and it's hard to take good pics on campus. he grades pretty leniently as long as you follow the crtieria on the syllabus exactly.
Although I received a B in the class, I would not take him again. He is very strict with grading and missing a class brings your grade down tremendously.

The workload is excessive and unrealistic between 500 and 1,000 photos to complete within a two-week period. He rarely responds to emails. Grading takes an unreasonably long time. Attendance policies are also very strict. If a student is late or misses even one class, a significant number of points are deducted. Do not take this class

ART 211 with Professor Year is a lot of work. The class is split into around 6 assignments that range from 250-1,000 photos each. You only get about two weeks to complete each assignment so don't procrastinate. Grading is strict and missing a class can drag your grade down a lot. Professor Year cares a lot about photos and wants you to as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He gives like 5 huge photography assignments. Every assignment is like 250 pictures MINIMUM and the last few are like 500-1,000. You only have a two week span of time to do all of it. No cropping, all in manual and you have to edit your pictures. He doesn't answer email either
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took him in the winter thinking it would be easier but he makes the quizzes easy and the exams super hard. Furthermore an A is anything above 90.1 and a B is 75-90 so that was just awesome too. Take 102 with someone else if you can hit if he's your only option just do the work

'Twas the night before Christmas and I still don't have my final grade. He's nice, but the lectures weren't that helpful and were a bit boring. I recommend going anyway for the extra credit assignments. Everything is in the textbook, and the class is easy as long as you study.

Very nice and enthusiastic professor, and a simple class. He drops the lowest grade for each assignment in quizzes and finals/midterms. All quizzes are open notes, and he allows a note sheet for the midterms/finals. The lectures are a little boring, but he does practice problems and gives extra credit during class.

Very easy to approach, his lectures were sometimes hard to follow but he had notes online that were practically a baseline of the exams. He let's you bring a cheat sheet on exams, so they're never too hard. Make sure to go to lectures because he offers a ton of extra credit throughout the semester.

decent professor, kinda just reads off his notes and writes on the board. we do practice problems that are practically the same on exams. he is a nice guy and answers all questions well. there was an online quiz due every so often, dont forget to do those. just make sure to study and you will do well.

He knows what he's talking about, and he's pretty funny. Open to questions and is always positive. I liked the hybrid thing he did, and he didn't really give you many assignments besides quick quizzes and regular quizzes. His tests were pretty weird like some of the questions would be the first time hearing about it. But overall really solid class.

This class was treated as a joke. No one ever showed up, and everyone around me constantly failed the exams. Lectures were difficult to understand, and there was no curve. I would take it online if I could.

I took this Fall 2023. Professor Yuan was really good! I am not the brightest, but he was always willing to clarify concepts when asked. Just make sure to take notes during his lectures and ask if you're confused. There's one simple project and the exams. As long as you pay attention in class, you'll do good. The exams are the bulk of your grade.

I took him over the winter online so everything was condensed. Grade depended on quizzes, one assignment and two exams. The midterm was optional but that meant the final would be worth 65% of your grade. He also offered a 5% extra credit. Had good curves for Cs and Ds. For the one assignment we had, he upload a video on how to do it so it was easy.
Straightforward course, everything you need to succeed is provided, and if you don't understand he is open to answer questions. Good man, also is funny
Aside from small tests, literally no workload given. Very chill and laid back class

Professor is able to review and talk about the material very well and encourages me to ask questions if needed for clarification or help. Encourages to email the professor if there are any problems encountered and is lenient with grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great teacher, like a dad to me, taught me how to change my tire. Thank you Chunming.

He wasn't the best communicator, and there were some odd rules he enforced on tests and quizzes, such as not allowing students to return to previous questions they had answered. We also didn't cover very much material. I think it would be better taken in person.

A terrible professor. I learned absolutely nothing from him as this class was 100% self taught. He held no lectures. It was like he wasn't even there. I'm not sure how this is acceptable, it seems very lazy. Avoid at all costs - take a professor that will actually be present and put forth some sort of effort.

No lectures; he simply provides slides and notes, and asks you to read the textbook. You are on your own in this class. Class had two midterms, one final, a few quizzes, and one analytical assignment. He had review sessions before exams, but in my mind, no lectures means he did not care enough about the class to make an effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I took this class over the winter. It is super easy over the winter. All I had to do was read the text book and take notes and I was all prepared. I don't remember there being any lectures so if you had a question, you would have to go to office hours. The quizzes were pretty easy and the final was a cake walk. TAKE DURING THE WINTER IF YOU CAN.
Very good professor. He is a fatherly figure to me. Great feedback.
Gives extra credit. Attendance not mandatory. Most test questions come from review chapter questions or online. Pretty fair grader. Not a lot of assignments. Tries to add humor.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Found the exams online, just memorize those. Nice prof though. Sometimes had extra credit as attendance.

Professor Yalew cares about students' success, however he is new to the department. He is a good lecturer, but it is hard to convert his lectures into usage/implementation without good homework preparation or study materials, which the course lacked in Fall '25. There are hiccups in the expectations and implementation of homework and exams.

I don't think he had the best approach for teaching this class. He would often go very fast, and it would be difficult to follow. While I went to every class, I do not think it is necessary as the lectures are recorded and posted to blackboard. There isn't a lot of homework, but it's 40% of your grade, with and the other 50% being the two exams.

This professor is literally THE best. He is one of my favorite lecturers that I will definitely remember for a long time. He's very understanding and is willing to work with you to help you get better in your subject. He was also understanding in terms of the finals and curved it for our class. Really loved this professor! 100% recommended.

respectful ,open to feedback, very helpful, few homework ,  test and the midterm are the hardest part (most important besides hw) which students should prepare by studying hw, guides , activity problems , and practice . Lectures are clear, handwriting is okay but could improve, heavy on note taking , but releases it online which is very helpful.

Lucky to have this professor. Was very understanding and generous when it came to asking for help. Also pretty lenient on partial credit (except for quizzes which are very little of the grade anyway). Also gave (though minimal) extra credit. Only small nitpick is that handwriting on the uploaded class notes was kind of hard to read sometimes.
Really nice professor and very understanding, quizzes were relatively easy. Midterm and final were difficult but he curved them generously. Overall a nice professor
The professor was amazing but the course itself was hard to follow and difficult. The class was difficult and many people scored low on the midterm and final.

Professor Zee is a great professor, but the class on the other hand is not so great. There's a lot about the class that is difficult to teach but I think professor Zee did a decent job at. I would definitely take this professor again, not for the same class. He also records lectures; put in the effort and I'm sure it will not be in vain.

Professor Zee relies heavily on printed notes and presentations, which may help some students but were hard for me to engage with. While the format didn't suit my learning style, office hours and asking questions during and after class were extremely helpful. His support, openness, and extra credit opportunities ultimately helped me earn an A.

Genuine buns.  Reads lecture notes and fills in a missing word and does absolutely no teaching.  Average on the midterm was like a 60.  Don't bother going to the classes it does you no good, but if you don't you also won't have anything to study so you're cooked either way. Good guy though.

Incoherent lectures, and when you inevitably cant understand the lectures and need to do some studying out of class, there are no resources available to you except the professors handwritten notes from the lectures, which are just as incoherent as his speaking. He's chill tho not a bad guy just not a good teacher. Avoid taking this guy for sure.

I took CMSC 331 w/ him, not 201. The class was extremely boring and useless. It's extremely theory-heavy. Every class was the same routine. He'd hand us a packet for note-taking and talk for the rest of the class. I could hardly understand his hand-writing. Extremely repetitive and stale lectures to point where I stopped showing up after 2 weeks.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Zee's lectures are okay and he's super nice in office hours and helpful. He might make mistakes on practice code in lecture but overall he's a nice prof who cares. This class is pretty hard at UMBC without python experience, so try to review some things beforehand. Exams are pretty hard ngl, but not in his control. Pray that you have a good TA

Kifle's lectures are relatively straightforward. His slight accent makes him hard to understand sometimes. He is really approachable during his office hours, so do go! He sometimes has EC in his lectures. Quizzes are usually straightforward. I thought that discussions were not helpful, but they are 5% of your grade.
Very knowledgeable professor, and the class was interactive and interesting!
Very supportive and helpful professor!

I recommend studying the slides for the exams (likes to through trick questions for 1st exam). Quiz in lecture & are straight forward & weekly. Nice & approachable, but check Gritview of other professors before taking him. He likes to do EC in lectures, so do go! TA study sessions sometimes have similar exam problems. Discussions pointless.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great, Professor, really learnt a lot, and class was engaging. So yeah, man like Kifle.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lectures are a bit boring and fast but he explains well and will answer your questions. His quizzes are extremely easy if you study and sometimes he'll give hints. Exams are harder, but still not that bad. Go to class because you will fall behind if you skip like me lol. The class starts easy but gets a lot harder at the end

Taking Stat 355 with Dr. Kifle was truly a privilege. I enrolled in his accelerated summer course, and even with three-hour sessions, he kept the class engaging from start to finish. If you need to take this course, I strongly recommend taking it with Dr. Kifle, even if it means waiting until next semester.

I had a great time taking this class with Prof. Kifle!  He made it fun and easy, with the same kinds of questions on exams as on quizzes and discussions.  He cared about individual students and was always ready to help.  He loves statistics and wants his students to love it, too!
Decent at lecturing. Great lecture slides. Exams and quizzes are easy if you go to the discussions.

Prof. Kifle is super nice, understanding, and makes sure the material is clear. Quizzes are copy-pasted from discussion worksheets—study those and you'll do great. Exams are a bit long but manageable. He gives bonus points too. One of the best classes I've taken—highly recommend STAT 355 with him!

Good professor. Quiz and exam questions are very similar to examples given in lecture slides with no curveballs. First exam was all MC w no partial credit, 2nd exam and final were mix of MC and short-answer. Overall Kifle makes the class fairly easy. Formula sheet given, just know how to apply formulas and use your stat tables.

I took him for winter and I liked it. He tought it well and sent the recordings before so you can watch whenever and however you want. He has a thick accent but not too bad. His online exams were multiple choice which had its pros and cons. in general hes a nice guy who enjoys answering questions which I think is important trait for prof.

Professor Kifle is really kind and great at teaching. He's good at summarizing lectures, explaining, and answering questions. He speaks slowly and clearly. He's transparent about what will and won't be on exams/quizzes, he offers lots of practice problems for preparation, he cuts out unimportant slides, and doesn't expect you to memorize formulas.

Dr. Kifle is a pretty straightforward professor. His quizzes and exams are directly from his slides. Usually in his 400-level classes, there is a final paper. The key to doing well is reading ahead of time and starting your final project early. Outside of class, Dr. Kifle is accessible via email and office hours and responds well to questions.

It was a mess all around for so many reasons. Was late on grading, didn't give much feedback, and bunched a lot of the class at the end. Intentionally made things unnecessarily difficult for most of the class. Avoid if you can

Middle of the road lectures, I didn't use his slides either. Fantastic homework's and tests tho. If you finish your weekly homework before the quizzes and understand it, you'll get an A. No curveballs. Sometimes gives hints in tests. Lots of multiple choice questions on midterms and the final. As long as your do your homework on time it's cake.

Pretty standard class. His slides are color coded well and contain many examples. No surprises on quizzes and exams; gives study guides for exams. He does have an accent, but it really isn't that bad. I understood everything he said.

First midterm was entirely multiple choice with no partial credit?? Second midterm was 20 MC with 2 free response. Odd format for a math class. Quizzes every week except exam weeks. Quiz problems usually come from slides which are pulled directly from the book. Lectures are boring as his slides are basically SS of the book. Formula sheet given.

Took summer online. No lectures, just watching his recorded lectures. Quiz every single week, sometimes a test a day after a quiz. After 1st day of class, was given a quiz. Quizzes/tests are reflective of practice problems in lectures. Majority of grade relies on quizzes and tests (6 quizzes, 2 tests, and 1 final). Ok class, get good at test taking
Difficult class but the class was well taught to the point that I was motivated to try actually learning about stats. Very good professor.

Very concise and clear lectures with examples that clearly reflect tests. Being in good attendance and checking work in discussion makes for easy A's. Gives a formula sheet, all you have to know is what each variable means. This is the easiest statistics can be made with the least work involved. Tests are simple. He's also just a really nice dude.

Winter Semester. Uses verbose online lectures to supplement in-person teaching. Online lectures are very bad due to his thick accent and lack of preparation - evident as his lectures fail to model either slides or textbook. Does not properly define variables and fails to show how where his formulas are derived from. Grade is padded by HW and Quiz.

Really good Professor tells you exactly what you need to know and what to expect during quizzes and exams. Lots of optional practice. Homework is WebAssign so if you like WebAssign that's a plus. One of the best stat professors at UMBC.

Accent so thick he needs to take classes to speak clearly. Forced students to use Lockdown Browser, which is well known as a unstable and destructive piece of corporate malware. Should not be allowed to continue teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Kifle is truly amazing. He tries to explain difficult concepts thoroughly with different examples and exercises. He's also very approachable outside of class, especially during office hours. If you come to class on time and pay attention to his lectures, you'll have a good understanding of the topics covered.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Kifle is a great professor who cares about his students. His lectures are easy to understand even though he does go fast. Make sure to study the material until you understand it, and you'll be fine. He'll even help with problems during the quiz and exams if a lot of students ask about the problem.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework
