Prof. Bhalla is a really enthusiastic when it comes to Asian-American studies, but it is apparent that she is still struggling to adjust transitioning from online to in-person, mainly because not much students want to be in-person. But other than that, she offers many extra credit opportunities and is extremely understanding.

Oh my god, she is an actual gem of a person. The switch to online sucks but she is one of the few professors that is truly understanding and accommodating. No a major textbook, just online pdf's & stuff like that. Very interesting class that she is clearly passionate about.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: i never write these reviews but i just think that professor bhalla deserves more recognition. during these difficult times with COVID, she has been the most understanding, accommodating, caring, and kind professor. she has gone above and beyond to make sure that we are enjoying learning rather than feeling overwhelmed w hw. best prof ive ever had<3

I took Dr. Bhallas AMST 375, 365, and recently completed an independent study. She provides students with the list of assignments and their due dates for the entire semester with very clear instructions for each task. Shes willing to provide feedback and guidance for projects. I found the topics covered in class to be fascinating and eye-opening.

This is my second time taking professor Bhalla, and she is freaking amazing! Key to passing her class: participate in discussions, do the assigned readings and worksheets, take great notes for the final exam and projects (she does not let you use outside sources for anything), and make sure you go to her office hours. She is willing to help student
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof Bhalla is a cool person but she has poor time management & gives unequal opportunity for extra credit. She also races through the PP & DOESN'T POST THEM online while expecting us to know everything on them for exams
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Prof. Bhalla is super sweet and this class was super enjoyable because of her! If you're looking to take this class definitely take it with her. You do have to read a lot and fill out a reading guide that you'll turn in later, midterm, and one big group project, and then final exam. Honestly a super easy class, but pay attention and participate!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Took this class as an "easy A" and to fulfill my culture credit. Class wasn't hard at all, but there's a lot of reading and you have to complete your work her way. Be sure to pick competent people for your group and work on the final project ASAP.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Definitely not the easiest A, but I read every book and still ended up with a 88% in the class. If you read and show up, you're guaranteed to do super well, she rewards effort and participation very generously.

She is an awesome teacher! This class was just a general ed class for me so I was very surprised how much I enjoyed it. If you go to class and listen you will get an A. Her lectures are very interesting and engaging. She is the best professor I have had and the only person I have ever written a review for. You can only miss two classes.

I'm an Asian Studies major, but I was skeptical about taking an Asian American Studies course at first. However, the course turned out to be very enjoyable. She gives many opportunities, few collected/graded assignments, and is very clear about what she is looking for. So long as you pay attention/do reading, it shouldn't be hard to pass the class.

I really enjoyed her classes, the topics were fun and she really cares about her work, like she is enthusiastic about Asian studies and brings up very interesting topics. I honestly loved to take another Asian studies class with her. I think I learned a lot!!  No textbook but she posts excerpts from books that you need to read!

Best professor I've ever had. Never once did I fear I was going to fail. Just read and do the assignments and you'll be fine. I got 100s on everything including the midterm and final. There were only 3 major graded assignments beside the midterm, final, and final project. 100% recommend. Loved her so much I changed my major!
Professor Bhalla is amazing. She is very passionate about the course. The material she decided to cover when I took the course were all very interesting. I would highly recommend taking her course.
Very very hard class
Please take her if you can! She's so sweet & friendly! She's very approachable if you need anything, and her assignments are easy!I wish she taught more courses, I'd definitely take them!
Great course, better professor. Dr. Bhalla is the best

There aren't many independent written assignments (two exams and two journal entries), but there is a considerable amount of short readings to keep up with. None of them are hard, though. There's also a group project, but the difficulty level depends mostly on who you work with. Fair grader. Covers interesting topics. Very kind and understanding.
She was pregnant during our class, but she is the best teacher. I got  100% in the class and I didn't even try that hard. You have some busy work, but they are quick and easy.
Easy course, take it!

The class was interesting, but Professor Bhalla was very difficult.  She expects you to read so much.  You have to read essays AND books.  Combine that with other readings and assignments from a loaded schedule and it makes for a "hot mess".  Avoid taking this class with her, your sanity will thank you.

Professor Bhalla was awesome! I was in her Asian American Studies course. Even if you don't have interest in the subject, you'll end the course learning a lot of useful information. I've had 10 worksheets, 2 essays, and a research paper + presentation. Her teaching style and class material was easy to understand. Plus, she's a cutie :)
Really interesting class! Professor Bhalla truly makes the material interesting and works with the students for an overall understanding. Highly recommended for a general ed requirement.

She is so wonderful. This was the most interesting class I've ever taken. She is very accessible & loves what she does. She makes you think outside the box. The assignments and readings are useful, as well. No busy work here.

I took GWST340 and GWST100 with Dr. Bhatt and she is such an enthusiastic professor! She likes people who participate, so be prepared to speak up during discussions. Homework was easily manageable and she gives study guides on quizzes/what you need to know. Take this class with her, definitely.

Dr. Bhatt is absolutely amazing! Her class is so well put together. There is a lttle bit of everything in her class: 3 Quizzes, 1 Homework a week, some readings, and Final posterboard and paper. She is an great lecturer and she allows for you to learn about the issues from all sides and then come up with your own opinion. Best Professor by far!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's amazing. Brilliant and articulate in front of class, and clearly is passionate about the material. The class is pretty easy IF YOU DO THE WORK. Show up, be attentive, and you'll be good to go.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's a great professor. Her teaching methods are so interesting and engaging that sometimes you forget you're in class. She is more than willing to help her students when needed and her class is super easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: HOMIGAWD the class was so easy you literally have to try to not pass. One HW assignment due every week, i did mine all during spring break to get it over with, the quizzes were so straight forward i just looked at my notes the night before to review, but you have to come to class or else you loose points, and she is a sweet lady, TAKE HER

Dr. Bhatt is a great professor! Her classes are heavily discussion based, but she creates an open environment. There is a lot of reading, and then discussing the reading. There is one homework due each week, very easy, and a big research project due at the end of the semester.

I love Professor Bhatt, she is the best professor I have had in my three years at UMBC, and everything that she taught me will stick with me all my life, I learned SO MUCH! I wish she taught more classes!

Dr. Bhatt is one of my favorite professors. You can tell she really cares about the subject and wants to get you passionate about it too. Class participation is pretty big and seems daunting at first if you're not a talker, but she creates a welcoming environment and asks good questions to engage students. Easy A if you put in effort.

Very passionate and knowledgeable about the subject, respectful of and willing to work with a lot of different (and sometimes stupid) opinions, very thorough in teaching the material, expects a lot but actively wants her students to succeed. Also maintains her authority while being super nice :)

Awesome class and awesome professor! Her lectures are well prepared. Class discussions are always interesting and they really make it worth going to class. Quizzes are straightforward if you really understand the topics discussed in class. Take a class with Bhatt, its worth it.

Wonderful teacher! As long as you keep up with the assignments, you will have no problem getting a high grade with her. The assignments are fairly easy, they do require that you do the reading and understand the reading. Her lectures are extremely interesting, it helps if you participate.

Hands down the most interesting class I've ever taken. Her lectures are thought-provoking and you really look forward to each class. The discussion is intense but remember to participate, it's part of your grade! But, she's da best.

Dr. Bhatt is a very knowledgeable professor. She makes class very interesting without a boring lecture style class. There are weekly homeworks graded for participation, a midterm, and a final. If you pay attention in class, you will ace the exams. There are also opportunities for extra credit if you need them.

Dr. Bhatt is an excellent professor! Class is discussion, she keeps class interesting. Not boring at all 2 HW per week (short reading & response) 1 Midterm & a Final. HWs count higher than midterm.Marks for attendance, listen dont have to pay careful attention since most is common knowledge. Just pay attention & do HW you will get A. 2 Extra credit

Great professor! Love the way how he explains things with great examples. Easy to understand lectures. Test questions are very straight forward. Nothing tricky. Replies emails also immediately. Very help.

Really good teacher. He is clear and makes the material extremely understandable and digestible. His tests are straightforward and are based exactly on the review sheets he hands out prior. Would absolutely take his class again.

Very nice instructor and a pretty simple class.  Relies heavily on text, but you can really get by with skimming. He hands out a study guide for exams with concepts to study and even notes which parts are most important.  Uses experience and real-world examples in lectures.  Highly recommended.

I honestly don't see why people are saying this isn't an easy class; everything that's required of you is crystal clear. He's a very nice teacher and uses lots of real world examples to help you understand the concepts better, and as for the assignments and tests, there's  no tricks. He's there to help you learn.

Good professor but do not take him.. he makes the class very hard to get an A in, when if you take it with any other teacher for mgmt 210 its an easy A. Yes I suppose you learn more but everyone knows you in college for the grade not the actual learning experience..

Mr. Bhansali provides short and to the point PP slides and study guides that tell his students exactly what to study. He sets his students up for success. The test does take some memorization, but at least you know what to study! Highly recommend him!

He is a very nice guy and knows what he is talking about. He does give review sheets but it just mentioning what are the important parts of the chaper, so there isnt any questions that you can practice with. He assigns homeworks and gives 3 pop quizes. Also, a huge group project at the end of the semester.

She is cool, but her lectures are super boring, and it's difficult to pay attention. She is big on group activities. Her assignments are annoying, too. Lots of essays in the class. If you can keep up with the assignments, the class is easy. Participating in class is the worst part.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Blair is a great professor! I took her HIST 301 class and she is a very nice person that enjoy the topics she teaches. Classes are discussion heavy so attendance is mandatory. Essays and the Mid-Term and Final are based on class discussions as well. I highly recommend taking this course it was very interesting

Prof. Blair is one of the sweetest teachers and I loved her MD History class. Be prepared to write. There are 2 small papers and one big one/ research project. But she does help walk you through the project, which makes it easier. Doing the readings and attending lectures is also vital to passing her midterm/finals.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Very good professor in terms of grading. In my 2 Essays and a Research Paper, even though I'm not a History major she straight up gave me B's. The Midterm and Final is based on the class readings that she assigns, there are study guides for both the exams. Very straightforward and easy-to approach professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is really sweet and caring to her students. Her love of the subject matter carries her classes. Like most UMBC professors, she is far left politically, but unlike most UMBC professors, she doesn't beat you over the head with her politics. Great professor for public history classes. I had her as my adviser and I genuinely miss her!

Do not listen to any negative reviews about Professor Blake, I grew to really love this class and enjoy his teaching style. It is easy to succeed in this class but you must be committed and take it seriously. Do the homework, go to every lecture, and study right before the quiz. If you don't like studying or reading, this is not the class for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I like the fact he curves tests and has engaging lectures. There's also only one major essay you have to do throughout the semester, other than that its just Perusals. I did not like the fact that we had lock down browser the exams weren't too bad.

Class is 70% self-taught. Required online videos & readings (Perusall) so you're expected to understand the material before class. Disappointing bcs class time serves solely as a review session. Paper on Lochner v. New York—expectations and instructions were barely discussed in class when it is 30% of our grade. Struggles to explain concept clearly
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's strict about many things, the assignments are very clear and demanding in my opinion, and he DOES NOT CARE about the students! I suppose it is a good preparation for law school if all the professors there are prudes.
do not listen to these other reviews. this prof is evil. his lectures are so boring and he does nothing but target students b/c he has nothing better to do. avoid taking his class if u can.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This course is like an undergrad version of law school. There are a lot of readings, and many things we need to know are discussed in class. Not a lot of assignments, but memorizing concepts takes a while.

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Blake for POLI230 and he was incredible! So kind and genuinely wants his students to succeed. He even offered to read our essay drafts and give comments before we submit to get the best grade possible. 100% would take a class with him again!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Blake is a fantastic teacher! Sometimes goes on tangents, but mostly sticks to the material and is willing to humor the class answering random questions. Decent amount of reading, but if you enjoy legal jargon this class is for you! Definitely not an easy A, but he is willing to work with you if you go to office hours and put in the effort.

reviews.comment: Class is pretty straight forward with weekly readings and three quizzes. The quizzes are online but they are lockdown browser which makes it a little more difficult. Definitely recommend! He's a little intimidating because he speaks quite fast and has an encyclopedic knowledge about the subject, so really listen during his lectures. reviews.comment: One of the best professors you'll ever meet. Super passionate about the course material and gives the class an easygoing feel despite all the legalese. Also runs Moot Court!

reviews.comment: Great instructor, engaging lectures. Lots of reading, with graded annotations (easy to score high if you actually read and try). reviews.comment: Professor Blake really knows the ins and outs of constitutional law. He checks attendance so make sure you show up to class. Even tho it's in person, he records lectures and has the slides available. Def pay attention to what he's saying. Make sure to do the readings well before the due date cuz these r actual court cases so some can be v long. also if you don't read them thoroughly, make sure to google what these cases r abt so that you can be prepared for the quizzes.

reviews.comment: The best thing about his class was that I figured out that I wasn't interested in polisci, so that's a plus. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Blake is awesome and makes easy for students to succeed. There was a big paper at the end, but he helps you with sources and ideas beforehand. Just make sure you take notes in his lectures and study before his quizzes.
Hands down the best professor I have ever had, balances a healthy workload with amazing discussion and a genuinely funny approach to content. Take every class he offers!!!

First Amendment Freedoms was excellent. Each week we were assigned 3 cases to read in full. You can skim and look for summaries online to help. However, it is important to know all the key arguments made during the case. Attendance and participation mandatory, but it's super fun. Assignments/papers 2 case briefs, 2 case opinions, and 1 moot court.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Blake was my favorite professor for the semester. His class isn't super easy, but if you put in the work you get great results. Loved the debates! Most cases can be found online, but the book is so helpful. He prefers students to bring the text, but I didn't have it half the time. Prof. Blake didn't care. Awesome class and teacher. 10/10
Great Professor!

Prof. Blake is  always willing to answer questions/go over something in more detail so students feel comfortable with the material. As long as you put in effort- do the readings, participate in class and take notes- passing is easy.
Participation matters in his class, so try your best to be engaged because it's graded. Also, try to read the texts given before class; they're really helpful, so you aren't confused.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: came back to say these reviews are true.

Prof. Bloom is my favorite professor! He's hilarious and speaks his mind. Lots of reading in this class and lots of summaries, the workload is heavy. Your biggest grade is a creative story worth 100 points and there will be discussions on everyone's stories. He HATES computers, almost everything is on paper. No final exam, no quizzes. Just homework

He flip flops so much on the grading of essays. Obviously grading literature is subjective, but he seems to love taking points off for stupid stuff and then contradicts the feedback hell give in previous assignments. Terrible teacher, seems nice enough though, but nice isnt good enough when youre making a mockery out of a class students paid for

reviews.comment: prof bloom really helped my writing skills, the textbook was called they say i say and was free and really helpful. if you write to the style he likes you'll get an easy A. he really gave good feedback and only had 4 synchronous classes for the whole entire semester.

reviews.comment: One of my favorite teachers in my experience here at UMBC. He's funny, he's nice, and he cares a lot about what he's teaching and that comes through in the class and its structure. If you have to take a class, do it with him! I don't think you'll regret it.

Took class as an AH elective. Bloom is a really good teacher and the class was fun, but expect a large amount of work. Journal due every class which mostly consisted of summarizing the book. Make sure you have the time to complete all the busy work if you're going to take it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Unless you want to read 300 pages a night and write summaries until your fingers fall off, don't take this class. There are easier ways to satisfy your ENG requirement, trust me. Just don't.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He is definitely my favorite English professor I've ever taken and I've taken quite a few. You do have to read for hw and do a journal on each of the readings, and take a quiz on the readings every day. But I did feel, as a writer, he helped me improved tremendously, and I am definitely wanting to take another class with him soon!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Bloom is a good guy, and I found him to be respectful and open--we even had some annoying people, but he was still patient. There were journals due each class for the reading as well as a mini-quiz, which was a lot of work and he insisted on printing, so that kind of sucked. Otherwise I enjoyed the socratic-style discussions of the class.

I think he is the best English professor here. He does give a lot of homework in the first part of the semester then later he focuses mostly on essays. There are only 3 essays with 2 revisions. Honestly do as he says and revise your papers and you will get a good grade.

Most of the time he is really energetic and encourages the class to feel comfortable to raise their hands and provide their thoughts from readings.  Even though there was a book required for us to get at the beginning of the semester, he was careful to choose a book which he knew would be affordable and not expensive. & He likes to speak his mind.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Bloom is a shining example of professionalism and passion that very few teachers achieve. He intensely polite and insightful, and genuinely cares about helping each and every one of his students improve their writing. Will remain objective at all times, and expresses criticism without being disparaging, even went talking one-on-one.

He is really good at letting you know your faults and helps you improve upon your skills. He is very nice but can be strict at the same time. Has a lot of passion for the subject and expects everyone to participate in discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Ryan Bloom is a great professor! He's a tough grader but is always willing and happy to help you with papers, understanding readings, etc. He is so energetic and passionate about what he does, and I feel like I am learning so much in his class! While he only assigns 3 papers, he assigns a lot of readings and participation is essential to success.

Although I only received a B in his class, he was the most fun and inspiring teacher. He was always kind and would offer assistance if needed. He grades very hard but if you do your best and ask for help he will guide you. I feel like I actually learned a TON in his class and would take again!

His class is pretty easy. He only gives you 3 papers the entire semester, while other teachers give you 4 to 5 papers. He also does not give you an assignment on the freshman summer reading. He gives you the chance to do revisions on your papers so you can improve your grade on them as well. Do the assigned readings, show up, and participate.

Ryan bloom his a tough grader,  if you work closely with him you can achieve a lot. My english skills were poor when I took the class but with hard work and dedication you can easily pass the class. If you want to take English 100  with Ryan Bloom  Make sure you attend all his lectures and show up in time.

Very hard on grading. Takes a lot of points off from workshop if you do not meet his requirement perfectly. Essays have to be exactly the way he wants. Avoid if possible. Unless you love English do not take.

Professor Bloom certainly knows fiction, and certainly has a passion for it.  He is an easy professor to talk to before, during, and after class about writing and literature.  Grades are based on participation and turning in your assignments on time.  It's a fun class if you're interested and willing to do the work.

Extremely tough class. Unless you genuinely love english and appreciate the course, do not take. He treats it more than what a 100 level class should be treated as. Do essays exactly how he wants or you will fail. I went to the writing center to edit my essay and still received a 72% even though the writing center said it was perfectly fine.

This is a grueling class. You won't have fun, it won't be easy, and Bloom will be very strict. Writing essays isn't just a matter of time and diligence; you need a stroke of brilliance and inspiration to even have a topic. Bloom tries to be cool and that's where all the other positive reviews come from, but the class is very difficult.

I really enjoyed this class. Participate in discussions and come to class (on time) he takes attendance. No final, just three papers and a presentation on your third paper. Grades hard but you can turn in papers twice for a better grade. Extremely helpful if you let him know you need it.

He is a very hard professor. Gives 3 essays, does not give tests if the class does well in discussion. Very tough grader. If you are not a strong writer, I would recommend finding a different professor. This semester isn't over but I think I got a C, when I am normally an A/B student.

The class is challenging, but helps you to become a better writer. Some of the books were interesting, others not so much. Reading the books for discussions, and writing the essays were the most time-consuming. Take this class if you have a strong foundation in English and it should be a breeze.
This guy is awesome, just ask him questions and do all the small assignments and remember the LARGER CULTURE THESIS in all of your essays. Definitely one of my favorite professors.

This guy is extremely boring, the essays don't make sense and he gives incredibly dull clarity, I would not suggest this professor at all unless you are a very good writer.  Also, MAKE SURE YOU READ THE BOOK, I didn't my grade hurt on one of the Essays, the grading format was way too unclear.

He is a decent (in that you'll probably learn a lot) but slightly difficult professor (challenging grader); even above average students will struggle to get an A.  His class moves at quite a clip, and it can be a challenge to meet all the minute requirements he has, all of which affect your grade; coming to class on time, little assignments, etc.

I recommend taking his class if you consider yourself to be a moderately strong writer, as he is a tough grader; the difficulty of the class slightly exceeds that of a typical 100 level course. That aside, the books he assigns are interesting and his assignments are easy. The Group work can be a bit aggravating. Attendance is mandatory.

Compared to other English professors, he is well liked. He gives one less essay than other professors but one extra book to read. This saves a lot of time. He has a class discussion after you read each book rather than a test. You can ask him for help, but be sure to delete a paragraph if he says so. Emphasize the "larger culture" in all essays.

Too much time spent on group work. It's fine if your group is motivated, but if you get stuck with people who don't care, you're really wasting time and learn very little. The discussion of the texts we read were brief and ill focused.

I really enjoyed his class, looking back at it. Somewhat of a hard grader on the papers, so go to his office hours and to the writing center. Other than that, most assignments are easy and take no more than 5 to 10 minutes. Makes class enjoyable and fun to attend

Great teacher, it's not an easy class by any means. He's hardcore about MLA formatting so make sure you know that. He's a tough grader all around. Grades are determined by some papers, showing up to class, and participating.

great teacher. caring, approachable, involved, and dedicated. he also responds to e-mail very quickly. his reading choices are great and he is very knowledgeable. show up for class and participate in discussion and it should be easy for you. recommended!
A pretty good professor though a hard grader.
He's a pretty nice guy. The amount of books you read and essays you write are reasonable. He's a hard grader on the essays though, and I didn't like some of the essay topics.
Bad to below-average teacher who thinks he's "hip" and "with it". Avoid if possible.

An overall catch; great guy, great teacher.  He obviously is passionate about what he teaches, and makes sure everyone's on the same page.  Never hard to reach, always willing to help.  Genuinely wants students to do well, grades on self-improvement.

Even though it's only a 100 level class, there's a lot of work involved. The essays are graded really hard, so you've got to know what you're doing when writing. But class was always interesting and fun and interactive. You only read a few novels and discuss them. Just go to class and participate and you'll be fine.

I've had this professor before and he's pretty clear on how his class is structured. For ENG 233, we had to read a book a week, write 2 major papers, do a presentation, and have 5 reading responses and 5 discussion questions. It sounds like a lot but is not. The readings were really fun and interesting. Great professor!I Definitely recommend him.

Professor Bloom is a really great Professor. In this class there is a lot of reading and I wouldn't call it an easy class but he always kept it fun. I never dreaded going to his class. He generally picks pretty good books too, although you have to read a book a week. I definitely recommend him.
best professor i've had. real laid back. take this class especially if you're a soccer fan. he loves soccer

Only took this class cause it was required. Prof Kegan gives homework and reading every week along with a discussion board. There are 3 exams, 10 quizzes, and 1 final. All of it is hard. We had to buy software called TopHat and the textbook we bought was written by her. Lots of grammar and spelling errors, examples didnt make a lot of sense.

reviews.comment: Great Professor, she makes jokes and accessible outside of class. I personally wouldn't take it again. There is a total of 10 quizzes, 3 exams, and a final exam. The software used was somewhat helpful, a lot of the class is really just learning it on your own. There is a lot of reading and homework. She does also give extra credit!

reviews.comment: Professor Kegan is very good at teaching people who don't like math and don't understand. There are three exams, 10 quizzes, and a final exam. I personally wouldn't take it again since I hate math. But she is a great professor. Also... she gives extra credit opportunities.

reviews.comment: This is an independent course you really teach yourself the material. There is a short lecture class but she doesn't explain thematerial really in-depth, she just goes over it because you're already supposed to know the material before class. Really dislike the software used in this class, pricey, and wish it showed explanations not just answers.

reviews.comment: This class is very independent, and it's probably the most work i've ever done for a math-related class. Professor Kegan makes it easy for you to pass, even if you don't do amazing on the quizzes/exams. Class periods are very short, but she is easy to reach outside of class. Highly recommend her for stat 121.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I would recommend her for this class. She is very lenient with online classes and the work load was very doable with extra credit opportunities. There is a quiz weekly with an exam for every unit (three exams total with a final). The textbook reading and activities are pretty clear cut but anything you don't understand she will go over in class.

Worst prof ever, maybe bc it's virtual? Read new concepts with no instruction. Hard to hear her in zoom b/c of her loud computer fan and voice trailing off. Mistakes with textbook software add to difficulty learning. Need help? Prof says to ask classmates on chat. You have to pray someone sees it. Not nearly enough interaction or help from prof.

Best professor to take if you are not good at math. If you work hard, you can get an A. This is the best professor... she even gave out her number and would answer almost immediately if I sent her a problem from the homework or quiz that I needed help with/didn't understand. She explains things super well and is kind/understanding.

I'm not a math person so the material was still a struggle but she is great. One of those professors that can calm you down with their lecture when you get stressed while studying. The material was all online. Text/HW. Not much. Wording a little unclear, it was okay. The class had an interesting mood associated with it, really enjoyed that.

Very understanding and caring professor, she really makes everything clear, even the super difficult stuff. She wants us to succeed and does not try to trick us with difficult questions or anything like that. I really recommend her! So so so nice and just a great person. Put in the proper amount of work, and you will be successful in her class!

She's amazing! I would recommend her class to anyone. Statistics is hard ( Not a math fan, but she made it bearable) Professor Kegan is very helpful through emails, in class and during office hours. She doesn't like seeing her students give up and will motivate you keep going. Ask questions do all assignments, and do your best!

Prof. Kegan is great! It's a hybrid class so reading (tbh) is optional. But you should read since the practice questions are sometimes used on the quizzes. The quizzes and exams were very fair. It's a lot of memorization and word problems. However, Kegan is always willing to help! And the TA Michael was great. I just hate the software we had to buy
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Shes amazing. I would recommend her class to anyone. Statistics is hard ( and Ill never take another statistic class again) but she made it bearable Shes very helpful and she will work with you. She doesnt like seeing her students fail and grades quickly. Ask questions do all assignments, show initiative and youll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Kegan is so awesome! She is the epitome of a quality professor. She works hard to teach her students the material and makes herself available outside of her office hours. She is so sweet and generous. I took her during a Summer semester and the course was very accelerated. I am terrible at math but she made is possible for me to get a B!

Dr. Kegan is a great professor. She is attentive, helpful, gives so much feedback and answers all your questions. She's very clear when she teaches and her exams are not that difficult. She's also pretty funny and her classes are enjoyable.
Very nice and help full professor.

Professor Kegan's class was beyond enjoyable and I learned so much that I received an A without having to take the final! Most work is online (which is really helpful because most questions are on the quizzes and exams). Best professor I've ever had.

This is the best professor that I have ever had, by far. She's kind and caring and will do whatever she can to help you succeed. The material is easy, as long as you do the work. Her quizzes are like the homework and the tests are like the quizzes. She's always available for questions and just overall a great person. I would take this class again!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Makes more boring statistics somewhat interesting. She is funny, kind, and understanding. Weekly quizzes that you will hate by the end of the semester but are not hard (forces you to study). Clear examples with practice problems just like the quiz so use them! 2 exams that are scantron. Need to study and you will do fine. She can't make it easier!!

Mrs. Kegan is the BEST stat teacher you will ever have. She tries to keep statistics applicable to real life, and posts practice quizzes that prepare you for the actual weekly quizzes. If you appreciate a laid back and independent approach to education, you will like this class.

Prof. Kegan is a caring and funny professor. I have never had a professor be more available outside of class. She presented the class with humor and an approach that made the content understandable. The material is difficult but Kegan makes it easier. Go to class, do the extra credit and the homework as you go. You'll do well. Kegans a good prof

If you're not a math person take this professor! She is understanding and offers a lot of extra credit. I am not a math person at all and was able to pass with a good grade. She will explain anything you don't understand and will go the extra mile to help.
Willing to chat with you about homework without making you feel like an idiot, also the entire course was basically online, but being a hybrid class it made the "lecture" more understandable.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Prof Kegan is amazing. She really cares about you passing the class. She makes it almost impossible to fail. She shows you how to do everything. There are so many things she grades and lets you drop some quizzes too! I don't know how someone could fail this class. If you study and come to her discussions willing to learn. I really enjoyed her class

She made it impossible to fail the class by telling the class straight forward what she was looking for. Gives extra credit for just showing up to class (which is not mandatory) & an extra credit project at the end of the semester. Gave practice final exam that was exactly like the actual final. Great professor who is caring for her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great Professor, She was extremely helpful whenever we had questions. Her quizzes are straight from her notes and the tests are all straight from the quizzes, because of her extra credit, I got an A in the class. Awesome professor with a great sense of humor. Highly Recommended.

Gives extra credit & partial credit. Makes STAT easy for non-math people!! Gives you clear instructions. You can be awful and still pass if you show you're trying. She's funny and very understanding. Helpful and gives great feedback when you ask her. Don't slack, work hard, and ask her for help. I don't know how anyone passes STAT without her!!!

Show up to class! She is so helpful. She makes STAT easy. Gives great feedback when you ask. Tells you every question thats on final & gives you all the equations! She's funny and responds quickly. Partial credit & extra credit! You have to work bc the material is hard but believe me she is the BEST if you are not a math person
Does not give clear instruction. Very brief and unhelpful.

She's great!  Stat is hard. She basically tells you what to look for in a problem to solve it. PLUS TONS OF EXTRA CREDIT. Don't let the comments fool you. If she see's your trying you'll most likely end up with a B. You just have to put effort.  She also has online chats at your convenience at night when you can't make lab hours. TAKE HER .

If you were planning on taking B. Kegan for Statistics, run. Don't walk- run, she is the most unprofessional, unhelpful and unclear teacher I have ever had.  I will most likely end up with a B or C and that's only because I had a weekly appointment with a tutor to actually explain the material to me.  I have more to say but am out of space. Oy!
SHE IS AMAZING! TAKE HER! YOU WON'T REGRET IT!

I took this as a hybrid course as well When material got confusing after a couple weeks into the course it was obvious she was too busy to keep up with students who needed answers to basic questions Only was I ended up with a C was thanks to extra credit I recommend any other professor for Stats since she tends to teach to herself and move quickly
Take her!! She gives out tons of extra credit and the class is easy if you keep up with reading

Toke it as a hybrid course. You really only had to attend class once a week for quizzes but the other day was optional. Lots of extra credit options and grading is fair. Breaks the final exam into 2 parts in order to replace your prior 2 exam grades if you do better. Her personality is great! Just keep up w/ readings & assignments online
HYBRID COURSE- This class met two days a week and only 1 was mandatory to take weekly quizzes. Class is pretty easy as long as you do the online work. She provides summaries of the modules.

This was a useless class, The professor had little time to explain herself and the TA (Navy) or Naveet was the most useless TA I had. She spent more time being inappropriate to students than what she was teaching people. Kinda worried for whoever has to suffer with her as a teacher. Lack of academic support in the stat depo. AVOID!

Professor Kegan was fantastic. I have never had a statistics course before & her Navy (Naveet, the class TA) made the class enjoyable & interesting. I took the hybrid class & the online portion was so helpful. It explained the elements perfectly; Kegan & Navy always took the time to clarify things. I got an A- and didn't have to take the final.

I don't know what professor these people met below me but I never had time to hear from her. I think she's a good professor in a bad system lacking of academic support. The hybrid was horrid and the material never helped. Avoid this class because you won't be helped at all, you'll fall behind real fast.

Hands down the coolest professor at UMBC! She's extremely chill, hilarious, and friendly. Never had any other thoughts. If this course is required, sign up for her class. She tries hard to help us understand the material. Not much math here, just analyzing data. Easy A if you put in just a little effort. The TA is just as awesome. Take this class!!

Kegan was an excellent teacher. Very helpful and very clear if you come to the discussions. A lot of stuff is online. If you keep up with the online assignments and come to class, you'll definitely pass. Great math gen ed class!

Professor Kegan has to be the easiest statistics teacher in the world. Most of class is online, so all of the quizzes and discussions are open book. The tests are prepped with big study guides and the worksheets are not difficult either. If you're looking for an easy Math credit, this is your class. Don't take advantage of how lenient she is.

Kegan was a great professor and the subject is extremely easy. She was very nice, pretty lenient, and always willing to help. She basically ensures that all of her students pass this class and discusses everything that you're expected to know for quizzes and exams.

This is a class for people that already know their way about statistics. If you're just getting into statistics, avoid this class. If you HAVE been around statistics, prepare yourself for differing terminology that will be graded. This is a ridiculously easy course but nothing is actually taught. Very poor quality learning experience.
Easy class. She gives extra credit sometimes, so go to class!! Funny class activities. Easy exams. Take this class and get an A!!!

Very applicable projects. Professor extremely clear and willing to meet with students as needed. Requires a willingness to read and listen. Best class I've taken. If you have a choice - take this class!
She is a really nice professor. She gives you EC only for going to class, and activities are a lot of fun as well. Take this class with her, she is the best!!!

This class was really easy for me. There are 2 exams and a final. The 2 exams, she goes over a practice that is exactly like the real exam. I didn't even have to take the final...I had a really high average before the final. She is really fun and energetic. Take this easy A class!

Great Professor! You will have lots of fun in this class and will learn a lot.  SHe makes the class interesting by having fun activities.  You should either earn an A or B. It is impossible to get anything lower. Take class with her!!!!
She is so nice, always willing to help students who ask for help.
Great teacher, very helpful and generally pleasant.  Gotta stay on the ball to get the A but B's are pretty easy.  Go to class and you'll pretty much never have to study out of class.

The course material was easy enough on its own, but her lectures were very clear.  Fun class activities that remind you of 3rd grade...lots of opportunities for easy points.  Goes over all material that will be tested and very quick to answer students' questions.  TAKE THIS CLASS!

TAKE BONNIE KEAGAN'S CLASS!  She's an excellent professor who knows what it is like to be a stressed-out college student.  It is not hard at all to get an A or B in her class.  I'm so glad I took class with this professor.

This professor will grade you harshly and give you vague feedback. She gives very limited time on big papers. She asks so many questions. She wants you to read the textbook, and her lectures are long and boring. You won't understand anything in this class. If you don't like to present in front of a class, then do not take this class.

She is a tough grader and only assigns a few graded assignments, all the "assignments" we do in class are just to discuss. Her instructions are extremely vague and when asked to clarify she's even more confusing. She seems to be confused as to how Blackboard works and asks you to submit by sending her an email of the google doc the work is on.

reviews.comment: I took a cass with Prof. Bozic back when she was at a 3.3 on ratemyprofessor and it doesn't surprise me that she's down to a 2.5. For the most part, she's a typical fair grader, but there are times where she acts incredibly rude and will grade based purely on her opinions and will threaten to fail assignments when some groups tried to question her.
This profressor is the worst professor. Do not believe any good reviews about her. So many papers and annoying grading system. She is the worst.

Not awful but not great. Posts a so called "rubric" for assignments but doesn't show how its actually graded. Reads of slides for lecture so it can be boring at times. Does allow a re-write which can help your grade and does allow a grace period for most assignments. She is nice which makes her easier to approach if you have questions.

I hate going to this class. She is an extremely tough grader on every single assignment and requires attendance for her to just read off the powerpoint. She asks all these unnecessary questions to her students and if you don't say what she wants to hear, she belittles you. Just avoid her at all cost because she is terrible.

I dread going to this class. She reads directly from the powerpoint but requires attendance. I can read the powerpoint myself. I've received terrible grades on every piece of work I've done. No set criteria. If it's not what she would have said or wrote, it's wrong. Hate it here. You also have to be almost dead for her to excuse an absence.

I had Prof. Bozic during Fall 2021 as a hybrid class. She's a sweet lady, grades kinda tough, but is very willing to help you out with your writing. I found the workload very manageable, there was usually only major assignments due every 2-3 weeks and we had maybe a month or so to complete the 15 pg final.

Prof Bozic is a great professor. I had her this Fall '21 semester and the class was hybrid. The class itself is pretty easy, a couple short writing assignments and one huge 15 page formal report at the end of the semester. She's really understanding and easy going, one of the best professors I've had at umbc. Class even helped me land a new job.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof. Bozic is a older woman and is SO super sweet you can tells she loves English. Shes super fair and understands we have other classes and will extend due dates if you just ask her! HOWEVER, that final paper is NOT to f with. DO THAT SHH EARLY. ITS 15 PAGES lol if you do that you'll be good cus i did it last minute and it nearly killed me
She is a mess online. Just looking at her blackboard ultra will give you a headache. Nice professor overall but disorganized online and the grading for the entire course is subjective.

Only 5 major assignments, if you let her know ahead of time, she gives extensions. She gave me 3 and gave me full credit on everything. Honestly if you don't like writing this maybe a struggle but to be fair everything is pretty straightforward. I didn't even use my textbook got As on all the major assignments.

reviews.comment: 3.4 GPA and this supposedly easy 393 english course was wayyy harder than any other course i've taken. Not that the topics or due dates are hard. But she corrects everything, even where there aren't any mistakes. Even when following the books format to the dot as instructed, she still "corrects" it and gives everyone points off.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Easy class just a lot of writing. You have to be on her good size and will receive a good grades.

She is extremely rude. She doesn't help you when you ask her if something is correct or wrong. She is an extremely tough grader and her class is based on reports, which are ALOT. All of them are about 10-15 pages long. If you are absent more than 3 times you won't pass the class. She's not approachable at all. Will not recommend taking her.

reviews.comment: Class grade is completely based off of papers and project work, and I constantly struggle to understand expectations on writing assignments. Lecture is not engaging, so class can be hard to get through. The worst part is how unnecessarily tough of a grader she is for a class that most of us are taking for a Gen Ed credit. Good luck lol
Its a technical writing class, yet she doesnt teach you how to write. Super strict grader for no reason. Assignments are not clear, she doesnt specify everything she wants.

reviews.comment: Professor Bozic is a a very nice teacher and very helpful. Very strict/tough grader. That being said, she actually takes time out of her day to review your paper and give you a line by line critique on what you did well, and what you could have improved on. Grading is hard, but good grades are not impossible. Allows rewrites on some assignments.

reviews.comment: Char limit Mandatory purchase(launchpad)-- used it once. Two weeks/paper except the final report(we had 28 days). Doesn't understand technology and there is a report on it, If she doesn't understand your tech, you will get knocked for it. The subjectivity of the class is what sucks. If she doesn't like the way it looks you lose points. Expect a C/B

Good teacher to take Technical Writing with. For a "writing intensive" there is very little actual writing. Several of the papers are not longer than a single page and focus on format and language. Think like an office memo or formal letter.

I find the material difficult sometimes but he's a great professor. He is very friendly and open to questions + makes sure everyone is on the same page before moving on. he talks about the work he's done in ABA and I think its pretty cool :) just make sure you do the readings and keep up with the syllabus and you'll pass without much difficulty!

Dr. Borrero is one of the most organized professors I've had. His class is extremely well-structured with fill-in-the-blank notes for every lecture. He clearly outlines what to study for exams and quizzes and truly cares about his students' success. His passion and sense of humor make lectures interesting and engaging.

Dr. Borrero is a great professor. Quizzes are super easy and an excellent way to earn more points toward your grade, try to get a 10/10 on all of the CQ's because he doesn't round up grades and a few points are a matter of getting a 69 or 70. Also he is super nutty and is funny ironically and unironically.

Dr. Borrero's lectures are very interesting and he provides guided notes for each lecture to help students. Pacing of the course is good, tests aren't difficult because he tells you what to study. He is also very caring towards his students and is very interested in the topic. This is one of the only classes where I can pay attention the whole time
Avoid this guy at all cost
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I took this as a summer class so the pace was much quicker, but there was a LOT of reading and the material was dense, lots of vocab. You may have to reread sections to understand them. Luckily, Borrero provides very detailed study guides for each chapter. Stick with those and you'll do fine.
He made class enjoyable and easy to learn. If you attend class, you will get an easy A. Definitely recommend and I would over and over again.

I loved his lectures. I was enjoying listening to him. Professor Borrero is very organized and clear with clarifications. I would take this class again. I would also recommend attending to the class because you should follow the lecture and Guided Notes. They will help you prepare for the exams

Everything is clear and direct with Professor Borrero. As long as you attend all the lectures and follow the guided notes provided by him, the class is easy as can be. The lectures are interesting and entertaining as well so it doesn't feel like a drag to attend either. A must have for any class where he teaches.
If you just attend and write Guided Notes diligently, I promise you'll get a good grade. Before you take 4 exams, just read the notes at least one time.

Dr Borrero is amazing! He clearly knows and cares about this topic. There are 4 exams with 4 redo exams. The online quizzes are difficult but you can try many times. Make sure you read the syllabus before you ask him any of those questions. He is strict but understands if things happen so communicate with him and you'll be fine.
Take this class!!
He's amazing! 10/10 recommend!!!!

The only downside to Dr. B is that he doesn't teach more courses! Not the most lenient, but that's because he makes his expectations crystal clear and even tells you "this is on the test, underline it!" Tests are based on guided lecture notes, so you definitely need to show up--but his lectures are great, so you'll want to anyway. LOVED his class!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, used real life and funny examples, made sure you actually understood, fair balance of strict and laid back personality. Material was pretty heavy for me considering working 40+ hours a week and was taking another summer class simultaneously. Wish he taught more courses!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Funny and easy class. Make sure you show up to take the guided notes. Very straight forward.

Dude's class is HILARIOUS. Seriously. And you HAVE to show up, there's stuff on the tests that he only discusses in lecture-- but that's all emphasized and obvious if you show up, so don't worry about showing up and missing the important stuff.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Took him over the summer. The material can be slightly dry at times but he makes it engaging for all students even over a long lecture. One thing I didn't like about him was that he picks favorites pretty clearly, was kind of mean to people he didn't like in class. But fill in the blanks from his notes and the tests are verbatim the same. Gives EC.

reviews.comment: Show up and study the guided notes. Leavthred are fun and hes cute lol

reviews.comment: I loved his class, It's an easy A. Do all the homework in the first week of classes, and print out the packets. Then you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Borrero's lectures were very engaging and he definitely made an effort to keep his students engaged. He sets you up to get an A, all he expects is that you bring and fill out the guided notes in class and study them before the exams. There's no final so the grade is based on 4 exams and more. But the class is an easy A with minimal work.
Very enthusiastic about what he teaches and gives practical examples
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Borrero is hand's down the BEST pysc professor at UMBC. He is so clear with his class, and grading. There is absolutely no way anyone can get lower than an A in his class. He gives unlimited attempts on quizzes (which are from the book) and he has retakes for all of his exams + study guides from lecture(provides lecture notes).
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Borrero is one of the best professors I've had in my four years of college. If you get a change to take a class with him I highly recommend it. You'll learn a lot.

This class was great. Borrero is energetic, funny, very clear, and always willing to help. He is there to teach. He makes you want to learn the material. Gives guided notes which are lifesavers to study for tests. 4 tests, no papers, online quizzes and that's it. Gives remedial exams if you need them. Extremely clear grading system. He is the best!

Dr. Borrero is the best there is when it comes to Learning in psychology. I took his 6-week summer course and while it's very fast-paced and the material is dense (yet interesting), it's so well-organized that it is practically impossible to not get an 'A' if you go to class and keep up with the online work. Yes, he can be a tad arrogant at times.
He is funny, keeps lectures exciting. I would take again with him!
He's very helpful and passionate about what he teaches. GO to class! just study from the notes he gives you. Everything you need to know for the test is on them! He also allows you to retake tests!

Fantastic professor whose lectures are always engaging. He is funny and gives good examples to help you understand the topic. Make sure to pay attention because clicker questions are part of your grade. Lots of opportunities for extra credit, along with remedial exams to make up for lost points.

Very easy class. Lots of extra credit opportunities. Easy exams that come straight from lectures. Attend class since notes are not posted on blackboard. Allows you to retake each exam and takes the highest of the two grades. Weekly online quizzes come straight from textbook and are a little more challenging but you can take them an unlimited amount

Attendance isn't required, but there are questions on exams that you really can't answer unless you were in class. He keeps things interesting, there's pretty much no way to fail this class. You can retake online quizzes as much as you want, and you get a chance to retake all four exams. You would really have to try to fail.

GREAT professor! Expectations are very clear, Uses a lot of pop culture references to make material easy, & he's very funny! Class was interesting & he gives 2 chances on all exams. Book only used for online quizzes which you take as many times as you want. I highly recommend taking him!
Good Teacher. Moves very fast but gives study guide fill in the blank notes for lecture. Need to know the material not an easy A.

Dr. Borrero expects you to work had and know your stuff. He quizzes you and offers extra credit, along with clearly defining his expectations several times throughout the course. Take him if you want to learn something. Not an easy A, but manageable if you dedicate a couple hours a week to study. He is a good lecturer.

Entertaining. Goes fast occasionally. Gives you guided notes. Lots of extra credit and opportunities to boost grade. Enjoyed going to his class. Read directions to tests, he gives bonus points if you follow directions. gives 48 hours grace period for online quizzes even though its do before then. Really good teacher. Impossible not to get an A.

The beginning of the semester he tells you exactly what needs to be done to get an A in his class. If you do exactly that and A is very obtainable in his class. He's a very easy to follow and his energy makes attending class interesting. Attendance isn't mandatory but I recommend being in class because the textbook isn't as helpful as his lecturing

One of the best teachers I've had at UMBC. Makes the class very easy to get an A (12 online quizzes that can be retaken infinitely, 4 exams that can be retaken once each, extra credit, provides fill-in-the-blank notes). Very fun teacher with great sense of humor and great interest in the subject matter. Highly recommended professor and course.

Psych of Learning. Probably the best teacher for it. Makes it easy to get an A. If you don't get an A. You are a complete failure at life. He's open to discussion in class, tests are relevant to lectures, helpful during office hours, and he's funny.

Borrero is one of the best at UMBC! He turns a boring subject into a class you want to attend. Classes consists of guided notes & funny videos. Your grade is a bunch of quizzes you can take as many times as you want & 4 tests (all with makeups if you do poorly) & plenty of extra credit for attending class. Hard not to get an A if you try at all!

Really, really fantastic professor. Fully prepared for every class, provides guided notes, has remedial exams for each exam you take, and is willing to explain for as long as needed until you understand. Also very funny and down to earth. TAKE HIS CLASS!

Great professor. Makes it extremely easy to get an A. He works with you and is open to interaction during lecture. Very welcoming and you can tell he cares about what he is talking about. He wants you to leave his class with new knowledge and works with you if you don't understand. In the beginning he makes it clear what he expects so remember that

Hands down one of the best professors at UMBC. Knows his stuff and also knows how to teach. He's clear, gives every chance he can to give students good grades, such as letting you take each test twice! Class is always fun and interesting too. He is highly recommended to any major.
Hands down, one of the most coherent and respectable professors I've had.

One the best teachers I ever had!! Huge fan!! He explained everything so clearly in class, that when it came time to studying for the exam- I only had to review the information. HIGHLY suggest taking him!!!
Awesome all the way around!

Dr.Borrero is one of my favorite teachers I have had at UMBC! He is very knowledgeable, energetic, caring, and has a GREAT way of explaining things. He is meant to be a teacher! He also is very good at keeping your attention, even though the material isn't that interesting!

He is extremely helpful! He keeps class extremely interesting through a lot of not so interesting material. I laugh a lot in this class. I definitly recommend him, he makes it impossible to fail. He is extremely organized.
Allow me to pile on; Dr. Borrero is a fine professor. He's and enjoyable lecturer so, while attendance is not mandatory, it's recommended. I'd highly recommend his courses to other students.

Definitely one of the best professors I've had!!!He made the class SO much easy and fun.Inspite of being so easy, he provides a whole lot of extra credit and second chances for quizzes and exams. This class is highly recommended.

Definitely one of the best professors I've ever had. He uses really good & easy to understand examples, he tells funny stories, we almost always finished material early, and I definitely feel like I learned a lot. Plus, the class is structured to give second chances for all quizzes AND exams (there's no way to fail!)...great class!

Dr. Borrero is 100% devoted to making a tough text and difficult material understandable and even fun for the class.He spends a lot of time and effort with guided notes, learning objectives, and lecture materials. He puts other boring, unprepared, and out of touch professors to shame. Take this class- you'll love it!
EXCELLENT PROFESSOR, TAKE NOTES!!! AND VISIT DURING OFFICE HRS FOR HELP IF YOU DON'T UNDERSTAND SOMETHING...use your classmates for help too!!!Don't be afraid to speak up in CLASS :)
Funny. Easy. Take this class.
The best teacher I've ever had. Makes the Class interesting and gives many chances to make up bad grades. All Classes should be based like this one.
Great teacher. Funny! Class is usually not boring although sometimes the material is rather dry. Go to class and take notes and the tests are easy.

Weekly or biweekly chapter quizzes online, 4 tests, quizzes and exams can be RETAKEN for better grade, extra points along the way, very funny and you WANT to come to class. New to UMBC but you'll love him. As long as you go to class, take notes, and review notes, you'll be fine on tests. Multiple Choice everything. Lectures never boring.
Very friendly and clear in his lectures.
Took his class at UMBC, he's a great teacher and extremely friendly. Would highly recommend anyone to take his class.

Wonderful Professor, he actually cares about you and is always available during office hours. He is very attentive  to the needs of his students and a good teacher.  He takes his time to listen and answer all your questions.

Amazing Professor. He's about to finish his PHD and genuinely cares so he won't let you fail. Quizes and test are exactly what he discusses in class and will literally tell you exactly what is on the quiz/ exam if you ask.
Class was pretty easy overall, though it wasn't light on work. Participation in the online lectures was graded.

Professor doesn' really engage students or was very approachable. She just meant business when she came to class and completed reviews. Good/ easy professor would take again.

reviews.comment: I had hard time learning spanish but professor Box made it so much better, Yes she is very stric and cold with her lesson but she understand that you are just learning so she is pretty chill. She was also a student so she knows what to expect from the student. Just do the homework and the assignments and you are good to go.

Is not an easy class, however professor Box made is so much easier. She is quick on her lessons but dont be afraid to ask her questions. Overall great professor I would of taken her if she had taught 102 but I think she only teaches 101

I love Professor Box . She is also a student I think working for her master so she understand you when you are having trouble. She is very on point with lessons always follow the study plan that is posted in BB. my Spanish lab is a little too much but she cant control that because is a university had plan it. I would take her if she taught 102

she was very nice, approachable, and organized. she's young so she's not prudy, she grades fairly. there is a lot of online hw but the homework was mostly easy to do, there are clear due dates so there wont be any changes and it will affect your average so you have to do it. overall i would take her again

reviews.comment: nice guy, lectures are HEAVY on notes so if you like notes you'll do good. i had gripes with the amount of reading quizzes for a calc class but apparently thats just how it works usually, nothing to do with dean himself

Take Dean if you can, he's the GOAT. I never went to lecture because he posted all of his notes and they were straightforward. The discussion quizzes help you not fall behind. His exam review he uploads is basically the exam but with different numbers. Thanks for making what I've heard to be a tough course an easy A+ and great learning experience!

He's the best math professor to take if you have the option, his extra credit on exams are very clutch, just try not to stay behind and do practice quizes/exams (they are the same as the exams but with different problems but same concept) and youll pass easily. He grades very leniently and wants everyone to pass

Provided very clear and accessible information for everything you need to know about the course. Lectures were intuitive and informational. If you do all the homework and discussions, most of the questions on the test are repurposed from those assignments. Manageable workload, studying material is plentiful. Overall amazing prof
didn't go to lectures, only discussions. Use practice exams to study, they are the same problems, just different numbers. dont miss any homeworks and study for your quizzes.

Great professor, especially considering the content density of Calc 2. Makes lectures comprehensible and digestible. Reasonable exams. He is no-nonsense and gets straight to the point. Blackboard is very organized with several resources for studying. Calc 2 is a difficult course, but he definitely makes it bearable.

This class is very by-the-book. Prof. Dean goes very quickly, and the class follows naturally, making it hard to catch up if you get lost. Also, he's very strict with grading. I had a 103 fever and had to sit for an exam with a box of tissues. His office hours WILL NOT help you, as his explanations are "That's just how the process is ".

I have some complaints about his TA's, but Professor Dean himself is very kind and shows a clear understanding of the material in his lectures. The homework consists of reading quizzes and homework that have clear due dates, as well as a quiz every week in our discussion. I'd highly suggest doing the practice exams!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lectures felt like we were just trying to get through the material vs. trying to really get it. However, Dean is clear, concise. Class went over a lot, which sucks because it's at night. Weekly quizzes. 3 exams, best 8 quizzes. Final is cumulative.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Dean is amazing. Hand-writes all his lecture notes & posts them immediately after. Provides practice midterm exams which are very similar to the actual exams. I went to his office hours almost weekly, and he cares about helping students understand calc 2 concepts. He does go over a few minutes in lecture often though.

Dean's lectures are beneficial because he excels at explaining concepts in class and posts his notes online. Also, his practice exams help a ton for the midterms in the course. Overall, great professor.

Teaches clearly and straight forward. No calculators at UMBC so it makes the math problems simple. 

Drops lowest quiz grades, replaces lowest exam grade with final and grades exams generously with extra points available.

Just study the practice exams and quizzes, extremely similar to the ones they test on to get a high grade.
Math 150 might be the easiest class I've taken thus far. The quizzes, group quizzes, and exams are so straightforward. Dean is a good professor with understandable and well-paced lectures.

The course itself is really easy, but his teaching method doesn't work for everyone. Really nice guy and funny at times, not a tough grader but his teaching style feels rather repetitive at times as though he's just saying things and not actually explaining them. Also, very lecture heavy but he provides resources to learn outside of class.

Prof Dean is amazing. Very easy to understand and all of his tests are basically identical to the practice tests he gives you. He writes his own notes at the start of each lecture so it is very easy to stay with him while he talks. Overall he made precalc very easy and I will be taking him again for calc 2.

2 weekly quizzes: 1 group (T.A.s give answers), 1 solo (same test). 20 min before solo, content reviewed. The lowest 3 groups & solo quizzes dropped. 4 easy exams; 3 have practice exams, actual exam changes numbers from practice. 
No time-wasting Qs in class. Ask vital Qs to proceed; others after class.

Long Lectures.

TAKE NOTES OR YOU WILL FAIL

Lecture can be a bit confusing but overall a good professor. I went to tutoring for extra help and that helped a lot with exam review to. The Practice exams are really similar to the actual exams so make sure you know the material!

If you are going to take Math150 MAKE SURE YOU TAKE PROFESSOR DEAN. I've always thought I was bad a math so going into this class I was nervous, but professor dean actually teaches you rather than just solving problems from a slideshow (targeted lol!) Just read and show up and you will be ok!
He's great practice exams are similar to the real exam so you should be fine.

Professor Dean goes through things a little quickly, and it seems hard to get a question in, but you can tell he cares. He is very polite and responds to emails quickly. The class is very formulaic, so once you get into a pattern that works for you, you should be comfortable for the rest of the semester. There's a lot of quizzes (two per week).

Notes are so good because he writes literally everything down, illustrates concepts clearly and USES HIS ERASER TO CORRECT NOTES because he's a perfectionist, so you can study on your own just with those notes.
lots of extra credit built into exams, final grade replaces another exam if it's higher than that midterm, gives a lot of partial credit.

Don't listen to anybody who says the lectures are "boring". They don't know what they are talking about. It's a math class and it's gonna be boring, but Dean helps you understand. 

Gives good notes and is always able to help if you don't understand. Idk about others, but he gave me an extension for a quiz when I asked.

Dean is an okay professor. He lectures constantly, but I managed to keep up. Pay attention and take notes. Weekly homework is good for practice. Discussions are crucial for tests/quizzes, but with a good TA, you'll be fine. You can't cheat; exams and the final will cook u, so lock in.

TA graded unfairly and when i talked to him about it he didnt seem to care that much but his exams made up for it. Actually go to lecture because even if you half pay attention it will help alot with the final which is kinda rough

Legendary professor. He explains concepts so well. The class was a breeze. The exams were hilariously easy. They were basically the practice exams he gave but the numbers were switched up. The quizzes are also easy. Homework is assigned every week and they can range from 10-20 problems but it isn't too bad. Overall, incredibly easy class.

Solid. The only word to describe him. Every quiz has a corresponding practice quiz that's clear and extremely efficient in preparing you for exams and quizzes. He made Calculus II feel like the easiest college course Ive ever taken. 10% extra credit available on exams, extremely lenient grading, he wants to see you do well in this course; it shows.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, really wants you to learn. Grades the exams really easily too.
Brian is the best professor out there for math. People coming into Calc may find that he goes fast in his lectures, but he posts his notes online and is super lenient on grading for the exams.
Good professor, easy tests, but boring

If you don't take Calc 2 with Prof Dean, you are doing yourself a disservice. His class is amazing, exams are very simple, and--if you study diligently--you can find yourself getting an A. He never throws trick questions or something not following the format of his practice exam, etc. I did much better in Calc 2 than Calc 1 because of Prof Dean.

Took this Spring 2024. He was a good lecturer, but sometimes he'll introduce a new concept quickly and rush through problems with it. Just attend lectures, and do the homework.

I don't think he is that awful of a professor but I would also cry in the middle of his lectures because his course load was super overwhelming.

Absolutely phenomenal professor, in my opinion he is the pinnacle of what a professor should be. Respectable, helpful, makes it clear what he expects and fair. Outside of attending lectures, if you review the practice exams and go to the discussions to review that weeks quiz topic, you will breeze through the class. No tricks, thats all u gotta do.

I took Dean last semester for Calc 2 and he does everything he can to make sure you pass. The practice exams are almost the exact same as the ones you take and while he may be super by the book (I stopped attending lecture after maybe a week), he's infinitely better than the other calc 2 professor (tighe). Do not take her, take Doctah Dean.

Best prof ever for MATH 152, if you have to take MATH 152, take it with Dean over Tighe, explains everything straight in lecture, makes harder concepts easier to understand by breaking them down.
5/5

Not good at explaining things and kind of have to figure things out yourself

I had Prof. Dean for Math152, and he was great. I used the textbook to complete pre quizzes, other than that lectures always covered what I had read and examples were often pulled from the text. Best Math professor ever, explains everything clearly, speaks a little fast so a good calc foundation is necessary as he skips simple steps during lecture.
