How does a lecture feel boring and fast at the same time? Lots of homework, but practice exams are basically identical to the actual. If you can keep your eyes open through the lectures, or skip them since he posts the notes, you'll be kinda fine for quizzes and exams. Just do some practice outside of class. Kinda easy A.

reviews.comment:
Prof. Dean does gives a lot of homework but almost all the prac exams and class exams are identical to one another. His lecture are easy and understandable, you can tell how much he care for his lesson when he HAND writes his lecture on the presentation like a champ. 

HE IS THE GOAT in MATHEMATICS

The lectures are very comprehensive and very thoroughly explained for all concepts. He goes over core examples and harder examples that you may see on the homework. for someone learning Calc II for the 1st time, his class was easy. homework was too much tho - so much harder than the actual exams and quizzes. exams were easily and straightforward as long as you took the practice exams - they're practically either identical or very similar with different numbers. THE Doctah Dean is nothing to worry about!

reviews.comment: He gives a LOT of examples in class, and goes into very good detail for all of the concepts. There is a lot of homework. You better hope you don't have anything come up and have to miss a quiz in his class. This man LIVES by his syllabus and thinks his course policy is more important than your life. He drops the three lowest quizzes but offers no makeups whatsoever unless its for sports or religious holidays. He's an okay professor but not a good person.

Honestly the best calc 2 professor that umbc has. If you attend classes and actually pay attention, you'll get by pretty easily. Great professor especially if math isn't that great

got the bad grade cuz I didn't put in as much effort as i needed too. but like, he's not a bad professor, he's very accessible outside of class and will answer ur questions if you email him! between him and tighe, he is def the lesser of two poisons (for me at least). I just wish he'd give us practice quizzes for the weekly quiz we'd have.

There is a lot of reviewing, quizzes and exams are short and sweet and he uploads notes after every lecture. Make sure to review them. Will take calc 2 with professor Dean for sure

Professor Dean was my Math106 Professor. This was his first time teaching this course, and he seems to know what he was doing. Since it was first time, he had no study guide for his Mid-term.  The only downside I did not like about him is, he tends to skips steps which make it harder to learn. Other than that, he is a great Professor!

Do the HW, study, and show up for your quizzes and you'll pass. TAs were very helpful and probably the only reason I passed with an A, but a win is a win.
Doctah Dean made the kitty purr!!! He rounded my grade up from 68% to 90% for a sloppy toppy. Loved his class overall! Highly recommend taking him.
Good lecturer. Quizzes were quite challenging and were graded harshly by TA's, Exams on the other hand were much less tough thanks to good practice exams provided (none for quizzes).

He is a very good prof, worth taking his class as most things calc 2 isnt the most fun, but his class was about as good as things are for calc. Tests werent awful the only issue is the TAs where very bad for my section and graded insanely hard.

Proffesor Dean teaching style is difficult, he talks mainly for the class time. Isn't helpful during office hours and if you ask a question about anything he seems annoyed. reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: he was very nice and understanding but i'm not a big fan of the people who teach the discussion. The class is easy if you know what your doing. Take Dean over Tighe if you're not a math major.  Dean makes calculus only as hard as it needs to be.  Is very clear on what he wants you to know by giving you practice exams which are very similar to real ones.  Has accessible office hours.  Extra 10 points built into every exam.
He is a very awesome professor. If you just attend well and review at least once, and solve exam practice problems, you will get a good grade. His lecture is very simple and straightforward.

He's a good professor and makes the material a little easier to learn. Drops lowest homework and quiz grades so you have a few chances to do well. TA's grade very slowly for there to be three of them but the discussion and group quizzes help solidify the idea of what you're learning.

It was lowk an easy class for a math class, f you do listen in class because he explains well IMO, the class should be pretty straightforward. It's a math class so it's going to be a little complicated but it's doable

Lectures are not enough to understand material and is v easy to fall asleep so just skip he posts notes on blackboard, hw is easy but do not forget due dates, practice exam is the same as axtual exam, group quiz and all practice is like the weekly quizzes. Dean is pretty good at teaching and easy to understand. Discussion sections are mandatory because that's when you take the weekly quiz. TAs are not the best. reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Although I never met him in person because this was a fully online course, he was an awesome instructor. Math is not my strong subject and watching his lectures were extremely helpful. I never reached out to him outside of class, but he made it clear that he was available. He also had excellent communication and sent emails regularly. Go to SIPASS!
This was probably the easiest class I've ever taken at Umbc, I got like 105% in this class, he's a great professor and as long as you pay attention to what he teaches in class you should do well!
The best Math professor I've had at UMBC! Definitely recommend taking his class!

All of the lectures were recordings from many months ago, and though I cant blame him for it, I would have liked to see a live lecture or two. The TAs/TFs were meh. he didnt care about lectures and if you attended or not but the hw he posted was super easy and if you didn't understand something you could watch his lectures or view his notes. The quizzes were super easy. He drops 3 of ur lowest quiz and hw grades.

By far the best math professor I've had. Despite being online and lectures being recorded, he made the content make sense. Exams were multiple choice and T/F. Just stay on top of homework and quizzes and you'll be fine.

Online class due to COVID-19. Great lectures, explains things well, and is very punctual when it comes to anything. He is always prepared and sends out emails whenever a deadline or something important is coming up. Very active professor and would def reccomend taking him as your Calculus 2 professor.

Online: He posts lecture content on the days that classes are typically run. He explains everything very well and he makes himself available outside of class if you need help with problems with the homework. All of his quizzes and exams are multiple choice and true/false, so basically one little mistake will lead you to the wrong answer. He's great

No partial credit, just all-or-nothing. This also meant there were no practice exams (maybe wait until after COVID to take this class). Textbook was used for two sections.

Prof Dean was great! I had a family situation that made me miss first exam but he was understanding to let me retake it. Clear grading criteria. Took him during covid, so exams were multiple choice (which is a plus and a minus cause no partial credit). Lectures easy to understand. Sends many reminders about due dates. Quiz is based of HW

reviews.comment: Professor Dean is the best option for calc 2. Incredible teacher who takes an extremely difficult subject (series and sequences) and manages to make it simple and easy to understand. Attend lecture, do the homework/quizzes, and study the notes and you'll get an A. Great professor overall!

brian dean is a goat professor. he had quizzes every week on thursday and homework was due every week on tuesday. i have accomodations for extra time and he also reached out to me and asked when i wanted to take the test. definitely going to try to take him for calc. never had any syncronous classes too which is nice
Super easy and straight forward. Class went very smoothly and was easily accessible outside of class.

I would just advise you to make sure you can do the problems quickly because sometimes the exams r a time crunch
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

Dean is one of the legends in the Math Department at UMBC, and rightfully so. If you go to lectures and read his lecture notes, you're more than likely to get a B. Calc 2 is hard stuff. Dean makes it somewhat learnable. I personally didn't go to lectures because I liked learning from HWK and his notes. Great teacher, will have him in later classes.

reviews.comment: A solid teacher if you're not strong in math. Though I would recommend taking si pass as the lectures are mainly for notes and are rarely enough to learn the material. Exams are reasonable and even easy as long as you have a general scope of the content.

Loved 150 w Dean but 152 was different, was expecting better. TONS of derivation, felt like he was reading from the textbook at times. Practice exams almost 1:1 to the real deal.

reviews.comment: study guides, sample quizzes, and sample exams are very similar to the actual assignments. Lots of extra credit assignments. Rational grader. He posts everything online but they don't really make sense unless you come to the classes.

Lectures are gems. Don't show up late, he gets bothered by door opening and closing. He spends some extra time deriving pointless theorems but he teaches very well. reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Litterarly cant ask for a better teacher. One of the best teachers in UMBC without a doubt. Amazing at explaining the topics during lectures, exams the same as practice test, homeworks are easy, and a down to earth guy. That's an A+ For me
Lectures are pretty boring, does some unnecessary work to derive theorems in the beginning of classes. Fast paced lectures. Only good thing practice exams are same format as actual exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: practice exams and lectures went hand in hand with exams and homework. If you show up and take notes the class is easy to follow.

Professor Dean is definitely one one of the best teachers I've had so far and is a super down to earth guy. He gives pretty easy homework once a week. His sample exams are almost identical to the real exams which makes studying a lot easier. Professor Dean and his TA's are really caring and truly want you to succeed. 100% recommend!!!!!

The best teacher I've had at UMBC. He is willing to adjust things for the class if he feels like the students haven't been taught the material well. He gives amazing lectures and takes notes as he is speaking and posts them on blackboard. He posts practice exams before every exam that are very useful. Overall Professor Dean is an awesome professor.

Dr. Dean was always very prepared for his lectures which were also very consistent with the progression of the book. Grading was simple and clear and tests were graded out of 100 points, though you could earn up to 110. Homework can be taxing but helps a lot. Practice exams were VERY consistent with actual exams so test prep was a breeze. Easy A

Dr. Dean is a really good professor and really nice. It is easy to do well in his class if you review his notes and his practice questions. All his practice questions are helpful, explains really clear in lecture.

Math 152 is the same style as Math 151- 1 quiz and 1 homework per week. Prof Dean is a solid professor and I would recommend to specifically people not that good at math. The tests are the same as the practice tests so that definitely helps boost your grade! From what I've heard, Prof Dean's class is also easier than Prof Tighe's class.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The legend Dr. Dean really cares about this class. His lectures are very informative and well prepared which helps increase the number of topics we cover. As long as you are sturdy with the practice exams you'll be good on the actual exams.

Although I found his voice to be quite funny, I liked how he structured his exams to be identical to the practice exams, except that he puts different numbers/ slightly changes the questions up. If you just study the practice exams and get a decent sense of what is going on, you should be fine.
Bdeanz is a quality guy, tests are similar to the practice exam and the TA's help a lot. He breaks down things well in the lectures but you don't really have to go
Great professor and great class. Dean cares and if you put in the effort you will do well. He gives practice exams that are nearly identical to real ones. Homeworks are good preparation and practice.
All around good professor. pretty average classes

My manz bdean out here coming through with all the practice exams and quizzes. The exam questions are same as quizzes- just different numbers. Do the practice exams he post online- it's literally the same. He's a great professor that really wants you to learn and is truly enthusiastic about his class. Anyways love bdean.

Look my homeboy Dean, best guy on campus. The man might be a little hard to listen to because his voice kinda puts you to sleep but, if you pay attention you will pass class. The man puts his heart and soul into all of the lectures, he wants you to make sure you know that damn material. You wont regret taking his class and the exams are easy.

Dean is my manz, great guy, beautiful voice, and very down to earth wholesome person in general. His exams are very similar to the practice exams, the final is gonna be hard, but his lectures are amazing therefore you went to most of them, you will do great! :)

Professor Dean had very good lectures and you will now what to do as long as you pay attention. He gets the material across very well and always answers question, answering them without taking up too much of the lecture time. Exams (3 exams and 1 final) are much easier than hw, so focus on being able to get through the hw.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: For someone who barely showed up to lecture + discussions, I still got an A in this class. The exams are exactly similar to the practice exams. I got a 100% on all of them. The final is extremely hard, so do your best on all the exams, so you don't have to stress about it.
Ehhhh. Material isn't taught very well
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Dean is the Calculus 2 teacher every student at UMBC should have.  His class is not easy, but some effort and the willingness to seek assistance can make a relatively challenging class a reasonable one.  Like Calc 1, there is 1 homework and 1 quiz per week.  Review his notes before every homework and quiz and you'll be fine.
Very straightforward lectures. Explains everything very well. Good at what he does.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Has homework due online once a week, discussions and lectures are not mandatory, would help with understanding though. Notes are posted online, the practice exams are almost the same format as the exams he gives, study those. Final is cumulative and not his test though, hard final
His voice tends to put us to sleep, however he is a good teacher. He goes into detail and gives lots of examples of problems which is beneficial when you want to study for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He's just really good at explaining everything during lectures.

3 exams, 1 final, quizzes every class but they help you keep up with the material. Responds to emails promptly. Puts up lecture notes online and practice exams to study from. He can put you to sleep during lecture. Would take him again over Raji. Does offer extra credit. Keep up with online homework. Can drop some quizzes. Easy A
Easy to fall asleep during his lectures. Much of the work is online, tough to keep up with but you're doomed if you don't
Dr. Dean is by far the best math teacher I have ever had.
Very dry lectures. Picks semi-hard to hard problems for quizzes and tests. Notes arent helpful. Doesnt give enough examples.

He was a great professor, and very funny as well. His lectures go over everything you had to do in the reading prior to class. A lot of quizzes in this class so be ready, but you can drop a lot of your lowest scores. 2 Mid-terms and a final make up a decent portion of your grade. Just read, and pay attention, this class was very easy.
His grading is very fair, weekly homework is longer than some professors assign, but completely reasonable and relevant.

Professor Dean is amazing. His lectures are straight forward and easy to understand. Homework is always relevant to classwork and helps a lot with exams. Will answer any questions and provides lots of office hours or feedback. If the final is campus wide it may be a bit harder than his tests which surprises people, otherwise amazing professor.

His voice kinda puts you to sleep. His exams and quizzes are no where as hard as Tighe's. He does do a small curve at the end of the semester. Make sure you do the math gym extra credit. 2 quizzes are dropped and lowest exam grade is replaced if you do good on the final. He also posts the lecture notes on BlackBoard if you need it.

Dean is a decent professor, but that's about it. He gives a ton of examples, but doesn't go in depth to explain any of them. He goes very quickly through class, so don't even consider skipping or sleeping through lecture. There are better mathematics professors at UMBC.
Dean was a good professor better than raji and he is approachable and helpful in giving advice.

Dean gives an easy A, and gives incredibly easy to understand lectures. I wouldn't take this course for fun though -- it's just a semester of memorizing methods of solving specific equations. Tests are nearly identical to the sample ones posted, and they all have extra credit available.

Lectures aren't mandatory but go if you don't want to read the book. Dean does a great refresher if you're refreshing on Pre Calculus. His notes are clear cut and if you need help, he is there. It's not hard to get a good grade since he does drop some homework s, tests, and there is extra credit on tests so there is no curve.
very clear and precise! must take for 150. His tests are a cakewalk, very easy and not tricky at all. highly recommended.

I've only been able to suffer through calculus 1 and 2 because of this man. Amazing professor. Gives a bunch of examples during class and is very good at explaining the material. Very nice and approachable. Beware that you DO need to do the homework and practice problems or you WILL NOT pass. His exams are hard but he'll prepare you well for them.
Brian dean is an amazing teacher, he explains things well and cares about his students success

DEAN IS GREAT. He is an extremely nice and smart guy! He is always there to answer any questions or clear up any confusion you have about the material. Took him for Pre-calc, Calc I and now Calc II. Calc II is by far the hardest, but if you ACTUALLY DO WEBASSIGN & study by doing the practice another versions & the practice exam, you'll pass!

Dean is the man! He's so clear in his lectures and is right on top of things if the syllabus has to be altered due to snow days or something. Calc 2 is a tough class, but his exams are extremely fair and if you work hard, you'll be fine. Take Dean!

Took him for both 151 and 152, best teacher I've ever head by far! His lectures are extremely well prepared. He writes his own notes at home, then copies them on to the board for everyone else to write down. Test questions are straightforward, but also hard enough to keep up with any other class. Highly recommend!
He is my favorite math professor ever
He is the best professor ever

Dr. Dean is THE BEST math professor, and one of the best professors in general that I have ever had.  I hated math before taking it with him, now I love math.  Wonderful at explaining. Always willing to help in any way he can.  Wish I could take him again.  Also seems to be genuinely nice guy.  Seems serious but is funny sometimes/hot too.

Great teacher. He makes his own notes at home, then rewrites them on the board every class. His tests are not too hard if you put in the effort to study, and he gives a lot of partial credit. Even if you get every question wrong on a test, if you show all your work, you can still get a B. I took him for 151 and 152. By far my favorite teacher.

TAKE HIM!! super easy!! class was like high school calc. attendance optional. quizzes and tests are easy. only takes best 8 quizzes and best 10 hws. His tests are easy too, they're like the quizes of my friends in other classes. glad i took him!!

Really good professor. Gives clear and structured examples during lectures. Responds to emails quickly and will provide many resources to help if you're struggling(which I was). Class shouldn't be too difficult if you do a moderate amount of studying and go to lectures.

Awesome awesome awesome teacher! TAKE HIM!! He puts his lecture notes online in case you miss something or miss class. He explains things very well and his tests are so reasonable its criminal! He is sort of monotone but very cool guy
Dean is a good teacher and very helpful, but it can be hard to focus with his dry teaching style. I usually found myself learning the material in discussion.

I feel bad for my friends taking this course with other professors. Dean makes this class a breeze, least of my worries. He gives practice exams that are great preparation for this actual exams along with extra credit, drops two homeworks too. He's very serious but a very cool guy. You'll get used to his californian accent.

One of the best professors I've ever had!! With many math professors lecture is a complete waste of time, but that is not the case with Prof. Dean. He tells you what you need to know in the clearest way possible and gives plenty of examples in class that help with homework. Answers emails very quickly. UMBC made an excellent choice by hiring him.
Best professor

I imagine the higher up the courses get the harder Dean gets, but for Precalc he's not bad (this coming from a student who had already taken precalc in HS).  Lecture notes are online so you don't have to scribble in class, but his quizzes and tests are difficult.  Good professor though overall.
His class was hard. He has a really cool personality but he just teaches so many concepts at once.

Toke this class last year and it was not fun. Puts you to sleep with his monotone voice and crushes your moral with his impossible tests. I was straight A math student since high-school and Calc I coming into this class before I got my first D. Tests ask  questions that are not gone over in class, he expects you to read the book and learn from it.

Please do yourself a favor and do not take his class. His exams are super hard and his quizzes are very tricky. He often teaches a concept and then asks you to apply it to situation or problem completely different than what was done in class. Never curves and moves way to fast. All he does is proofs during class and never does an practice problems.

TAKE DEAN. He gives clear and detailed notes during class, homework is from the book and straight forward, and exams are from the homework. He is always willing to help. You will not find a better or easier professor at UMBC.
BEST TEACHER AT UMBC TAKE HIM HE WILL MAKE YOUR LIFE SO MUCH EASIER

Really great prof, and one of the best math teachers I've ever had. Though it's a lot of writing in class, the notes he gives are very detailed and great to study from. As long as you show up to class and take notes, the class is easy to pass and there are no surprises on his exams at all. Great guy, pretty cute too! I definitely recommend him!
Best math teacher I have ever had. He teaches so well you dont even have to study.

Great professor!  Notes are very clear & easy to understand.  Quizzes & exams are straightforward & based off of the notes.  He's very approachable & helpful during office hours.  Plus he's cute!  :)  Definitely recommend taking him!

He's the best teacher ever. Goes straight to the point, and very helpful during office hours. Practice the examples he does n class, go over problems in quizzes and you are quaranteed an A in this class. Very simple and nice

He's the best teacher ever. Goes straight to the point, and very helpful during office hours. Practice the examples he does n class, go over problems in quizzes and you are quaranteed an A in this class. Very simple and nice

He is clear and gets right to the point with what we need to learn. His lectures will focus on about one section per day and he basically teaches what the book is trying to teach us but in a clear, organized step by step way with none of the analytical or extra b.s. the book has. All of his exams offered extra credit. Great class!
Dean's easy.

Best math teacher I have had at UMBC. He is a really great teacher. I like his style of teaching. He really makes sure students are following and explains very clearly. keeps open office hours, Extremely helpful. Willing to explain just about anything.Take all of his class! Especially 152
By far, the best math teacher I've had at umbc
He is very good at explaining concepts

She's a sweet old lady, but like I said, old. She can't work the projector/ipad. She can barely get through a single problem, and when she does it's often wrong. She's constantly late or just completely misses the lectures, typically with no heads up. It also takes forever to get grades. You can tell she was a great professor in her prime, though.

Avoid at all costs. She's nice, but she left in the middle of the semester without warning and we had to get a new professor. Prior to that, she couldn't get through 2 practice problems before class ended b/c she couldn't get her iPad to work. If you do have her though, do the past quizzes and exams that she posts because the concepts are the same.

Tighe seems like a great professor and human, but her age affects her ability to teach. Lectures were often slow, and many ended up unproductive with skipped topics. Also, homework due dates were frequently incorrect. I'd recommend skipping the lectures and using The Organic Chemistry Tutor to actually learn the material. Steer clear of her class!

Unfortunately, age and frequent illness impacted her teaching. While I don't blame her, if you're aiming to pass or truly learn calculus, I don't recommend her. Often covered a few problems per lecture without clear explanations, making it hard to grasp the material. I'd advise against taking Tighe for Math 151, unless she's recovered by then.

I had this class 3 days a week which meant that 3 days a week I would drive to school, show up to class, and wait for bonny to never show up because she couldn't even email when class was cancelled. Then go to discussion and have a quiz on material we never had class on. When she did show up she was late and confused. This class was a waste of time

Please read this before taking her class, as I am someone who will provide you with all the reasons to not take her on as a teacher. First of all, don't bother showing up to lecture because she probably wont either. Expect to learn all of the material on your own as for when she does show up, she cant figure out how to use her ipad and teach us.
SHE DELETED BAD REVIEWS SHE'S NOT A 4/5 BEWARE!!!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: don't do it. she will not be at half the lectures then just move onto the exam without giving any semblance of preparation.  the class itself is hard enough as is and you would basically be spending a thousand dollars on a class you'll homeschool for.

If you have her, be SURE to look at the practice quizzes that she posts because she copies and pastes them as the quizzes with different numbers. This is to the point that sometimes the numbers do not make sense. She had test questions that she COULD NOT SOLVE herself during class time so she gave us free points on the tests afterwards. Beware.

The class she teaches is hard, but she makes it that way to ensure you learn all the material well. She is a good lecturer and even better to learn from one on one. Use the resources she provides wisely and you will suceed in the class with ease. She is very smart and passionate about what she teaches.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Extremely unorganized on blackboard and in person. Always takes half the class time to set her ipad up. Redeeming quality: she teaches the subjects decently but makes a lot of mistakes. Exams/Quizzes are pretty simple thanks to the practice provided. I sympathize due to health problems but if you want a prof straightforward, avoid her.

I have never taken calculus before, and I mostly self studied so far. We didn't get our exam one grades until a new professor took her place. She'd do one question on a subject in a lecture. She showed up late often, and she didn't show up at all a lot. Grumpy. Much of this is due to health, so I do not credit this entirely upon her character.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: PEOPLE WHO ARE REGISTERING FOR NEXT SEMESTER: She is great, but she basically abandoned my calc section because she's been missing due to health and all the sections was more than she could chew. She is a great professor, but only when she shows up. If she will even be teaching next sem I recommend choosing a diff professor. Sorry Tighe :(

I love Tighe! Take her if you want to have a deep understanding of calc. Exams and quizzes are not easy but they're very similar to the problems she does in class. She seems intimidating but she's sweet if you approach her after class or in office hours. On the other hand she can be disorganized and misses class often due to her health :(

I am currently in her class and DONT TAKE THIS CLASS she is by far the worst professor I have had in my lifetime it genuinely surprises me that she is still able to teach. You will have to self teach yourself all the material. Quizzes are very long. She showed up late to our exam day and didn't sufficient time to finish.

Im currently taking this class and abeg stay away from this woman. She designs her quiz for you to fail she says 15 hours a week for her class it will swallow your time. her test are long with insufficient time. She cant even teach with the 50 minutes of time you give her. if you haven't taken calculus you most likely WILL fail.

Reading most reviews on this professor most concerns are correct she is old and often times has problems with her iPad and she can make mistakes which is human. However she listens to the class and does multiple example problems to help explain the concepts. She also provides blank course notes papers to easily follow her in class.

DO NOT TAKE MATH 151 with Bonny Tighe, YOU WILL REGRET IT. I had her and she was one of if not the worst possible professor i could've gotten here at UMBC, you might aswell not even attend her lectures because i promise you that you wont learn anything. Before i even seen her she had made something due on webassign which she told no one about.

Insane she's allowed to teach. Makes mistakes we have to correct, every minute or so. Often takes several people to correct her, then w a straight face blames us for not "explaining ti clearly". Other times she says she's testing us. She's way too old for this. Half her lectures are spent figuring out how to use her iPad. Will be self-taught.

Very bad "Teacher", doesnt teach anything in class, rather solves problems on the board. She consistently gets problems wrong and its always an argument with the class to see her mistakes. I don't know how she's allowed to teach anymore. 

She doesn't know how to use her tablet so expect to sit there and watch her struggle during the lectures

Tons of people seem to rag on Tighe and her class and claim that it's difficult and that she's hard to deal with, while I see their POV I have to disagree. She does tend go fast on topics and loses track of what she's meant to be teaching, but if you're a person who can cram material a day before an exam or quiz then you'll do well.

Bonny tighe is the worst professor at UMBC. If my professor was a dog i would have a better grade because then at least i would have the will to attend lecture. Quizzes and exams are so long that barely anyone finishes in time. No one got an A on an exam so she gave everyone 10 free points. Every average grade on hwr exams are failing. Just dont.

After a midterm she tore into the class for poor scores. A week later all the grades increased. She wouldn't explain it, the TA informed me that Professor Tighe had sent all the graders the wrong answer key. So when discovered to be at fault after spending 30 minutes ranting to the class about their performance pretends her mistake never happened.

Tighe is by far the worst professor I've encountered in my academic career. Often makes mistakes lecturing, I no longer attend because its a genuine waste of time. Quizzes and exams are made intentionally long (around four to five pages per quiz, given 50 minutes to complete) and difficult, problems are dubious compared to other UMBC professors.
Avoid at all costs

If you really want to learn the content, take Tighe. Her quizzes and exams are harder but I learned so much. It prepared me for 152 (currently taking). Suffered through it but it was worth it. She was entertaining and kept my attention the whole lecture. She did take surprise attendance once and it was worth a grade. Actually learned in lecture.
Extremely difficult course, but the professor does everything she can to help you. I highly recommend taking her if you need Calc 2.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Tighe is old, and she gets sick often hindering her from teaching us. She's also very snarky and mean with her responses to any questions during lecture. Her quizzes are 10 questions and 50 minutes (much harder than all the other professors) and her exams are notoriously horrendous with one being 25 questions and having only 50 minutes to complete.

Tighe doesn't teach, just does practice problems without explanation or just outright does them wrong. Very disorganized, multiple times she didn't give her TA's the quizzes they were supposed to administer and had to call tech support for very basic issues. Tests are also too long for the allotted time. The textbook is a better teacher

Doesn't teach, just does practice problems without explanation or just outright does them wrong. Very disorganized, multiple times she didn't give her TA's the quizzes they were supposed to administer and had to call tech support for very basic issues. Tests are also too long for the allotted time. The textbook is a better teacher and will save you

Tbh I learned much more from YouTube and the old quizzes/exams than I did from her lectures but this applies to a certain extent for all calc professors here.What I knock her for is the over-the-top quizzes which were harder than other professors.She is a somewhat snark lady at times but that's negated by how nice she can be outside of class.

Mrs. Tighe is not a bad person but a terrible teacher.  I asked for help multiple times yet still received none.  If you have a choice do not take Tighe. She will belittle you if you do not understand something and instead of helping will ask "Why didn't you learn this in Algebra??"

She makes a lot of mistakes during lectures, gets sassy if you ask questions, AND THE EXAMS ARE DUBIOUS! The exam questions are overly complicated and unreasonable, but at least the exams and quizzes are recycled so study the past assessments.

Guys, I don't think you understand the struggle. She is not even my professor but she makes my final exam and that thing looks awful you will not be able to even comprehend 50% of it. So try really hard all semester.

Tighe's tests are more complex then other calc 2 professors and no longer match her prior year examples. The average score on the second midterm was 50%. Her solution to this was the spend the first 5 minutes of lecture complaining about how terrible her students are.

Class is a mess. No point in going to lectures because she is on a different topic while everyone is trying to study the previous topic for an upcoming test. Harsh grader. Half of the time the practice quizzes for the tests aren't even on bb. Sometimes her lecture notes are wrong. I promise you, you will teach yourself the course. Don't chose her

Skips the problems she can't solve. Horrible notes, can barely read what she wrote, doesn't show all her work. Gets annoyed or frustrated when someone asks a question. Lectures are not helpful and she goes really fast and barely explains what she's doing. Only pro is that she provides past quizzes and tests. But grades barely get updated. Just no

Tighe is a very average professor. She gives good lectures and her notes are easy to follow, but her exams are brutal. I often ever was able to even finish them in the given time, and partial credit is few and far between. My quiz and homework grades were the only reason I didn't fail. She makes Calc 1 a total slog, so try for another prof.

The class average at the moment is between 67% -70%. This says a lot about what kind of professor she is. She is very picky with her partial credit and is a harsh grader. I have to teach myself 90% of the material because her lectures aren't helpful.
Tighe makes a lot of mistakes in lecture. Exams are hard, but it helps to look at the past exams uploaded on blackboard. Really picky on partial credit. TAs in discussion are helpful.

Honestly the only reason I am not failing this class is because I took calc AB and BC in high school. I can always feel the confusion and irritation every lecture. She just goes through practice problems, but she constantly messes up and we have to correct her. The TAs in the discussion are a lot more helpful, and we have weekly quizzes.

She is definitely not nice or sweet. She gets smart when people ask a question she thinks you should already know the answer to. Lectures are very choppy. She has incomplete problems and skips problems that she can't figure out herself. Don't skip lecture bc you'll be more confused when you look at the mess that is her lecture notes w/o context.

Tighe is honestly not a great teacher. She often times will stop answering questions midway if she forgets how its done and moves onto the next problem. If you ask questions during lecture, she asks the student why they didn't learn it in algebra or something. She is very respected though and not too harsh. Just a difficult teacher.

Professor Tighe is awesome!! She really knows her stuff, is super approachable, and gives very good lectures. sure the classes are hard, but if you go to class and have good study habits, it'll be a breeze.

Tighe is really good, I really like her as a professor. She gives off sweet grandmother vibes and has a good sense of humor. The only thing I don't really like about her is her slow grading sometimes. She's been having some health issues so it's understandable but sometimes throughout the semester, we've been held in limbo for weeks w/ exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Mrs. Tighe is a great professor, but she's tough. She makes you take pre-reading quizzes, tedious HWs, and challenging quizzes and exams. She provides a lot of old exams and old quizzes. She has high expectations for students but provides you with a great foundation for Calc 3. SI Pass and Office hours are also extremely helpful.

she may seem harsh and a little scary at first but shes nice & i got the vibes of 'i want u to pass, but u gotta put in the work' from her. like its calc, so ofc it's gona be hard, but I think you hav a chance if you spend ur time on hw, practice problems, previous exams & quizzes + she'll help u outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is not only strict, but also be mean sometimes.

If you learn best from reading the text then Tighe is the teacher for you. When you come to class it is expected you will be able to do problems from that days lesson. Her teaching method is 70% doing problems & 30% going on verbal tangents. I watched professor Leonard videos all semester to actually learn the material.

Tighe is the best professor I've had at UMBC, period. That being said, she's tough. She makes you take pre-reading quizzes before the lectures, plenty of long HWs, tough quizzes and exams. Sounds awful, but trust me, she gives you the resources to do well. Great lectures, and a fair grader. Going to OH is your key to an A with her. Very accessible.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: she offers loads of materials and options for extra learning. Unfortunately I took her online and I can faithfully say that she is terrible at online learning. Not only does she shrug off student complaints, but her online quizzes are often times graded wrong, she usually does not even go back and fix them. Only take if in person
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Tighe is a national treasure. She gave amazing lectures and really wanted the students to pass. She was a tough grader and had not time for questions she had already answered so pay attention. If you really don't understand she is willing to work with you outside of class. Her quizzes were the right amount of difficulty.

Tighe makes you teach everything to yourself. What's covered in lectures and on homeworks, is a lot easier than what she tests you on. She's had to curve most of our exams and quizzes because so many people aren't learning what's being tested. She makes a lot of mistakes and expects the students to deal with them, good luck to those who have her.
Bonny is fantastic! I took two courses at UMBC quite a while ago, and she was genuine and accessible. Seems gruff, but is very humorous and quite enjoyable!

Tighe is a great professor. She goes thru lectures quick, but will stop and explain better if you ask. Blank notes, previous quizzes/tests, etc are provided, so there is a lot of material that can help you prepare for exams. She's very down-to-earth and understanding, too.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had Professor Tighe for Calc 151. The good thing about her is that she gives you previous quizzes and tests for last semesters and the previous years before so you can see what is going to be on the test and quizzes. The bad thing is she is a very strict grader she has a standard on students on how you do things
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is a very good teacher, and goes through lot of examples in class, though she sometimes goes through actual notes a little too fast. You NEED to read the textbook, since she doesn't go over very much outside of examples or the first 10 minutes of class. Her TAs are almost completely useless, and they NEVER give helpful answers to questions.

She told us beginning of the semester "It is not my job to teach you. It is your job to teach yourselves from the book and I am here to give u strategies and guidance." MandatoryAttend ButSheDoesn'tTeachInLecture SheJustDoesTheProblems AndIfAnyoneAsksForExplanation SheTreatsThemLikeTheyAreStupid ForNotAlreadyKnowing "BecauseThisIsSoEasy" (HerWords)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is a really great professor and she is funny too which helps when the material is really tough and you just want to die. The class was really difficult for me but that is because calc 2 is not an easy class, if you actually do the problems that she does in class and work hard, then you can get a good grade. Could have gotten a B, but oh well.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Mrs. Tighe is a phenomenal professor. I had her for both Calc I and II and received A's in both. She has "print out lectures" that she provides, or you print them out and fill in as you go along in class. She has her old quizzes and exams online, so if you go to class, take good notes and study the old stuff, you'll have no issue getting an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof. Tighe is overall a great professor, as she goes through step by step explaining how to do problems. She can go through the notes a bit too quickly at times, but if someone asks she can slow down. The tests and quizzes can be difficult, but she provides plenty of practice exams and quizzes online to help. Discussion is also very helpful.

she is great to take her if you can, she is a bit difficult compared to other teachers but other teachers don't teach and she is a great teacher and she makes the final so if you are used to the other professor the final is gonna be hard

She might come off as tough but she is really caring and wants her student to walk away with BOTH knowledge and good grades. Most math professors here only care about grades and if you memorize their exams, you'd pass. Tighe is really focused on making you understand the materials. 100% recommend her!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's an amazing teacher and gives you absolutely everything you need to get an A, it's just that you actually need to do it

Prof. Tighe is my favorite professor this semester, she isn't easy but definitely wants everyone to succeed. I enjoyed going to lectures and her tests were always fair, she gives you every tool possible to succeed

You need to be willing to dedicate a HUGE amount of time to studying, but Tighe is absolutely the best option if you want to come away from this class with some real skills for a future in Math. The amount of practice problems she has from old exams and quizzes are nearly endless. GO TO PROF + TA OFFICE HOURS! Practice w/ feedback is the key!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Though she is a tough grader she prepares us well (along with the TAs). She has tons of previous quizzes and exams for students to practice and posts all the lecture notes. She is available outside of lecture and overall is great. You might have to get use to her personality though
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Mrs. Tighe has been teaching mathematics for many many years. Her lectures are formated incredibly well, and she uploads her notes to BlackBoard. To get A's on her exams, practice exams from the semester she taught before (accessible on BB) because they are nearly identical to the test you will take.
Professor Tighe is a quality professor, explains everything really well. My favorite professor.

Mrs. Tighe is a wonderful professor. I am not the greatest at Math and so calculus 1 was a little challenging. She gives out quizzes that she has used in previous years as practice. She also gives 10% curve on the tests. She is nice and if you go to lectures and do the work, you should pass her class.

I took her because she was super highly recommended by literally everyone on campus, but I ended up dropping. When I found myself taking her class I just couldn't understand anything. If you need a teacher who explains every step out so you understand the hows and whys of the math you're doing, you might be better off with w/ someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I want to believe all these positive reviews are true, but it's not (at lest I've never got the experience that these guys have got) I'm taking her in the summer and I am currently failing calc 2 and I am trying. Quizzes aren't given back in a timely matter to study from and the TA's just straight up don't care. Try to take someone else if you can.

This course is fairly easy as Prof. Tighe is very good at explaining calc ii. She posts everything online including lecture notes and old quizzes/exams. Exams are extremely fair but also very long. Apparently the final was curved, but if you spend time to understand the content you won't need it.

great professor. I took her for calc 1 and calc 2 and she breaks it down into simple algorithms so you can use the same patterns for different problems. If you can take her, TAKE TIGHE. Wonderful prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Tighe was the only professor I liked before I transferred out of UMBC. What she teaches is exactly what's going to be on the exam. She posts old quizzes and exams and she is very consistent every year with what kind of problems will be on exam and quizzes. She might seem unapproachable but she is a very sweet lady.
She's a tough professor but it's so worth it. She cares if you care and she's really laid back. If you need a calc 1 or 2 professor at UMBC highly recommend.
Personable, invested, thorough. Listens, and is genuinely interested in helping students do well. Excellent!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Ms. Tighe's prowess in teaching makes her a remarkable professor that I would highly recommend to anyone planning to take Math 152. She understands that most of her students possess a superficial understanding of basic algebra skills, and she focuses a good portion of her teaching on algebra techniques because of this.
She makes you work, but you will definitely learn something if you try.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: She is honestly the best Calc I teacher I ever have. She really takes the time to go through each problem and explains on how to do it! Sometimes she can go a bit fast, but otherwise as long as you pay attention in her lectures and practice her quiz and exams, then you should be fine!

Professor Tighe is easily the best Math professor I have had throughout all of my years in school. She knows what she is talking about, and she is also realistic in the work that she gives in and out of class. Just be sure to start the homework a few days before it is due.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Caring

reviews.comment: She is hilarious and really helps you to enjoy calc. She is caring and very approachable. I agree with the statement about her being scary at first but she really is a sweetheart. Best proffesor I have had yet. She prepares you well for exams; important thing is going to class and putting in work on practice problems to succeed
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Mrs. Tighe is a very good professor and really cares about her students to do well. She might seem hard and scary at first but as the semester progresses, you will love her! I highly recommend her!
Bonny Tighe is an amazing professor. She provides her students with many resources to succeed in the class. She also gives advice about things outside of the classroom.

Not a math person but somehow survived. She expects a lot from her students but gives you the tools you need to be successful. Lectures are interesting and she's a very kind and understanding professor. Do the practice exams to prepare!

Ms. Tighe is an amazing teacher. She is very demanding of her students and really expects a lot. I was motivated and worked very hard, and even though math is not my best subject I improved so much this semester. You will probably have to work very hard, but it is worth it, also her lectures are important and you should not miss them.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She was a very helpful professor, clarified any difficulties and told us the type of format for the final exam (Calc 2). Even though her quizzes and exams were difficult, because of the final exam, I managed to maintain a B in this class. Tighe rocks!!

A great professor. She is a bit sarcastic at times, but it is very funny and brings some humor to class. Her teaching is great. She drops quizzes and replaces your lowest exam grade with the final. Her exams are hard, and so are her quizzes, but the final was a breeze.  I would recommend her to anyone interesting in learning calc.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Get ready to work like crazy, but when you finish the class you'll be doing math in your sleep. Not for the faint of heart but she's the way to go if you really want to learn the material. Moves quickly and seems a bit grumpy at first but she's happy to slow down if you need help and is really the sweetest woman if you ever talk to her one-on-one.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This is a difficult class, but Tighe is a great teacher. She is tough, but she can also be humorous and if you reach out for help she is more than happy to give it to you. She really knows her stuff but does not tolerate disrespect.T Definitely come to class as her lectures are very helpful, and from there it is practice practice PRACTICE!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Very tough class, old quizzes and exams are sometimes helpful, but what she throws on her actual tests can be very challenging. Expect finals to be much more difficult.
She is such a BOMB teacher seriously. She is the best teacher for calculus. Anybody that didn't do well did not take the time to reach out to her and get help.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Tighe is an okay professor. However, her lecture solutions and quiz keys sometimes give wrongful answers, giving students a higher chance of getting low scores on tests.

Compared to other teachers, Bonny Tighe is the hardest. Her quizzes and exams are longer and harder. Many people fail this course in general and I can tell you taking it with her makes this easier. She is a very good teacher and puts effort into the class, but if you want to increase your chances of passing Calc 2, don't take her.

I failed the class I took with her. I got a D. But she taught me more than most professors and I retook her class and got a B. She helped me understand the mathematical thought process, and not just how to solve math problems. I promise you if you put in the time, you will be on your way to understand math much much better with her guidance.

LOVED Prof. Tighe. While she seems intimidating at first and her humor is demeaning to the unprepared, she is a sweet woman. Never had a professor who made winter hats for her students who came to office hours. The material is difficult and exams are challenging, but it trains you for the final. Take her class, but be prepared to do some work.
She's very funny
If you work through her quizzes and practice exams, you are guaranteed an A. GO TO CASTLE. Develop a relationship with her and your TAs. It may save you on an exam or in my case, a letter grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Calculus II is hard on its own, don't really like the way she teaches it. Lectures are online, so are practice quizzes and tests, they are HARD, be PREPARED. She projects the lecture sheets, goes over theorems, then problems. Terrible way to teach, but passable if that's your thing.

She is an AMAZING professor. In both courses she emailed everyone outlines for the lectures so it was very easy to follow along with what she was saying. The tests were a little long and difficult but it really prepared you for the final exam. In addition to that she posted multiple quizzes and exams from previous years so you knew what to expect.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Best math teacher I've had! She is great at math and teaching both, so she is who you want teaching a difficult course like calculus 2. Always helpful with questions and in office hours. Partial credit always given. Quizzes are in groups, but with individual submissions. Print out her lecture notes before classes, they really help you follow along.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She is by far my favorite professor at UMBC thus far as a college student. I had her for both calc 1 and calc 2, and she made it not only understandable, but fun to learn. Going to her lectures were always enjoyable, and a must. The homework is the hardest you will do to prepare for quizzes, and then quizzes prepare you for exams. Would recommend.

While intimidating at first, she is very sweet, funny, and  approachable. Her exams are very difficult, but as long as you prepare well with the quizzes and practice exams, it'll be better. She talks quickly in her lectures, but if you let her know, she'll go slower. She answers all your questions and offers as much help as she can.

Best Calculus teacher on campus in terms of explaining what to do. However,  she is not the easiest. So you have to make a choice; do I want to pass and not know most of the things for the final or do I want to suffer a little to understand the content. Most students pick the latter; which is respectable.

Probably the best Calculus II teacher at UMBC. Sometimes she goes through her lectures too fast without thoroughly explaining things and you just get lost, but if you do well in her class, you will be very good at Calculus II in general. Sometimes took off points for stupid things, though, like writing "3 + 1/4" instead of "3 1/4".
She is the one of the best Math Professors I've ever had. Defiantly ask for help if you don't understand her and her TAs will work with you. She wants her students to do well!

She is a tough old tigher (: difficult grader, but she tells you what she expects and wont take less than that. Be ready to work but it is very possible to succeed in her class. She is one of the best teachers I have had at UMBC. Would recommend

I LOVE Ms. Tighe. She's the best math teacher I've ever had. Quizzes and tests are straightforward, just practice with the old quizzes and exams and they are pretty much exactly the same, just with different numbers. Final is easy and can replace your first exam grade. Took AP calc AB in high school (2 on the test), but got a 99% in calc 1.
Great teacher. Quizes can be a bit difficult, but exams aren't too bad. Ms. Tighe definitely makes the final exam look like the easiest exam in the world if you do well in the class.

I did not like Tighe at all. Yeah, she gives a lot of examples in class but she goes through them fast, usually skipping multiple steps. I had to do a lot of work outside of class. I honestly hated her sarcasm and pessimistic comments. She's tough, which I appreciate but she's just bad at explaining the material.

Professor Tighe made Calc II a great experience. Her unit exams were tougher, which allowed me to feel more than prepared while taking the final. Her lecture notes were always clear and full of good examples. I always looked forward to her class because of her hilarious personality. Definitely one of the best professors here.

Bonny Tighe is a great teacher. She made it clear that you needed to actually understand the material to pass, so just take the class seriously. Definitely go to lectures because she does lots of practice problems in class. Khan academy videos and the homework website webassign mostly helped me pass because she goes kind of fast over the materials.

Bonny Tighe is a great lecturerboth clear and engaging! This isn't a class that you can get an A without learning the material, but It's taught in a way that makes it easy and accessible. If you put your due in, you'll get an A or B. CASTLE (Tighe's and Prof Nanes Friday coach class) is a great resource, & you just might get a hat out of it!

Mrs. Tighe is one of the best professors you can have for Calc II at UMBC. She is very good at what she does and makes sure you get what shes doing. Dont be intimidated by her, shes a sweetheart; go to Castle on friday for extra help. How to Succeed: STUDY FOR THE QUIZZES AND EXAMS FROM THE WORKSHEETS AND TEXTBOOK.

Her tests are a little bit harder than the other  teachers but that just makes you more prepared for the final. Can seem a bit intimidating at times but don't be afraid to ask questions duringafter class, she'll respect you for it. Make sure to do a bit of studying on your own to get an A. Be sure to stop by CASTLE for math help and a Tighe hat.

She will work you to the bone. The tests are hard, and the quizzes are killer. The thing is, in the 2 classes I had with her, she doesn't make the final, another, easier professor does. So, her students are used to harder tests, and are more prepared for the final. Regardless, I never would have anyone else teach me math.
One of the best professors in the department!
She's amazing. Take her for Calc I, or you will miss out. She is so funny when you get to know her. And if you stay on top of the material, her class will be a breeze.
Good math teacher. She did not make the tests easy, you will need to study. I took AP Calc and still had to study for my A.

Tighe is awesome. The best math professor I've had by far. I took 151 and 152 with her and she is the reason I understood it. If you work hard she will give you the grade you deserve. Her tests are harder than other professors but the final is easy. If you go to class and do the work, it's easy to get an A.

Great Professor! She made the material so easy to understand. She was also funny and easy to listen to. Super understanding. I had a problem with taking one of the exams at the scheduled time and she let me take it a day late (I let her know before hand). With I could have her for calc III. One of the best professors I've had.

She uploads packets of notes that are 'fill in the blank' so that you can keep up during class and listen wo having to worry about writing down EVERYTHING! She will answer questions during class (immediately remembers the students who do!) and encourages office hour visits. She wants you to learn the material and gives every chance to contact her.

I took 151 for the 3rd time wher. 1st time w Nanes & got a D, 2nd time w Dean, got a D. Took it with Tighe, got an A. She makes the material so easy. Quizzes are from lecture notes, Exams from quizzes, Final from exams-study and you'll get an A wher. She seems mean in class but if you see her in 'castle' for help, she is the sweetest person.

Professor Tighe is a very hard grader and the material might be hard for you to understand if you don't go to lecture. She is very fair and open to suggestions. Tests are hard but the large amount of homework and group quizzes definitely prepare you. She is very sarcastic and funny.

Math 152 can be a challenging course for many students. It is especially challenging for those who skipped straight into Math 151 or Math 152.  Tighe gives good lectures (or so I've been told), and the tests are very similar to tests from previous classes. The quizzes are done in groups, and quizzes from previous years are available online.

Ms. Tighe is a fantastic professor, but she expects you to put in the effort to understand the material she presents at lectures. She is extremely helpful if you go to office hours and castle. Her humor is absolutely a plus, and she is very clear cut as to her expectations for the course.

If you want to study really hard and take exams that are not a reflection of her lectures then definitely take her class.  She writes down the procedure of the problem and expects you to write it down. Her handouts are pure laziness on her behalf. She could do a much better job of explaining the material. Nice lady, sucky teacher. NO Ph.d.

She gives printed notes. Exams are harder than the rest of the professors, but she teaches the material very well so you should do fine. Know your algebra and trig. Overall, she made calculus fun for me, I really enjoyed the class.

Her lectures were really clear and on point, one of the best lecturers I've had; she explains things that can be overwhelming in a really simplistic way. She may come of as intimidating, but really cares about her students. Her quizzes are in groups. Exams are tough, but will prepare you for the final. Don't expect this class to be an easy A.

No one has ever explained Calculus in such a simple, easy to understand, and fun way. She speaks in a language that everyone can easily understand and as long as you understand and pay attention the homework, the quizzes and exams are  a piece of cake.

I had Bonny for Math 131 Part 1 and Part 2 (elementary education math  class) This class was not an education class but strictly a math class. She teaches by showing which is the greatest thing a professor can do. She knows math VERY well and knows how to teach it. She has her tangents every now and again but get ready to work in her class.

We don't use calculators because it is all possible to solve without one; unless you are doing the homework because you need to put the exact answer.  She is good teacher, but she makes the quizzes and exams hard.  ALWAYS print out the class material before class, which she sends via email unless you have photographic memory...

AMAZING professor. I had her for MATH151 and 152. Before taking her classes, I HATED calculus, but after calc 1 and calc 2, I left with a love of the subject and a feeling that I actually understood it. Best professor I've ever had.

Mrs. Tighe is a hard teacher, but is also one of the best teachers I've taken. She explains everything clearly. Quizzes are taken in groups. Exams are hard, but if you study hard you can get a B or an A. You will learn a lot in this course. Take her class!!

Very good teacher. Lecture attendance is not mandatory, but highly recommended. Tighe often explains things differently than the text, and her examples usually pop up on the exams. Exams have extra questions, so if you work quickly there is the potential for extra credit. I found weekly quizzes more challenging than the exams. WebAssign homework.

She's a great professor if you're willing to put in the work. She gives 3 exams and a final during a semester and they're somewhat lengthy. Though the exams are all harder than the final, so by the end of the semester it's basically a victory lap.

She is not here to joke around when it comes to Math. She's really nice, really easy to talk to, but she is going to make sure you learn the material better than any other professor. If you want an easy class, don't take her. If you actually want to pass the class knowing the material and get an A on the final take her class.

If you actually do the work and study, easy A. Personally, I am lazy and didn't try too hard. Yet, I will still get a B. Tighe is the best calculus teacher at UMBC; anyone I know agrees with me. She may be the "toughest," but she'll prepare you and you'll be less stressed in the long run. Don't question it: if you're going to take calc, Tighe wins.
She was amazing, and very kind if you went to her office hours for help. One of the best!

One of the best calculus professors you will encounter. Makes a difficult subject very clear and concise. Also keeps the class engaged and has a sense of humor. Excellent professor, I would highly recommend her.
Great teacher, very clear and helpful, quizzes are in groups, and the tests aren't too bad if you go to class and really study the homework and quizzes. Highly recommend for Calc 2

Very helpful teacher, she was intimidating at first but was very nice when I approached her. Her class is tough but if you do all the practice exam/quizzes and go to class you won't have any problem getting an A. Very sassy and funny.

She's the best math professor ever!! Shes willing to help and gives us 5 hours every Friday to do homework with her! She's very clear and really nice. Also gives nice and funny examples to help us understand better. Only thing, goes fast is lecture. But I love her. If you have the opportunity...take her class!!

One of the best teachers out there. She is very helpful and clear in class and cares about your success. Extra credit is available and quizes are in groups with the lowest 3 being dropped and 4 lowest HW's. I also suggest to NOT BUY THE TEXTBOOK because its useless; she provides you with handouts for each lesson that are much more clear helpful

Wow she is simply an amazing teacher. I do not know why she even had some bad comments in the past, she went through a teaching workshop where she improved everything about her class. Her exams and quizzes for 152 are much easier than Brian deans. She answers all questions in class, has great office hours and now offers extra credit in her classes.

She's an excellent teacher - her exams are pretty tough but fair. Classroom is pretty social so it's easy to get into study groups which will help even more. If you take her class over the summer the quizzes are in groups (exams aren't, make sure you know your stuff.) Also, she's super nice.

Tighe is great! She cares about her students unlike any other prof. Calc 1 is definitely hard and it requires a lot of time and effort to succeed, but Tighe is fantastic. She makes it clear exactly what you need to know. Go to lecture, it definitely pays off!

Mrs. Tighe is a great teacher! Calc 1 is not an easy subject but if you go to her for help and really work for it, you should be able to get a good grade. She can be a little rude sometimes but if you work hard, you'll be fine.
I love Professor Tighe.She is always willing to help students and definitely likes to teach calc. Don't show up late to class though because it makes her mad.. all in all I recommend her!

She spends precious class time pointing out those who enter late. She actually STOPS CLASS, therefore limiting her own instruction of the students who are already there. It is unfair to those in class. She spends time telling us how little we know about various topics as opposed to teaching us about said topics. DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS.

Good professor. Kind of sassy, but she's funny. She cares about her students and will help. Her exams were hard in the sense that there were a lot of questions in a limited amount of time. Her exams made the final easy though. I recommend her.

The best math professor that teaches one of the most difficult classes. Calc 2 is brutal, but she does everything she can to help you without watering the material. Go to her weekly study sessions in CASTLE.  They saved my life. If you need more time, she loves helping students during her office hours. She deserves every compliment mentioned here.
A truly wonderful woman who truly cares about her students. I would recommend her to anyone.
Great prof, makes it easier than it has to be,still need to work hard and do well on exams, don't fall behind

I think Bonnie was a great teacher. She is definitely sassy and will call you out if she is in a bad mood and you are texting or "disrupting the class", but I found the lessons really easy to understand. If you are decent at math and attend every class and do the homework, you will be fine. Also we barely used the book, don't buy it.

Probably one of the worst professors Iv'e ever had. Course material wasn't hard, her rude attitude is unbearable and unnecessary. She treats her A+ students much different then everyone else (I'm one). Made the class feel unintelligent by talking down to us for taking MA155 rather then the harder clac. Avoid unless you will be an A+ student.

Shes an above average professor. Going to lectures helps, and she knows her materials really well. Shes funny in class. But sometimes she doesn't very interested in helping student when you tell her your issues.

i love her! i take two class with her and she will help you if your willing to learn and if you let her know who you are. her exams and quizzes are similar to old exams and quizzes and she does post up the old exams and quizzes on BB!

Overall your basically teaching yourself in Math 155. Either you know the material from high school or you dont, if you dont it will be really hard, more than half of her class is failing, while a small percentage is doing good, I would not recommend her as a teacher. She can be very rude and always has a sarcastic comment to say.
LOVE HER!!!!!!! She is amazing in this class and i recommend her no matter what math you have to take - try to get Tighe!!!!

I dont know if its because this is her first semester teaching 155 or if she's just mean but she treats her math 155 students like we're not smart enough to be in 151. She is not very helpful and her quizzes are more like tests. Basically study on your own and you'll pass. Do yourself a favor and take 155 with someone else.

Absolutely not understanding, not willing to help out in relation to personal issues.  Assumes that this is our only class and is unwilling to listen when students have timing conflicts (with a full time job for example).  For the sake of personal sanity, avoid her.

This class is already hard.She was very nice but had a certain way she wanted you to solve problems. The exams were  long and hard to finish. You have to practice alot if you want to finish. She also expects you to read before class so you already know what you go over in class. She left early in the semester due to illness but she was good overall
Mrs Tighe is great if you let her know you

Ms. Tighe is a good teacher in a difficult subject. You pretty much will have to go to lecture and discussion if you want to do well, this stuff is not easy. She does manage to make the stuff fairly clear. Exams and tests can be a little tough, but if you can do well on most of them you will be fine, some of the lowest HWs and quizzes get dropped.

She is the best math teacher I have ever had. The course is a difficult course, but she makes it easier. If you show up to class and do minimal work outside of class besides the homework, you can get an A.

She is very smart and genuinely likes calc. Read the section in the book before going to class. Do ALL the homework (even though she drops 5). Do practice quiz/exams if she gives them. Don't forget to look over your notes before the exam. TAKE GREAT NOTES! I got an A by practicing every old problem, quiz, or exam I could find.

One of the best math teachers at UMBC. As long as you go to class and ask for help when you need it you WILL be fine. She is approachable. Her exams are tough so just beware that this isn't your normal skip catch up class. I would recommend her highly :)

I love Mrs. Tighe! Her exams are pretty tough but her quizzes are certainly manageable in comparison. Although she doesn't curve her exams, she offers several other opportunities for grade inflation. She's intimidating at first, but if you go to her office hours she's super nice and helpful. Very clear and concise, I took Calc 2 just to have her!

I had Raji first but transferred to Tighe and that was such a mistake, kinda. She explains things well. When it comes to exams, it was like I was looking at new material. They really hard. But she missed a few classes and end up leaving in the middle of the semester because she had lymphoma.

i would like her test content to be more challenging and actually have to do with what we learn in class and in the book... btw, the book was useless to me no matter how hard i tried... she was ok but i dont recommend her if you want a good understanding of CALC, esp if youre going to take math in subsequent semesters. mega attitude and not cool :(

lets just say she took the asian out of me. she took my love of math, my straight A streak in math from algebra to pre-calc..AWAY. now thats not right. take gloor (he's a beast) rather than tighe; you wont regret it. i sware you that.

She is a bit overrated. The main goal of her teaching seems to be about solving a bunch of routine calculus problems quickly. The exams are not about a good understanding of calculus either; instead, they test one's ability to do bunch of ugly problems fast. Personally she is very nice, however, I would not recommend her despite all the hype.

I've never understood all of the hype about Mrs. Tighe. Overall, she's an okay teacher. She has an irritating attitude and her exams focus more on algebra than calculus. I earned an A in her class, but I feel like my high school calculus teachers were more efficient and helpful.

Mrs. Tighe's class is pretty hard. She expects you to do your work, study and not slack off. Go to her office hours, she really cares and helps you learn. DO NOT SLACK OFF IN HER CLASS, she knows the people that put effort in her class.

She gives you practice exams and quizzes from last semester with the exact same material that will be on the quiz/exam you are taking. Can't get any easier than that! She does have a bit of an attitude but she's also really nice sometime. She's human so of course she'd have emotions. Duh!

DON'T BELIEVE THE HYPE.If you like learning everything on your own take tighe and don't bother going to class. Wastes 10 min a class talking about non-sense. Only went over examples in reading. Tests are not like homeworks. Good hard calc class with independent thought involved  which I like but the material is glossed over @ best + the book sucks

Overall, she's a good teacher. She could definitely do without the attitude but it's not so bad. She's very clear on what she expects and provides practice exams/quizzes that are very similar to the real deal.

She's a tough professor, but if you do the work (pay attention in class, take notes, homework, study, etc) you'll do well and learn a lot. Also, don't be afraid to go to her for help. She's very willing to aid anyone who asks, and she will usually go over practice problems with you.

BEST MATH PROFESSOR AT UMBC!!!!! She lets you know exactly what is required to know for the exams, gives you plenty of practice exams and quizes, and the problems are similar just with diff numbers. She is very clear, she really cares if you are doing well or not. Just put in half the work she tells you, and guaranteed A!!!!
