Very, very, very hard teacher. However, she definitely knows what she's talking about. If you need a good structure and someone to kick your butt in order to learn, shes the one for you. Great teacher, but hard.

I took Math 151 last semester and took this class right after and had a feeling it will be terribly hard course but I just finished and it was easy. Just do all the homework  thoroughly and keep up with A+ on quizzes and the material that she teaches. Reading prior to class helps. Her exams are known to be extremely hard but it's really not.
She is an ok teacher...but she is SO DAMN RUDE. Ive never met someone with as much sarcasm in my life.

Dont' be discouraged in the beginning of the class...she trys to warn people by intimidating them to weed people out. But she is extremely nice and very helpful. Just go to class, listen, and you'll do fine. A lot of people failed the tests, but I think they didn't come to class. Just as many people got A's. Best teacher for calculus

Best teacher I've had, hands down. I hated calculus in high school because I didn't understand it, but the way she explains everything it makes total sense. She's available for  extra office hours to work on problems (which i heard are helpful) and she puts out old quizzes to study from. Seriously take her if you can!

She is the best math teacher ever!  If you have the chance take with her, you will learn so much more than with anyone else.  She makes it so clear what she wants you to be able to do.  Go to her for help, because no one will want to help you more or be able to help you better.  Also the final will be insanely difficult if you haven't had her.

Best math teacher I've had. She is great at explaining hard concepts. She breaks things down and repeats herself so that everyone can understand it. The only downfall is there is alot of online homework that is time consuming. Quiz once a week but if you do the past quizes you'll do good. The homework helps alot to prepare for quizes too

Good teacher as far as TEACHING goes, but shes snarky. If you have a stupid question, she'll make you feel stupid while answering it. Not that I asked any... Her grading system is really fair, but overall shes just kind of rude.

GREAT TEACHER!! At first she seems intimidating but then I just confused that with her bold/sarcastic/funny personality. She always is determined to help you if you ask her until you understand. Great quizzes every week because we can work with a group! She is my favorite teacher so far because it is obvious her passion for teaching!

She was a great teacher. I had her for a whole year of my freshman year. She at first I thought was going to be a little intimidating the 1rst week but then I realized it was just her sarcastic/funny personality. She is willing to help you until you understand. She is really passionate about teaching. GREAT PERSON IN GENERAL ALSO! : )

Took calc in high school, so class was easy for me, but didn't seem too hard. Quizzes were hard, but really helped for exams. Make sure you practice problems. She's very entertaining, good sense of humor. Ask questions, she'll answer and help you out. Loves participation. Some EC in discussion, but STUDY for exams.

I got an A. Bonny Tighe is a very good professor. She makes the lecture material difficult so the exams are much easier. She makes calculus interesting which is hard to do. But you still have to put in work to do well. Make sure you study for the quizzes every Friday.

Her tests had ten questions, each question is half a page of answer.  She curved down and up.  Some people she made 7 into 9 and the others she made 7 into 5.  Chew gum even when lecture.  Lots of homework.  Each homework had at least 30 questions, each question is half a page of answer.  Take her class when you only take one class for a semester
Best math professor/teacher I have ever had

Mrs. Tighe is very helpful and clear. she makes the class not boring and actually keeps everyone's interest in class. her tests are extremely hard but if u go to study sessions she hold every week, it really helps. she gives out old quizes and exams to practice on and you get xtra credit if u do them.  take her over other profs. if u can.

She's funny, but when it comes to the exams, it's a bit tricky.  Actually, it's hard.  Unless you took Calc in high school, good luck studying.  Go to her office hours; she'll help you out (especially when she gives out final grades).

Very interesting teacher, makes learning fun. Although the subject is difficult she goes out of her way to help you. Even has extra study hours where she'll answer any questions you have and even work one on one with you. Other students go to these hours, so eveyone helps each other out. Its very beneficial, wish every teacher did this.
She makes calculus easy, and never hesitates to give one on one help.

AMAZING teacher. very thorough and clear and loves her students. best teacher i have ever had. the class is hard but she provides you with everything you need to get an A. her TA is also the best TA ever. some extra credit is always offered. make sure you go to discussion.

Very good professor.  Gets right to the point with teaching the material, which is VERY helpful.  The course work was hard, but Mrs. Tighe is always available for help. If you have to take Calc II, take it with Mrs. Tighe

I had Prof Tighe for both Calc 1 and 2. And she was awesome through out both. Her class can be difficult but she is always there to help. She can forget things like that she made office hours...but if you remind her and really communicate with her you will have no problem in her class. Go to class, do the homework, and try!

She is a sweet person and really wants to see her students succeed. She presents material clearly and will give diff examples until you understand. She drops a few quizes and homeworks, gives so MANY extra credit opportunities, and gives previous exams/quizes to guide you. Definently one of the BEST TEACHERS i've had here.

She is extremely perky and shows such enthusiasm for calc, that you start to get into it. She explains clearly, and is very helpful if you come for office hours. Posts previous quizes/exams--> if you study those, you'll get an A. She's funny and is the reason that I want a math minor, even though I used to hate math prior to this course.

Textbook not neccesary. There are example tests and quizes online from previous semesters and she makes her current ones exactley the same way (if you understand the practice ones you will pass the actual ones) There is homeowork on mathzone every week. Overall a very good teacher she has alot of energy and a firey personality. (love the red hair)

Excellent lecturer.  She's humorous, upbeat, helpful and expects you to put forth effort.  She is more than happy to help her students in anyway possible such as holding extra help sessions in addition to her office hours.

Nice lady. Loves to help and answer questions. Tests are very long, but she likes to give partial credit. Not too much hwk, and gives group quizzes. I have previously taken Song for another class and I strongly recommend her over Song! SHE'S THE BEST CALC TEACHER AT UMBC

Almost always late to class. Doesnt clearly explain what a section is about -just does lots of easy examples and expects you to catch on. Very helpful during her office hours if you go to them. Posts practice exams- but often makes mistakes in answer key (and when doing examples) Don't take Tighe's class if you dont have all your free time for math

Starting Spring '08, the textbook will be changed. However she was quite easy for Calc 2, there were plenty old exams, quizzes, finals posted on blackboard and if you studied from them you are guaranteed an A. However, now that the book has changed, I doubt she'll post anything online, just like Calc 1.
she's horrible, could care less about her students. she's lazy and pretends to care. average class grade is a D.
She really knows how to teach the subject.  Great at clarifying the hard stuff, while reinforcing the concepts we need to succeed.  Will definitely have her in Calc II!
she doesn't even give practice quizzes anymore..her quizzes are extremely hard. she's tough and seems to NOT care anymore.
BEST TEACHER EVER! You really learn a ton in her class, and as long as you do homework and review her old tests and quizzes, its almost impossible to fail. Good sense of humor as well
My favorite professor at UMBC.  She gave me extra credit for writing the Integral Test the way Mr. T. would.  You have to work hard, but quizzes and tests are related to homework.
She is the best teacher I've never had. If you plan to take calc2 don't hesitate take her
No Comments

i love her to death! she's the best teacher ever! she's so helpful and actually makes sure that students understand the material well and she gives out old exams online so you can memorize all the steps and answers for the exams and quizzes, that's how i got As on all my exams

By far the best i have had. She gives a lot of homework but its only because she wants you to get a lot of practice so that you can do well- calculus II is not easy and the more problems you do the better you become. She drops some quizzes and homework, and is very nice about bad exams (i.e. she gives extra credit).

Calc is hard, she makes it look easy but don't be fooled because it's still hard. Following in-class examples and going over her old exams and quizzes are helpful. Lots of homework. Discussion was useless due to the TA there.

Best math teacher I've ever had. I had never taken Calculus before and I aced out of the final exam. She makes students actually like Calculus. Of course it's a hard subject, but her lectures are great and if you go to class, do the homework, and do the practice quizzes, you can succeed at Calculus.
hes the best teacher ever. i hate math and she made me love it. i highly recommend her. justa side note. dont ever be late for class coz she creates a scene if u walk in wait. love her, shes the best

Great calculus teacher. I took AP calc in HS and got nothing but C's during the whole year (even though I deserved lower). After taking the class with Tighe, everything became much clearer. Know your algebra, do your hw, get help, that's all you really need to do to get an A. If you're bad at math, it'll be a struggle.

Don't get on her bad side.  I actually got a C in the class, but lemme let you in on a little secret.  If you show up to her office hours, and get help every time she has her office open...she'll raise your grade dramatically.  My friend and I were both gettng C's...but since he went to get "help"...his C magically turned into an A.

This was my first time taking calculus and I'm SO glad it was with Mrs. Tighe. She's really really nice, and pretty funny about math. She tries hard to make sure everybody understands what's going on, and has review sessions on the weekends before our exams. Just try and come to class and you'll be fine.

Dr. Tighe has been a blessing to my life.  I entered the class nervous and fearful that I would have to drop.  However, I have excelled beyond my wildest dreams as a result of Dr. Tighe's teaching method. She sincerely cares about her students and resemebles a gentle auntie or nanny.  Make sure you come to class early, she hates late students.

A very motherly professor but full of tough love.  You have to be a self-starter to do well, this isn't a memorization course AT ALL. Know the material inside and out. She gives lots of homework but also long office hours. Be warned, exams are tricky, always from that one problem you skipped on the homework.  So study HARD and you will do well.
Good teacher, but has very hard exams.  However, you'll come out of the class knowing the material very well.

Mrs. Tighe does not seem to buy the idea that some people really are bad at math. My brain does not work that way and her tests are too freaking long for someone like me to do in a hour. She erases the examples from the board before I can finish copying them down. She chews loudly during our tests. All I can do is memorize in her class, not learn.

Mrs. Tighe is the best math teacher I have ever had! She makes a boring subject more bearable, she is also very helpful. She is very upbeat and has the best TAs. I lived in her office, I would sit off to the side and do homework and when I had a question she was right there to help. Mrs. Tighe is the best and I wouldn't take calc with anyone else!

Seems to expect that you already know the material. Assigns homework that seemingly has nothing to do with what she lectures about. I got A's in math before this class; had to drop it because I wasn't even sure I could pull off a C.

BEST MATH teacher ever. I paid $1000 out of MY pocket to take her calc 2 class over the summer. Calc is not easy but when teacher is nice and is willing to help u every step of the way...its much better. DO NOT take calc with anyone else...Tighe for Calc 1 and 2....and any other subject she teaches :)
Average Teacher. She explains everything very clearly; however, she doesn't seem to helpful when you ask a question. Her quizzes are actually sort of difficult as well as her test.
I can't stand her....she's rude and sarcastic.  The class isn't that hard but the bs homework is a waste of time as it has nothing to do with quizzes.
Dr. Capoor is much better. I cant understand this lady.
I had Mrs. Tighe years ago and still remember sitting in her class, actually understanding calculus.  WOOHOO.  She is, like everyone else is saying, the epitome of an excellent teacher.

Wow, I totally disagree with all the reviews. I actually LOVE math, never had any problems with it before, but Prof. Tighe is just a HORRIBLE professor. From the very first day she acts as if you already know all the material and she's just there to review. She's very rude when you try to ask her a question after class and not helpful at all.AVOID!
best teacher at umbc

Best.Teacher.EVER. I had her for both Calc I and II and I am certain that you will not be able to find a better teacher. Her class is entertaining, clear, and casual. Very lenient when it comes to grading and class structure. For Calc II i had a 88%, not only did she give me the A, but I was also exempt from the final. TAKE THIS TEACHER!!!!
All that can be said is she's nothing less than the best.

Ms. Tigh is one of the best in her profession. She is the epitome of what a professor should be. Her method of teaching is very understandable and easy which is further complimented by her warm and approachable personality. She brings out the best in her students as long as they do their part.

She's hilarious, interesting, easy to talk to, explains clearly, and will let you know that you have to be absolutley stupid to not understand that for Calculus you have to study a little bit. She is definitley one of the best teachers I ever had.

She is a really great professor. She is really helpful and witty which makes taking Calculus extremely easy. She is great later on with recommendations and with syce your grade if she knows that you try really hard. Work really hard to get an A and there is no final!!!!

My favorite teacher. She is always there to help anyone who wants it and she will give your grade a boost if you improve in the class. The material is hard to understand no matter who you take, but Mrs. Tighe is the best person to take it with. Highly recommend for any class you can get with her.
Best teacher at UMBC...helps you out and understands what it's like to be a college student.  If you take the class with anyone else you're crazy.
Do not take anyone but Tighe for 151 or 152, she's the best!
I loved Ms.Tighe!!! She was an excellent professor and was a huge help.
Ms. Tighe is the sweetest professor, and very helpful!!! She's always in her office to help or just chat. I would definately recommend her to anyone!!!
great teacher, makes funny jokes to strike interest of class and makes sure that everyone understood the material and was ready for exams

Mrs. Tighe is the best teacher I have ever had.  She is extremely helpful and caring.  She welcomes all her students to her office at any time (not just office hours) for help or to chat.  And she always has candy for you!  Great teacher and person!

This is a pretty easy class...just pay attention and do ALL the problems. The exams are pretty easy as long as you pay attention in class..the only hard part of this class was the final..everything was on the final and its hard..but if you get A's on all the exams you dont need to take the final.
Great teacher! Alot of work though, including weekly quizes and homework assignments.  However, she is an understanding teacher and gives you the grade you deserve.

Tighe is one of the best professors i've ever had. She is clear, helpfull, and very funny. She also is every lax, she almost always lets us out of class 10 to 15 minutes early. Great teacher, highly recommend!
Good teacher, funny, just come to class everyday, otherwise she will know who skips, but shes very helpful and tries to make the class interesting.
No matter how bad you are at math, if you try and come to class (she'll know) there is now way you won't at least get a B. She'll give you an A if you get at least 87 overall.
Great teacher! Class is a little hard, but she tries hard to help you understand it. The best teacher I have ever had!
Awesome professor.  The class is real hard but she does her best to help everyone through it.
She is awesome with help and extra study sessions!
Great Prof. Very Clear, very cool.
GREAT professor. Knowledgable and informative. A++ would take again.
Cool and fun teacher, and easy to work with.
great teacher
great professor! always helps and makes calc easy.
great teacher, really prepares you to go ahead, a lot of hw and often quizzes u
Nicest person you'll ever meet. If you really try, she will not give up on you!
The best math professor I've ever had!
Stupid course, go to lecture, it helps. I didn't . . .
Good person.  Hard course. Puts sample exams on web! Take her!
Will help one to succeed in life realistically

This was my second course with her, and I had the same problem as last time. We had so few chances to practice what we learned, so I did fine on the homework and pretty bad on quizzes/exams. She's really nice and funny, but I we had more chances to practice the skills that we learned.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: please come to class, it could be the difference between an A and B! Other than that, hws and quizzes weren't too bad but I wish we had gotten more ways to practice in between because the hw wasn't nearly enough for the quiz and she didnt give much to practice with in lecture either. other than that, class was easy.

One of the best linguistics professors in the department. Fantastic lecturer, well organized, and very funny. I learned a lot. Has a zero-tolerance absence policy (so you lose points for every absence), but you can regain some of those lost points by participating in class.

I took LING 210, which isn't listed here. She's good at teaching, but my only complaint is that there weren't very many assignments or assessments. There were few graded things, but each worth a lot of points. That might sound great, but it meant we didn't have a lot of chances to practice the material, and didn't have many things to be graded by.
Shes so fun just do the work

I learned a great deal in her class, she know what she talking about.  That said, she comes off as condescending when asked questions.  her exams are worded very poorly/awkwardly which makes them challenging.  I cme to her office hours once and she made me feel stupid.

Honestly, an amazing professor, I took this class because I needed a culture credit. Best decision I made, I am a STEM major but taking this linguistics class was amazing. Solid lectures, she was amazing at engaging students and often times incorporated her own stories to showcase the ideas. The readings were lengthy, but not undoable. Great prof!

Incredible class. There is a lot of reading to do, but the professor goes over the main points in class anyway. She has some funny stories to share, and there are opportunities to share your own stories as well. There is a scientific research poster, paper, and a few exams involved, but she is a lenient grader imo. Very fun professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I love her. I didn't do well on my final paper and it brought me down a letter grade, so I wouldn't call her easy, but she's a fair grader. She's interesting, encourages lectures, and loves her subject. I was struggling in another class and when she saw me waiting to take the final for it, she came over and told me I'd be ok. One of the best.

Renee is so sweet! This class had no exams, the grade was based on in-class presentations, guided reading questions, assignments called "thinkaloud"s, and a final essay. She is super chill, and an easy grader.
Dr. Lambert was amazing. I very much enjoyed her class. There were only 3 exams and 1 group project. The exam content came from the powerpoints she presented during class.

She takes no crap, leads thoughtful and intellectual discussions, and doesn't hesitate to give her opinion, but encourages you to disagree if you do. Very welcoming, funny, and expects a lot from you. Quebequoise, so she second guesses her english sometimes, but it's not an issue and she's easily understood. Easily one of my new favorites.

Dr. Brewster is passionate about the course content and is very knowledgeable about the material. However, the exams are disproportionately long for the allotted time frame, forcing students to rush through complex, highly specific questions (which are also graded extremely subjectively).

Dr. Brewster is kind, friendly, and passionate about developmental biology. However, she takes a while to grade and exams were inconsistent/very long. Most (except final exam) were long free response and graded subjectively, it was often hard to tell the exact answer she wanted. She had a generous curve and gave plenty of extra credit, though.

She recently switched exams to only 25 free response questions which was very hard. Final was 50 multiple choice questions. Material is rough and her lectures don't really help. Exam questions are very specific and all free response which will take up the whole exam period.

Developmental Biology is a hard topic, but Dr. Brewster makes it interesting and she is passionate about her field. She graded on a point based scale which allowed for more flexibility in receiving a higher grade in the class, especially with all the bonus points she gave out. She really cares about her students succeeding and is willing to help!

Devo is a difficult topic but Professor Brewster makes it very fun to learn. Her exams are fair but you definitely have to study hard. She gives great feedback and a lot of extra credit opportunities. I wish she taught more classes.

Devo class itself is a hard topic. One of the best profs. for it,however. She stresses high understanding over memorization. Is pretty organized and one way that helps to study: use end of lec. learning obj. Look them over while listening to lec. to focus in on the key points.   If you skimp in anyway, youll be lucky if you manage a B.

Brewster is very knowledgable and despite what people say, she actually is quite approachable. DO NOT even attempt to memorize everything. You MUST UNDERSTAND the material to do well in her class. Exams WILL be hard if you expect to get by with memorizing!! Amazing class, nonetheless.

Amazing teacher, knows a lot about her field. Makes Blumberg look like a babbling reading rainbow lady. Exams were fair but hard. Memorization does not help. Applies the material to current research, which is interesting. Usually pretty serious during lecture, but when she does make a funny, her little jokes are pretty good.
Dr. Brewster is an awesome teacher! She was very helpful and really wanted the students to succeed.

Way better than Blumberg. She displays a lot of enthusiasm about the material, and tries really hard to make you care too. I got an A, but I didn't think the exams were cake. Not bad looking. Unlike Blumberg, she is honest and upfront when you ask her about something she doesn't know.
Great teacher, especially when compared with Blumberg. Cares about the material and want you to be interested too. Exams are do-able.
So much easier than Blumberg. So, if your failing the first part of the class there is still hope as Brester's exams are a lot easier. You still have to study tho.

She taught the 2nd half and Eisenman taught the first. Brewster is not as clear a lecturer as Eisenman, but she had good powerpoint slides that covered all the material on her tests. Overall an unspecial, but relatively easy teacher.
brewster is mean in person....i was surprise the first time i talked to her. i like eisenman....he's very approachable
she's a good professor. she explain her lectures well. study your butt off for the exam, know the material and you're guarantee an A. I definitely recommend her.

She was very helpful when asked. She didn't just read from the powerpoint, she added some of her own explanations. As for her tests,whatever she emphasized was what appeared on the test, no bs. I liked that.
Don't take this class. Exams were unbearable, reviews are outdated. No practice exams, no study material, encourages studying quizzes which are nothing like exams. No curves, and no help.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The exams can be tough, esp exam 1, but the quizzes are super fair. He also offers test corrections for multiple exams and extra credit throughout the course. He is very approachable and friendly, and I definitely only got an A due to his fair grading, extra credit, and helpfulness. In general, a p chill guy, just make sure to study hard for exams.

Having a quiz every week can be a little stressful, but the problems are very similar to the homeworks. Peercy is nice, but his lectures can get a little dull. He explains things well.The most helpful resource is definitely the textbook. Exams are not that bad but the t/f sections will get you, so watch out. Do the homeworks thoroughly and its okay

Quizzes are very fair and based on homework, exams on the other hand are straight out of hell. older reviews says he gives practice exams, but now he does not. Questions from exams are way harder. The class is insanely boring and you have to memorize concepts as its a biology class as their is no real life applications. otherwise, he is a nice guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not bad, his lectures are a bit boring but there are video lectures that come with the online textbook. He follows the textbook to a tee, all of the problems on quizzes and exams are similar to it. Quizzes and exams are hard but not asking anything he hasn't taught, it's just the class content. He's very nice and friendly
0 resources, 0 help, useless lectures, awful exams

He took over my MATH221 class for the last 3 weeks when my last professor got fired and he was amazing, I learned more those 3 weeks than the entire rest of the semester. If you show up he will answer any questions and help prepare you for the questions on the quizzes and test, don't know his usual style of grading since he kept ours from before.

Expects you to teach yourself. Must read the book and do examples for next class 'cause there are quizzes before each one. He goes through theory, but isn't the best at explaining IMO. Has you work alone in class rather than teaching you how. However, he's a forgiving grader. Quizzes each week, heavy HW, but each are good chunk of the grade.
lots of hw, harsh grader, and he doesn't like.... teach you basically teach your self everything and he makes you take online quizes on stuff he has not taught in class yet but he is a cool person
Peercy is a great choice for linear algebra. Although his lectures can get a bit boring, he takes his time and posts the notes. Exams can be difficult, but he helps prepare for them.

Required usual effort for a math class. Did lectures with ipad/projector and would post his notes, very helpful for review. HW is due every week, and is graded. Tests often draw from more difficult HW problems. Allowed us to submit test corrections for partial credit. Excellent explanations, office hours are very helpful. Highly recommended.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Fantastic instructor who takes time with students and is interested in hearing about specific issues. I had holes from my high school math classes which I'd brought up to him and he addressed those in class and noticed some general issues he cleared up for all students. I don't think i'd have my degree without his clear teaching. I received an A.

Dr. Peercy is an amazing professor! I really liked his lecture style of writing the notes on the board, and he makes sure to explain everything clearly. He keeps lectures interesting, will answer the any question and is also very funny. He makes a lot of dad jokes so we call him Brad the Dad. If I worked a little harder I would have gotten an A.

The best math professor I have ever had from Calc I, II,  III & Diff Eq. He's dedicated to his research, but always open during office hours.   Exams come straight from the homework and he provides previous year exams.  His class is not easy but as long as you follow up with the book and understand his lectures you'll pass.

Peercy is the man! He is a bit hard to follow during lectures as he tries to fit in all the nitty gritty details that aren't going to be tested. He is super helpful during office hours and is just a generally chill, nice guy! Also his tests are straightforward and he is more than generous with partial credits.

Broford Peercy is pretty cool. He is incredibly helpful during office hours, very funny, but PDE's is definitely a very hard class. He is a merciful grader with beautiful gelled hair, but he teaches the class straight from another professor, which can be annoying. Definitely would take again, but PDE's is just a rough class.

My problem with the way he teaches is he skips too many steps.  He kind of just copies the notes he brings to class (Bell's notes?), and sometimes if a student points out a mistake, he doesn't seem to know where he is or how to correct it.
Very helpful in office hours, but lectures are sometimes difficult to follow. Easy grader on exams. Homework is difficult.

Favorite professor thus far. He is prepared and his lectures are well thought out. He is always available at office hours and willing to help. Homework was fair and practice exams helped on the exams. Definitely taking another class with him again and would love to do research with him.
Super friendly, and very enthusiastic about the subject. Always more than happy to help if you go to office hours or ask for extra help.

His exams were straight from the homework. put up practice exams w/ no key but you could look em up in the book. But once again, exam problems esp T/F were word for word from the book. Lecture was pointless though. Overall, he's nice, fair and easy exams, interesting extra credit, but pointless to listen to, unless you have a specific question.
Wish I took this class with someone else.
Practice tests don't come with answer keys, so they are useless.

Excellent professor.  Homework each week does not take much time at all, but can be kind of confusing at first. Posts practice exams that are extremely helpful. If you just review your homework and the practice exam you will ace the tests.  Gives extra credit on each exam and final was the easiest out of the 4 exams.  he even offers to go over HW.

Not the greatest math professor I've had. He relied almost entirely on PowerPoint, which was very ineffective. Exams were difficult and homeworks were littered with mistakes. Given the chance, I would go back and take this class with Bell.
Easily the best math teacher I've had. Helpful, clear lectures, test based on homeworks. Learns student names and demonstrates real applications like MatLab. Take it with him.
He is very helpful and he cares about his students.
Exams come from the homework.

Took him for linear algebra he was overly fair in a class full of slackers he let people do test revisions for 1/2 credit.Not a really hard class learned a lot of conceptual info it  benefits you to read before class he kind of glosses over things.  Hes really into research but an overall decent teacher. I would take a class with him again again y^

Best math teacher I have had at UMBC. From Pre-calc till Calc 2.  He was my fall2010 DE prof.  His exams are very fair.  You just need to invest some time on your hw. More than willing to go over material during class and his office hours. After taking his class, I am interested in having a math minor.
He's not the best professor I've ever had, but he's not bad. Plus, he's fun to look at :-)

Great professor! He sometimes makes mistakes in class but they're simple algebra and always corrected right away. He really makes sure students are following and explains very clearly. Take him for 225!

Having heard horror stories about Diff EQ, i was worried, but he taught the class very well. Made it known what was expected of you, and if you did the homework, you could get through the class no problem. Listens to the students for insight.
Extremely Helpful. Personally nice although he's tough as a teacher. He has a good reason to make his class hard; it is because he's extremely helpful. another excellent math teacher in my life!
Awesome Teacher! Extremely willing to eb flexible and work with the class. keeps open office hours, Extremely helpful. Willing to explain just about anything. Listens to students.

He's a freakin' doucebag that doesn't know how to teach; however, he thinks he is a badass in math which is not true  because he is confused himself when he is teaching. His exams are hard as**** and tests on material which is not covered in class which is a absolute waste of time to be in class. F**K THIS CLASS with him as a teacher!!! :/

Complete ass. AVOID IF POSSIBLE. To learn/teach math, you have to review/practice problems; however, he just goes over theorems in class which are also mentioned in the book!!! Can't teach, don't waste your time. Class will be harder than expected because of him.
He just reads out something he has memorized right before the class. Sometimes, he's even confused with his note.
he is making the class harder than it should be. especially he has a different harder note than the book has.
No Comments
Professor Dunnigan is very kind. The prompt for the final is very strict and it makes it harder to write. So much busy work.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Loved Professor Dunnigan's class! Took ENGL100 in the summer so a lot of essays in a short amount of time but his class was enjoyable. Conversation based class so participation is graded but fairly easy. Gives GREAT feedback after assignment is graded, few pop quizzes about 5 questions per quiz on short reading
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He never releases a rubric for essays, he just tells you what to write, and that can make things unclear when he grades. There were some essays I believed were better than the grade he gave, and some I didn't even think I deserved an A. He's great with feedback, but only after your grade has come back.

This is relatively basic English course, although high school does not teach you nearly enough when it comes to writing clearly. Thankfully, he gives a run down of all the necessary factors of an essay. He is a patient grader and cares about everyone receiving a passing grade. There are a lot of assignments in general but very completable.

Professor Dunnigan is a really great instructor.  I will say is that his class is writing intensive which is given in any English course but his prompts are very ambiguous and difficult to understand. If anything is unclear just go to him, he clears any concerns up. He absolutely wants you to succeed just be sure to communicate with him.

You are graded on participation, but participating is relatively easy to do and complete. He gives recorded feedback on all major assignments which are pretty useful! He isn't a tough grader if you follow all guidelines. His energy even at 9am in the morning makes classes interesting and the filler assignments, if you pay attention are easy!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Dunnigan was really nice and thoughtful in the essay feedback. He definitely wants you to dig deeper on the topics that you write to make sure that you are understanding all of the different perspectives. Great teacher!

I don't say this lightly: best class I've ever taken. Prof developed this class and it is very important info in today's political climate. There are various types of media (newspapers, posters, comics, etc) from the women, gay, and civil rights movements. I took another one of his classes in a later semester because it was so impactful to me.

Professor Dunnigan's class is engaging, with thought-provoking discussions on the assigned readings. The workload is manageable, and Unstuckstudy proved helpful for essay prep. Stay on top of the work, and you'll do well in this class.

Overall, Professor Dunnigan is not a bad professor. Great sense of humor and applies his hilariousness to the class extremely well. The pop quizzes came out of nowhere with some of the most random quiz questions ever. Was extremely jammed up towards end with 3 papers being due within 1 full month. Wish there was more clarity on how to write papers.

I loved Dunnigan's class! No matter how bad my day was, this class was random in the best way. He values all opinions, whether "good" or "bad," and listens with genuine curiosity about different views. Grading is a bit tough, but as long as you can back up your views, you're good. He's accommodating, open to questions, and always willing to help.

Had Dunnigan for a 7 week summer ENGL 101 class online. Class was easy and he graded on criteria more than anything else. Follow the instructions and you will be fine. He was a slow grader and I often didn't get a rough draft grade back until well after I'd turned in a final draft. But, because he was not a harsh grader this wasn't a big deal.

This class is simple as long as you read the books and participate in class. Professor Dunnigan was always flexible with deadlines with valid reasons (so long as you spoke to him before the due date about any circumstances), and always was willing to read our essays and give us feedback before we submitted.

Course is extremely back-loaded, with only 2 papers due in the first 14 weeks of the semester and 3 papers due in the last two weeks (two of which are 10 pages each). Doesn't give clear instructions for the papers, then takes lots of points off because we didn't write it exactly how he wanted. Feels more like a history class than an English class.
Honestly he's a chill teacher however the quizzes were so random... so it was difficult because it's not like you can study ahead of time because he asks the most random questions ever
Super fun lectures and caring professor. However, he is a harsher grader. There are books to read and essays based on the books. About 4-5 I believe.

I love Professor Dunnigan, he is supportive and caring, and the workload was manageable, with 4-5 essays as the basis for your grade. If you stay on top of the novels and essays and ask for feedback, you will ace it! You do have to talk in class which makes up 10% of your grade but other than that, I would retake this class with him if I could!

His lectures are more philosophical and discussing books than teaching English. Participation is a grade. Try starting on papers early because you need to put a lot of thought into them. His feedback is good but slow because grading takes forever. He gives extensions for the papers if you need, but only for 1-2 days. Overall good prof and class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: I loved going to this class even though it was just an annoying GE credit. I found some of the essays fun to write and I got lucky with the books I got to read. PLEASE participate if you want this guy, he loves it and it gets awkward without anyone participating (you are also graded on it). Felt like a philosophy class.
Chill professor. Typical english class, start your essays early, read the assigned readings for your book, participate in class and you'll have a smooth ride.
His lectures alone are worth taking him for your English credit. Really fun class and the readings were interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took Eng Composition hybrid class in the fall and I loved it. Professor Dunnigun engages the student by asking different questions that help with critical thinking. Just be prepared to participate, it matters. It is not so hard, you just have to contribute at least one reply for the discussion and you are good.

Hands down the best professor I've had so far. I was dreading this as an online zoom class at first but it was entertaining he made it interesting it wasn't boring. He is very nice and is willing to give early feedback if you email him. I never struggled in English so it was really easy for me. His standards are clear and not difficult.

Professor Dunnigan is a very nice and understanding professor. He chooses interesting books to read and beware of philosophical tangents during his lectures (I happen to enjoy them but I can see how some may not). He gives helpful feedback on every paper and always encourages students to attend his office hours or to email him if any qualms.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Dunnigan is very passionate about his Introduction to Literature course. We read Frankenstein, V for Vendetta, and a Raisin in the Sun. I think there were a couple essays, of which it is very important to write about what you actually think and interpret, not just copy some analysis from the internet. Expect to read and participate a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great professor! Really turned your usual English class into something much deeper. Has made great accommodations and easy adjustment for the online format. Really interesting books/ topics discussed.

I took his summer class online and it was not great. His feedback was not clear and did not help towards improving my writing. All of the lectures discussed Philosophy and all assignments focused on writing.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved his class! His lectures were interesting and funny and we usually ended early. Really easy class as long as youre a good writer (I put an average amount of effort in and got an A). There were a few 3-4 page papers, a research paper, a final paper, and some other small writing assignments. The books he picks are good and easy to understand.

Mr. Dunnigan is so fantastic! He is a caring, witty teacher who respects his students and tries his best to have us engage. He is also very philosophical, has one thinking of the big questions in life. We do a lot of papers, so beware, but that's expected. You need to participate and come to class! Thank you, Prof. Dunnigan for a great semester!

He is an awesome professor hes relaxed and informal. As long as you read the supplemental readings the night before and the novel readings you can earn an A or a B (depending on how you write). His papers are easy and not long (about 2-3 pages). Take his class!

Dunnigan is a very friendly, relaxed, informal guy. Class was fun a lot of the time, and we got out early often. The grades are paper based - we'd have one big paper due while three others were to be written and due at the same time. The required readings are what's discussed in class, and you get a participation grade based on how often you spoke.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: He either grades really easy, or I'm an amazing writer. A paper I got a B on in HS that I added to he gave me an A+! There are a few papers, each dealing with a different theme/book, but he picks good, interesting books for the semester. Really enjoyed his class, but do PARTICIPATE!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He respects every each student. His lectures are mixed with humor and useful background information. He makes you feel comfortable and enjoyable in class. There is alot of papers and books to read but the books were very interesting and he thoroughly explains the rubric for papers and gives it way ahead of time for you to prepare.

Prof Dunnigan is probably one of the best professors in the english department. Really engaging topics in class and a fair grader. However, one of the books required for class was used no more than 3 times and I paid 35$ for it. We weren't tested on it or anything it was just used for background knowledge.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Somehow got an A in this course, despite taking it in the summer before college. Thought this class was going to be easy, but the fact he drops a letter grade for missing 2 lectures is quite biased. Very tough essay grader. Cool professor but difficult topics.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Dunnigan is hands down the best professor at UMBC! This is not your standard English class. He creates interesting discussions and chooses interesting novels. I recommend him to all my friends and would recommend him to everyone. BEST PROFESSOR!
Great professor that cares and has interesting, engaging lectures. Assignments include minor or major essays, and the final is also an essay. Two main books - a novel and a graphic novel.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: He was the best English professor in my educational career!! His socks were amazing and he made me enjoy coming to class every day at 9 am! But he aint that easy you have to read and talk in class! He's great though 10/10 would recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Professor Dunnigan really knows what he is talking about. As an English major, I was very interested in the book discussions we had in class. Be sure to keep on top of the supplemental readings as they often make appearances on pop-quizzes and exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: So funny and straightforward and keeps the class entertained! pretty hip

He is a very chill and laid back teacher but I don't understand how he grades his papers. I did more writing in this class then I did in my writing intensive class. Class participation is key. Pop quizzes here and there. Make sure you read bc he's gonna ask the most random questions. Keep up supplemental readings, thats the bulk of the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Prof D was pretty chill, class was philosophy heavy. Gives decent feedback on papers, but vaguely graded. You can find all books online. Keep up on reading b/c he gives pop quizzes. Exams are heavily focused on the supplm readings. First 1.5 month was a repeat of ENGL100-fell behind on the syllabus, so last 3 weeks of class was exam, essay, essay.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: He's pretty awesome. Felt lucky I got him for my first semester. As long as you speak up, even a little bit every class, your participation grade will be solid. Even if it's just word, at least he knows you're engaged with the class. The papers themselves aren't half bad either. Time consuming yeah, but it is college mate.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof Dunnigan is a cool guy and his lectures were interesting. He is nice and funny when you talk to him personally. His grading is not too bad but it sometimes seems random. HOWEVER, he grades participation very strictly. Be SURE to speak 2-3 times PER class because the participation grade will make or break you.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: My class experience was 3 hours of this man's random opinions of life.  He's funny and cool but spends the majority of the class off topic.  He counts participation and you cant miss more than two classes a semester.  Don't take him.

He's a pleasure to have as a professor. He's hilarious and is really amazing at making lectures entertaining. Overall an amazing person. But make sure you come to class and participate, or you won't pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He's a great guy, pretty interesting too. I would definitely take ENG100 with him again. I took him over the summer if you focus you'll get an A
Gave good feedback on papers and interesting lectures. Also he's very easy on the eyes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Participation matters !!! To me , his lectures were pretty confusing , he likes to relate everything in book with history or philosophy or  things you never heard of . However , that made the lectures interesting I guess . Have an advice for pre-med ppl , don't take it , choose something more practical ..

I took him for a second time for ENG 392 and he was a great teacher to have yet again. If you need help, he's there and he's very approachable. His comments are entertaining to hear during the small group discussions and he has some pretty good insight. I definitely recommend him as one of the better professors at umbc.

I don't like his grading skills. He doesn't use blackboard and  sometimes he loses his students papers. He never gave me a clear calculation of my grade in his class but was very arbitrary when grading . He's a very chilled guy but he needs to work on his grading. and fix his blackboard use. Also, he is a very disorganized man
Dunnigan is a great professor and his lectures are interesting, He is one of the tougher graders as far as English 100 goes, but then again its English 100.

He grades the first paper easy then as he goes on he grades papers harder. He always offers to read rough drafts and gives really good feedback on them. He's a good teacher, but he takes forever to give you back your workpapers.

Attendance is definitely necessary, if you miss more than 4 classes, you won't pass. There's no leniency for that, excused or not, so go to class! I found his sense of humor hilarious and he's a very nice teacher!

BEST PROFESSOR EVER. His lectures makes you question your current view on religion, government while connecting literature. BIG on philosophy, very chill, open minded, you will NOT REGRET taking this class Frankenstein, V for Vendetta 3 (500-750 word) papers, 2 tests, 3-4 in class assignments AttendanceParticipation mandatory if you want an A
Great professor. Interesting class. Doing the reading and put effort into your work, easy A

She has a particular writing style and she expects everyone to write the same. What she expects is not made clear and you're left confused! I really want to like her, she seems to be really nice. But, I CAN NOT!
yes
He's a hilarious guy and chooses good books to read. Was very helpful with essay feedback if you go to his office hours. Fun guy to talk too.

Best professor I ever had. This is the only class I actually looked forward to attending just because the guy is hilarious and class discussions are fun. The work is easy, all the papers were under 10 pages (usually 7 pages max) and the books he chooses are SO INTERESTING, they're really easy to write papers about. I wish I could have him again.
Would not recommend this professor. Arbitrary grader and didn't update grades until the last day. Plenty of easier teachers you could enroll with.

Buy the books. Go to every class. Exams are based on class discussions and imp. details in books. Not hard if you pay attention. PARTICIPATE! Write 3-4 essays. Give yourself at least 2-3 days to write, edit and re-write. You can also email your drafts for him to edit. He is a fair grader. Doesn't rush class. Pretty laid-back. Do not slack off.

He's a good person, but grades really harshly. All the classes involve lengthy discussions on very detailed portions of books, but tests cover a wide range of poems and topics that weren't discussed. Little feedback, doesn't post grades. Not worth taking Eng 210 with this guy

Great personality! Horrible Professor! He gives almost no commentary on graded Essays besides "more devlopment". I emailed him several times with no reply. He is big on participation with unreasonable expectations. He talks for 80% on the class but wants every single student to participate ever class period. Pre-Medders stay away. Not worth the B.

I would not recommend this professor. While Professor Dunnigan is a nice person, he is not a helpful teacher. He rarely responds to his emails, is unclear about assignments, and an inconsistent grader. Expect significantly more work  than other professors. He is the only English 100 teacher that I know of that is giving a final exam as well.

Must attend class since he does take attendance but class is not at all boring or dull.  Doesn't expect over the top writing skills though you better read and take notes for the exams and papers since its concept questions and no secondary paper sourcing.

So I felt like the class was remedial since I had already taken a couple AP English classes, but I still think the class wasn't a waste of time. The material is interesting and I enjoyed hearing Mr.Dunnigan talk despite his constant disclaimers on things he said not being his actual opinion. He's rather dorky, but it's cute.

Interesting and thought provoking class. Classes almost always discussion and participation is required every class. 5 major essays are the majority of the final grade, fair grader and respects opinion as long as you explain your thoughts. great teacher and easy to talk to!

He is nice and open minded. He says something he always ensures it does not offend anyone in class. However, his grading system is very poor. 10%is in participation which is ridiculous since one kid in my class never raised his hand and blurted out everything. The last essays had  close due dates and disregarding students have other work and exams.
All around solid teacher. Very good experience :) Would recommend

Extremely nice and approachable. The kind of person you want to grab a bite with. Very articulate, and gives mind blowing lectures. However, his grading system is terrible. I had 4 papers and a participation grade. He does not post grades on Bb, so nobody knows their grade thruout the semester. Still, I would recommend his class.

He is by far the best professor I have ever had in my life! He actually makes me interested in the topics he brings up. He also chooses very interesting books to read for class. You will love being in his class!

This professor does not use blackboard and because the majority of the 5 assignments are piled at the end of the semester, you could have a high A and have it drop down to a C after the last day of school. His niceness does not make up for the frustration I've had with his grading system.

I have always loved english so I looked forward to this. We only had a total of five papers all semester, and he piled the last three on at the very end. Rambles on about the most open ended things. Its hit or miss with him, and there is no way of knowing whether he will love or hate your papers. Completely inconsistent. Not profound imo.

He was an amazing professor. He was so helpful and nice. Never said anything negative and had the best personality. He made jokes all of the time, and was super easy to approach. He would even edit your paper before it was due, which I highly recommend. Not too hard on the eyes either!!

One of the best professors I've ever had, and an interesting man. When you first see him, all your preconceived notions of what professors should be go out the window. He's a brilliant, and really gets you think critically. Also, he's easy on the eyes and just has this refreshing youthful charm about him. TAKE HIS CLASS!
best professor i have ever had IN MY LIFE. encourages critical thinking and is really interested in students success. TAKE THIS PROFFESSOR. not hard. just read the materials and participate in class.

He's a fun, easy-going professor. There were three books for my Spring 2011 semester, which were "V for Vendetta", "The Handmaid's Tale", and "Geek Love". There was a 500-750 word paper on each, and a 5-7 page paper at the end of the term. Easy stuff, cool guy.

He's a rambler, but pretty interesting. Unfortunately, the class material itself is pretty boring, so he can only do so much to make it appealing. He normally picks "controversial" books and you write simple essays for them. Longest paper is 5-7 pages at the end of the semester.

Dunnigan sets the standard for what professors AND teachers should aspire to be. Helpful, engaging, intelligent, are a few of the virtues he possesses toward teaching and will do just about everything in his power NOT to leave you in the dust. Neigh sayers of this popular professor should be silenced. His methods should be kindled not killed.

The information he taught was good and innovative. He doesn't keep grades posted. He lied and said that I didn't participate in class enough, although I was one of the many who volunteered to do everything. He isn't very reachable.
WONDERFUL!!!!!!!!

Wonderful Teacher, you do one paper per book plus a research, and then like 2 or 3 like one page things. Class attendance is a must. If you participate are speak up in class everything will go great. Longest paper was research paper, 7 pages (nothing at all) Take him!
Very helpful if you're having trouble and kind hearted.
AWESOME. He is the best. Very helpful and discussions in class were very open and easy to get points. Overall great professor

Take Dunnigan! He is a huge promoter of thinking critically for yourself. Now, unlike the others I didn't have "revelations" towards English (because he never focuses on grammar), but I always enjoyed going and learning something new. Attendance and Participation are MANDATORY. Overall, great class. And.. it doesn't hurt that he's good looking.
Really loves teaching.
he is SOOO Hott!!! and i can't help but pay attention in class and smile : )
This teacher is AWESOME!! One of the best teachers I have ever had. He involved the super orgasm into lecture, thats how hilarious he is!!

He is an awesome teacher and really helpful. You just have to write a lot of essays and he makes you think critically. He is also REALLY hot which makes you pay attention to his class. I have sexual fantasies about this man.

Prof Dunnigan is byfar one of my favorite professors so far in my college career. i don't know what i got yet, as i am still in his class but he seriously makes you think. i learned so much from this class. i came into this class just wanting to get my english credit over with, but he is very interesting..he is pretty hard though on his grading
good
AWESOME TEACHER!! Not as much reading required as everyone has been saying but defiantly manageable. Very interesting lectures and entertaining. Pushes you to critically think. Really cool guy.

AWESOME PROFESSOR! Only class that I enjoyed attending. His grading system is straightfoward, he grades fairly. The lectures are hilarious and you can go offtangent like crazy and get full points. Definently enjoyed having this class and it is a REALLY EASY A!

His teaching is ok. Expect to read a lot. Though he loves to mention how objective he is, this is not a constant truth. He can be insensitive. Things like racism or genocide he will qualify as wrong, but topics like sexual assault or subjugation of women get "all opinions welcome" or "there is no wrong answer". If you're sensitive to this avoid it.

Brian is easygoing and entertaining.  he has great insight and energy to spare.    his books are interesting.  The teacher doesn't force his opinions on you, but rather lets you think about issues for yourself.  He touches on everything from the relative morality of murder, to Malcolm X's change of heart.  Very interesting class.
You could sum up everything Dunnigan teaches in one lecture.  His class should be an easy A but it's a huge a waist of time.

Tries to draw critical thinking from various students, and often does a fairly decent job. He often repeats the same questions in different words however, may just be us not being responsive though. His reading syallabus is demanding at first, but turns out it's not really held to (good thing). Probably 3rd best proff I ever had, love the class.

Took the summer session. I looked forward to his class and did well but I wrote top-notch papers. The discussions were amusing and his grading was reasonable. Understanding person and nice person. You must attend class and do the required reading, though. I recommend him as your professor - you will enjoy his class if you have an open mind.

Quite possibly one of the best professors I have ever had. Immensely interesting, wants to hear other (even contrary) opinions, and loves what he teaches. Extremely helpful (you can email him your papers ahead of time) and grades based on content (even if he personally disagrees). Funny, but he rekindled my love of philosophy. HIGHLY recommended.

LOVE LOVE LOVE him! The BEST prof i've EVER had. I wish he'd start teaching something besides eng100 so I can take him again. He's totally hot (<3), very intelligent and evokes critical thinking. 5 essays, 1 research paper, and participation is vital along with attendance, but with dunnigan you wont want to miss class but rather look forward to it.

By far my favorite teacher.  He is so enthusiastic about his teaching and makes you want to come to class. Be sure to participate, he's really big on that.  The novels are pretty interesting, they are not boring at all especially "The Handmaid's Tale."  No tests, just papers and you can e-mail them to him ahead of time for his feedback.

Very interesting professor. You only have to write about 4 to 5 essays. But what I liked most about this professor is that he grades your essays primarily based on your ability to demonstrate critical thinking instead of minor mistakes such as grammar and word usage and whatnot. You do not have to be an eloquent writer to get a good grade.
He was an ok teacher. There was more reading and writing than in most English classes (We had to read 7 novels and write a paper on each one). If you like reading and writing you should be fine.
talk alot in class and try to write what he wants to hear.
Great class!  Brian will talk about anything and is by far the best teacher I have ever had!

He is a very interesting guy, he talks about new ideas and encourages the student's new ideas. You have to read about 5-7books but they are very interesting also. However, he grades essay in a weird way. If he doesnt like your style, he will not give you a nice grade. But overall classes are interesting.

Less than 25% of class time is actually used to improve writing skills. This instructor basically gets paid to whinge about his political opinions in a required course using straw man arguments and endless rhetorical questions.
Very playful guy. Doesnt take the class seriously and grades papers unrealistically. I do not recommend him.

Everyday is an experience with this professor.  He is all about promoting critical thought.  Your grade is based off 6 papers, participation, and small quizes just to make sure you are reading.  He is an average grader but a very interesting guy.  I loved his class and it was fairly easy to get a good grade.  Just read and work hard on the papers.

The best english teacher at UMBC! He is so interesting, makes the class fun and it never feels like ur in a boring old english class. I took the class as a junior so i've had many manyyy professors and he is def one of the best.

I love this guy/class!  He's totally the best english teacher I have had yet!  The class bring up interesting critical thinking, fascinating ideas and I would definetly suggest it to anyone taking english 100.
Pretty hard grader,but very funny, he tries to make class interesting.  You definitely want him for ENGL 100.  Every other teacher I have heard people complain about

Loved his class.  For English, you want him.  He is a harderish grader, but he makes literature interesting. Once he turned off all the lights in the room, took out candles and we read by candlelight for a class!  Sometimes he took us outside too.

Class is pretty boring but you have to attend because he takes attendance.  Tough grader on papers and class discussion is VERY important (10% of your grade).  No homework except to read the books and no quizzes so you better be a good writer and active participater!
No Comments

Expect to think in this class, grades essays a bit hard. Psych majors will have an advantage during discussions. And he is an interesting character. i.e. "Is this class really just mental masturbation?" need I say more
wow class is pretty boring.  you talk about the same stuff everyday.  he grades essays pretty easy though and there are no tests!
Great teacher. He expects college students to do college work and is big on class participation. Best teacher I ever had.

the stuff you do in this class is nothing like what you should learn in English 100.  You have to read 6 books and an essay for each then a research paper on the 6 books... so if you dont read the books your screwed.. ALSO he takes ATTENDENCE and if you miss 3 you get a grade lowered.. and if you 5 YOU FAIL.. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS FROM HIM!!
One of the best professors here at UMBC.  Keeps everyone involved even though he is a hard grader on essays.

This class is very entertaining.  If you like English and critical thinking then this is the class for you.  Don't hesitate to ask him questions, go to class, take notes, read the books (they really arent that bad), and TRY on the essays.  PARTICIPATION is a big thing but come on thats not that bad... overall AWESOME teacher, I got great insight!
I don't like english, but enjoyed this class. I just didn't like all the reading that was needed.

Prepare to do about 5 essays and 1 research paper. You read about 5 books, most of them are entertaining... like others said very helpful but you have to put the effort into getting your grade.. He is big in participation.  Overall not an easy class but not to difficult. ATTENDENCE is a must

Awesome teacher (even tho he looks like a young punkish guy haha).  Very fun classes.  talks about ANYTHING, no matter how risque.  He even cancels lab mid way through semester.  He's kinda a hard grader on essays, but he's available to check your paper before hand.  He made me like english class!

he is liek a precious young/aging punk. he is so cute and has such cute style! ooh and hes so intelligent and aware of social norms and gender norms.. and he totally is goofy and a werido and makes things fun.. and gets u thinking critically. PLUS hes so down and totally ur homeboy!

He is perhaps one of the best teachers I have ever seen in action.  He makes you think, and wants everyone in class to participate in discussions.  These days stand out. 1. Led the class outside to chat... just because.  2. Turned off the lights and put a candle on every desk inside... to read.
I had him last semester and he's really awesome. Class is fairly easy, but he really wants everyone to participate in discussion. The final paper kinda sucks, but the rest of the semester is fine
focuses a lot on class discussion, but he really wants his students to question and think critically.  Fun class--very casual atmosphere and he doesen't talk down to you.
He is super nice and is always willing to help. He also lets you out early quite often

Dr. Burns is passionate about arthropods and generally friendly. However, she graded especially harsh on the final presentation (worth 30% of the grade) with no prior warning and inconsistent feedback. Be sure to collect arthropods early on in the semester so as not to be left hunting for them when the weather gets cold.

I never write reviews but Dr. Burns is compassionate, respectful, and genuine about what she teaches. This course opened my eyes to the diversity and complexities of life and how nothing is normal. Rather than calling this course difficult I would call it challenging and interesting as it teaches you to think. Work hard your grade will reflect!

Dr. Burns is an amazing professor! Her class was really well organized and structured- we had scientific literature reading and quiz due each week, followed by lecture presentation by Dr. Burns relevant to the paper. Whenever I needed help with a topic, she went above and beyond to help me understand better. She gives lots of cool assignments too!

Dr. Burns is awesome! She is a fairly new, but I really loved taking BIOL 483 with her, which is an evolution based class. That is her passion, so she teaches it really well. I would have taken her class in Spring 2020 too if I could. She was always willing to meet with students outside of class and help you where she could. I recommend her!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I rarely say this, but an awful professor. I'm sure she's a great researcher, but as far as teaching goes, she's incredibly lazy, yet demanding. She's planned a total of three lectures, all other classes are student presentations of random papers, on esoteric topics, ultimately we learn almost nothing of value from.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Burns actually cares about her students. Her lectures were easy to follow along. She was funny and connected with students. Definitely recommend taking her.
Dr. Burns is very available to her students when they need help. The exams are little tricky but studying the learning objectives help a lot!

Dr. Burns is an excellent lecturer, always clear and understandable in her presentations. Plus, she answers questions very well after class should you ever have any. Prep for the exams are crucial. If you study the learning objectives (the main focus of the exams), you should perform well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Burns a very inspirational professor. Her lectures are amazing. She does everything to make sure the class is fun and the content is very well organized. BIO142 is a very hard class so you have to study a lot. Go to her office hours, she helps students anytime you need. There is a lot of reading, but she points out the learning objectives.

The best CS professor at UMBC, hands down. He is incredibly passionate about the field and makes lectures interesting with relevant facts and history of the industry. He puts learning first and grades second. If you put in the effort to learn and try your hardest, you will get an A. This was his actual policy. Incredible energy when lecturing.
I cannot recommend Burkhardt enough. UMBC needs to hire more professors like him! He's an amazing lecturer. This class is hard. That being said, do your homework and study hard!

This is a difficult class and you will struggle in it. However, the professor is quite good at lecturing and makes the material very understandable. Be prepared to spend some time on the homeworks as they are quite involved. The class is heavily weighted towards tests and even though they are straightforward, you need to be familiar with material.

Hardest Compsci class no matter who teaches it (Coming from someone who took 313, 331, 341, 421, and 449), however the curve he gives is high. Lectures are helpful for the basis of topics, but you should really read the textbook for the chapters needed if you want an A. I got lucky to get a B because of the curve. Exams worth a LOT compared to hw.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is not easy no matter who teachers but he is very knowledgeable in all the courses he instructs. Always encourages students to try, don't give up, and not to worry about their grade. Focus on learning. That definitely allowed me to focus more on the subject. Would 100% take again and again.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Best professor I have ever had. I feel like a lot of his low ratings are because the class itself is difficult. If you ask questions, stay focused in class, you will succeed in this course, I highly recommend Burkhardt because I learned so much with him. You won't have enough time to finish exams. Pretty he does this so people can't cheat. Respect.

He writes a lot but like if you just write some stuff down on your notes and then like write down some answers on the hw and tests then you'll be fine. i put like no effort in lmao and i still passed despite basically failing all the hw and tests thanks to how he curves the grades. as long as you show up for class and write something down u gucci

just show up lol. with how he is you can just like "do" the hw and quizzes and still pass with how he curves the grade. easiest class i have ever taken thanks to that. long as you show up and just like write something down on your hw and tests you'll be fine.

Having him as a professor has been so nice. Stuff has been tough at home with all the covid stuff but he's given us 3 hours on exams including the final and if you miss quizzes as long as you email him about it he'll let you take them! With how he curved all the grading none of us in the class failed.

He puts a lot of information into his lectures but if you dont understand it then he will happily meet with you during office hours and explain stuff step by step for hours until you understand. He also curves his grading a lot so even if you dont do well on quizzes and exams its actually very hard to get a failing grade for the class

Even if you dont do well on quizzes and exams as long as you show up and do the homework and classwork you will pass. Its because of the way he grades on a curve making it actually EXTREMELY difficult to fail his class. The other professors are not so kind with the grading. So his class is much easier even if he does write a lot on the board.

Material was presented in a inefficient way. Spend a majority of the time writing notes on the board, rather then explaining. Quizzes have a low class avg 40%. But at the end the curve was 25%> got you a C, 48%> B, 73%> A. Nobody got below a C in my class (according to his email). Overall if you see him writing notes on the board, just drop.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Teacher spends 60% of the class writing notes on chalk board. Which he refuses to post to Blackboard, even tho they are already typed up in his binder. Test are very hard (test1 avg: 40%, test2: 39%). Grade comes from 4 test: 40%, 20% HW (10x2%), 40% Final. Lectures are not helpful, but they are the only place you get material.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Was quite an awful experience for me. Not a math person so I was constantly struggling and his lectures were so rushed and unclear. I don't really love being negative like this, but if he does teach again, this is a warning. Take another. I've had a easier time in higher levels of math. Was constantly with groups and tutor to get a passing grade.

A laid back teacher who wants to see you succeed. Do the homeworks and assignments or you'll most likely struggle in this class. A great guy, going to his office hours are a must if you are struggling.

Easy class as it was algebra but I lost my skills after learning it so many years ago. With him, I quickly relearned the math and the quizzes were a breeze. A very chill and nice professor. Definitely would take any class if he was the professor!
Best math professor ever. Thanks for helping me realize I love math!
Office hours were lit, but I almost failed the course. Not because he's a bad prof but I just a lot suck at math. He's a pokemon lover so I guess that compensates for that.
Very rude, not understanding and stubborn
DO NOT TAKE
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: i loved her, she was very chill & understanding. she does give extensions on papers & grades things pretty late. exams were online in class & didn't take the whole class.

I don't get why so many people dislike Dr. Burns, she is an amazing professor. We had three essays and two exams (both exams were online, and we had no class that day). Make sure to take notes on what she says because they're helpful for the exams. I typed almost everything she said, took advantage of my notes, and got A's on both my exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Burns is a great person! She responds within a day to emails and is very caring if you are sick or cannot attend a class. 3 essays, 2 exams, tough grading for both but as long as you try you'll get a B- (all I got and put minimum effort).

She teaches higher levels of English, so if you're taking ENG100 beware. There're 3 essays and 2 exams that determine your grade and it's difficult to calculate, she doesn't use BB, she emails you your grades. Lectures are boring/unnecessary, attendance is taken but isn't clear if it matters. She's very picky abt grammar, she loves semi-colons...
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is very friendly and approachable. She does talk for long periods of her lecture and doesnt require much from students in regards to talking in class. Show up to classes and just completed the essays and you should pass. If you want an A, just reread over your papers and edit before you submit and there shouldnt be any reason you dont get one.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: In the modern era, grades or assignments are online. But this professor has another professor that turns in the graded work online at the end of the semester.
