Most of the material is submitted to her email. She often loses her student assignments as well grades exceptionally late. Often extend her class periods with discussions with nonsense.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The whole class is just watching old films like Hitchcock, Casablanca, etc. writing 3 papers analyzing these films, open to any topic generally. 2 tests where u define film-related terms and put them in context of the class work. As for Burns, she grades heavy on grammar. The class and the professor - not hard but not interesting at all.

9 hours of mandatory synchronous class a week? in the middle of a pandemic? The work itself isn't too hard but there's just so much of it, she constantly adds new assignments without warning and is unclear about due dates. Also be warned 391 is basically a film class, there's no reading but you'll need to research old movies a lot on your own.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great teacher definitely take the class
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is a very sweet professor. About 4 writings. Maybe 2 online "exams", very easy. Very chill classes. Readings, there are some. Most of the writings are okay, except for one. No final. 5-6 page papers.

Mrs Burns is nice and helpful, but her class is very uninteresting and monotone. She is very unclear about the assignments and their due dates, and it is hard to know what she expects from a paper. The worst are the readings assigned with those papers: very old, long, and uninteresting articles. This could have been an online class
Nice person who cares about her students, but lectures are long and very dry. Assigns a lot of homework.
Dr Burns was a great english professor she cares about her students and wants them to improve their writing

I liked her much more by the end of the semester than at the beginning. She is so helpful if only you ask for help and ask questions in class. She responds to emails very quickly and takes a big interest in your writing. Just make sure you turn things in on time and proof read at least once. She is very nice.
Easy class but VERY boring. Several papers and one in class assignment each week

Nicest woman ever! Seems extremely passionate about English but is extremely hard on grading. I'm currently in her English 100 class and it is very difficult to get a good grade on her paper assignments (All C's), but she is really nice overall.
Love her!

5 essays heavily graded on grammar, but most of the work in class are handouts focused on improving grammar.  Very writing intensive but she's always willing to give you help.  If you like to write, it will be easy.  If not, still an easy A if you proofread and don't procrastinate.
If you have a chance, take Margie's classes because she is really nice, and will go off on stories for hours.  You will not have to do that much work...

Will talk about everythng under the sun, and while most of what she says is somewhat related to the course material, don't expect her to help you with writing past teh grammatical level. Grades papers SOLELY on grammar. Gives far too many handouts. Tests are on definitions glossed over in class only. Too much Shakespeare for a class on writing.

I had to drop out of her class because she was literally failing me. You had to write 5 essays and she was big on grammer. If you had a lot of mistakes you got a c and lower. You got a good grade on your essays if she found it interesting; she didnt care about structure much. Also felt she was kinda bias. I would never take her again.

TAKE NOTES ON ANYTHING SHE LECTURES ON because they will be covered on her definition based midterm.  PROOFREAD YOUR ESSAYS! (5 for the course)  If you have a large amount of simple grammatical mistakes, don't expect a good grade.  She's a good teacher and brings out interesting points about various topics.  Don't expect an A with no effort.

Way to many papers to write, which were completely irrelevant to anything we were learning.  At one point we had 3 different assignments and papers to write at a time.  She grades basically upon grammar.  Mid-term and Final exam were based upon random words that needed to be defined from the articles.

Her class is iffy. I got straight B's on her papers. The papers are pretty easy but check your grammar or she'll hate you. The midterm and final are based on ONLY vocabulary. I failed both the midterm and final but my paper grades pushed up my final grade to a B. Weird. She IS boring and waking up for her class was hell.. but you can pass.

The papers for the most part are pretty easy, and except for a couple of them you can pretty much write on whatever subject you want. That midterm hit hard though, in a class with no text book or lecture schedule, a definition only test is really hard to study for. Now I just write down definition she gives out. Hopefully I'll do better on the fina

Although you can pass this class, it seems as if all the wrong parts of this class are emphasized. For instance, she pays more attention to grammar than the topic of a paper. Not a very appealing professor, and combined with an early lecture time, it gets very tedious. If you miss a class, the videos are available at the library.

I got an A in the class and thought she graded really easy... She teared up papers with basic, and I mean basic, grammar issues but so long as your paper was interesting to read she was nice.  I enjoyed her lectures she obviously knew a lot about the subjects covered. The book is totally boring.

I found this class to be boring, but I went so that I could be counted for in class and to get a heads-up on assignments.  You need to ask if there were any assignments given out if you were absent.  She isn't that bad of a teacher, but she's not very entertaining either.  The most entertainment I got were from some of the films we watched.

Holy crap, she is probably the worst teacher ever. Her grading is down right terrible. First paper we did, I was given an "F" because I had a few grammatical errors (SIX). Second paper I was given a B with MORE grammatical errors. She has a terrible grading style. Her lectures are probably the worst out of it all. SO BORING
No Comments

Probably the worst professor I've ever had.  Instead of actually grading papers, she edits your grammar and says nothing about the actual content.  If it weren't for her tangents, each class would be about 20 minutes long.  I learned nothing in what I thought would be an interesting course.  AVOID HER LIKE THE PLAGUE!!!

Rude to me, lost one of my essays. The exams were basically vocabulary tests. We spent most of the class talking about the novel we were reading and showing us nature videos (wtf). I wouldn't recommend her.

Take her during the summer. The papers are a week apart, but this means there's less on the midterm, and then NO FINAL. easy, easy A. she rambles and can be terribly boring but she's nice, and the class is very, very easy.

It was a composition class right?  Well I felt like I was in a Literature class when midterms and exams came around.  The papers were not difficult, but I thought she was a bit too picky considering she really didn't teach the class any composition.  A nice lady, but avoid her if you can.

WORST EXPERIENCE EVER.  I'm a junior, ive seen my share of bad profs, but this woman is monumentally awful.  Rambles about the library of congress all semester long, lousy unclear exams, AVOID HER AT ALL COSTS!  EVIL!
Boring class, and the papers are on the most boring topics.  Not hard though.

The papers we had to write were dumb, although she wasn't tough on grading them.  The midterm was very stupid-mostly on things completely irrevelant to writing. In fact, we hardly learned anything about composition.  Instead we learned a lot about literature.  Which defeats the purpose of the class.

6 essays, midterm, and final. essays are reasonable and she does not grade harsh. i got B's. the midterm i got an F - she didnt explain at all what was on the midterm/final (format sucks). she is actually really nice. sometimes classes are really easy. usually found myself sleeping in 9am classes.
She was unclear, unprecise and her assignments taught me only to despise Composition.  Assignments did nothing to teach the course.

whoa, i dont kno what theyre talkin about, but i got an A in the class and i didnt show up half the time.she takes attendance but it doesnt count for grade.final and midterm can be typed in class so its easy(since u can use the net). i got As/Bs on papers

I took a risky chance for having her as my english teacher. Because of her, I might have to take english over again in my sophomore year!!! She was such a horrible teacher with horrible paper assignments. i hate her teaching so much! DON'T SIGN UP FOR HER

Yeah.... she is a complete idiot.  The only redeeming fact about being an idiot is that she has a grading scale for the papers that doesn't make sense.  I got a better grade on an essay I know I did worse on.  Easy B for the class.

WORST teacher anyone could possibly have for freshman english...she goes off on tangents and gives the worst assignments...for one essay, we were supposed to relate something in a documentary on animals that we watched to computer technology! WTF?&#63

He taught us about Latin America and it's cultures since the beginning to present time. We did two presentations. 1st was a country of Latin America and brief information. 2nd on a Latin American country and a specific topic. We had two essays. We did voice threads about each week's topics. Lot's of readings. A final exam. He is amazing and caring.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Honestly the best professor I have had at UMBC. He is so caring about his students and really wants you to learn and to have the best experience possible. His lectures are really interesting and you learn a lot about the intricacies of the Spanish language as well as culture. There is a lot of hw but as long as you do the work you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Felix is a solid dude. He is easy going, pretty funny, and engaging. He gets side tracked pretty easily if you talk about Colombia. If you are thinking about taking 201 over the winter, do it. The class is easy if you put in the work. I do not recommend taking this class without doing 102 or 103, or without prior experience, you won't do well.

Prof. Burgos is the real deal!! Younger professor. Took him over winter and was expecting to struggle. He did a good job pacing the class and is very approachable and helpful. He made the class interesting and I left the class clearly understanding concepts that I struggled with earlier. Go to class, do the homework and assignments n youll be ok.

I had Professor Burgos over the winter session and I went into this course dreading Spanish.  Having not taken Spanish since 4-5 years, I was worried that I would not get back on track.  But the class was enjoyable and the material was easy to grasp if you read and do the HW.  If you take his course you will surely enjoy it.
He is a very nice guy and funny. Makes class enjoyable. However, he is disorganized and is not good at making sure everyone understands the material.

He is a funny guy and makes class enjoyable. However, he is not a great teacher. He is disorganized and does not adequately teach you what he expects you to know on quizzes, etc. He is a harsh grader as well.

He made the class more enjoyable to sit through, and he has a good sense of humor.  The class was pretty easy, and he explains everything clearly.  In my opinion, he should've collected homework because people complained about not understanding anything (they didn't do the homework...)

One of the best Spanish professors I've had. He understands what it's like being a student and doesn't overload the required work. He may seem unclear and difficult to understand. However, when he's teaching a comment if you're 100% honest with him and tell him you don't understand he'll slow it down and go over it until you do! Great professor!

I think he has good intentions, but overall he is not that great of a professor. I you want to actually learn something, look somewhere else. Not very good at explaining things and was not very helpful at office hours.

He is a sweet guy and always tries to keep the class fun an entertaining. Attendance is mandatory and oral participation for in-class activities is required but the exams are based mostly on those activities so they help you. Just remember to do your homework/online assignments and you shouldn?t get lower than a B. Recommended!

Very nice guy and a good teacher but if you're bad at Spanish I would stay away from his class. He wants to help you if you're struggling but does not know how and will fail you if he thinks you're not ready for 201.

Felix was an awesome professor. I learned so much in that class. He was very patient with students' questions and his exams were easy if you followed his study guides. Definitely take spanish with him if you can.
You have to go to class, but it's worth it great teacher lots of work with other students. One of the best teacher's I've had here.
Professor Burgos is a very fair teacher who is willing to help students. Prior to taking this class, I dreaded Spanish, but this man helped me a lot. I will always respect him for that.
Great teacher! Native Spanish Speaker makes the class go by very quick. He grades fair and makes class entertaining. I didn't like spanish before I took this class and now I love it.
Amazing teacher!! really cool and fun. class goes by way too fast with this guy. He's really chill because he's still a student himself. 100% helpful and clear.
DO NOT TAKE HIM. you won't learn anything much. Class activites are hard. Too much work. Exams are also hard. There are 10 quizes weekly, and they are fairly ok.
Nice guy. He wants his students to succeed. He's not a hard grader.
Great teacher. He keeps class entertaining. Exams are based on class activities. Take him!! Do all the work, then you'll be fine!
I enjoyed his class very much! He's very helpful and willing to help

Took him for winter session which I was NOT looking forward to-but he made it not so painful. I was disappointed to see the negative comments about him b/c he is very passionate about teaching & always willing to clarify. My experience w/ him was positive, he is fairly easy on the grading but really wants you to understand the material. Funny too.
Professor Burgos is a wonderful teacher, very committed and does his best to help the students. I made a lot of progress with him. Go Felix! you rock!
Stay away. He his not a good teacher at all.  He is boring and you will not learn anything about spanish.  You will be screwed for spanish 201.  Find another teacher.

He is not a good professor.  He rambles on and on about things that have nothing to do with anything to with the class.  His quizzes are pretty.  If you plan on continuing your spanish career do not take him for 102. You will be screwed.  His accent doesnt make things any easier to learn and his blackboard and online chats are useless.  Stay away.
chabite!
No Comments

She is a phenomenal teacher that just helped me fall in love with the field of psychology even more.  I didn't know what CP was before taking the class, and even now that it is over, I am actually going back to some of the readings. I keep applying CP to almost everything I see.  It is a lot of work but a really great class.

I would recommend taking a different class then hers. She seems to forget you have other classes and assigned like 150 pages or more to read a week. Assigned long papers. Group project were just awful with no support from her.

Ms. Buckingham is a fantastic teacher! She's pretty funny, definitely knows what she's talking about, and is super clear. Lectures follow the book but don't cover everything. You definitely need to read for this class to get an A.

i got an A, so it's not impossible!  yeah, you have to study hard, but i actually thought her lectures were interesting and review sessions were pretty helpful.  i also went to her office hours, which helped me.  id recommend you take this class, but i think too many people take it thinking it is an easy A - i worked for my A but learned a lot.

Lectures are pointless as she just regurgitates everything from the textbook. You better be there, only for the sparse clicker questions that add up. She does not prepare you for her exams, which are somehow difficult even if you've read the textbook. You probably won't get an A in this class. Just find someone else.
interesting class, nice professor, and fun group work. Just do the labs and study with peer mentors and you'll be fine.

I loved this class!  It was really interesting!  I actually decided to double major in psych (I'm also a bio major) because of it.  Professor Buckingham was really nice and upbeat.  She made lectures interesting and fun.  I hope to take other classes with her in the future.

Class was difficult but professor cared about students. Always willing to answer questions in lecture and wanted us to participate. I went to her office hours and emailed when I had questions and she was always helpful. Class was interesting. Yes, a lot information was in labs, book, and lecture, but that is what made me learn. You need to study.

The class wasn't difficult, it's just that there was alot of reading and online labs. Going to class was mandatory because there were clicker questions and group work during each lecture. This class definitely isn't an easy A, therefore, you should read over the textbook and review notes before every exam.
would rather play tetris
good

This professor wasn't difficult by any means. The main assignments in this class at 4 exams and quizzes. I would say to be on top of quizzes due to their grade importance. The professor was fine and she did try her best I'd like to say. If anything I believe more discussions would be beneficial instead of simple slide show lectures.

This course was not easy and you need to study to do well. However if you find the right study methods you will be able to earn an A. She also offers many extra credit assignments and test retakes so you are set up for success.
The class is really easy if you do all the work on time - Read the chapters and you will come to lectures prepared. Her lectures aren't that exciting but she is nice as a prof.

The course is okay, the professor/TA isn't that helpful. If you miss even 2 out of the 11 quizzes, your grade suffers tremendously- no exceptions or excuses. She has guided notes that you can teach yourself from. Should do great as long as you stay on top of the quizzes and spend as much time as you can studying

I found the professors teaching method ineffective, if I didn't already have a background in ABA I would've failed this class because the lectures are unhelpful and I don't have time to teach myself so much material in such little time. 
The exams are tricky, but luckily the tests are open note. 2-3 extra credit opportunities

Lectures don't really give you anything that reading the textbook doesn't and she posts the slides anyways. The class is really easy overall, but if you miss a quiz or two your grade is basically irrecoverable unless you do the small extra credit opportunities given which only help on the brink of a letter grade. very nice prof and lab opportunity

Had her for the Fall semester. Very boring lectures, literally could teach myself. You can have multiple attempts on the quizzes. She offers you guided notes if you ask. Overall easy class, but very boring to go to.
She isn't flexible at all with her deadlines, no matter what the reason may be. Droning lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She gives you the chance to get the easiest A because she takes the quiz questions out of the textbook and exam questions out of the lectures. She lectures by guided notes and emphasizes the exam being based on such. The only downside is either her or the TA, who make multiple mistakes on the answer key for some exams. Overall an easy class.

Dry lectures, not good at explaining things, is combative with questions, may or may not address questions from homework.  Lenient grader -- will give credit if you mix up signs or if you were close to the answer thru your work shown. Seems like a nice person but not a good teacher if you are not math-minded already. I got a tutor for all tests.

Took her for 152 and didn't pass, mostly because of the weird team structure and group quizzes were not a good set-up for Calc 2. Just took her for Calc 3 and it was a lot better without the teams. She would be better if she explained things a little more thoroughly instead of just writing definitions but she did show a lot of diagrams.
Made a tough topic more clear. Highly recommended.
She is nice and sweet, I would love to take a class with her again. Has an accent but she is understandable,  I do not think anyone would have trouble with that.

If you took BC Calculus in high school and never had to study, this class will probably be easy for you. She is not very clear in her lectures, especially in the first unit on vectors. She shows steps but doesn't explain them. I went to lectures, but I found the textbook more useful. It is not required for class. She is helpful only if you ask.

After reading these reviews, I reluctantly signed up for two classes with Dr. Budimirovic for this semester. Much to my surprise, I found both classes pleasant, with requirements and expectations clearly outlined. Although the lectures aren't incredibly inspiring (it's math after all), I have to say that I definitely enjoyed classes with her.

I appreciate her in that she tends to be a lenient grader. She also hand-grades homeworks and (most) assesments by herself, so I appreciate that. But overall she is a terrible lecturer. Going to class makes you develop a hate for Linear Algebra because she is just way too boring.
Hard to hear, but she teaches through examples (which are usually helpful). Reading the textbook is extremely useful for quizzes and tests.

I took Linear Algebra and Calc III with her.  Obviously, she was not the best at explaining certain concepts but if you read the book before class, it was easier to follow along.  Quizzes and exams are manageable, especially because she gives practice exams.  It also helps to come to class because occasionally you get some helpful tips from her.

This was by far the worst class I've ever taken. The professor does not speak to the class and the lectures, if you can call them that, are not relevant to the course material. She is helpful for office hours, but you are better off taking it with another professor or just waiting another semester if possible.
I took math 151,221, and 251 with tatjana. i think she is a good professor, but her exams are harder than other professors'. She gives extra points for every exam.

Lectures are useless, but you have to show up to get credit. Tests are difficult in relation the amount of instruction we are given. She is a very nice lady, but unfortunately just an awful teacher. Nearly impossible to understand.

Doesn't know how to teach. Tells her students to attend another professors lectures rather than helping. If you haven't taken calc 1 before you will struggle in her class. I would not take calc 2 when I was supposed to just because I would have this professor again. It's better to not take this class, than to take it with this professor.

She's a nice person, but you have to teach yourself a lot of the material. Definitely definitely read the book. Quizzes can be tricky but her exams are easy and she gives a lot of extra credit on them. It can be hard to understand her explanations because she doesn't teach well; also she speaks really softly so it can be hard to hear her.

good stuff first: on test review day we would get some helpful information out of her. she also knows her stuff. bad part: she speaks quietly and doesn't say much. i was unclear about what she was saying half the time. the book helped, linear algebra was new  and i struggled to understand it. help from the book my team mates and coming to class
The professor doesn't use a microphone. Skips around in steps. Everything about this class is ridiculously hard like we're expected to be math majors. Don't even bother with this person.

She's a perfectly nice person. However, her lectures are useless. She halfway solves problems on the board without lecturing, speaks in a soft voice and overall is no help. Most people don't attend class. Not a horrific experience, but I self-taught myself everything.

Worst professor I've ever had. She expects you to already 100% understand the material before class, and skips steps constantly with no explanation. If you have to take this course, avoid this professor at all cost.

kind person but a bad professor. She skips steps when solving a problem and her voice is low. After the 2nd week of classes 80% of people in the class stopped coming. TA's grade most of the tests and were lenient with grading. But you will be teaching yours CALC 2. Professor Leonard Youtube  I passed all my tests bc of him look him up.

Basically, everything that's already been said here. If I could give the money spent on this class to this youtube guy "Evans Lawrence" I would. His series of youtube lectures follow the stewart textbook we use and are the only reason did well in this class and learned anything. If you find yourself in this class, check him out.

Her speaking abilities are poor and she is difficult to understand at times. Apparently she is just a lecturer and doesn't hold the experience of an actual professor. I recommend asking you TA's for help and reading the book.
She is a good professor.

She's a nice enough person, but a terrible professor. Class is always spent with her sort of doing examples on the board with no one paying any attention. Class wasn't unreasonably hard, but plan on teaching yourself. She never explains material and is generally useless for anything other than answering questions.

She is very quiet in her lectures. It is very hard to understand because of her accent (which isn't her fault). I took Calculus BC, in high school, so the class was pretty straightforward. But if you are coming just from pre-calculus, you will most likely struggle a lot. Do the homework, it helps.

AVOID AT ALL COSTS. If you have taken Calc AB or BC in highschool, you might be fine. But if you've just taken Precalc or Calc with Apps in HS, withdraw ASAP or switch to a better professor like Nanes. Tatjana does not clearly explain what's gonna be on the test and skips around different problems in her lectures

Here's a warning to all students of this school: do not take this professor unless your school career depends on it.  Lectures are beyond useless; they will confuse you. She's impossible to hear and refuses to change her lecturing style.  Exams are very, very tough but doable.  If you take this class, YOU will be teaching YOURSELF calculus.

Can't hear anything!! Doesn't clarify what she's writing on the board!! Learn from your teaching assistants and/or fellow classmates!! Jeez I knew calc 2 was hard to teach but I didn't know it was this bad!!
She is very confusing. she can't even speak with clarity. DONT take her class

Her lectures are very difficult to understand, and she does not always lecture or assign homework covering what ends up on the exams.  For me, the TA and Khan Academy got me through this class.  I would say her only plus side is she does offer some extra credit on some quizzes and other random things.  Maybe six cumulative points by end of term.
Could use to be more clear as to whats on the exams.

I dont know if she tries or not, and I feel bad just bad mouthing her incase she is trying but she isnt a good professor. She uploads her notes online which is nice but I never understand anything during lecture, let alone hear her and i sit in the 3rd row. She solves problems without much explanation, as if we have math degrees already.

Super quiet and doesn't use a microphone, so sit in the first row if you want to hear. Accent makes it impossible to understand as well. Rushes through material and does not explain it, though sometimes gives a half assed explanation. I had to withdraw from the course. I had just taken precalc and got a B so it wasn't because I was rusty.
I think she is a pretty good teacher.

I am extremely dissatisfied with the quality of education this teacher was providing to her students.  For one, she was not clear.  By this I mean that she constantly provided wrong answers to her lecture examples and did not speak up.  I did not feel comfortable learning from a teacher that could not make the most basic efforts to teach correctly.

I love Dr. Cella. She means super well and always wants what is best for her students. If needed, she will extend deadlines if you communicate with her. She values effort and honesty and wants what is best for her students. She's the best!
Dr. Cella is friendly, flexible, and funny. She wants to see you succeed, and her musicianship classes are relaxed and semi-informal.

Dr. Cella is a huge asset to the music department. Although somewhat challenging, her classes are always enjoyable. She really wants her students to succeed and is willing to help them get there, but don't expect her to let you make excuses or just slide by. If you participate in class and ask for help when you need it, you'll do just fine.

One of the best teachers I've had. She always has more than one method to learn a specific skill and her teaching style really helps you learn how things are related. She will do anything in her power to make sure you succeed and learn the material.
Dr. Cella is one of the best teachers in the music department. Her enthusiasm, musicianship, and teaching methods are unparallelled. Come to class and try hard and you will get an A.

Dr. Cella actually wants her students to succeed and each day of class is enjoyable, if not outright fun. She's a teacher who will make you want to come to class and work hard to improve yourself. She's energetic, enthusiastic about her work and entertaining besides. Plus, you'll never find her without a cup of tea in her hands.

I love Dr. Cella. She's kind and funny. If you ever need help, don't hesitate to ask her.. she'll stay and help as long as you need her to. I had her for class at 9am... and it's probably the only class that early that I could wake up in time for. She made it worth it. Try your hardest, that's all that matters.

She's hilarious. I could care less about what we were learning in the class, but she made it enjoyable. She doesn't grade on how well of a singer you are, but how you're improving. She's a great professor, and as long as you do what you're asked of, you should be fine.
Funny, interesting, and always willing to adjust things to accomodate students' needs

This course required a lot of reading but once you get the hang of it, it's pretty easy. The professor is passionate so the lectures are easy to follow. There are multiple extra credit opportunities. I would highly recommend if you need this course or even for an elective.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. C is a nice person but gives true lectures (as opposed to discussion-style), which is not my favorite. Class material is super interesting but the way she teaches it can be a little boring. She is flexible with deadlines (within reason) and is understanding to personal circumstances that affect your ability to attend and participate in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. C is an amazing person! She is very understanding and knowledgeable. She remembers that we are more than just a student, that we have lives and responsibilities. If you take her class be ready to put in the work and know that you are respected by Dr. C and that she wants you to succeed!!!

She is the best professor honestly. She is so understanding and just wants you to be stress free as possible. the one note assignments are not hard at all and one is due each week. She literally put a week where we get to relax. The midterm and final is not hard either. TAKE HER FOR EASY CREDIT!!

Dr. Ceraso's brings a new and fresh approach to taking an English course that doesn't rely on heavy lecturing but instead leads a dialogue that involves the entire class. Some of the reading is dry, but there isn't much. The projects are a fun alternative to writing papers. I would certainly recommend taking her class. PS- she's stunning :p A+

I took Web Design and Multimedia Authoring with Dr. Ceraso. The class work wasn't easy, but it was pretty fun. You'll need to watch a lot of tutorials online to teach yourself how to use the different software programs.  Dr. Ceraso is very approachable and helpful. She clearly enjoys the course matter, and it makes the class more interesting.

Here's a teacher with a sharp wit and a brilliant mind. You won't leave the class without practical skills. Dr. Ceraso is the best of the UMBC English Department. She is passionate and cares about her craft which makes each class engaging.  Most of the class is discussion and very interactive.  Bonus, she doesn't believe in tests!

The coolest! It's like having a professor who's an actual human being. She cares about her subject and she care about her students. Plus, she knows what's up with digital rhetoric. People complain that she's hands-off but if you go to her, Dr. Ceraso is always, and I mean always down to listen and help. Super cool professor, 1010 would rate again.

Extremely hands off approach; group discussion and independent learning. In class you'll discuss the artsy, english-y aspects behind multimedia, but learning how to create it means being assigned a bunch of tutorial videos online. You won't get mad media skills, but you'll have the chance to create a variety of projects with an engaged professor.

Dr. Ceraso is, by far, one of the best professors in the department. She clearly cares deeply for her students and their success, not just in her classroom but, more importantly, after you leave her class. Many topics in the class are accompanied by a discussion of how students can apply the skills in a variety of career situations. She's a treat.

Awesome professor, probably one of the best in the english department. This class was challenging but still worth taking. We created our own websites, used photoshop, and made a video documentary all in one semester. Def taking one of her classes again.

Dr. Ceraso has a great hands-on approach to the material. She encourages students to give feedback on the lesson plan and is always willing to work with you (within reason). She is really good with attendance, don't skip class unnecessarily. A lot of the class is discussion.

Very nice and understanding. Don't expect to get an extension unless you have a good reason. Projects aren't hard, but her DIY approach means you learn a lot. She tries to get you to learn practical skills in addition to theoryideas.  Take it seriously, don't miss things, try hard for your own education, and you'll do well.

Dr. Ceraso is a great professor that is enthusiastic about her field. She's very good with email and responds back quickly which is extremely helpful. If you would like a challenge with editing and web design, then definitely take this course. Learned so much!

Dr. Ceraso is fantastic! She is extremely passionate and knowledgeable about her subject. Our lectures were really interesting and had basically every format possible. Lots of participation and small group exercisesdiscussions. Definitely my favorite class. We had quite a few readings, but projects for midtermfinal and no tests.

Dr. Ceraso is awesome. She's very enthusiastic about her stuff and she knows what she's doing. Her lectures were pretty engaging and she expects you to participate and do the reading assignments. Her assignments were SSRs and 2 projects. Overall she is a very fun professor, I would definitely take another class with her.

SHE IS Fun, smart, inspirational, hip, great teacher, current in everything, and very helpful. There are SSR assignments that can be quite difficult, but she helps you through them. She gives some awesome assignments that are really fun to do. TAKE HER CLASS!!

Deanna is SUCH an awesome professor! She is very lenient when it comes to late assignments (as long as they aren't TOO late) and is super helpful outside of class when extra help is needed. I thought I'd get a C in this course but ended up with a B with the help of her extra credit! Will definitely take her for 201, she was super cool.

Deanna keeps class interesting and is super nice! She was always willing to help students, and was almost always willing to accept late work. I really enjoyed Spanish and looked forward to coming to class every week. Definitely take with her if possible

Deanna es muy caliente! And she understands the material that she teaches to boot. The closest I've come to a perfect mixture of beauty and brains. She makes class as fun and stress free as possible. I will continue learning this language because of her. The level of interest she shows to know each student by name is AMAZING. My top recommendation!
She's an awesome teacher.  She makes the assignments as fun as they could possibly be.  Definitely would take her for all Spanish sections.
This class was a blast. She's very approachable, fair, and good at explaining the material. Reasonable amount of work assigned, and a lot of humorous moments in class.
One of the best professors I've ever had. Simple as that. She's Italian but understands and teaches Spanish better than a native could.

Absolutely loved her! She is a grad student but an awesome Spanish teacher. You can tell she loves the subject she is teaching. My class is bummed that she isn't teaching 201. She doesn't assign much homework, and the assignments she assigns are easy. Quizzes are easy if you pay attention and attend class.

not only is professor cheah hilarious, but charismatic and super intelligent. she is amazing and i'm looking forward to having more classes with her in the future and maybe even participating in her lab because she's just that great!
Nice professor, very passionate about the topic, and encourages participation.
Dr. Cheah is very knowledgeable and passionate about the topic and makes it interesting with lots of examples.

Professor Cheah is great; she is extremely lecture-based, and you can tell she is passionate about her work. Her lectures can be a little boring, but they are important to attend. There are 3 quizzes (done in class), discussion posts for homework, and a final project. She is a very late grader, and that is the only annoying thing.

Professor Cheah is very nice and understanding. She does take attendance, but is willing to work with you if you let her know that you're unable to make it to class. Tests are online but done in class, and otherwise she is very anti-technology in the classroom. Very clear lectures and assignments. Make sure to study and you'll do great!

I loved this class! I wish it was in person so that I could interact with Dr. Cheah more. She had a lot of experience in the topic area, and her lectures were really interesting. She was also accommodating and took care to respond to questions. Most lectures were asynchronous, with set live classes with discussions. Great class and prof.

I liked the layout of the class as it was flexible. Nearly all lectures were async but they were boring as she was monotoned and read off the slides. Live lectures were group discussions. Exams were long but not hard at all as long as you do study guide. 1 single final essay, but it was frustrating to do. wouldn't take her again.

3 assignments that were either based on an article or a video but they were easy. A couple live classes where she goes over the assignments. Lecture videos had questions in them that had to be answered. Posted study guides that reflected the exams. Had a final paper based on a video which was easy. Discussion board were extra credit. Really nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: very nice person and you can tell she cares about the subject

Very clear grading criteria, assigned reading 100% helpful and relevant to course topic. The people who say she jumps around a lot were not paying attention. She teaches cultural psychology and developmental psychology and no concept in those fields are independent of each other. It is so interconnected that she HAS to jump around to fully explain

I don't understand the previous comments considering there were many people in my class who were disrespectful to her. She is a nice teacher who offers some of the most extra credit opportunities I've ever seen in a 300 level course. She offers clear criteria on what to expect. You can get an A if you just try. It was not a difficult class.

Cheah was passionate about the material, but since lectures were difficult to focus on I got less out of the class than I expected. Many concepts and studies are over explained, leading to students tuning lectures out. Your grade is det. by 3 exams, few assignments + a final paper but there's lots of EC. I never touched the textbook and did fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Cheah is a decent she is nice, but her lectures are heavy. She puts way to much on her slides and flies though it quickly. She jumps from topic to topic it seems as she isn't prepared. She does offer a variety of extra credits. BUT her study guides are not helpful and it's given 5-7 days before the exam. She takes forever to return grades.
Class is boring, but you can get an "A" if you need one. She give way many extra credits and you can earn all of them if possible.

What an amazing professor! Her lectures were so awesome. She is a really talented lecturer who keeps you interested. This was her parenting class. She is very knowledgeable about the field but encourages students to offer their perspectives. Although you have to work for an A, she offers a good amount of extra credit. Highly recommend!

I don't understand the last two comments AT ALL!  I LOVE this professor and the topics that we covered in class. I enjoyed going to every class and thought that her lectures were interesting.  She also encourages participation in class, which makes it interesting.

Horrible. First off, her TA was only proficient at English which has a strong  impact on this course when SHE is grading your final paper. Second, this class is a complete waste of time and expect to learn nothing. The teacher is nice but extremely dull and leaves you wanting to lick a homeless mans feet rather than listen to her lecture anymore.

I took this class because I heard great things about Dr. Cheah.  I was not disappointed.  The class was really interesting, and Dr. Cheah is very dynamic, caring, and knowledgeable.  You need to work for this class, but you will definitely learn something that you will actually remember even after the class ends!

Great professor! Really helpful and nice. Tests are easy if you study the study guide. One 8 page paper and some take home assignments. Gives LOADS of extra credit. Extra credit totals to 15% of grade. Very interesting material and reading the book is not mandatory.
Very interesting material and knowledgeable prof. If you attend class, study using the exam guide, you'll learn a lot and do well.

I took this class last semester and really enjoyed it. The material is very interesting, and the prof. really knows her stuff and encourages great discussion. If you study you will do well AND you will learn a lot. I would definitely recommend this course and prof.

She was a pretty easy going professor. First exam is hard but after the first one exams are pretty easy. Give small extra credit through out the semester. have one small group discussion  based on assigned article. lecture using powerpoint. One 15 page paper. Easy to talk to about grades and assignment.
This was the parenting class.  The prof is very easy going and ready to explain everything.  Greatest prof ever!
Very interesting class and really nice teacher.  Very helpful and cool.
This prof is great.  She is really nice and helpful.  Her courses are very interesting (I've taken two).
This professor follows what others say. Does not have any opinion of her own and is extremely biased. People think she is nice but she is very fake and will be rude if she feels like it. BE WARY!
SO friendly/nice/approachable. Exams are very easy and shes an easy grader for the paper. Take her!
Fantastic teacher.  Love her!  Take her course.
My favorite class and the teacher is great.
Awesome prof and class!

Good personality.  You need to read the text and read the lecture notes to do well on her exams.  She'll usually available to help you if you need it and was generous with giving some extra credit.  Note though:  you're gonna have to write a 10 page paper for this class!

Awesome professor, nice, clear and helpful. Her exams can be a bit hard, so in addition to studying the notes she puts on BB, reading the book is important if you want to do well. There are inclass assignments, and sometimes she give extra credit questions during class.
liked the course and teacher very much
REALLY INTERESTING COURSE.  EXCELLENT TEACHER, COOL MATERIAL.
Very interesting course - have to study and attend lectures, but the material is interesting. She gives good hints, and is very helpful and nice.
Great prof - don't know where the weird comments are coming from as everyone i know in the course loved it and the prof.
Great prof - definitely one of my favorites.  She's kind, helpful, and really cares about her students.  Very interesting class.  Highly recommended.
i agree. she seems nice but she is biased, artificial, moody and weird.

I have no idea why anyone would call her a biased hypocrite. She is extremely nice and a good teacher.  Unfortunately, some of the class content overlaps a great deal with psych 100 so you may be especially bored at times if you are a psych major (or very good in psych).  Some interesting material though, but you do need to study.
biased hypocrite
sweet but careless teacher
No Comments

Friendly and funny professor.  She seems very interested in the material and encourages lots of class discussion.  Exams were multiple choice and pretty tricky; make sure you study the text extensively and take good notes, especially on case studies and experiments.  Highly recommended!
My friend took this in the Fall and recommended it to me so i took it in the spring of 2005. i really liked the course, and the prof is very nice and interesting.

I didn't think her test were that hard (you do have to study) and the class average was a B-, so it couldn't have been that hard. She's very helpful and funny. Gets the class to particpate. Highly recommended.

She's a really great teacher. She really cares about her students and is fun. Her tests are tough, but you just need to go to class and take good notes.  She gives you tips during the lectures. One of my favorite profs!
Tests are hard, you have to know the studies like the back of your hand, but she's nice and tries to make class interesting.
She is a good teacher. She's young and she tries to make class fun and interesting. You have to take good notes in the lecture, because a lot of the material on the test isn't covered in the book.

Sweet teacher, not a difficult subject HOWEVER she makes the exams EXTREMELY difficult.  On a multiple choice test she will make choices a. and b. be practically the same thing and choices c. and d. practically the same as each other as well. Very hard.

Amazing professor. His lectures are wonderful and well paced, making it a great learning experience. Exams can be tough, but extremely fair. He is very helpful in discussions and office hours and seems to truly care whether you grasp the material.
Great professor, great at explaining concepts very personable and approachable.

He's a very good professor, cares about feedback and actually listens. Is very clear with what to expect on exams doesn't throw any curve balls. Made this really hard class so much more tolerable, but still it's a hard course so you need to study a lot I won't lie to you. But he makes it better!

Very organized and punctual, clear information was given well in advance well before due dates and exams. Material was not very difficult and exams were quite easy. Plenty of opportunities for office hours with prof. or TA's.
Dr. Hennigan was a very nice professor and I would recommend anyone take his classes. For ENES101 specifically he was very helpful and would answer anyone's questions. Very nice man!

Chang's teaching style is very fast and technical, and his notes are worthless. He's condescending when you come to OH with a question about the difficult homework. I'm not sure what happened after 2020, but the reviews from then DO NOT reflect his current behavior. The course itself is hard, but he makes it harder than it needs to be.

Awesome professor. The course content is extremely valuable if you want to go more in depth with CS, specially if you're interested in compilers. Course is only as difficult as your schedule, make sure to read the textbook and learn Haskell. The exams are reasonable and the homeworks can be challenging. Do the practice questions in the textbook :^)

definitely very exam heavy but prepares you well and provides practice exams. lectures are helpful and hes generally a very lenient chill professor. he gave us extra credit and is lenient with the grade cutoff, which helped me get an a. he also grades very fairly.

Kind and funny professor, but has very high expectations. Homeworks are difficult, so going to office hours is a must. Most of your grade is 6 quizzes and the final exam, which are similar to the homework. Overall a hard class, but doable if you put in the time.

CMSC 331 is an objectively tough course.  Regardless, he cares about the class and teaches well (although a bit boring sometimes).  We use Haskell as our programming language, and some of the homeworks are a bit difficult.  The slides will be your best friend for exams.  Utilize office hours and any external help if possible.

Out of the many professors I've had, I found his lectures to be particularly difficult to follow. His approach is very theoretical, which can make the material harder to understand. Be prepared for a challenging experience if you take his class. PS: HE IS A VERY HARSH GRADER!

One of the funniest lecturers but the thing dragging down this class was having to write in Haskell. Functional programming is just not for me and I'd be surprised if it was for you. Otherwise course material is super informative and helps you understand computer science as a whole much better.

Attendance is mandatory 331.Would not recommend taking him b/c his explanations were not thorough and the lec. overall are very boring.Did not understood anything in his lectures and had to chat gpt all lectures to understand. His tone during lecs makes you sleepy.Class overall was easy like the HWs but overall wouldn't recommend taking the prof.
He's a nice guy and the class is an easy A, but you don't really get to learn much in the class. It's such a broad topic that everything is lightly touched upon.

Professor Chang is a great professor who knows how to teach and is not just well-versed in the topic. The class is difficult and becomes trippy with turning machines and onwards, but as long as you keep up with homework you won't fail. Super quiz/test heavy.

Class was challenging, but not difficult. Chang is a great professor all around and teaches well. Records all lectures and notes so review is easy. Provides past quizzes and exams, and content on the exams is explicitly stated. Class weighted heavily towards exams.

Chang is a great professor, 331 is just a boring class. He's a naturally charismatic guy who seriously knows his stuff. He decides to teach his classes Haskell, which is initially weird but is pretty cool once you understand it. Slide material is tested heavily on exams, and is a *relatively* lenient grader. Easy quizzes and sometimes tough HWs
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Automata specifically with him is very hard. There is another professor who teaches it and their material only goes up to our third topic. Don't be fooled taking this class, when you get to Turing Machines, everything after that just spikes in difficulty with no warning. It goes from minimal effort to active studying required. He's a nice guy tho

Chang is a great guy. Easy to talk to, funny, and super knowledgeable. However, the course material for this class is boring and confusing, and i felt that Prof Chang didnt really do much to ameliorate that.
Since hes so knowledgeable, i feel that he didnt break down topics very well for students to understand
Also haskell SUCKS

Quizzes and exams are all in person, with one homework every week.
I could cram for a quiz the day before cause they were just Haskell coding problems and do good on them.
Exams were a lil more tricky and needed preparation. He knows his stuff, and homework could be a little difficult sometimes, but it all relates back to the topics.

Most people that gave him a one rting are just coping. He's a very caring professor. 
The material is obscure and can be tricky at times, but prof Chang knows his stuff inside and out, he's highly qualified, and the hard material is made up of insanely lenient grading-Gives partial credit back almost everywhere, which makes the class not bad at all
Hardest computer science class I have ever taken...
the quizzes are so hard, he says they're like the homework but they aren't. I studied for a week straight and still failed
just dont.. class is too hard. wish he takes students advice and makes exams/ quizzes online rather than on paper
dropped this class. It is SO hard, he teaches haskell which is not necessary. took one quiz and had to drop the class cause I knew I was going to fail eventually. take it with anyone else

was not a fan of him. nice person, yes. but as a professor this class is very difficult, harder than 341. take it with any other professor. homework is difficult, we have on paper quizzes which make no sense.
TERRIBLE WORST PROF AT UMBC, MAKES THIS CLASS WAY HARDER THAN IT SHOULD BE. AVOID AT ALL COST TAKE IT WITH ANY OTHER PROFESSOR

This was one of the toughest classes. Most of the students will ask why you have to take it and why it needs to be tough but it's the most crucial class in Computer Science. The class had 12 homework and 6 tests with retakes. Professor checks the test himself and for him its mostly about logic. If your answer makes sense and is good, then its good.
Wonderful professor

70% of the grade came from 4 quizzes, midterm, and the final. The other 30 was HW. Not being a great test taker, I really struggled in this class. The quizzes were hand written code in haskell language.

Prof Chang wants students to learn, he's easy to talk to and accessible. The only issue is that he chose to teach Haskell which isn't practical but it useful for learning recursion. The overall course material is dull and boring. He knows a lot of students are in 341 at the same time and he tries to keep 331 lighter due to overall load.

There are two textbooks you have to read, weekly homework, lectures that are monotone and boring, and in person coding quizzes. He is the only professor that teaches Haskell and he does not do it well. Even if you rewatch the lectures, reread the boring textbooks, and look online you will still struggle on the hw. And the grading is so harsh. AVOID
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Chang really cares about the students! Yes there are a lot of hw assignments and exercises due but they really do help with the quizzes. There are no tests just 6 quizzes. And he does retakes! He definitely knows what he is doing! And hes amazing.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor to take CMSC 441 with. I learned a lot in his class. Homework were super helpful to learn, although there were difficult.

Even though we took it remotely, it was still a very challenging class and you have to put in a lot of work. We had an assignment almost every day and several quizzes (retakes are available but still challenging...). The overall class really helped me grow in my algorithm skills.

Chang was awesome for 441. VERY friendly grading policy for students including quiz retakes. The class was a lot of work with 3 assignments due every week but it really did instill the material in you, and they weren't particularly hard. Quizzes weren't too bad at all, and no midterm or final. Chang put an emphasis on teaching rather than grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I would take a course under him only if I have no other courses. I have been a victim of his peer grading format where you are indirectly forced to adopt exactly the same method as he teaches or else the peers will grade you bad. His teaching is relatively better than his tests and grading techniques.

Dr. Chang made this class very organized. You end up learning a lot from the homework. His office hours are definitely very helpful. He is very fair and caring, but it isn't an easy pass class; you need to study for it. Quizzes are fair. Understanding homework is the main objective that will get you the feasible grade.

One of the best professors at UMBC, he expects you to work for your grade but is super considerate and approachable. A really good lecturer and the HWs are extremely helpful for his quizzes. I feel like I came out of the class learning something and not hating algorithms.

This is the hardest class I've taken at UMBC thus far. The content went over my head at times and I sunk myself in the homeworks every week. BUT if you pay attention in class and work to understand the homeworks, then the quizzes are alright. HW is the biggest part. Understand the HW then you should be fine on the quizzes and exam.

Chang is easily one of the best professors I have ever had taking an Algorithms class. He is funny and tells the class a lot of jokes related to his lecture topics. Homeworks may be difficult, but he knows how to explain any misconceptions students have. Quiz problems he gives are similar to the homework problems. Accessible outside class also.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Chang is great. Hes been teaching for a long time, so hes great at explaining things multiple ways if you dont understand. Really familiar with algorithms and really knows what hes talking about. Also a really funny guy. Textbook is only used for a couple of hw problems

Chang is one of the best option for 341 class. He spend decent amount of time make sure everyone understand about the project/hw/lecture. This is not fairly easy class but also not difficult as long as you work through it.

341 with Chang is great. Goes over the project description for 1 class, then responds to the inevitable questions that arise as students work on the project. Had the best project write-ups. Fair exams.
Fair grader.  Only 10 days allowed for each project, which was tight.

He's a really smart guy and knows what he's talking about, so I think he just assumes we understand the material 100% when he explains it. His tests are really hard. There was no fill in the blank code on exams, the second part of the exam is just writing code. He puts up sample exams which are really similar to his actual exams, so study those.

If ur used to programming, A is attainable with some effort. The 5 hmwrk assignments (writing large programs) are the time consuming part of the course. Lectures sometimes entertaining, usually boring. If do labs & homework, studying for exams should be simple. Just review lecture notes posted online. Nice, accommodating, flexible, cares abt stdnts

His lectures are boring. Tests , projects  and even some labs are tough. Its hard to get an A. Good at clearing doubts, and replying emails. Reading textbook will help understanding  it better.  202 is rough so be prepared well in advance. DO NOT just depend on instructor

202 is a hard class, and he doesn't do much to ease you into coding in C++, but he explains the important stuff pretty clearly. The projects are tough, but he answers questions in class if you have any. Exams are pretty typical, but it's hard to study for them. He's great about returning emails and is generally very helpful.

Explains things well, class is interesting and was a major part of what I learned. For Algorithms, he doesn't do midterms, just a handful of quizzes throughout the semester and a final at the end (which was pretty much 4 quizzes stapled together.)

Best CS professor I've had to date. For programming assignments, his write ups were incredibly well written. Though sometimes difficult, projects and homeworks are super valuable. Oh, and he's hilarious. If you want an easy A, avoid him. (Else) If you want to struggle, and learn a ton along the way, Chang's the real deal.

CMSC 313 with Dr. Chang has been my favorite course at UMBC so far. I may be alone in this, but I LOVE assembly language programming. Dr. Chang is a great professor and is extremely knowledgeable. The course is quite easy if you start the projects early in the week.

Great Professor.  Very clear.  Has an assignment due every week, but with a forgiving late policy.  Only complaint is that it sometimes took a while to get grades back.  Would highly recommend taking him.
Chang is my favorite professor so far. He is extremely smart and is a true nerd. He is very approachable and has an interest in what he is teaching.

Great professor; made the lectures fun and understandable. Gave a 3 for easiness only because he had a program due every week; hard programs. Not a good class to take if you're taking a full-time schedule of courses and working at the same time. Hard to keep up if you miss classes, so even though attendance isn't mandatory, going is a good idea.

I really enjoyed this class. The programs we had to write were interesting and a nice challenge. He allows you to finish classwork outside of class if you have to. If you actually pay attention in the beginning of class instead of catching up on work, you'll probably do fine.
Didn't use textbook. Was helpful somewhat but sometimes you were totally on your own but did have help from ta. Some quizzes were easy others were harder and final exam was ok.

This was my least favorite class of the semester. MAybe Im just not a computer science fan. I cant believe this is an introductory course. We had short quizzes he was lenient with grading but over all I still didnt like the class

Junior in college and this is easily one of the worst professors I have ever had. Might be good at teaching upper level classes but not lower. Gives wayyy to much work and its harder than it should be on top of that trying to figure out my grade is impossible. Its like trying to debug a program in itself it makes no sense. keep it real truth hurts.
terrible at an entry level class. way to much work. very bad at introducing the subject.
Hands down the best teacher I've had at UMBC.  Always in a good mood, and actually cares about his students.

Chang is by far the best professor I've ever had. He's incredibly intelligent but also knows how to dumb things down for the rest of us. Very straightforward in what he expects, and tests and quizzes look exactly like what goes on in class and on the homework. If you can take 203 with him, do it. He's far better than anyone else who teaches it

This is a difficult class just because of the introduction of new mathematical concepts but I think that Dr. Chang does a really good job of explaining them. Lectures were very helpful. He's a pretty funny guy too, in a nerdy way.

He is an extremely nice guy.  A very fair grader.  His quizes are more like brain teasers than typical plug and chug questions of other teachers, but he gives plenty of partial credit.  Basically, if you put in a reasonable amount of effort you should not fail his class.

Nice guy, but his lectures can be a bit unclear sometimes. The weekly hw was definitely the hardest part of the class (ask for help). I found the quizzes and tests easy by comparison, especially since he curved one of the quizzes and gave us a formula sheet for the final.

Great professor. Somewhat hard class. Weekly hws are str8 out of book but can be difficult, so use him as a resource. EXTREMELY knowledgeable but very friendly + helpful. Exams follow hw + lectures. Class complained about graders but I found them very fair. Material can be overwhelming, so ASK if u dont understand. Watch out for proof by induction.

Very nice guy. Easy to talk to and very understanding about any issues you might have. His lectures were a bit unclear and so was the book. I found myself researching topics online to finish the weekly homework assignments. Problem solving ability isn't really learned. You have it or you don't. That might be a very important statement in deciding t
Great knowledge of the subject, very fair grader
Very helpful especially during office hours. Tries to know everyones name. You can kind of get lost during lectures so you shpuld read ahead.

Very interesting class, probably thanks to him.  Unlike early Calc and CMSC, there's a lot of problem solving in this class.  You'll definitely feel lost in the beginning but it should eventually make sense.  Sometimes his lectures are difficult to comprehend but his quizzes are fair.  Very good professor.  Definitely get him for a class.
Good teacher. Read ahead though- otherwise some of the material may be difficult to pickup during the lectures.
No Comments

Accepts handwaving arguments instead of rigorous mathematical proofs, yet manages to teach very clearly and well.  Also very entertaining and animated.  This was the best teacher and best class I had during college, hands down.  Highly recommended.
Moderate class, but good professor.  Knew the material very well, and was quite helpful.  He is a fairly difficult grader on homework and tests.

One of the best professor I met so far. He knows very well what it takes to teach this class. He doesn't use a projector something very evil in an algorithms class, instead he works out everything on the board. His pace is good but sometimes he went fast near end of semester. Strongly recommend.

Great professor! Very organized and fair. No surprises on material.  some projects are tough but he gives ample time and proper amount of background to complete them.  Hw and tests are straightforward.  If you want to learn this is the guy to take.
Very helpful. Knew the material very well.
wouldn't recommend.

Instructions are really confusing, she is unclear on why you receive certain grades, and if you miss class you might be screwed. If you put the work in you'll do alright but it is so easy to get lost and just be confused all the time.

reviews.comment: This professor is so sweet and caring and if you need help, just reach out because she will make sure you get the help you need.

She is all over the place! Never has clear directions on Exams and when teaching she jumps from topic to topic. If you have a chance to take this course at a community college or another professor at UMBC do it because she doesn't want you to move on to 201!
Easy online course, attendance was mandatory, home works were sometimes long and annoying but pretty easy. Exams were also easy (no respondas lockdown browser :P).

Lectures were not very engaging or focused. Lots of issues with online platform, not necessarily her fault but it was distracting. Very homework heavy with multiple homeworks a week that take a bit of time.

I don't know why she gets such bad ratings, despite attendance being mandatory, it's very easy to make it to an online class and participate a bit in chat. In addition, 10% of the grade was to simply attend an entrepreneurship event which is a free 10%. Exams are all online and open note, very easy class. However some hws are super long/annoying.

reviews.comment: This isn't a good teacher to take if you want to learn more about accounting. She only reads off of textbooks and the exams are a headache to do because everything you know is self-taught. I wouldn't take her again
Terrible professor. Going to lectures was pointless, even she says so. The entire course is better to learn from youtube or chatgpt.

Talks about nothing for most of the class reads straight from the textbook/slides, so you'll learn nothing. The homework assignments only have 2 attempts per question, and the tests are very long with many questions having numerous parts. Very slow to reply to emails. Accounting is already hard as is, and she makes it even worse. Don't bother.

reviews.comment: Prof. Ward was my favorite professor at UMBC and is the reason I am pursuing accounting. There's no lockdown browser for exams. Just be make sure to actually read the textbook and you will understand the concepts. The exams are almost identical to the homework. Attendance and participation is graded but overall it was an amazing class.

reviews.comment: I thought I would never write one here, but this lady is so putrid at her job that I just have to. I really do not understand how she still has a job. don't take her for econ unless u know econ and the hw only has 3 attempts per question other teachers do unlimited btw
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She says not to listen to the ratings others give her, but I realized that what others say is accurate. Her class seems complicated, and she doesn't respond to emails promptly. The homework is very time-consuming, which wouldn't be an issue if she gave you unlimited attempts for questions (she doesn't). If you have the option, just avoid it!

The professor said to ignore her rating but I can understand why her rating is so low. She is a nice person and her lectures were good but when I didn't understand the material she wasn't of much help.

One of my absolute favorite professors. She is an extremely good teacher and nice person, and keeps the course organized and easy-to-follow. Personally, she influenced me to want to pursue accounting as a career.

just don't take the class it's mad work and babyyyy the quizzez no thank you

reviews.comment: Prof. Ward isn't a bad person. Her lectures are a little boring, and the weekly HW was a little difficult unless you really understand the material. The exams were similar to the HW. reviews.comment: Very average professor. She basically only goes over the chapter objectives and few examples during lecture, but mostly expects you to learn the material on your own. The homework and tests are all on Pearson, but they were very difficult and very lengthy. Shes also particular about participation. So overall, I would skip taking it with her.

This instructor is one of the worst I've ever had. You're better off reading the book than paying attention in lecture. Exams have multiple choice questions graded the same as 15 min questions and you do not have anywhere near enough time to finish. Roughly half the class didn't get anywhere near the end of the exam, even after two attempts. AVOID!

Literally a joke. Lectures in Microsoft paint. Assigns chapter quizzes, before the chapter hw, grades neither of them . Pearson website is terrible with inconsistent formatting and misleading instructions. Gives you 2-3 days between different chapters to read 40-50+ pages. Literally impossible. Horrible prof never take this professor.

This is the worst professor I have ever had in the 6 semester and 2 different Universities I have attended. Her exam questions are all worth the same point value, regardless if its a Multiple choice or a 15 part question. She did not enable going back to previous questions for online exams, and the way she teaches is absolutely basic and barebones.
Wasnt clear that if you miss a class you will lose 10 percentage points.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: There are 2 main problems in her class. 1. Her online exams are horrible. There were 3 exams not including the final and the shortest one was 2 hours and 3 mins the other 2 were 3 hours and so was the final 2. She never grades, nor does she tell you that the grade you have in Pearson is your actual grade.
Replies to emails very late most of the time and is not clear with the grading.

don't take her if you don't already have decent knowledge and strength in accounting. She is a decent grader but her online lectures wouldn't do enough for people who genuinely don't understand the concepts. She builds a little bit of a relationship with her students but thats about it. she responds to emails quite bluntly and isnt very helpful.

reviews.comment: Pretty good. The class sucks because of my accounting lab but that's not her fault. She likes to converse with the class. She makes class feel less uptight.
