Sure, a decent teacher but overrated in my opinion-- it may have something to do with the fact that all the girls in the lecture thought he was cute. Developmental is one of those subjects that you end up teaching yourself (at least in my experience) and Eisenmann was an average prof.
Best biology teacher there imo.  Great lectures, fair tests, very clear.  Notes available online before each lecture, complete with pictures.  Very organized and very intellegent.
Eisenmann is HOT! and his exam questions are easier than Bieberich's
No Comments
Super clear lectures and is willing to engage with students during them! The homework and clickers can be difficult but the tests are pretty clearly based on lecture material.

Eisenmann is definitely an expert in his field. He is very knowledgeable in his lectures so definitely pay attention. Genetics is not an easy class but he tries his best to help you. The clickers are the KEY to his exams. Very understanding and empathetic with his students.

One of the best professors in UMBC! Knows the subject very well, answers questions clearly, helpful and welcoming during office hours. Exams are fair nothing tricky. CPS questions and the questions from the back of the book Dr. Eisenmann suggests at the beginning of each lecture very helpful for exams! Go to class, understand cps questions study!
Excellent Professor! Really known his stuff and wants everyone to do well. Goes a little fast buts posts lectures on Itunes. Would definitely take him again

Great professor. Excellent, detailed slides, relevant cps questions (very similar to exam questions). Very good speaker and answers questions precisely (not like certain other professors also teaching 302 who never answer the darn question).
No Comments
He goes over stuff really fast in class. So be sure to go to class, otherwise you will do bad. Don't buy the book...you don't use it very often.
Nice teacher, brings insight from outside experiences to class, reviews tests and cares about his students.
Great Teacher. Best at UMBC. come to class pay attention and do your part and get an A.Very helpful teacher. One of a Kind
Very easily teacher. very easy class, always willing to change the class aroudn to accomdate to the student as long as they show up to class

Easy class. Good Professor! A day before the exam he will go over what will be on it. If you study from that you'll be fine. Learn a lot from this class. WOrk load: 4-5 exams (easy), 1 project, 1 oral presentation. Very good Professor.
Yeah I already knew some accounting coming in and he had no idea what he's talking about. Read the book and you'll be fine. Nice guy, just doesnt prepare at all for class lol.

Read the book, you'll need it for this class. People say this is easy class, if might if you actually do the work and read the text. It's not easy as it looks, as half of our class drop. Anyway, great professor.

The class is very easy. Just show up, listen to him go over the slides, and then leave.  Even though he moves at a very fast pace (a chapter a class), it's very basic and general.  If you have basic accounting knowledge, you'll be fine.  Ask for take-home tests and open-note tests, he'll more than likely will give it to you.

This is one of the most ridiculously easy classes I have ever had!  The teacher is a nice guy, but he doesn't teach anything.  I don't think he does any preparation work for the class at all (I don't think he has even read the book).  He makes up for this by giving open note exams, which, again, makes this class a total joke.

Dr. Lasson is kind and forthcoming but his lectures are very slow-paced.  Sometimes, he does not even finish the lecture and then does not post the slides either, which is stressful.  Make sure you read the books and go to office hours!  Very few "low stakes" assignments so mostly essay and exam heavy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Lasson is your typical boomer who believes all classes have to be in person, even when it's just a lecture. When he found out other professors were doing their courses hybrid or online, he forced them all to come back in person. It's not like we're doing labs in any of these classes; they're all just about HR. This man is stuck in the 1900s.

Dr. Lasson is an expert in his field and it is evident in his teaching. His exams are application based so they require you to have knowledge of the course and require lots of writing as they are not just multiple choice exams. To put it simply, if you want to learn the field: take Dr. Lasson - If you want an easy A: do not take Dr. Lasson.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I didn't dislike his class but I felt like we were beneath him a little. Like I was in a class with 80 students rather than 20. Other teachers I felt more respected as a professional with work experience and meaningful contributions rather than just naother student
Professor Khan is so kind and caring. She gives valuable feedback and the class is pretty easy as long as you do the work and participate! Love her, I wish I could have all my classes taught by her.

Professor Ellia is new, she has a lot of good traits, she was slowly settling in to a consistent teaching style.The textbook is informative. Attendance is mandatory no matter what she says! The group project was poorly organized. The lectures are informative, but don't go if you are not engaged because she will call you out. in-class notes only
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Ellia is great. I learned a lot; her work experience provided great examples and insight! The few shortcomings I noticed that became an issue for others: fluctuating lecture style, mandatory attendance; in-class activities that cannot be made up (big chunk of your grade), NO study guides for exams, no extensions (better luck in-person)

She is a kind person, but I don't feel she teaches the material effectively. She doesn't always take students' individual situations into account, and I found her approach to be unreasonable at times. The course material is difficult, and the class moves at a very fast pace, which made it hard for me to keep up.

Dr. Stanwyck is my favorite professor! She made calc fun and easy to grasp in every lecture. You have homework and quizzes every week and three exams, but the homework and practice problems are essential for studying! She is super loving, energetic, and a great communicator. You will succeed if you stay on top of everything and ask questions.
Prof Stanwyck was a great prof in STAT451. There were weekly homeworks which were long and hard, but quizzes and exams were super easy. She is great!

Very enthusiastic about the subject & cares about students. Takes her time to explain the material. things we don't get to in class she adds them in the quizzes and exams so you have to learn it yourself. 3 exams. quizzes every week. Provides study guide but no answer key. One downside about this class was how terrible and unhelpful my TA was.

She cares and wants students to learn the material well, but this class is HARD. MATH 155 goes fast! Homework and quizzes every week; Dr. Stanwyck doesn't give answer keys to practice quizzes and doesn't hold in-person office hours. If you're okay with that, then she's the best professor that teaches MATH 155, but her teaching style wasn't for me.

Overall just a terrible structured class by UMBC's math department. Goes way too fast and it is the first class I've ever had that hasn't had a single review day for any material before any quiz or exam. No reviews. No extra credit. Discussion is terrible as well. Overall a depressing experience.

Stanwyck remains the goat. She could teach paint drying and I'd be there. Phenomenal lecturer, good notes she uploads from her iPad to Box, thoroughly goes through homework during class, and is incredibly reachable for office hours through her Discord server. Cares about every student's learning experience, and makes lectures lively, 453 is hard.

Makes STATA easy. She cares about what she teaches so her pre-recorded and live lectures are great and helpful, she gives great feedback on homework which is very long but very doable. She has her own discord server for outside of class making it insanely easy to get help. Probably the best teacher in the STAT department.

Legit the GOAT of all math teachers. 451 and 453 are among the most boring and difficult classes in STEM and yet she made it so much easier and fun. Never met someone more passionate and kind to teaching students. The class was hella hard but I would have failed if I took it with anyone different.

I failed Applied Calc twice at a different school. Stanwyck's enthusiasm was a breath of fresh air. The textbook is confusing, but you can rely solely on your notes from class. Just attend every lecture, take good notes, and ask questions. The tests are hard. Quizzes are fairly easy. Do every problem on the review packet. Go to office hours.

Heard a lot of good things about Dr. Stanwyck, but her teaching method was not for me. I don't like the idea of her not giving out the answers to practice quizzes and sample exams to study, cause I'm not sure if I'm doing the material right. Also don't like the "classroom setting" office hours she gives, I prefer to meet with them one on one.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Retook this class after taking it with a horrible professor and Stanwyck made the class a 100 times easier. I did WAY better this time around and actually found myself going to lectures, when they weren't mandatory, because of the way shes able to teach. 100% would recommend and she is very nice to approach as well

Great professor, very accessible outside of class. Genuinely wants you to succeed and is a subject matter expert in math and statistics. Be prepared to study alot though. Her exams were INSANE but she explains everything thoroughly. Probably the best math professor at UMBC.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Definitely easier than MATH151! The class starts easy but requires a solid start to understand later chapters. Stanwyck is encouraging, she makes the subjects easy to understand. HW, classwork & a pretest balance your grade even if you suck at tests. Speaking of, the exams & quizzes were straightforward except for Exam 2 which was unusually hard...
Great professor. Very enthusiastic but no matter how low the class average is on exams, she WILL NOT CURVE. Would take her again, really understanding and always willing to help

I loved Stanwyck! She's my favorite professor I've had so far. She goes very slow and in-depth on the topics so that everyone can understand. The math itself was super easy but got harder closer to the end of the semester. Overall, I thought it was a great class and she made math more enjoyable. Seminars were annoying but easy points.

Dr. Stanwyck is an awesome professor! She really cares for how her students learns and is willing to stop lecture to help with questions. She has a great presence in lecture so it's never boring. However, there are quizzes every week but LAs literally go over what's on it right before it so it's not too bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: very nice, makes it easy to take notes by providing structured note sheets for you to fill out along with her in class. The class had a pattern of HW due Tuesday, short quiz on that hw on thursday. The quizzes are not difficult if you complete the hw, and the volume of them can help build a solid grade. Bonus points are often built into tests.

I'm not even a STAT major and this class was just amazing. Be prepared to do the work; Most of it is based on completion, but it really helps in the long run when it comes to the weekly quizzes and tests. Her lectures are amazing, and they're free participation points as well. If you're good at Calc III and need an out of major, look no further.

Prof. Stanwyck is an excellent professor for math and she really makes the subject easy to understand! Even though this was a hybrid class, she taught the subject well. She knows that the Statistics subject is not a easy one but she tries to make it simple. Class had 3 exams and 6 quizzes and lots of homework. You have to spend alot of time on it
This professor is awesome she shows how much she cares for the class and willing to help you succeed.

Liz is absolutely wonderful. This class is difficult and should really be 4 credits, but she still manages to teach well with the time given. She is very attentive to every student and cares about them all. Office hours are crowded, but helpful, and she sends you a copy of all the work done if you go. Homework not graded officially, but do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great math teacher, even if you're not that great at math. She builds in a lot of extra credit into your tests. If you show up to class and do all the work, you should be able to get at least a B.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is a very good professor, and it's actually fairly easy to get an A in the class. You don't even have to get A's on the exams.  There are so many quizzes, projects, etc. so make sure you do good on those and do ALL your aressignments. I feel like I gained great math skills from this course too.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Stanwyck is the best. Stat351 hybrid would be intolerable if it weren't for her. The textbook was bad, but Stanwyck makes up for it and really knows how to make things 'click'.

Dr. Stanwyck is one of the best. She really wants her students to succeed. She converted one of our office hours into an extra classroom hour for anybody who wanted to go over more problems. She constantly innovates in the classroom to keep it interesting. And she's probably the nicest person on campus.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Stanwyck is an amazing professor who really knows her calculus. The way she moves around the class and talks you can tell she's really passionate about what she does. Although there are only 2 exams she gives lots of quizzes, weekly homework, and even projects so that your grade isn't weighed heavy in one area.
she builds in A LOT of extra credit. Shes very upbeat and positive during lectures. I dont feel afraid to talk to her and ask her questions  both inside and outside the classroom.

Dr. Stanwyck is a great! She's super nice and is always available for office hours. She's very enthusiastic during her lectures. Do ALL of the problems from the study guides when preparing for exams; she uses problems from there. If you don't understand an excel project, go and see her. This is a fast-paced class so go to SI/PASS if you need help.

Dr. Stanwyck is GREAT! She really wants to make sure everyone understands what we're doing and is always super willing to answer questions. There are weekly homeworks (not graded) and weekly quizzes as well as group participation work on non quiz days. Not an easy class, but if you do the work, and take initiative to ask for help, you will do fine.

Professor Stanwyck is a must! She really gives you EVERYTHING you need to successd and provides plenty of opportunities to earn extra points. Need help, she is there. Good math teachers are extremely rare, and I wish I had her for when I took Calc 1 & Calc 2. Apply yourself and ask questions, and you will succeed!!!
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is helpful when you ask, but if you suck at math no matter how hard you try, it's still difficult to get a grade that shows how much effort you put. Almost half the class failed the second exam, I passed yet my final grade is still a 'C' as if I'm like the average student in the class. Grading system sucks, and she won't bump you up.

She is absolutely lovely as a person, so full of energy. Without approaching her, I loved her lectures  because she was so positive. She made me love math even more. If you've done some calc before, and you read the material, you should be good in this class. Everything is made for your success, and at so many levels. It really is an easy A!!

She's not a hard teacher, she's very fair. She wants you to succeed so if you talk to her, she'll be really nice to you and help you calculate a way to pass the class. I really liked her and thought she was really nice, but she's not easy exactly.

Stanwyck is so passionate and excited about teaching. Both classes I took with her were very challenging, but she is very helpful in office hours and gives you a lot of time in class to ask questions about the homework. Sometimes she talks about statistics in a way that is over my head, but other than that she is very helpful and fair.

Professor Stanwyck is one of the best professors at UMBC! She is very helpful and her excitement in the class actually helped me pay attention and learn. I'm not a strong math student but she kept it straight forward and easy to understand. Just study and stay committed and  everything should be okie dokie!

she is the best stat professor in UMBC. I took many stat classes with her. She will help you anytime, just walk in to her office and ask her. She is very patient and nice professor. DO NOT MISSING IT.

Not a good professor. Her lectures are long and boring most students leave early or just don't pay attention because of the way she teaches. Super hard grader no curve at all. If you don't  know stat 100% before entering the class be prepared to spend your whole semester on this class or take a low grade. Take a different professor

Worst professor at UMBC. She's the kind of professor that comes to class teaches doesn't care if people learn and goes on with her day. People would literally not pass quizes and she would blame it on them. Lectures are ambiguous and long. If you can't learn this material on your own then your going to fail this class.
Best teacher ever. Very clear, fair and interesting. Fantastic lectures. Do the work, and you'll get an A.

I read all of the reviews for Dr. Stanwyck on here and I thought at first it sounded too good to be true. However, I was pleasantly surprise this semester as Dr. Stanwyck completely blew me out of the water. Amazing professor, was always there to help anyone who had a question. Everyone should take her before graduating, you won't regret it at all.

I loved Professor Stanwyck! She was one of the nicest professors, I have had the pleasure of meeting. No matter how stupid the question, she would answer quite graciously. I could tell she genuinely enjoyed teaching math.
Excellent Teacher
Amazing teacher! Highly recommended! very interesting as well!

My all time favorite teacher. Extremely inspirational. 451 required very hardwork, but as long as u r trying, she'll do everybit to help understand. Make good use of office hrs. She's kind, generous, caring,  & most of all super-excited for what she teaches. It's just so much fun to be around her. For me, she's a goddess & I'll never forget her..:)
Great teacher. Do the practice quizzes and keep up with the reading. Pretty easy overall.

Her class is very easy, but she moves very quickly. Her quizzes look like the practice quizzes on Blackboard. Make sure to do the study guide for exams because her exams may have questions from there.

Don't take Math 155 or Stat with anyone else. She's AMAZING! She's always willing to help, all you have to do is go to her office. She's understanding, and is always there to help her students succeed!

One of the best professors I've had. She clearly explains everything. Her theory is that people who are bad at math just didn't understand a single concept and never caught up after the class moves on, so she addresses everything really well. She is funny with exciting lectures too.

She is such an awesome professor.  Always willing and ready to help. She employs the "there is no stupid question" mantra and answers every questions as clearly as possible.  She is very charismatic and actually wants you to do well.  Make sure and keep on top of pre-reading quizzes, those add up in the end!

Stanwyck is so nice and charismatic, she wants you to pass. She does move really quickly during the lecture though, but she does stop sometimes and ask if you have questions, but she made it clear what was going to be on the tests based off the discussion quizzes.

TAKE HER! She is one of the most nicest and understanding professors you will ever come across. I took her for Math 155 twice, failed the first time because I slacked off bad, and decided to take her again, and passed with a B! Now I'm taking her for Statistics, and although the hybrid format of the class can be tricky, she's worth it!

Love her! Had her for MATH 155 and have her for STAT 351. She can move really quickly, so make sure to attend lecture and follow what she's saying. She assumes that you know the material and will treat you as such. Very helpful outside the classroom, responds to e-mail quickly, very professional and accommodating.
She is awesome! She makes math fun! Definitely recommended!

I am not a math major nor a math fan at all, but Dr. Stanwyck made this class pretty easy all in all.  She had some issues with class cancellations this semester (three of them), which disrupted the flow, but she more than made up for it with pushing back HW.  Very, very good professor, HIGHLY recommended.

AMAZING professor! I wish ALL of my professors were like her. I'm not even a math major, and seriously feared taking another math class since high school, but I am so glad I did with her! She is very clear, helpful, cheerful, and this experience has helped me realize that I am good in mathematics. Come to class, take through notes, and do the hw!

This professor is just simply amazing. She is VERY helpful and answers emails really fast. Very easy going and understanding. The class is fairly hard but this is due to the class material itself. DO THE PRACTICE SHEETS she hands out in discussions - it will help you in the quizzes and even exams. Online HW is a lot harder than her tests. Take her!
She is really easy to talk to and is very helpful. The content can get confusing but if you do the homeworks and ask for help it isn't too bad. Her projects are fairly easy. Recommended.
She is the best math instructor I have ever had.  1st and 2nd exam were easy, 3rd was very difficult.

She was a great teacher, really passionate about math and always very clear in explaining problems. She is funny and engaging in class. Quite an easy class, do the homework and there is extra credit offered. Group projects can be tough if you have a bad group. If you put a little work, you will get an A!

Love this teacher! She was very clear, helpful, and understanding. She answers any questions emailed to her promptly. A very nice lady. Kind of hyper but it makes the class entertaining. You don't really need your book. I never even opened mine. I highly recommend this teacher!
She's a greater teacher. Just do all your work, go to class and pay attention and study. She gives out study guides before tests. MAKE SURE YOU STUDY THEM. THEY ARE KEY.

One of the best teachers i had. Very helpful. Talks rly fast but very comprehensive. Give you pratice sheets(not graded).  Must study practice sheets. I had a quiz the was exactly the same as the pratice sheet questions word from word. Replies emails fairly quickly. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!!!!!!!!!!!! EASY A!!!

This is a challenging course, but Dr. Stanwyck is great. She will answer questions via email and allow you to set up appointments to meet with her one-on-one to go over problems. Quizzes can be challenging, but exams follow the format of the practice exams. She makes the course enjoyable- I highly recommend it to any math/stat major!
good teacher, but hard class, sometimes the exams are easy (if she follows the sample exam)

FALL 2012: AWESOME Professor. If you attend class and take notes, the exams/quizzes shouldn't be too hard. I honestly never liked calc and I ended up getting an A in the course. She goes out of her way to help; utilize office hours and tutoring! (My TAs were horrible though). Didn't use the textbook much because exams are very similar to notes.

Best Math teacher I've had in awhile. If you do poorly on her exams its probably because you didnt go to class or listen. She explains things VERY clearly and makes sure that you understand it. Very passionate and likes to move around when she lectures. Overall, THE BEST

Passionate about the subject and has high expectations for her students. The downside of this is that she often assumes that you are stat wizards like she was. However, statistics is difficult to teach for any professor. She cares for her students and encourages them to come to her office hrs for help. HW is optional, DO IT ANYWAYS.

Careful when taking her class, you do not get curves, last semester about 60% of the class had failed.  the class avg of the first test was about a 28/50.  the 2nd exam was pretty much the same.  She is really difficult but she does try her best to help you in any way possible.

Great attitude, genuinely seems to love what she does and makes it easy for you to love it too.  She was open to meeting outside of class for a little extra help when needed, and was super animated during lectures.  Very hard to fall asleep in her class, which is good because the material is insanely difficult.

Great professor! I was concerned about taking a 400 level compressed summer course, but it was not bad. Weekly quizzes based on the non-graded homework which are not too bad. Liz Stanwyck is energetic and happy to answer any questions! I would recommend this course, she makes what could be a very dry course interesting and engaging.

I had Prof Stanwyck also for Stat so I knew she was gonna be great for math. Her exams match the homework problems online. The only thing I didnt like was going to discussion which the only purpose for it was to work labs.But I would recommend Stanwyck as a professor.

This teacher is the best for this class. Honestly I am bad at math and I had a tutor for the whole semester and I passed the class.The materials aren't too bad and she is willing to help a lot. She definitely notices you in class and it helps a lot if you show up at her office. great teacher easy passing

Excellent in every way.  Organized and on time to every class.  Very energetic about what she teaches.  Crystal clear on every point.  Exams are exactly what she teaches.  She only asks you know the material, she doesnt require you to do tedious algebra on tests.  Excellent class, even if you dont like math you will like her, guaranteed.
She is an amazing professor. Her lectures notes are very clear and she is willing to help. Her quizzes and exams are just like the practice so do those and you will be fine.
Professor is a good teacher, she will help with any questions you might have in the class. Alot of busy work and these labs that take a whole week to accomplish.

Killed my gpa last semester. apparently a good stat teacher, as for calc -.- I missed 6 classes & it hurt me soooo much. it could be just be me but calc with stanwick was VERY hard.. hard to approach her cuz her presence/vibe's intimidating. but she lets you correct some of your midterm for some extra points. quizzes = hard after the first one! >:[
There is no curve, I had an 89 and got a B... not very organized... overall not bad, but not as great as what these guys are saying, if you take her winter class its a blitz and overwhelming at times
Awesome professor. Amazing curve at the end of the class and very easy to get an A in if you try at all.

Awesome professor! Very down to earth and really tries to make sure everyone understands. Her ppts are incredible and do an excellent job of simplifying the book while highlighting exactly what you need to know. She lets you know exactly what you need to know for all quizzes and tests. I will try to take more classes from her in the future.

Liz Stanwyck is an amazing young professor. She is enthusiastic about what she teaches, has great energy and takes time for any student questions in and out of class. I recommend her and praise her to everyone. I will take her again for 453. She is simply outstanding.

I have no words to describe how nice she is. Very clear, extremely helpful, teaches what you need to know in detail so EVERYONE can understand. (YES, EVERYONE- NOT JUST MATH GIGS). Ms Stanwyck, It was a blessing taking your course. THANK YOU!!!!

She teaches the class like an elementary school teacher but with college statistics material.  She's so easy to understand and very helpful.  Her exams are ridiculously easy.  My STAT200 class was so much harder than this one.  If you have to take STAT351, do not take it with anyone else but her unless you want to make things hard on yourself.
She is very good. She is very helpfull and try to make as simple as she can.

Awesome professor! I'm not typically great at math, but she explains everything clearly, answers questions and includes good examples, and makes statistics interesting. I am very exicited to be doing well in her class!
She looks like Donna from That 70's Show. She's always encouraging asking questions and is extremely helpful. I like her as a professor.

Awesome professor. Kept STAT interesting and the quizes and exams we exactly what she taught. A little effort on your part but if you pay attention during class you should be able to easily pass this class with this professor.
She's awesome. Explained the material well and is definitely a class to take.
she will make you love statistics. She explains material clearly and makes everything clear to understand. Gives a lot of review that are helpful. Take this class with her, will learn a lot.
THE BEST PROFESSOR AT UMBC ...
Helpful for allied health
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Online lectures can be lengthy, but Professor O'Brien is passionate and helpful. The workload is manageable if you stay on top of it. unstuck study is a great tool for efficient study prep.

Met once a week, 2-hour-long online lectures with a 5-10 min break, and group work at the end of every session. Wasn't too bad as long as you did the synchronous work you a guaranteed an A. 4 exams which had 150 questions- had to do them in 2.5 hours (insane but only downside) overall nice professor she was very sweet and had a nice voice

Online course for 2.5 hours long, 4 exams throughout the semester and they are 150 MC questions for 2 hrs 15 min which is insane. Some material on it we never even talk about. But overall, she is extremely nice and a great professor and passionate about human growth and development! Take this class!

The professor is nice and is very excited about the class. The class consists of each group facilitating the chapter on the day of the class. The majority of the work is online and those are usually quizzes and critical thinking and a project. Overall, the class is interesting and she makes you engage in the discussion we have each week.
very approachable. Helped during office hours and read multiple drafts. if you do the work, you are fine. You learn alot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is a super harsh teacher, her critiques are all criticism and not about improving your paper. She's rude over email and is not easy to talk to at all. PSYC 465 with her is not a good choice, most of the assignments are busy work and the research critique is so hard because of her grading. I would not recommend at all.
Easy
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: just do the work...fair and makes the course relevant to allied health.
really works with students.  cares and tries to help you get a good grade. If you don't show up or do the work, then it's on you. lectures help review the readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She reads powerpoints the whole time during class and then does group work after that. Prepare to participate in her class because most of the points come from that. She is very condescending in her responses when emails you back. I did not enjoy her at all as professor and will avoid taking her classes in the future.

She's a very sweet, kind, and considerate woman. It's best to get on her good side so write a nice email when you reach out w/ a question :) Textbook is included, but going off her lectures work just fine to pass this class with a high B or an A. Kinda dry/bland though, but attendance is needed to do group work.
Easy course
good online course; just do the work and go to class
wants students to do well
Good class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: very helpful for nursing and premed.
LIfespan is really interesting and she helps by getting you ready for exams
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: For an online class, more work was done than any in person class. She's condescending when speaking and gets irritated when the class does well considering her questions all come from online. TONS of group work and will keep you the entire 3 hours. Very monotone and slow and only reads her slides.

Dr OBrien is an amazing professor. Most writing intensive courses make you write a lot of papers; this course only required one, and we spent the entire semester on it. She's a very kind, understanding, and flexible person who was always available by email for anything we needed. Her lectures were also interesting, and she encouraged participation.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Teaching style was a bit dry, but interesting. You get credit for clickers (not graded on accuracy). The hw/labs took a few hours, but are simple. Read the textbook! Know what it contains well enough so that you have basic knowledge on it. Basically memorize the book if you can. The concept is simple, but you really need to know the stuffs to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: good class in psychology. I am a social work student but really enjoyed this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The class is easy, just lots of online work. The only thing that was kind of tricky were the exams, but going to the peer mentor review sessions really helps prepare for exams because they go over questions from past exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: fun class and just do the online work.

Lectures using powerpoint slides adapted from the textbook that she doesnt share with her students. However, there are various resources available to help you understand the material. Review sessions, etc. If you read the textbook and study the terms you will be fine.
Class was really interesting and had actual cases to discuss. Really good for social work and psyc mental health.

Dr. O'Brien was very disorganized with how she does things and is unclear with how she grades. Her exams are very disorganized and are tricky. It seems like she grades and teaches based on how she wants to, rather than sticking by her syllabus and the textbook. She lectures immensely.

Dr. O'Brien is a solid professor. Teaches using PowerPoint-based lectures (not posted on BB), videos and light humor. Interesting and useful material. Attendance graded by participation (clicker ?s, in-class assignments). 4 unit exams; no final. Read book; some exam ?s are verbatim. Sit in front to avoid disruptive students (talkers, texters, etc).

Dr. Obrien was a nice lady, and she definitely knew what she was talking about. She would occasionally give group work and clicker questions unannounced, so I wouldn't skip her lectures. As long as you read the textbook, though, you should be good.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Easy A, show up to class for group activities and clicker questions (Worth 14% of your grade!), do your homework and you should do fine. The textbook is really nice, and definitely has useful information relevant to the tests, which were tricky, but not impossible. The class was at 8:30 AM, but she showed us interesting videos to keep us awake.

The tests really aren't hard as long as you read and practice some of the practice problems she gives you and the ones in the book and you will do well. Attendance is not a grade specifically but she has group assignments and those are grades (you never know when). Online labs aren't that hard but make sure you DO YOUR LABS (easy A's).
She plays carpool karaoke in the mornings before class starts. Such a sweet professor and wants the best for her students. Is very knowledgable about the topics she discusses. Show up to class!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: fun class discussions. Papers are short and rubric is on bb. Had fun in the course with the topics.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: really good topics ; some boring, but mostly fun. movies were good. make sure you look at paper rubric before submitting. online tests and basically good course. come to class as there are group projects once a week.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: great discussions with lots of reflective writing before class. But there is a rubric that tells you what you should include in the reflection. very open and honest.

She assigned minor reflection posts, due at 8am before every class, and 4 major reflective papers. If you don't write the way SHE expects you to, you will not do well. It was an awful class to take considering her feedback for papers consists of "good job," "poor job," etc. I feel that if I'm not doing well in the class, proper feedback might help.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I loved this class so much. The material is interesting and O'Brien makes it even more interesting in lectures. Her teaching is clear and she has a sense of humor. The work is pretty self-paced and it isn't difficult to get a good grade. Just do the reading (textbook is easy to understand) and do online assignments on time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: course is easy-just do the work online and come to class to participate. You learn if you read and do the work. some really good sessions. Movies are fun.

Nice and fun prof, You need to either do the reading or take really good lecture notes, pay attention in lecture she will call people out for sleeping or being on there phones in lecture. A fair bit of work but not to bad over all.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I've had Dr. O'Brien for two different classes now, and I still really like her teaching style. She is a very sweet professor, who cares for her students. She is big on discussion and how you can bring your real world experience into the classroom. She might be my favorite professor in the psychology dept!

Great class on problems in teens and college age adolescents. It is writing intensive so beware you write each week and there is a paper. She gives feedback electronically just read the rubric comments. Helpful and wants students to succeed. Good discussions in class.

This is one of the most frustrating professors I've ever had at UMBC. She is a nice person, but her feedback is unhelpful and useless. She will not grade you based on how you write (and help you improve), but rather if you don't write the way she specifically wants (and I mean the way SHE wants), you fail. I would not recommend her as a Professor.
weekly writing but it's ok. It is a process to get to a good paper at the end. Loved the content and felt like grad school seminar.  If you love psyc, then you will love this course.
really good class.  Attendance is more about participation in groups discussing related issues. Sad topics but so much in the news!  I really liked the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: General course in large lecture hall.  she knows most of the students after midterm and likes to relate psychology to other disciplines.  STEM major who did not like the content but liked the course. good teacher
better than my social work class.   come to participate in a really good discussion and see contemporary films.  great class for anyone interested in child welfare.

Weights attendance for WAY too much in final grade. Got A's on all exams and most homeworks but ended up with a C! DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR! If u don't go to class EVERY SINGLE TIME she will pick u out and treat u like crap grade-wise and during class (consistently belittled anything I had to say for in class discussions and ignored constantly.)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Sweet professor. Her exams aren't overly difficult but there is a good amount of online homework due, as well as labs. If you do the readings and complete all online materials on time, it becomes very easy for you to earn an A. The final exam is incredibly straight forward; I earned a 93% without studying. (You should still study though!)

Dr. O'Brien has decent lectures and is pretty funny. There is group work. She randomly does clicker questions for participation points, so show up to class. Homework consists of reading, labs, quizzes, and tests; exams are taken in class. Don't worry though; there are plenty of review sessions and TAs there to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Do the online labs on time. Don't wait until the last minute. Peer review sessions are concise and helpful, and if you have any concerns, go to Dr. O'Brien's office hours because she's such a great person and very understanding. Her chapters take a long time to read, but they're interesting. Manage your time well, and you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She's a very nice lady. Her lectures were taken straight out of the book, so reading and paying attention to her lectures is good because that will help you out for the exams. The questions are a bit random, but it's really nothing too challenging. She gets you the information you need in a clear manner, and doesn't beat around the bush.

Not a horrible or mean professor, but her lectures were just condensed versions of the textbook notes. The exams were given with not much review material so I didn't know what to study for each one. I think review sessions are a MUST.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I love Dr. O'Brien. She is very genuine. This class consists of preclass postings, reflection papers, a midterm, and a final.  All of the assignments are easy.  She posts the powerpoints so you do not have to write quickly in class. I highly recommend this class.

She lectures fast but posts power points. Not many exams but definitely go to study session or you'll be lost for the exam. There are little assignments every class to make sure you're reading but they are not hard at all. You don't have to read to pass, but you'll need the book to study.

Dr. O'Brien is very unclear when questions about expectations. Her syllabus contradicted itself and she did not  follow through on things listed within. Class is always rushed and she covers exactly what is in the textbook, but includes attendance in grade. An online textbook is used and graded but does not prepare you for exam material.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Do the online labs, prepare for exams, easy A.
good for gened course. fun class topics
really interesting even though I am not a major.  Funny class discussions and good examples of how psychology fits into everyday life.
Good class, but you have to work. She helps if you need special care. Has lots of resources for students

Half the class is based on participation and online labs. The online labs are easy just time consuming. She does clicker questions and group activities in class. She never tells us whats going to be on the exam, so you have to memorize the book from cover to cover because she asks the most random questions. Her lectures are so pointless.

She is a very nice professor who is passionate about psychology. Easy to approach and talk to if you have problems or concerns. Learned a lot about family psychology through weekly discussion style lectures, textbook readings, and writing assignments.
writing intensive but learned so much! Get ready to discuss and talk about readings. Can't be lazy and allows for different viewpoints.

Lots of small groups, clickers, and labs. Lecture powerpoints are okay, but you have a better chance reading the book and taking notes on your own. Finishing online labs is the key to success. The semester is organized in the syllabus. Keep up and you'll pass. Peer mentors are super helpful.

Pretty easy class and the material is interesting. Attendance is a must since there is usually assignments to do in class and there is also a lot of online work. She's not really a harsh grader though, so if you do all the assignments it should be an easy A.

I found this to be a pretty easy class. People say her lectures are boring, but I thought she was very engaging. If you want to get an A in the course, do these 3 things: Read the book - some MC test questions are random, so knowing the random facts is necessary, Go to class (graded exercises), Ask her for help. She cares and is a good professor!
There are so many resources to help you pass this class.  Had some people in class who really did not like it, but they were not interested in much .
not relevant to my major, but she cares about students learning and tries to keep us interested.
Just go to class, read and do your work.  Learned about pretty interesting stuff
The class is boring and she can't teach at all.
Really a fun course and we learned a lot.  Fun online work and small groups were hilarious.  Good time and good application of concepts.  Liked a lot.

class is too large, but the topics are good.  Learned but had to read a bunch of chapters. Great discussions, but  wish we could have had more time to talk in groups. Liked the balance and not all feminists stuff
good online content and class is fun
class is so easy if you just follow the syllabus. good discussions in class. don't skip class or lose points
Really great class and it is seminar so you have to read and talk. But just a good class to take and fairly easy if you do the work
Loved this class!!!
really leaned alot but wished there were no exams.  Guest speakers awesome and she really knows the field.
good intro class with lots of online learning.  Had a blast in class with groups
Great class to come to.  Enjoyed the reading and class discussions.  Online stuff prepares you for a final but the group work is more important.
Really good gen ed course with lots of online work that helps.  Would take another psyc class with her.
really hard topics and makes you think.  Not for students who like multiple choice.   Really good essay exams. Got to read to the book.
good class, nice person and fun group work. Just do the assignments and study with peer mentors.
really good gened course. Like her and enjoyed the group work.  fun class
great course and you learn alot
good online work and you can sleep in class when not in group.
hard class but most interesting one yet.
didn't think I"d like the subject, but it makes sense.  Good ss course
loads of writing for WI class but really helpful, interesting and great class to end my four years at UMBC.  I wish I had taken her other courses.
Tough class with reading and essays tests, but it's good.  She let's students use books for exams and have input into test content. Great guest speakers.
This lady wants you to do well and will help, but you gotta work. Read and do labs.
really great class and OBrien is very good with helping us understand and relate the text to our families. learned alot
just do the work like they say and you are fine.  great online studying so just come to class and have fun
very concerned about students.  will adapt testing if you ask her.  knows her stuff and brings in interesting speakers.  read the book!!!
clean on what to do.  You have to work but it's all very clear. Learn how to use online labs.
Good class and requires you to work. No loafing but 4 credit A is worth it. learned a lot.

I was so confused about the many non-user friendly layers of the online portion of the class that it was difficult to focus on the content. She words questions on tests in a tricky way and was apathetic when I reached out for help with the homeworkstudying. Psychology is such an interesting subject but she finds a way to make it boring.

In class Dr. O'Brien is very helpful, when it comes to class work. Any questions via e-mail or in class about the final or assignments will either be very vague or not answered. No exams, only the final, which is 100 questions but easy overall. A lot of online work, but not hard. Overall, an easy grade if you do the work. Also, she's very nice.

This is a hybrid classTopic interesting,but Dr. O'Brien presented it in a boring way. The class was easy but tedious and time consuming. She should make it completely online. That 1hr in lecture could be spent doing the online work rather than hearing her summarize the book. But if you want and easy, boring A then this is the class for you.

Taken Fall 2013. Extremely boring. Lectures straight from the book, but mandates attendance. Always fell asleep in class. Psychology is my minor, but I'm starting to regret even that. Online labs are long and pointless; some material from them are not on exams. Take with ANYBODY else but her.
Boring class do not take with her. Some of the questions on the exams you have more than one right answers but she she only give you credit if you choose the answer she picked.  AVIOD THIS CLASS

I took the hybrid psych 100 course.The labs were stupid and time-consuming,but easy.The online exams and quizzes were easy.She is knowledgeable but tough.Exams are easy only if you do the work.Do all the work, review the study guides at the end of each chapter,show up to class and you should get an A. Bring your clicker to every class

Terrible teacher. Attendance is mandatory even though her power points are straight from the book. She has a monotone voice that puts half the class to sleep. She is never able to answer a question unless it tells it to her in the powerpoint. Grades unfairly and shows favoritism. AVOID!

Requires so much useless busy work. It would be so much better if you could just use the amount of time wasted doing the busy work to study. Also, her lectures are useless and not insightful in the least. One of the most useless professors and a waste to the educational system.

very, very horrible class. requires far too much work for a 100 level class. attendance is mandatory, yet everything she says in class is straight out of the book. In order to even begin  homework you must pass a prelecture quiz with a 90% even though you receive no credit for the quiz. I found her very arrogant. Graded unfairly as well. Stay away!

For those who have read the book 1984, this woman would be one of those high ranking officials working for Big Brother. She's one of those psychologists who thinks that anyone who shows signs of embracing particularness and individualism is mentally ill. If you're a PSYC major, choose your leaders carefully. We don't want 1984 to come to life.

You've got to read the book. Everything comes from the book. Going to class is one of the most frustrating things I've dealt with so far in college. It's completely pointless because her slides literally come straight from the book, but if you don't come to class, then you forfeit any group work done that day. AWFUL.

This professor does not connect with her students, nor is she helpful to questions and concerns you may have.  Her exams are hard even though open book the questions have nothing to do with the book.  I would not take any of her classes again.
You ALWAYS have to write in complete sentences even if it's unnecessary.

Not the best professor. Goes over the material too quickly. She has slides but they are pointless because she flies through them and does not post them to Blackboard. The class has a heavy reliance on the textbook. You MUST have the textbook in your lap doing online work because if you don't get it word for word you will be wrong.

took her twice now-psych 200 displayed correct quiz answers as INcorrect online. 465 syllabus is unclear-different sections propose diff due dates and pg lengths. exams are unclear. lectures from nothing-not the book or PP. expects you to have newest book but hers is old as dirt bc she doesnt want to read the new bk and update her notes-lazy/boring
All tests open note from the book. Questions tricky though! Curved at the end of the semester.

For a 100 level intro to psych class Professor O'Brien definitely stresses INDEPENDENT study. Meaning the student is mainly responsible for learning course materials. The student will be expected to read, attend class (only to reinforce difficult materials),and do online homework to ace exams to get a good grade.The workload is laborious but simple

horrible teacher. her lectures put you to sleep. more then half the class skips, you notice that during exams when there is a completely full class. does nothing to help prepare for exams. DO NOT TAKE HER!
Very nice teacher to talk to.

I took her class Spr2010. The A was alot of work for a level 100 class. There were multiple errors in the online hw, which was very time consuming. She has in class group work which is a percentage of your grade.  Her lectures were not very engaging. The work required for the A is not worth the A.

The slides aren't made available online, but the class is based purely on the book. Attendance is only needed for the small groups, which is how she grades attendance. The online work is quick and easy.

coming to class is basically pointless since she just vomits what we learned from the book. actually reading the book is so much easier, and somehow FUNNIER/more engaging than going to class. she goes by lecture incredibly fast, she can be nice but sometimes she can be really ****y, go to class for the group work, and bring a book to entertain you

Clearly this woman has a lot going on with her. She has two sides, one nice and friendly, the other horribly curt and rude. You'll never know what you're going to get with her. Couldn't be happier for the semester to end. I would never take a class with her again. Good thing she's not teaching many classes---not real faculty.

This was an online class, I took it over the summer.  Many of the questions had the wrong answers, and when I asked about them, I was given curt, poorly written, and frankly insulting responses.  It wasn't too hard to get an A, but it was clear that the teacher put very little time and effort into the course, and many things were just plain wrong.
stupid online groupwork was the worst part. Other than that, it was a regular class, go to class, read the text. She puts the posts the powerpoints, which is helpful.

She is a very good teacher. Tests are a little on the hard side, but they are open book. You have to go to class to be able to get the class activity points. Topics are very interesting and lecturs greatly enhance the textbook.

A repeat of every Health Ed class you ever went through in middle school.  Does not make the subject matter in any way relevant to psychology and essentially reads from the textbook or puts on videos. Disrespectful and unprofessional if you seek help outside of class. Also tends to contradict her own syllabus and grading policies.

you have to know the textbook forwards & backwards to get an A on the exams; the online quizes help your grade out a TON! i had a D average on the exams but an A average on the online quizes, resulting in a B. u find out at the end of the semester that the TA help sessions give u extra credit, so go to those!
rude

To get an A you have to agree with all her beliefs and make sure you blog that way as well, or else you will not receive full credit. Although tests are open book they are really hard even if you study, they are not straight forward questions. This class sounded like it would be fun before I took it, discussion was interesting sometimes.

Would NOT recommend- she is  unclear about assignments, refuses to be proven wrong even when you point it out in text, very unhelpful takes forever to respond to e-mails if she responds at all, tricky test questions, got a B but it took an unreasonable amount of effort and confusion

a bit hard to get an A in the course b/c not a lot of points in the class. exam format changed throughout the semester, but it was always open-book. class lectures are generally very interesting if you're interested in gender at all. also, COME TO CLASS. the class assignment may be the diff. between a B or an A :(.

She's an alright teacher with an alright class; not overly tough, but also not overly easy. The homework can be time consuming and sometimes the questions aren't even addressed in the textbook.  I'd recommend taking her.
very good teacher. if you study and try it is guaranteed an A. learn practical things too! films are very interesting

Lectures = boring but go because of group work. Test = easy if you know how to use a book since open note open book. Group project= a real pain. if your group members don't do their work trying to talk to her is pointless because its a group grade. do it all yourself and make it look good. bring a laptop and print and read the slides.

who brings a 100 question on a four chapter test?!?! three test that were almost impossible, one presentation that was not structured clearly.. the class would have been interesting if someone else had taught it...

She is an okay professor. Exams are open note, open book but it does not really help. Grade fairly. Give out a few in class activity and one huge presentation for 10-15 mins. If you do well on this presentation You will do will in the class.

This lady is HORRIBLE she doesn't know anything she is talking about. very rude and sarcastic. she doesn't care what so ever about students grades. she has her favorites in class and doesn't care about the rest. if you try to prove her wrong and even show it in the book she won't drop the question on the test. she is very narrow minded about topics

The majority of lecture was her reading directly from the slides taken from the teaching material provided with the books, verbatim.  Hardly cracked the book, and aced it.  She's a professional with her own clients, but the class was dreadfully boring.

Very hard to fail. She gives 4 tests one is the final. She also uses the online program so there is alot of assignments but all of them help your grade extremely. She lectures out of the book and her powerpoints which she also posts online.Only reason you would have to come to class is the little group assignments she gives for extra points.
Boring lectures, but the class was easy. The online work is time consuming, but a lot of students feel it's helpful in learning the material. If you want an A, you'll have to go to class.

It mineaswell have been an online class.  The stuff we did in class did not help me understand the material any better then the book.  I expected in class activity and learning and thats not what I got.
One of the best teachers Ive had! She is clear, and sweet. Very helpful and her lectures are clear and interesting. Just make sure you read for this class.
She was cool.  the homework will make you want to gouge your eyes out but the lectures are very interesting.
she is ok

Great, Great, Great Professor, and little on the feminist side, but kind of motherly in a way...She is cool, and can teach, people say the lectures are boring, but she knows how to teach..she gives you these hard online quizzes but they help you for the Test...I am now a Psychology Minor Because of her!!
The quizes help prepare for exam but be careful. She changes the wording around. Lectures are BORING!

While attendance isn't mandatory, she does hand out worksheets for participation points. She really likes the online exams, and you have to do 3 for each chapter. All of her powerpoints are online. She taught directly from the book. Very easy to get an A or a B if you did the online work.

Interesting information and she just wants you to learn something. Not big on memorization of facts-allows a lot of open book and take home because she knows whats really important. She wants you to take somethin away from the class, other than just a grade. Definitely recommend class for psych and education majors

way i got an A: read the book, did the online stuff, night before the exam i redid each online quiz from those chapters, a bunch of the questions were almost verbatim from there...boring as hell lectures though, makes u want to sleep, attendance isnt mandatory, but there r occasional worksheets that count as participation points
it was an easy class....very dull. reading thebook got you through it but she was nice, so. extra credit exists!

I'm a psychology major and I hated this class. The notes are available online, she makes you do online quizzes. Her tests are multiple choice. There's no point in going to the lecture. If you want to learn anything not covered in high school psych, don't take this class
Online powerpoint notes that are gone over in class.
A good professor with fair tests (but you will need to study).

This class was great, not to mention easy if you read the text and do the labs.  Tests are moderately difficult, but she gives a study guide and curves.  Plus she offers extra credit for GOING to class and participating in research studies.

If you are thinking "hey this is an introductory course so I won't have to do crap but still get an A" but you are sadly mistaken. Since this is a 4 cred class, you have to put a lot of effort into getting an A. She knows what she's talking about, but the class itself is hard. It wasn't worth taking in my opinion, but I still got my A.

Great professor.  Really wants her students to do well and goes out of her way to assist those who need help.  Classes are mostly powerpoints, which can be found online.  Also uses videos in class, which are nice because they break up monotony.  Online quizzes are part of grade and helpful.  Go to class and read, get an A.  Slack off and get a B.

Very awesome lady, she knwos her stuff and keeps class interesting, uses lots of power points and videos, her tests are fairly challanging but she does let you use your books and notes for part of it! very interesting class highly reccommendable
this class is the only psych class that doesnt grade on quizzes..the grades are based on three exams, on five chapters EACH. which is why just about half the class failed. my advice: STAY. AWAY.
No Comments
needs to open eyes more

Decent teacher. Uses lots of powerpoints and videos. Rather challenging tests, but they are from the book company and most of them are on the online component anyway so you can study them before taking test. Boosts grade if you spend a lot of time online and if you sit in the front row.  I recommend her.

The class was long and kinda boring cause she used A LOT of Power Point slides. Like, 150 for each exam. Very hard to study from that, imo. Exams were multiple choice though with bonuses and there were online quizzes that we could do on our own time (an easy way to make 10 points...AND if you forgot about them she'll let everyone redo them at the end of the semester!)
The class was very interesting, and not hard, but she is disorganized, and tends to go off on tangents
Never went to a class and still passed! She is pretty nice but not leaneant about make-ups or late stuff. The tests are a little hard but just study the online guides.
Easy class... all the exam questions come straight from the online book you have to buy. put in a couple hrs studying b4 each test and you are good to go.

Really, REALLY easy class. You only have to read the slides and most of the stuff on the test is from the practice exams online. Easy A, but class can get excruciatingly boring sometimes. It's an intro class, so don't expect any indepth stuff (at all). She does seem to lean towards humanist psych.
Her 100 course is straight forward, easy A if you have good study skills.  Seems rather biased against evolutionary psych.

One of the most interesting classes I ever took.  She wants it to be an active learning class and it is for the most part.  Open note and book exams just because she wants you to do well. Projects are not hard at all. (Powerpoint presentation about article)

The tests/exams are very difficult and detailed even with notes and the textbook. If you read, you can still fail. EVERYTHING detail is on the exam, no study guide. I would NOT recommand her at upper level courses. You might learn a lot from her BUT have a hard time passing the course. GOOD LUCK!

Boring/pointless lectures, goes off on tangents-confusing, unclear about test material- always a suprise!  Tries to add last minute projects/papers- last week of class!  CLOSED-MINDED and BIASED!  I really regret taking her class- it is a waste of time and energy!

She is a very helpful teacher who uses material straight from the book and online quizzes. If you take all the practice tests, you don't even have to read the chapter.  Sometimes lecture is boring but the movies she plays are hysterical.
A very nice and understanding person. Definitely an easy A.  Just do all the reading and the online chapter tests and quizzes.  Exams arent the main focus, learning is.
No Comments

She's just like any other lecturer, BORING!!! There's alot of material and her lectures come directly from the publishers of the book. Take the optional Pre & Post tests and optional chapter quizes to see right answers. Her online quizes and 1/3 of her tests questions come directly from those.

I don't know why people complain about Mrs. O'Brien. If you go to class and follow along with the reading, you'll have absolutely no problem. This isn't a hard class. She's clear and there's not that much information.
READ THE BOOK.  the tests are the hardest part of this class, so make sure you study everything.  if you did good memorizing junk like names and definitions, you'll be alright.  NOT a bs class.
I never had any problems with her.  This class is a definite easy A.

Good teacher, go to all the lecture, might be a bit boring sometimes, but go anyway, you will learn a lot.  Read the book, it's easy to do well in this class, but you have to do the work and read the book.  Very nice person and very understanding.
VERY UNDERSTANDING AND VERY WILLING TO HELP

She is very lazy. I didn't get the "smart" impression from her. She seems to just use the powerpoints from the book company. She said that stuff wouldn't be on the exams and then there was a whole section on it. This happened on EVERY exam.Nice

she's a smart person- i'm glad that exams aren't the biggest focus, just wants everyone to learn about women (isn't that the point?). yea, u don't have to go to class but its no fun b/c the discussion can be interesting. read the text- its cool.
This class is so boring, she reads the Powerpoints that came with the book word for word and they are online so there is really no reason to go to class, all in all she doesn't really teach

Easy enough class to pass but kinda pointless to go to class.  She uses slides that the book company gives her and you can just read the book to get the same information.  For exams just use the study guide she gives and read the book.

Never in her office during her office hours. The LAZYEST teacher ever. She uses the powerpoints given to her by the book company, which is basically word for word. She skips many slides because the company has too many slides ex: 100 just for one section
take this class! it's so easy, and she is so nice!  very smart lady!  easy easy easy tests easy A!!!!

For Psych of women class, she is extremely enthusiastic about the material. Sweet, kind lady. Exams are essay but they are OPEN BOOK & OPEN NOTE (very easy!). Very interesting class. Actually look forward to going to class!

This is an easy course: 4 multiple choice tests, one short paper. She puts PowerPoints on the web and then reads them in class. Very cheeful and happy to answer any questions. She tells you what will be on each test. Very straight-forward.

Professor Hernandez was very caring. There is a lot of homework, but if you do them little by little over time it becomes more manageable. She is very understanding that most students haven't taken Spanish in a long time. She is very kind and helpful, she tells you exactly what will be on written/oral exams so you can prepare. Def take her class!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: There are assignments every class. You can access them online, but she will not accept submissions unless you were in class. I already speak spanish, but this class is not really beginner friendly. Since day one, she was adding spanish into her vocab. A classmate of mine struggled a lot and decided to drop out. Way too many assignments tbh.

Huge workload and many quizzes. Quizzes are in person, and mostly fill in the blank with zero partial credit. However the amount of other busy work you are graded on means you can basically fail all the quizzes and get a B if you do all the other work. But this class was def tedious. She does call on people randomly and we did get a pop quiz once
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: horrible horrible teacher she does not answers emails or messages and gives missing assignments in your grade book even thought they are turned in.

Check blackboard religiously. There are a lot of assignments that are hard to keep track of. You'll have weekly homework in the chapter folder, there are two projects that you have to do something for weekly, and there's this thing called "Quest" that you will absolutely forget about until the day it's due (or after if you're me)

took her at loyola. I rlly dont like learning languages. however, she was a very pleasant teacher. class wasnt bad at all. class is easy to follow and prepares you well for tests/quizzes. decent amount of hw but you online resources speed it up.  nice lady and good teacher. learned a lot actually. never thought id positively review a spanish class

honestly went into her class expecting the absolute worst last Spanish class i took was in 10th grade during covid so i was barely present but let me tell u, if u attend class, do all ur home work projects and quests on time  (they are all online) heck u can even get cs on all ur quizzes and u can get an F on the final and  still pass with a high B

Hernandez is a good choice for Span 201. Even after 3 years without Spanish, I was able to pass 201. She makes it clear what to study for quizzes/exams, & genuinely wants her students to get their foreign lang credit. Span 201 course is heavy in general, so you honestly need to put in the work and participate. I'd recommend Hernandez for Span 201.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Mary Ely is a pretty good professor but I would recommend that you take Spanish 101 before 201 because a lot of the material was not taught to me on the HS level and she expects you to know it already. She can get frustrated with the class when they aren't understanding and isn't the nicest about it. 4-7 HW assignments every week, but few quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Lots and lots of homework, so be ready for that. Overall, she's a good professor and is clear about what will be on exams and the oral assessment. If you stay on top of the due dates and study vocab, you'll be fine but it is definitely NOT an easy A. She might also randomly call on you.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Just a horrible teacher who moves wayyyy too fast and gives a crap ton of bs connect assignments as if her class is as important as a STEM class.

I recently had to repeat Spanish 201 because I failed last semester, I took Katherine Solano last semester and decided to take Professor Hernandez this semester. When comparing the two I found Professor Hernandez to be more easygoing to her students and more lenient when comes to grading.

Lot's of homework but that's mostly the department's doing. Participate in her class, show up, and try your best and she'll be your favorite professor. If she knows you, then you'll do great in her class, but if you skip constantly then you won't get any slack from her.

Honestly, I dont like her. She seems to have favorites and i think influences her grading on some papers. There is alot of writing, and all exams were taken paper/pencil. She gives you a "study guide" a day before the exam! Non-resposive to emails. But, she is willing to open up assignments if you missed it. Get ready to get randomly called on!

Things started out okay. Seemed nice, but disorganized. Due dates not clear, nor were homework assignments or projects discussed much in class.  Lots of online homework with various due dates. Main issue was lack of communication/no or long email response times. She was very confrontational when I had an issue with the syllabus/course organization.

Professor Hernandez really cares about her students. She does a good job at engaging the classroom, and is passionate about teaching. She is a fair grader, and is willing to go over and explain things when you don't understand. I looked forward to going to her class every week.

We always got called on randomly which I hated. Profe would not be very good at explaining and she would not give clear examples; she would use other conjugations in her examples. I feel like we moved so fast. Let me tell you we always had Connect homework (the online textbook). Group quizzes were nice. She was kind.

I love Mary Ely Hernandez. She's a truly a gem of a professor, and really does care about her students. I surprised myself, and ended up really enjoyed learning Spanish with her when I took it over the summer

Definitely use her class as a way of practicing your Spanish because she will help guide you all the way, and answer all of your questions.

Class is fairly easy if you put in the effort. Felt like she assigned a lot in the beginning of the course, but as the semester flew by, it was pretty easy to adjust and the course load was decreased a lot. Doing homework is important for grade and attendance is mandatory. We had to do two oral exams, one midterm, one final, and one group project.

Awesome professor. She is caring and wants all of her students to succeed; she gives everyone the resources and opportunities they need to do well. Power points are extremely helpful for studying. She gives clear instructions on all exams and quizzes. Responds very quickly. If you study and put in the effort, you'll get a good grade. No complaints.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I would advise everyone who needs to take an language course with her to take it over the summer/winter. Good professor, tries hard to help students understand the material. Easy tests/quizzes if you study. Take notes and read the textbook. Do your part, submit your work on time and you'll pass. Attendance and participation is really important

She is very nice and down-to-earth with a relaxed but very involved way of teaching. Participation is your ticket to success with class exercises. There is a good amount of homework weekly, but most are simple with the very occasional writing assignment. As long as you actually do the work, you will get an A. She is very helpful with her feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She can be kind in the beginning but becomes more brash over time, especially when students aren't understanding concepts. The number of due dates were horrid and random by the week: Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday, Sunday. Sometimes all 4 in the same week. 9am due dates for some homework and then 11:59pm for others. Speaking grading isnt always clear.

For a class that is only taken by the majority of students for the requirement, this prof grades pretty harsh. Not consistent with grading and will call on you out of nowhere so be ready in class. She invites questions but only in the chat where it's hard to get your thoughts across, especially in a foreign language course.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Its difficult due to a language barrier and comparing english to spanish. If you send an email sometimes she wont respond until 2 days after it. Which is difficult due to if you have a question on an assignment.

This was an okay class. Only took it to finish out a Language requirement. Her classes are a bit annoying. Only had it once a week but still assignments are due throughout the week. Unlimited attempts on online submitting. Quizzes i didn't like due to proctoring. Only annoying part was her saying "chicos" 24/7 every statement.

Prof Hernandez cares about her students, and does her best to ensure that students are actually understanding the language rather than simply memorizing it. Participation is very important as that's a large part of the way she teaches. However, being in her class was not intimidating because she is very understanding and clarifies mistakes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is a really nice caring teacher. If you are worried about Spanish 201 I would definitely recommend taking it with her. Even though it is tough she wont let you fail if you try. Go to office hours and ask questions. She wants you to pass. Very organized and on top of things. Goes above and beyond to help students.
