reviews.comment: A kind professor who really cares about what she teaches. She has attendance assignments every week (at least in AGNG315), but they are not super challenging and you learn a lot from them. If you take notes in class, then you'll have all the material you need to do well in assignments and exams.

Dr. Murray was so sweet. This course was conducted online but she made a real effort to get to know each individual student. She was very helpful if you had any questions and encouraged contact through email and virtual office hours. She helped with editing our papers before handing them in which was a great part of our final grades.

Prof Murray is truly one of my faves. She is so sweet - Im taking another one of her classes again this semester. There is definitely a lot of reading the textbook, but it's okay because the testing material is basically verbatim the textbook. Definitions and all that are a big part, especially at the beginning. Memorize all bolded textbook terms.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Murray is a very kind professor. She has been very accommodating amidst switching to an online format and is a relatively easy grader. There are quite a few discussion posts and written assignments to do but they're not difficult at all, just slightly time consuming. Exams are pretty straight forward if you pay attention and read the book.
She is so kind to everyone in my online class and the work is easy to manage. You'll learn a lot about aging if you focus during lecture and watch the narrated powerpoints!
I had a great time taking her class! Even when switching to an online format, she still helped students transition.
She is very caring towards all of her students. Definitely one of my favorite classes I have taken in the last year :)

I took her for Online Aging 100 class, she makes the discussion way too difficult and very picky, she takes points off everything make the 100 class way too difficult, even some of my 400 class are easier. If you want an easy A, dont take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Took the course online which made it easier although she can be a critical grader. Two exams, open-book, are apart of the course curriculum so you must read the slides, the chapters in the textbook, and take very detailed notes. Students must over provide details in their answers to online discussions. Every point on every assignment is important!

Bad communication, doesn't send out notifications about when things are due even though we only meet once a week, no rubrics for projects/essays, SO MUCH READING!!!! Class was pointless-I learned more from classmates than I did from the professor. Would not wish her on my worst enemy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Avoid this professor at all costs. Assigns so much reading like it is the only class you take and only releases it a couple days in advance, also makes 25% of your grade a group project. Unless you want to stress yourself out I would find a different sociology professor

DO NOT take this class with dr. Henderson. She is an ambiguous grader, and very unforgiving in regards to the needs of individual students. She almost made me lose my summa cum laude status and was my least favorite Professor at UMBC

I have never in my academic journey had such a bad experience with a professor. I never once learned anything during online meetings. All she did during class was answer questions... because nothing was organized and the class was confused throughout the whole semester. The assignments were never posted on time, never flexible or understanding

Worst teacher of my educational journey thus far! Terribly worded questions and a very poorly taught course. She is extremely inflexible and doesn't really care. DON'T TAKE THIS COURSE! I promise you will regret it!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: One of the most annoying class at UMBC. You have 2 papers, 2 exams and YouTube video group project. lots of readings!!!!!!! she says she doesn't want you to memorize things but her exams speak otherwise (KNOW THE READINGS). in the exams its multiple choice, fill in the blank, and an essay ( yes 5 paragraph essay).

Dr Henderson was a pretty amazing prof and you'll get an easy A in the class as long as you participate and follow along with the readings. She isn't a professor that will spring pop quizzes as long as your class is participating.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Barely passable until the lecture on how to coerce an abuse survivor into reporting by implying they're responsible for future incidents... that was beyond the pale. Easily the most liberal (read: reactionary) sociology professor I've ever had. Mindlessly parrot feminist theory to pass. The PDFs are formatted in different directions, so heads up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr H is an amazing woman!!! She not only structures her lessons so that students decided the progression but she makes the environment welcoming for all to contribute! She gives a lot of readings weekly, so make time to read. The readings are very interesting and rarely boring. Shes not one to mess with so respect her and work hard! Group work!

She's not a great lecturer.... she doesn't seem to actually know the material she is teaching. I asked her a question to differentiate 2 concepts and she had to google it? I can google... my professor should not be googling my questions. Also pretty disrespectful and constantly calls people out in a really rude way. Shes just unpleasant overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Man- HATED this class. She's good at lecturing and is funny- but the material is DENSE, readings are 50 PGS LONG- and exams are a MESS. No criteria on exams ever provided, and is tough on grading papers- if youre not a PSY major good luck- this class & style of teaching is way too mumbo-jumbo for me. She expects participation from EVERYONE.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Although this professor is caring and hilarious, the class itself is the hardest for non sociology majors. You have weekly readings which are about 40-50 pages long and they are hard to comprehend. She rarely goes over the readings, which is what the tests are made of and requires participation from every individual even when you dont understand it

She's funny and keeps it pretty real. Definitely one of the better professors you will have in your college experience at UMBC but do not get on her bad side. Group project is pretty easy and her TA grades the papers. The exams for me were the hard part of the class so keep up with the content and readings. Would overall recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Henderson is amazing!She's incredibly nice and very knowledgeable about the world of Sociology. Go to every class and pay attention and you'll easily get an A. There's basically 2 exams, 2 papers, and a group project. Keep up with the readings or you won't do well on any assignment. She is super helpful and funny too! Overall a great professor
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr Henderson is a sweetheart and she keeps it real with her students. Taking socy 333 was amazing, yet a bit rough because the readings that were assigned were very long. For anyone who wants to take her in the future, please do yourself a favor and read Atleast 2 days before class. Do not cram the readings in one night b/c they will be long.

Professor Henderson i genuinely tries however she does not make her power points nor are they available online. When she gives a review sheet its just an email giving you generic tips on how to study and a vague ideas as to what one question would be like. Her section on rape education was lacking and almost apologetic.

Loren Henderson is one of the best professors I've ever had.  She makes lectures exciting and teaches on interesting relevant topics to our society. She's funny and I actually enjoyed going to her classes each day. She does assign group projects but they aren't too bad. She assigns a few papers too but will allow you to redo them for more credit.
A lot of work, but follow guidelines and you'll be fine. People made it harder than it was

professor Luis is a bad professor i have ever had. He is rude and expect the student to know everything.  He makes you feel incapable of doing anything as if you are worthless. He is a bad professor as well as a worse adviser. Bottom line is that avoid taking his class.

He is by far the worst professor i've had at UMBC. He complicates everything and makes things harder than they need to be. He constantly contradicts himself. He is a very harsh grader and as no problem trashing your work and leaving rude comments. He also expects everyone to come to class but he just goes on rants about nothing. AVOID his classes.

I've heard from multiple sources that he is a terrible adviser who frequently contradicts himself, does not help with graduating on time, and is overall very difficult to work with. See if you can change advisers if you have him, and try to avoid his classes. The fact that he is the department head makes things all the more challenging :(

I think this professor wants his students to succeed. However, his diplomacy skills are terrible. He lacks a lot of tact. So, don't be surprised if he comes off as rude. He is also not very clear on his expectations on things. As an adviser, I do not think he has helped many students graduate on time.

Probably the hardest class I took in my entire college career because of this professor. I'm a senior now and back in freshman year, I was considering majoring in happ. But nope not after taking this class! He was so rude, put everyone on the spot and was an awful grader. Avoid him! Definitely a million times happier graduating as an IS major :)
He is very rude and very unprofessional. Fights you and basically everything and provides little to no guidance.  Barely checks his email..

I love this professor! Yes, this course is harder than an average 101 course. However, Pinet-Peralta is amazing with explaining US Health Care and concepts focusing on this study. This class is interesting and you actually learn about the country you live in! Do not be put off by people who are lazy. Take this class. You can understand him.

A lot of people don't like Dr. Peralta, but that's because they don't like to do work. Dr. Peralta wants to make sure you have a good introduction to health and are serious about your future (I know right, how dare he). He opens up some great discussions and the class has a generous curve in my opinion. Dr. P is one of my favorite professors!
Not easy. You can get out of this class with a brain damaged, just because of the frustration.
He can make very simple assignments, very difficult. There was issues ever turn with him, and he can be difficult to work with. Avoid if you can
Avoid this professor at all costs! He is not helpful! Does not respond to emails! He is rude! This is my warning to you!!!
He is very strict. Can be very rude at times.
Make use of his office hours and read the book before taking tests and quizzes!

Although Dr. P seems nice, he is very strict. He puts everything online (assignments, quizzes, tests, etc.) but does not announce or update any changes made or any upcoming events. He does not update grades in a timely manner and is very slow at responding to emails. I'm a sophomore here and he's in the top 2 or 3 worst professor I've had at UMBC.

Took this class my Freshman year and was considering a minor in HAPP but after taking Prof. P I quickly changed my mind. Very cold professor and not very helpful. All quizzes & tests are on-line, including final. Unless you are a HAPP major I do not recommend this course.

Not an easy A. Too much work for a Intro/100 level class. Prof. P is very strict, always tells you to "refer to his syllabus". You must read the book to understand class material. Be prepared to have discussions in class, he will randomly pick on you. He is nice and approachable.

you have to read the textbook if you want to do well in the class. he teaches the class very closely to his syllabus. he gives opportunities to succeed, but you have to put in the work to get an A. definitely a LOT more work than any other 100 level class I've taken.

For a 100 level class, this professor teaches as if this is some 300 level class. Because of the language barrier, it is sometimes very difficult to understand him. There were many instances where he would say something that would be contradictory to what he said before, or what the syllabus stated.
Be Prepared To Work Your Butt Off For This 100 Level Course. If Only There Was Another Professor Teaching This Course.

Its a hate & love relationship wit Prof P. He's very easy to talk to and helpful outside of class. If you find yourself  struggling, seek help ASAP, do not hesitate! He is a VERY strict teacher, and he challenges your knowledge on the material. Therefore, it is VERY VERY important you read the textbook, witout it u will mos def fail.

I have never worked this HARD for all Chemistry classes I have taken so far-such INSANE work, yet he grades paper really low-even with 5 reviews, seeing him-Nothing helped. It is like he promised not to get good grade. Extra Credits are "joke" because he gives really low scored on those too. Got lucky got 100% in Final Exam. DO NOT RECOMMEND.

Dr. P is an amazing prof. All his quizzes and tests are online including finals. If you go to class, pay attention and do your reading you will do fine.He does pick on you randomly, but i guess it is good so that you pay attention plus they count towards participation point.. Take him. Not an ez A. but if you try you cud get it. I so far have an A.

This class is ridiculously hard! And so much work. He expects my 2 and a half hour lecture to be more of a "discussion" and always puts people on the spot randomly to answer his questions. Really hard to get a high grade in this class. Wish there was another HAPP professor...
straight forward....lots of extra credit

Nicest professor ever, and always caring and interested in what you have to say and write about. Clearly very passionate in english and really does a great job of making you have fun writing. The class structure is small and built around you growing as a writer and critic. Very useful and fun class that I will miss.

Amazing class, amazing professor, I had so much fun this semester. She is very encouraging and helpful, and I definitely enjoy writing even more since I've taken this class. She wants to hear what students have to say, both to her and their classmates. I would love to take one (or more!!) of her classes in the future.
Great professor would highly recommend. She gives great advice, is super patient with students, and her class was structured well.

McCarthy is well versed in her subject and genuinely curious about the contributions her students can make. She poses readings from multiple perspectives instead of a "one-right-way" style of lecturing. My class was small and we were able to go in depth about our opinions and backgrounds. Essays are open-ended but laid out well in advance

She's very kind and was flexible when my job caused conflicts. She couldn't remember my friend's pronouns ever though. At a social event, she also once asked me if gay people existed in the middle ages (she seemed happy to hear that they did). I wouldn't take her again but if it's a required class, just show up and you'll do fine.

ABSOLUTELY PHENOMENAL! It was a pleasure taking this class. I enjoyed it way more than I thought I ever would. She is passionate about writing and excellent at teaching. Well spoken and very caring. She lets you write whatever you'd like as long as you're passionate about the subject. No stress in any way. I'm going to miss her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. McCarthy is someone every student should have the opportunity to know and be taught by. She genuinely cares for what she is teaching and has a great presence overall. I would recommend her to anyone in any major. She just asks that you participate and share your true opinions.
Thank you
Stay away from this class please. She keeps graded work for so long and too harsh

Dr. McCarthy is very knowledgeable, reasonable, kind, loving, and encouraging. She genuinely enjoys teaching, and listening to her students. Very interesting class discussions, attendance is mandatory. 3-4 page papers once a week (33%), midterm paper (10-15 pages) (33%), final paper (10-15 pages) (33%). Fair grader. Highly recommended.

Extremely passionate about her teaching. This course has to be the best English course I have ever taken. I learned more with Dr. McCarthy than I did out of all my secondary education English courses combined. This class definitely helped me make great strides with my writing.
She is very passionate about her teaching. Down to earth, and really cares about your work as a writer.

Dr. McCarthy is one of the smartest, nicest professors at UMBC. She is truly interested and active in her field. There are two papers, no exams, a lot of reading to do, but it's all worth it. She's also extremely flexible with the papers, allowing you to write on almost anything. Plus, there's no minimum/maximum length.

She is the best of the best! Not only does she love what she does, but she's good at it! She gives her students so much freedom and is always full of encouragement and solid advice. Honest and always up for a class discussion. I took the class only for the credit, but it's definitely my favorite class because of her hippie-esque style!
Dr. McCarthy is very thoughtful and an excellent teacher. Class is very discussion oriented. Questions based on readings were due every week, and papers were open ended.

All my friends hated their Eng100 classes but 100H with McCarthy was GREAT. Make sure you come to class because she takes points off and your grade WILL SUFFER. She is very helpful and encouraging. I took the class just for fun. Open-ended assignments. You pick what you write about. Despite being a comp class, it isn't heavy writing.
Really, really laid back.  As long as you have a genuine interest in any sort of writing and attend class, you should get a good grade.
Brilliant, helpful, interesting--she is everything you could want a teacher to be.

She is the reason I became an ENGL major. Passionate, fun, and truly interested in making her students better writers. Not your average Comp prof by any means. She encourages creativity and class discussion. Excellent.
terrible. doesnt teach. no time for quiz.

James Lo is a completely useless professor. His explanations of concepts are nonsensical, he lectures multiple units ahead of the quizzes so his lectures are useless, and he doesn't give enough time on quizzes.

Avoid at all costs! He gave too little time for quizzes/final with too many questions. I never attended lecture (minus the first). I learned everything from Kimberly Brehm on YouTube. (She uses the same textbook.) I only got a B because of some curve. Grading was broken down as such: final exam at 32%, 6 quizzes at 8% each, and homework at 20%
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Listening to Lo's lectures is actively detrimental due to how poorly he explains the topics. Do not bother attending his class. The good thing, though, is that Linear Algebra is a relatively standardized topic, and the book (Lay & Lay) is absolutely top tier. Find good lectures on YT (I recommend James Hamblin's), and you should be set.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Online only provides pre recorded videos of lectures, the class is completely asynchronous. Only way to find out how you lost points/answers to problems is by pestering the grader. Textbook is difficult to understand and the lectures do not help. Do the homework, read the book, and get a tutor. 32% of your grade is the final.

This guy deserves a 0 star. Online lectures are horrible. He says he does not answer questions about homework or quizzes. "You need to learn by yourself." This guy should not be getting paid for being a professor. Read the textbook, watch youtube videos, and hope for an A. Getting a B is not bad if you really work on examples. Avoid this guy.

Lecture are useless so you reading the textbook is a must. Grading policy with homeworks and quizzes are vague and you'll find yourself losing points for arbitrary things if you don't email the grader about it. Quizzes can be difficult and you'll find yourself rushing to turn it in on time unless you're super prepared. Avoid this class if you can.

Took him for fall 2020, and his lectures really sucked. I stopped watching them a few weeks in because they were just so boring and reading the textbook was faster and more clear anyways. Avoid taking him if you can.

Professor Lo is by far the worst professor i've ever had, and trust me the bar at UMBC is not high. First off, the class is asycnchronous. His video lectures were so awful, he had to make another professor's videos available to us. He doesn't even do any of the grading himself, a TA does. He actually does nothing. He also refuses to communicate.

I have him for an online class. He is strict and unhelpful. Def the most uncommunicative professor I have ever had. I asked if he could have one of his TAs send out an announcement on days when quizzes are due and he told me "don't rely on other people." Keep in mind his class is the only one out of the 5 I'm taking right now that doesn't do this.

Professor Lo is the worst professor I have ever had in a class. I understand with Covid going on that online classes would be different, but this classes schedule is absolute garbage. 6 quizzes that each focus on a topic you turned in the HW for months ago and he said he'd "ignore messages about HW and quizzes because it doesn't concern him" AVOID

My advice as someone who did well in the class Ignore him read the text book and know the hw every hw problem he gives you even if it's not for credit do it Make a study group Do the homework over and over again until you can do it quickly Past quizzes won't help you he changes them every semester TA's grade everything he only grades the final
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Worst professor ever. Unapproachable and won't help you with homework during office hours until after it is submitted. Never in my life had another professor who would refuse to help with homework questions during office hour. He doesn't know how to teach either
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Get ready to teach yourself because this prof is basically useless. Even if you show up to every lecture, you can't understand what he is talking about. He goes on frequent tangent and starts ranting about things outside of class. Frequently comes in 10 minutes late and always has technical problems with his mic which causes another delay.

Go to lectures, because if you don't and he decides to take attendance you lose 3% of you grade. Bring other work to do during lectures, because they're not worth paying attention to. The textbook is great, which is good since it's the only way you'll be learning. The exams are easy and mostly MC, though he is liable to mess up printing them.

The class lectures are structured straight out of the book but you can't skip to read the book because he takes attendance sometimes, for a grade. Tests and exams are pretty hard but doable with book knowledge. Half of the time you ask him for help he'll just tell you to read the syllabus and walk away. Don't take him.

Lectures are near useless but if you skip, you lose 3% of your final grade. Won't tell you what the homework is outside of class. This textbook was amazing though and the reason I passed. All quizzes are multiple-choice with few questions. You're lucky if you get partial credit, even with work. Kept grading quizzes wrong. Blames TA for everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: His lectures are useless. The one thing I am grateful for in his class is the quality of the textbook. If you are unlucky enough to get him, study from the textbook during class so you don't need to do it outside as much. Office hours are just something written in the syllabus, he does not want people to come in. Does not use any type of feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Hard to hear, can't teach (so you have to teach yourself). Literally the worst professor in the math department. Attendance is mandatory, though he doesn't take it all the time. When he does, if you're not there, you'll lose 3 percentage points off your weighted average before your course grade is determined (taken straight from the syllabus)

He's kind of strict, but the class was structured nicely. Just remember to read the textbook and complete the homework assignments. Attendance is non-mandatory. Didn't go to class other than reviews and exams, still got an A. It's an easy class. While Lo's lectures are not the best, his grading is fair. Stop being dependent on lectures, guys.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Lo seems kind, sometimes says funny things in lecture... but it's very difficult to understand him in class. Speaks quietly to the board, can't see what he's writing but made attendance mandatory. 4 quizzes worth 12.5% each. Quizzes are mostly multiple choice so either you get the points or you don't. Read the book, do the hw and you'll pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Impossible to talk to. If something was graded incorrectly, he is no help since he doesn't do any of the grading himself. If a mistake was made on his end, he'll either blame you or his poor TA who has to grade all his stuff for him.
He is the worst professor I had ever seen.

Dr. lo cannot explain math concepts to you. lots of hw, 4 quizzes, final exam. He says he curves, but well see. He has a grader for the class and that damn grader will give you a 0 or a 10 for each problem. You will teach yourself and still not pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Terrible professor, never answers hw questions correctly
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: He doesn't really teach and he's a little rude, but you can learn almost everything you need to know from the textbook. Homework every week.

Do not take James Lo for any math class. He's impossible to understand in class, just reads of the lecture slides and expects you to understand everything he's saying. Goes on tangents very often. Exams are poorly structured, often there will be one question which is either wrong or out of the course content. Self-taught everything in this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I taught myself Differential Equations. Although I went to every lecture, I can't honestly say I got anything out of it. Dr. Lo is a really nice guy (he'll talk to you about machine learning or control systems for an hour), but a terrible teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Not a difficult class, but the professor simply read from standardized lecture slides word for word. Often rambles about irrelevant topics from other courses. Has a couple policies that simply hurt students with no added benefit (ex. If youre sick and miss a class, he wont tell you what you need to make up. Dont have a friend in class? Take a 0)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Horrible Professor. He is not clear and hard to follow during lecture, no lecture outlines or powerpoints just all chalkboard. Need the textbook for homework. Grades consist of homeworks and 3 exams. If you are good at reading the textbook and learning on your own he might be good for you, otherwise do NOT take him.

Awful teacher that constantly loses assignments. He misplaces homeworks and exams. He makes class completely pointless because he only goes over theorems and spends the rest of class on a single practice problem. Although his exams are SUPER easy, if you plan to use linear algebra in the near future do not take his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: So, he is just okay. In terms of lecturing, he is not one of the best but he makes the class easy for you. If you read the textbook and practice problems, you should be able to do the homework and exams well. He also drops the lowest 2 homeworks and he listens when students complain about stuff

Dr. Lo makes it very clear from the beginning that he is willing to accommodate student requests and criticisms about how he teaches. Pretty easy exams. I haven't studied very much for any of them (maybe  2 hrs for each) and averaged a mid/low B each exam. He outlines the exam questions. Do all assigned problems.

Extremely unprofessional. Regularly showed up late; one time came to class 18 minutes late. Loves bragging about himself. Complains about students' criticisms about him and is visibly enraged while doing so. Speaks to the whiteboard and does not know how to explain things. Exams were very hard and averages low, and he still claimed they were easy.

To start, I'm retaking DFQ with him. Compared to my last prof he is completely rational, and fair. Lectures are sorta useless, but go to them or else he'll threaten harder exams. He will tell you, question by question, what the exam will include. Studying is super efficient. Super nice dude. He's gonna try to convince you that you're immortal.

It's true; Lo's lectures are basically straight from the book and not worth going to (I never did). BUT. He is also extremely knowledgeable, attempts to make class interesting, and--most importantly--his exams are incredibly fair, even easy. As someone who prefers learning on their own, his class was perfect for me and I would take again.

I had Diff Eq with Lo as a last minute addition to my schedule. The man is obviously brilliant, however his ability to teach is not all that strong at all. Lectures consisted of him reading from the book and talking about his research. Also, the book for this class is awful. It doesnt help when the book is bad and the professor doesn't teach well.

Lo isn't hard at all, but don't take him if you want to truly learn DiffEq. That being said, he'll do anything you ask within reason- homework extensions before exams, doing extra problems for a section, etc. Also remember to READ THE BOOK, not only does he tell you what's on the test, but most of the problems come from the textbook.

Basically, majority skips class all the time and turn in hw at the beginning of every mon.  Dr. Lo goes through proofs then examples without numbers to confuse you.  Best bet is to learn from the book during class and get a free tutor.  He curved generously because I had a low B coming into the final and had an A.  Also, he laughs at his own jokes.

I took this class for fun as an elective.  I did not take a single note all semester, and I skipped 75% of the classes.  And yet I ended with a solid A average on homework, a B+ on the first exam, an A on the second exam, and most likely an A on the final exam.  The exams are ALL multiple choice, which makes them 100 times easier.

Find old exams from students who have taken the class in previous semesters and study them like your life depends on it. If you can't find them then the application problems from the Homeworks are almost identical to the ones in the exam with different numbers. Going to class didn't help, READ THE TEXTBOOK!

No partial credit. Not helpful with answering questions. Boring to listen too and will focus more on making jokes then teaching you material. Weekly hw, no quizzes. doesnt explain well. had him for math 221

Knowledgable professor but very boring to listen to. Most students only showed up to turn in homework and left early. Homework is weighted heavily and test questions are multiple choice and a lot easier than the homework. If you do the homework it should be pretty easy to get at least a B in the class.
nice professor! average teaching.  he will answer every HW question if u ask. no quiz and tests are easy!
Funny guy, he'll make many jokes. Horrible teacher. Stands in front of the board, doesn't actually teach. Difficult to comprehend. He'll answer any questions though!

tests are multiple choice, so no partial credit. this sucks, but his questions are fair. they are based off of homework and examples in the book. he doesn't include anything hard or tricky because he knows that we wouldn't have time to finish. i thought he was very fair. answers every single question asked in class.
His tests actually test comprehension, and although he's a bit set in his ways, the class explains the stuff, and he'll spend all of class explaining questions if need be.

Looks like no one reviewed him for diff eq. He is terrible, I end up teaching myself everything, grade consists mostly of tests. His tests are impossible to do well on because they are multiple choice and there is no partial credit if you circle an incorrect answer, so small mistakes take huge chunks off grades. Test problems look nothing like HW.
Avoid if possible.

not to easy, not to hard. hw and quiz every week, but the quizzes were very easy. test and quiz questions were basically from the book, but you do need to study for tests. hes a bit hard to understand and bad at explaining but he'll try till you pretend to understand. if you get a 94 on the final, you automatically get an A. id take him again.

The way the class is set up isnt bad, but requires a lot of study. Homework and quizzes are very important tho! I just grew annoyed with his accent. He knows how to teach (done it for a while so its like a script) but it becomes hard to understand when you ask him questions..and everytime he laughs and/or tells a dry joke it sounds like hes crying

James Lo is not a bad professor, but isn't a good professor either. HW and quizes are 40%, 2 exams 15% each, final for 30%. The quizes and tests come directly from the HW. DO THE HW, it will get you an A. Class is pointless bc he just regurgitates the book. The class isn't too hard, get in groups. HW is around 20 prblems  a week. Is a little funny.
Outstanding teacher when compared to Dr Pittenger for Linear Algebra.

I skipped class daily and when I did attend, usually left early and pulled off an A.  You MUST study though.  Grades are not curved.  Homework is assigned weekly and there is a quiz every Thursday so be ready!!  He's difficult to understand, so sit towards to the front of the room.  Course is VERY easy, so you won't see many people on non-exam days

This is an easy class, but it does require a lot of your time. I aced both exams, but messed up on the final (like the other person said, final is really long)- ended up getting a C overall. So not as easy. A lot of quizzes. Probably one every other day. A lot of hw. Let's just say this class requires you to do a lot more than you really need to

-THE- best teacher to take Linear Algebra with. Especially if math isn't your thing. He graded our second test out of 110% in order to help everyone do well, and his lectures, though somewhat boring, can be very easy to understand.

HWs are never returned on time to study for exams. Lectures are boring. Always goes off topic. Someone used a calculator for their exam and he didn't do anything about it after he was informed of it which was very unfair.
I think he grades pretty leniently. Quizzes and exams but if you study then you'll do fine. He switched the exam formats into multiple choice and it seemed to make them harder.

He gives homework and grades them based on accuracy, but his quizzes are easy, and the quizzes and tests are designed so that if you did your homework, you will do well on them. About 12 h.w., 11 quizzes, 2 tests, and final. I think he has tendency to make the subject seem harder than it is, but overall I would recommend him.

TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!  His quizzes are extremely, first exam was mild, and both the second exam and final were multiple choice.  As long as you keep up with the material the class is an easy A.  Lectures are a bit on the boring side however.  Just read the book.

Dr. Lo knows his material: he teaches on his own thing but it's carefully planned to parallel the book, sometimes he goes on tangents about related material. His jokes don't make a whole lot of sense, but that's all right. His lectures are very clear and he won't test you on something he hasn't returned homework for. Very Nice.

I really enjoyed this class. It wasn't too hard, and he tries to make the quizzes and tests easy. The homework is really simple as well, especially if u buy the Study Guide that goes with the textbook. His stories are pretty lame though

Okay, all he does for exams is use the example problems from the text book didnt figure that out untill around the 2nd exam , there is no curve --- he speaks somewhat english and whines about how we " american students" have it easy
No Comments

asian accent, goofy, makes stupid jokes, try to aoid, if need to take him, make sure to do all unrequired homwork, thats what his exmas are they arent too hard. wastes time, usually 5 min late to class

Dr Lo brings chills down my spine. He won't help you with questions about the homework, because he believes in your mistakes... He's a fun person and has a stable family -I hear his kid is a party animal, Chris I think? Anyway, you have no choice but Lo with 215. Easssy class, FRUSTRATING GRADER!!!

He does have a thick accent and make errors.  He is very nice and the material and tests are very easy.  Not everyone will be helped by him but he does answer questions.  For linear algebra he is a good choice if you sit towards the front.
makes no sense at all

He is incredibly hard to understand because of his accent and he talks to the board.  He also makes at least one error per problem that he does in class.  He's not very good at answering questions people have.
yeah what he said.
Accent makes him hard to understand, tests are EASY- they all have reviews

Didn't show up to class a lot of the time and was condescending in emails and when approached. Many of us had to reach out to the department head to get her to fix our grades. Would not recommend her class.

I wouldn't take this class to actually learn anything but if you're interested in an easy A then it's perfect. Professor Lucas is extremely rude and unapproachable but her class has only a few assignments that are straightforward but pointless.

Super hilarious and makes class enjoyable! One semester-long group project, but it's just a few assignments. 2 individual assignments. No exams. Fun and laidback intro class. Would recommend her 100%.

The class was amazing. She was energetic and taught many valuable lessons and led me to many valuable resources. Her class was easy for the most part as long as you paid attention. She had a sense of humor and was understanding. After every class I felt like I learned something new. She is definitely one of the best professors I've ever had!

One of the best! She is very inspirational as a mom and business owner. Teaches with experience in entr. The course was fairly easy: we had the semester long group project and entrepreneur interviews. With the textbook assigned readings (which are never quizzed), she has us listen to podcasts (also not quizzed), and we don't get midterms/finals.

Don't worry about the other reviews, I heard he was fresh out of grad school and was new to teaching. His test are a little theory heavy but if you read over the slides, they are not too hard. MAKE SURE TO DO EVERY REVIEW PROBLEM. He's a nice guy but I did find it more helpful to go to the TAs for help.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The lectures were confusing and repeated the same problem for multiple days. We fell very behind in material. However, the preparation for the exams was good and allowed people to do well in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: His lectures...absolutely terrible. He'd spend a whole week trying to solve one question, sometimes he'd get stuck on a question/need help from his TA. Lectures don't help with homework and his homework doesn't help w/ exams. His exams cover in-depth theory not stressed enough during lectures. He's a nice guy though if you come to his office hours.

Absolutely horrific, this was his first semester teaching and it shows. His lectures were very bland and often useless for completing the homework. His exams were more theoretical and complex than they had to be. Overall a bad experience and this course has killed any interest I had in the subject. Stay away from this professor at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: homework unrelated to the lectures in class. exam free response punish early mistakes through the problem. can not lecture. discussion is just more bad lecture no engagement with students. lots of theory without practice. homework problems do not prepare you for assessment. but he does give practice exam problems despite being very challenging.
just dont for the sake of your sanity just dont
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework
Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Weekly hw and quizzes. He had video lectures that were an hr long but really good so I didnt have to use the book at all. Had to use lockdown with webcam for exams. Uses quickly for attendance. Discussion board was extra credit. The discussion section was optional, only had to attend if u need more help. Overall nice guy, but strict grader

This class was whew. He loves to make your brain dance for the answers. Overall he's a good explainer(so I didn't use the textbook) in his prelecs but they were an hour long and given the day of your class. If you don't have time, don't take him, if you do, enjoy. Make sure to do ALL of the extra credits esp since exam averages were low!

weekly online quizzes  say goodbye to partial credit, if ur off even by a little bit ur answer is wrong and u lose 3pts out of a 10pt quiz. there is prerecorded lecture AND synchronous lecture, so the class is 2 hours long instead of one, plus you have discussion. I wish the class were in person, maybe then I could pass. in conclusion: get a tutor

Dr. Grinnell is a wonderful professor and very easy to speak with. She is a fair grader and gives good feedback. I liked how she would interact with students in the discussion boards. This is the professor to take.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Grinnell is a great teacher. She gives students feedback on the two papers she assigns. Since this was an online class, she gave time for students to complete assignments such as the discussion(worth 10 points) and quizzes(worth 5 points). She has students interact with each other. Textbooks were helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: There's a lot of reading but the content is interesting. Take good notes, will make the in class reflections pretty straightforward and easy. Very fair grader. Show up, do your work and reading and you'll get an 'A'. Dr. Grinnell is easy going, would definitely take another class with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The only really hard thing about the class was the very vague essay prompts, but she will take the time to help you out with them. Exams for this class were online and very reasonable. It met once a week which meant lots and lots of textbook reading. Participation mainly meant showing up and she allows one free absence. Overall reasonable and nice
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The lectures were interesting and he's a funny guy and makes the class more bearable. Exams are verbatim from the lectures. Take good notes and he will list exactly out what you need to study for the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great professor, he tells you exactly what's on the test. There 3 tests and 1 paper. Responds to emails quickly and there is no textbook. Only got a C because I didn't do well on the test. Since he teaches at college park, he goes by college park schedule. If their out most likely he'll cancel class. He's funny, fun and passionate about geography.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Good for an easy gen ed. Make sure you come to class, it helps on the exams. Professor was kind of boring though, but a nice guy.

Dr. Luna is a nice man, but I feel like he dumbs things down a little too much for a 300 level class. Exams are essay based, and you have to write quite a few papers. Not too difficult of a class, but dreadfully boring. This class is definitely more of a history class than an environmental science class.

Literally the worst class ever. I have never had such an incompetent professor. He yells at students for being lazy to not attend class but is too lazy to give any extra credit. 3 exams. Doesn't even appear to care for the material. I have yet to see a worse teacher than this guy.

Great class, amazing professor. Luna really explains topics well, and makes the lecture fun to learn. He's really funny, which made the class lively. The class is very easy.. just come to class and listen and you'll get no lower than an A. We had 3 tests, no homework and no quizzes. And before tests, he would tell us what was on the test.

i took ronald luna in ges 102 human geography and ges302 selected topics in latin america he is a very good teacher human geography was really easy. ges 302 was a little bit harder but still did really good just allot of writing in 302 on exams and two research  papers but not exteremly long papers/

This professor is obviously very passionate about what he teaches. His lectures were very interesting, and he told you the important things that you needed to know or write down. Also provided a study guide for his exams verbally if you showed up to class.

Human Geography. Great professor, funny and interesting. Luna shows interest for class material and loves to engage students in discussion. Material is not difficult, mostly facts and concepts. There is a direct positive relationship between attendance and exam grades. Go to class, take notes, get good scores and you'll LOVE the class.
loved professor lynch. she was very chill you just do a few papers and there's a midterm and final. make sure you read the textbook tho.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: very chill professor. brings real-world experience as a government affairs professional in her day job!

Absolutely my favorite professor at UMBC, cares so much, even recommended me for a fantastic internship! Super informative and interactive lectures. She does a great segment at the beginning of class where everyone shares some recent news, this sparks excellent conversation. If you have the chance to take her class, DO IT!
Really fantastic lecturer, Gives fantastic feedback and hints for quizzes. Would take any class she offers.

Very knowledgeable as she's involved with political campaigns, and she knows the material well. There were weekly readings, I did none of them but still got an A because I attended an extra credit opportunity that barely pushed me over. Pretty easy class overall, she's also very helpful and accessible.
