reviews.comment: I absolutely love Dr. Pekarkse. She is funny and kind and does her very best to make class interesting and enjoyable. She is extremely passionate about poetry and truly puts her everything into teaching it. She does slack a little bit on updating grades, so don't be shocked if you look on Blackboard and see that you have a bunch of 0's lol

Very cool professor. Easy to communicate with and more than willing to offer help. Offers many resources and outlines to support you in your work. Does not assign too much work, but make sure that you stay on top of things or else it will get difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Pekarske is probably the worst professor in the entire UMBC. She randomly takes points off for no reason without offering any explanation and then takes a whole month to respond to emails. She also gives very little assignments which gives you no opportunity to bring your grade up. The class is easy but the way she grades things will fail you.

this class is ridiculous. if you can get another prof for this course PLEASE DO. she is very unorganized, nothing makes sense, switches up the schedule in the middle of the semester, the way she grades makes no sense, work is poorly explained and just vague. supposed to be an easy A but it's not. a very confusing class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Extremely disorganized, schedule constantly changed and there were many due dates that weren't clear or changed last minute. Classes were also moved online at the last minute. Grading criteria for papers is unclear and when discussing readings, be careful not to go against what she says because she will shoot you down immediately.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: A poetry class always involves interpretation, however Pekarske only had one alleyway to go down for interpretation: sex. Predicting what shes going to clearly misinterpret can make you audibly lol. As long as you hand in poems youll get an A. Shes very forward and encouraged students to drink to have more fun. Funny but not cut out for teaching

In a creative writing class, she is a really good professor albeit stubborn and at times rude. She knows the craft very well and she does a good job engaging with your poetry in a meaningful, helpful manner. However, as a teacher she is a bit disorganized and can be a harsh grader. If you are not on top of your work, do not take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: It's one of those classes where it's supposedly an easy class, but it just isn't. She makes the assignments much more difficult than they actually are, and the instructions are never clear. She's a nice person, she just isn't clear at all which makes her class difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: She is really vague about what she wants out of your writing. She grades harshly and is picky about wording. A lot of the activities in-class felt like filler assignments. You pick one topic for all of the essays in class. Because of this, you'll find yourself hating your own topic by the second essay. She doesn't like if you disagree w her ideas
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Have to read about 30 pages per reading, does not answer emails, does not post grades, doesn't update things that she says she would. Honestly one of the worst English teachers I've ever had.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Friendly, open-minded professor - engages with students and works with diverse feedback. Has high expectations, but makes them clear so you know what is expected. Best way to pass is to engage with her and ask lots of questions. Also drinks a lot of diet Coke.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Theres daily readings for about 1/4 of the given book. Lectures were given by student instead of her. You may even be able to plagiarize as she lets it slide. Nothing is posted online so dont expect to keep track of it. Never went off the syllabus.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: I had a wonderful experience in her poetry class. She is laid back and cares about you. Critiques were fun. Gives clear info on how you can improve your poems. Easy poetry assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I usually dislike English classes. However - Pekarske has been one of the few English teachers that I genuinely feel has helped to improve my writing. Her essay critiques are of the best I've ever been given. I highly recommend this professor.
doesn't answer emails and her rubrics are very vague, pointless, and don't make sense

WARNING: INFORMATIONAL WRITING IS NOT WELCOME. As an engineering major, I write things based around hard evidence, facts, and logic. In other words, I do not like to present unproven theories as factual, because they aren't. However, she likes writing that jumps to conclusions, so if you don't write like a tabloid, you better learn how to B.S.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: She is amazing. I agree with some of the negative comments because she does not like it when you disagree with her but besides that she is perfect. She is very knowledgeable and an entertaining professor. Once you understand what she likes, you will get an A no problem.
My favorite English professor of all time, she's very nice and funny. She cares about her students!

I was scared to take her class because of the reviews. There are lots of papers but you can pick most any topic. If you go to the writing center they can help you with grammar. I was going through a very rough time. I talked to her privately she gave me very good feedback on papers and listened to me. I would take her again, made me love english.

She's not a bad teacher exactly, but she isn't clear on what she wants. She does cancel class sometimes and isn't specific about what answers she wants on exams. I think I'm doing well in the class, but she's very hot and cold depending on the day. There are only a few writing assignments, but the exams are difficult. Participate and it's fine!

She is a very intelligent professor and teaches unique ways how to write a paper. However, she only had the class out of 100 points and a 91-100 was an A. I am a 4.0 student and got my first B in this class. Very hard grader on essays (only 5.) Not doing the readings and posting discussions would only count against you, not for you.

No exams, I believe there were 5 essays total. There was homework at times but it was rarely turned in, more for the purpose of in-class discussions. Having good writing skills will benefit you greatly in this class. She grades essays harshly and focuses mainly on how the entirety of it pieces together. Pay attention to grammar and MLA citation.

Dr. Pekarske was an awful teacher.  If you want to get a good grade (I somehow ended up with an A), your papers need to have very little information, a lot of fluff, a lot of questions, and you need to figure out how she likes stuff written.  She canceled class a lot which was nice, but there are definitely much better english 100 teachers at UMBC.
She's kind of a harsh grader. Give your papers your all and don't slack off (There's 6 of them). Pay attention to her rubrics. I recommend her.

Unhelpful. Terrible teacher. Essays about politics will be ripped to shreds if you don't have the same opinion as her. Avoid this class. Only likes people that suck up. If you're willing to lose your dignity to get a decent grade, go for it. If you aren't willing to suck up, avoid this class. Not worth it. Maybe you'll get a C on your merit. Maybe.
Don't take this class with this professor! No grade updates at all so you have no idea where you stand. Required reading doesn't count toward the grade at all.

Made us buy a textbook that was full of articles that were available online...unnecesssary. She missed class way too much. And if you want even close to a B, make sure your midterm paper and final paper are your best work ever. Nothing else really counts

She is a decent professor. She cancelled class many times due to being sick. She makes up BS assignments for class that don't really help with the papers that we need to write. Do the work and you will get an A, but make sure you do it the way she wants you too.

I had her for intermediate poetry and I really enjoyed that class. She has some conservative views on poetry and I disagreed with her a lot but it was a pretty fun class anyways. (and it helps that she is so frank.)Just do the work and you'll get an A.

She's a great teacher and really likes teaching English. If you want to get an A, your papers must be publishable, which means grammatically correct, clear, and interesting. She's very nice and often uses smiley faces on papers when grading. She's definitely a recommended teacher.

An excellent professor, passionate about her work, very knowledgeable, and always ready to help students.  Also very funny and nice!  And pretty!  Really helped me write better.  Take her class if it's available!

This instructor grades fairly if you follow the rubric for the assignment.  Some of the classroom activities didn't seem to really help, but the overall experience was positive and Dr. Pekarske was very helpful.
Classic english teacher who hates arguments that don't match her own views.  Be warned about taking her class if you really want to improve your writing.

self-absorbed and genuinely unfriendly. does not respond to e-mails, gives ambiguous assignments, acts as though her interpretations are solely valid. felt she didn't really care about the class or her students, though.. and left us to do the the teaching, while she threw in a sarcastic joke/fact about herself. interesting subject matter, however.

Leaves the students to teach the class rather than doing it herself.  Gives out too many assignments and not enough time to do them.  Very blunt.  Spends too much time on somethings and not enough on others.  She thinks she is very insightful because she asks rhetorical questions however they're completely irrelevant to the topic of discussion.

241B was overall an easy class. I definitely reccomend it for an AH elective. She is difficult, yes, but you will learn a lot in the class. There were weekly journals for the first 10 weeks of class and one final paper. Participation is a MUST! She definitely does not hold back on her opinions. Don't be afraid though, just say SOMETHING in class.

Nicole is intelligent and funny. Some people get frustrated with her because they simply cannot think on her level. If you do not want to think or participate, don't take her class. If you want to be involved and pushed to think, take it!

If you like English and really want to improve as a writer this class for you.  If you are normally and don't care about writing do not take this course.  You will write 6 papers in the semester ranging from 3-7 pages each. She's really particular and will fail you if your writing style annoys her.

So, you really have to pay attention when she's talking and have read the required material before class. She'll start a statement then ask you to finish it. No exams, but a lot of writing. Pretty self-directed class. Do the reading and you can't complain! A lot of deep thinking required.

Okay yes she is hard.. but I never liked English and I got an A... I was very upfront about that to her as well. She does care about her students and will help you if you go in.. or maybe she just likes me. She does expect a lot of your writing but it makes every other writing assingment you do look easy compared to what should be easy in her class
Yep, couldnt agree more.. wish i wouldve read the comments before taking the class. I'm probably gonna get a C in this class and its gonna destroy my GPA... goodbye dean's list

i agree with the last person.. pretty bad. she thinks that information is useless whether it is or not.. she will not help youif you have problems.. u must be able to write well above your level and probably hers to get an a. writes poetry and is 'snobbish' about it. she is so full of herself. i will never take another class that she teaches

AWFUL TEACHER! she does not know how to fairly assess a students work... she is very cold, impersonable, sarcastic, rude, boring, rigid, intimidating, unenthusiastic, and yeah that about sums it up! :-)

Fun class.  Only really needed to attend class to hear the presentations.  Videos on reserve at the library...only downside is that you could check them out, so if someone had already checked it out you had to go to Blockbuster and try your luck there.  She was very open to discussion, would take another class with her.
Has an attitude, very condescending dosent seem to like to help. If you actually like writing, this class might be alright, otherwise find another professor.
DO NOT take anything with her!!! She is very unclear, and not approachable.  Totally stuck on herself, and is not  interested in herlping the students.

Quite possibly the worst teacher I have ever had and the worst human I have ever encountered. She is unclear, unmotivated, lazy (cancelled class all the time), and stuck on herself. Never take her. She should be fired. A waste of money is what her class was. I suggest holding out for a better teacher for 391.

It's hard to really gauge what she wants in the class.  Two writing assignments, and show up every day and particpate.  The material you will read is very interesting and classic, but she is not.  She really doesn't do anything except add her two cents.  Most of the time she was friendly, and added some humor, but really, don't take the class.
Above average for toughness.  Class had 110 points possible and was graded out of 100. We didn't read any novels.  We just learned about writing.

Not a bad teacher, tried to lead discussions rather than just lecture on pre-defined interpretations of material. Light work-load, 2x 5 page papers that were both not backbreaking to get As on. If you're a decent writer, it's cake. If you can't write or think criticaly, um, pick a different major kiddo. Zero research required, friendly demeanor.

Class is conducted as a reading circle, taught by a different STUDENT each class.  Can I have my $1,000 back for this course?  I'm not paying to be taught by other students.  If I wanted that, I can go to my book club on the weekends.  She sits and listens each class and puts her 2 cents in every now and then.  She might as well be a student.
horrible Do nOt take it , unless you are live in the fantasy world
DO NOT TAKE!!!!  She has you write papers on the most ridiculous of topics and do the most asinine of class work.  A total waste of time.
she is the worst professor i've ever had. she has no format and doesn't tell you what she wants in a paper, which is perfection. i warn you not to take this class because you will regret it.
No Comments
No Comments

On the first day of class she said," If you follow all the directions and meet the requirements of the paper, you will get a C." She expects wayyy too much. Her grading is very subjective and it basically depends on her mood. She expects you to write Pullitzer Prize material every time. Waste, AVOID
WTF...worst class EVER. she definitely expects way too much.  very unfair and sarcastic. she makes everything 10 times harder than it realli should be. worst class i have taken so far.
unfair... too many papers... says one thing, means another... shell take off letter grades for it too. if u take her... good luck! and have fun learning nuthing
No Comments
expects wayy  too much from freshmen. avoid if possible...!!

This teacher expects a lot from her students.  If you are someone who gets straigt A's, don't take her. But as long as you are happy with a B, you will learn a LOT from her about writing.  She can even make evening classes interesting.

Ughhh DO NOT take her... its a freshman basic comp class and she expects all A or B work to be publishable.  college level writing is a C/D to her.  too bad she only has one thing published and she has her PH D.  Shes extremely biased.. her activities are pointless. wat a waste of time.

Professor Novak truly cares about the success of his students. Attendance is optional but I 100% recommend going as he his slides are not posted online and the tests are based on content in the lectures. He explains things very clearly.

Dr. Novak is extremely organized and designs the class so everyone can get an A. The class consists of 4 exams and 13 quizzes, the exams can be retaken once and the quizzes have unlimited attempts and a built-in grace period. His syllabus tells you exactly what you need to do to be successful making this class super easy and worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
He's really sweet, the quizzes are online and super easy and based on the textbook and the exams are based on the lectures, but he gives guided notes as a study guide and so theyre super easy. Only need to go to lecture to fill out the guided notes, unless you have a friend who goes and gives you notes. 
Overall great prof and really easy class!

LOVE PROF NOVAK! Honestly the best professor ever! Class is so well structured, he cares and you can tell he wants you to pass! You do have to study to do well on exams but its very doable. Extra credit opportunities and very responsive. No group work and built in extensions for every assignment. He was great, overall the perfect college professor!

I liked his course. The professor set everything up in a way that reflected the class topic. This class made me feel I got the grade I deserved based on my work, and I thought it was fair overall. Textbook and lecture when they felt they complemented each other. The note system was interesting, and it helped with understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: If you do your work this is an easy A. There are four quizzes, and you can retake them if you get a 50% or higher on the first attempt. Attendance isn't mandatory but I would go because he uploads a fill-in the blank note sheet and that is basically your study guide for the exams. The lectures aren't bad at all, and he includes jokes and videos.

Dr. Novak is a amazing professor. I just finished up and he has very clear criteria of what he expects. The weekly reading quizzes and four exams all have a remedial to them. Basically a redo on exams and on the quizzes you can take them as many times as you need to get a 100. Be sure to always go to lecture as he does not post the slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr Novak is an amazing professor! We had four exams and 11 quizzes that were online. The textbook info was not on the exams; it was only on the quizzes. The exams were on the lectures and he has layouts of his notes that you just have to fill in the blanks. He has remedial exams that are helpful if you score 50% or above on the exams!

Professor Novak is fine. Personally, the way he teaches is not for everyone. Quizzes are pretty much based off of the textbook, while his exams are almost entirely based off of his lectures. Go to class and get the lecture notes for yourself, because they are not posted! I personally wouldn't take him again, but I was able to pass with an A.

Professor Novak is a nice teacher and if you go to class you should be able to score an okay grade on the exams. He has this policy that if you score above 50% on your exam you can retake it. He's a nice man and tries his hardest which is more than I can say for other professors here. If you need to take Psychology 210...take it with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Novak is an okay guy, but his teaching methods did not hold my interest. His quizzes and exams are easy, you honestly don't even have to go to class to pass them. That being said, I heavily disagree with some of his teaching ideals. He's insensitive to a lot of things and uses a textbook that's just as bad. Would not take again, but easy A.

I believe he is new this year, but he gives several opportunities for extra credit and other ways to improve your grade. His quizzes are heavily text-based while the exams are based on examples and topics from lectures. He takes criticism and uses it to improve the class if needed. It's hard to get a bad grade if you're actually trying.

The way he words everything is in such a professional manner that it can be confusing. Exams really are the only trouble, STUDY HARD!! Can't really hear him during the lectures, he's very soft-spoken even with the mic on. I don't really like the class, but it is easy.
The exams are the only trouble
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I looked for classes with Dr Zaidi this semester because I took her South Asia history class as a freshman and learned alot. I thought she would be the right Professor to take a class in current history with before I graduate but she's not teaching. But she was a great lecturer. I took the class to fulfill a gen ed requirement but I'm glad I did.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor knows her stuff and is interesting with lots of topics to manage. The class first seemed harder than it was but it was fine in the end and I got a good grade.

I feel lucky to take this class with professor Zaidi. Her Middle East class changed how I see the world and talk to people about it.. She's funny inspiring and her lectures can even make you emotional. If the semester was longer I would still have loved to sit in her class for more.

Took the class for the title but fr I learned SO much. She doesn't post her slides but you get used to it. Truth you don't really need them. Theres a lot of material but she always in her lectures checks in if you are confused and reposts past slides for review. We talk real things like race and womens lives and she has open mind about any opinions

From Ottomans to ISIS is the best class you will take at UMBC there is NO COMPARISON!! Professor Zaidi is an incredible lecturer. She's brilliant and also funny and engaging to have convos with. She creates a great environment in the class. If you're leaving UMBC without taking a class with her your loss.

NGL does teach very well and her lectures are incredibly interesting BUT she will grade very hard!!! LIKE SHE GRADES discussion has exams despite that it is history class and not everyone has sm clue about Islamic culture. SHE GRADES VERY HARD !! BE PREPARED TO DEAL WITH STRESS.
Very knowledgeable, although a bit fast paced. I would take more of her classes. She values communication, so just make sure to

Prof Zaidi's Modern Middle East class listed as 312 is awesome. It is intense because of the subject but she makes you think and care and cares what you think. It's a lot of reading but they are not boring and you learn a ton. Lectures are packed with content but interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Zaidi is very serious about her courses. She does not post any slides, assigns A LOT to read, and grades very tough. If you are the type of person who needs to reference the slides after class, or does not do well with tons of readings, this professor is not for you. Professor Zaidi treats her class like its the only class you're taking
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very knowledgeable professor but she's strict and not easy to talk to. Class was interesting, prepare to take notes and participate. I wouldn't take the class again but it was an okay experience.

A brilliant professor, but short-tempered at times with blinders on. Sometimes demonstrating authority overrides rational approach to class dynamics. Immense respect for her accomplishments & knowledge. Low marks for professionalism. Very low. Class-coasters beware: this is not a professor to look for an easy A. Or B. Or even C.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Zaidi is very good in what she is teaching. She has a complete command of the subject and is fabolous in teaching the material in an engaging way. There were sometime when I wanted to read her materials assigned in class later for a more in depth knowledge. Take her class, you won't be disappointed!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Does not respond to emails, and does not give any help to her students. Would not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: She is easily the best professor I have taken a class with at UMBC. She cares about her students, gives dense but interesting lectures and she grades fairly. She is personable and builds great relationships with students. If you take one History class I highly recommend taking one with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Zaidi is an amazing professor. Her lectures are fascinating, extremely informative, and unbiased. In addition, she readily answers questions and allows students to debate among themselves. I learned a lot. Her expectations are largely reasonable and you should be fine if you abide by them. She's very clear about what she wants.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. I took her for Modern Middle Eastern History and learned a TON. She definitely makes you work for your grade and grades hard, but all in all your cultural literacy will increase substantially. Classes can be lecture or discussion based but both ways are very engaging. Take this class if you can, but get ready to read/write a lot.

reviews.comment: The course is a fake course
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Great Prof, will take any class under him.

First let me say if you're taking 491 with Dr. Nicholas it will not be taught by him 90% of the time. The class is run and taught by the Cyberdawgs mostly. That being said, I thought the class was interesting and pretty low stress. When Dr. Nicholas is teaching he's pretty funny and anytime both he and the TAs were helpful when needed.
This man doesn't deserve to be a professor.

Took active cyber defense with him. The TAs were very helpful, they be up at 4am helping people. The homework got gradually harder as time went by and there are no exams. This class is not the most free A you can get, but if you try, you are fine. I learned a lot from the lectures and homeworks, and the CyberDef exercise was a true test. 10/10.

I took the Malware Analysis class with him. I learned a lot from this class. Dr. Nicholas and the TA was always helpful. The class is well organized. Homeworks are fair difficulty. You end up learning a lot from the homework. His lectures inspired me to choose my focus area of study going forward. I definitely recommend taking this class.

Dr. Nicholas was a fun professor teaching a fun class (Malware analysis). This is a very interesting field to get into and he makes the class enjoyable. There are no in class tests. There is a bit of HW that is graded easy and enjoyable even. Not the shortest thing in the world but not too long either.

Took him for Malware Analysis. Easy class. I liked his dry sense of humor. The material is interesting and he does a good job giving us hands-on practice through homeworks and take-home exams. Buy the book for sure, it's a valuable asset for quite cheap! I definitely want to look into this field more as a result of taking this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Nice guy for an elective class. Interested in subject. TA's harsh on late days. Fairly straightforward class but not the easiest A.

Malware Analysis was a fantastic class! I learned a ton while also slacking off a bit and enjoying my last semester at UMBC. Very caring and interesting professor to talk with. Easy A as long as you are willing to learn and do hands on practice. Definitely buy the book for this class, it's on $20 anyway.
Very reasonable professor. Going to take him again for Malware Analysis.

Enjoyed the Malware Analysis class under him. The class is perfectly balanced in terms of the work. You have guest lectures which are very interesting and the assignments are challenging as well as fun!

Dr. Nicholas is a great professor. Exams are easy (he let us use a note sheet). Projects aren't easy, so don't wait until the last minute to do them. Easily accessible via email and during office hours to explain something if you're having trouble understanding.

If you have to take 331, Nicholas is not a bad guy to take it with. Projects and exams aren't too bad, but there aren't a lot so each one has heavy weight towards your grade. He has a sense of humor and lectures can be fun if you're interested in the stuff, but he tends to go off on a lot of tangents. Might only spend 15 minutes actually teaching.
Exams and projects are hard and length. Can't finish on time! Do not skip lectures.

Dr. Nicholas is entertaining and helpful, but goes on tangents often. Only goes over what you need. Exams are fairly easy. HWs and 5 Projects are the same for all sections. Go to the TAs if you need help with projects, but he is helpful as well. Would recommend him.

Professor Nicholas only makes you learn what you will use in other courses; minutiae is not his priority. This class had a lighter workload than the introductory computer science courses at UMBC. He is very knowledgeable of the subject matter and is one of the best professors that I have taken a computer science class with at UMBC.

Charles Nicholas is not interested in working you to death or on minutiae memorization. He focuses on topics that are important later, gives enough of a homework for you to reinforce your understanding of the topic, and then lets you get back to life. One of the best professors I have had in my two years at UMBC. Highly recommended.

Dr. Nicholas tells great stories but it is very hard to learn anything in his lectures because of tangents. He doesn't grade quickly so it's hard to know where you stand in class. Interesting subject, guest lecturers and all, but not recommended.

Dr. Nicholas is actually a really cool guy. But he does have a tendency to roam off on tangents that aren't necessary. But 331 overall is NOT a difficult class. Just do the homeworks (like 5) and study for exams. Pretty easy to get at least a B.

Rusty on teaching skills.  Cannot clearly define approach and requirements of problem solutions to students. Grading is inconsistent.  Better off doing admin work in the department, and leaving teaching to those that can. Things taught are generally not practical, concentrates on theoretic material not useful in real world situations.
Professor made students use AI for our second assignment, disgusting use of college money. This guy needs to be fired

took drawing 2 and had a great time, very heavy on character design and helpful critiques. We watched old and new cartoons to contrast styles and he taught a little bit of history in regards to them as well. He will always give you the respect you deserve.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Suuuuper chill class. Nice guy, pretty much lets you focus on developing drawing in your way. He'll give you individual pointers but that's it, which might bother people if they're looking for a lecture-type-teaching-class. Doesn't collect things till the end. Also don't buy all the stuff, get good charcoal and a notepad, eraser, pencils, and go.

For a beginning drawing class, this class was pretty difficult!The professor is really nice though. Do not bulk up and buy all of the supplies like I did, because I did not use over half of the things and I wasted money.

I love this art class! I've never been an artist, but the atmosphere makes me want to draw and actually try. The class is really small so you get more individualized attention. Nohe doesn't favorite those who draw the best, he gives everyone good feedback.

By far my favorite course. Not only did our class learn techniques that can help in future careers, the class overall was very relaxed, able to complete challenging yet fun assignments and overall just learning something new. I definitely recommend this class to both majors and non-majors.

Prof. Nohe generally gives helpful comments during studio time and wants students to improve their skills and do well. He is also very open to students' ideas and approaches. The final discussion was very insightful as well.

Great professor, nice and laid back attitude. Extremely helpful and encouraging if you express interest- many resources to introduce you to.  Open-minded and fair. Presents very interesting lecture material, and will be glad to help if you need it as long as you make an effort.  Good email response time.

I never had him for VC whatever, but I love his personality. Somewhat quirky but funny & laid back. The atmosphere of the class is just really relaxing but you still learn a lot about Flash, particularly. Great, "can get an A" upperlevel art class! Take it!
one of the best teachers so far. always willing to lend a hand and very encouraging. i'd take any class he's teaching
He is not helpful. A nice guy but not helpful. And he is never in his office!
Nohe is very good at what he does and his classes are always fun. Great professor, extremely helpful, and would take any class that he teaches. Easy grader and will help you improve and learn a lot.

Was replete of ideological cant & double standards. Abilities of power-tripping of enthusiastic & obnoxious only lasts for so long before losing its appeal. Cold harsh reality of game playing. Emails go unanswered unless you push. Reading over 20 novels+ is force reading - it is unrealistic & it serves no productive goal.

reviews.comment: As public servant, Prof. North exercises her coercive power and needs to be let go from her position at UMBC. Her job is to teach, no more no less. I have no patience for her rudeness and cocky attitude. My guess would be that she is unhappy with herself. Perhaps, she suffers from psychosis and delusions along with low intelligence level.

Thank goodness this class over. Professor North expects an immense amounts of work to be done, which is unrealistic. She is not understanding or realize that life does not solely revolve around the class. With this volume of homework & the complexity of assignments, I would not recommend this demanding course, esp. being taught by Dr. North.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class should not have any asynchronous meetings. Prof. North teaches students what to think, not how. Assigning 20 novels for one assignment is overkill. Students are being taught to follow orders. Assigning too much homework to keep students busy deliberately results in not asking questions and not being creative which means indoctrination.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Remove TK20: it's indirect measure tool of assessment. Asking pronouns is not good. Students whose gender presentation may not match their gender identity are forced to lie or to out themselves in a new & possible unsafe environment, while those who are unsure of their gender identity are made to feel uncomfortable & force to choose a pronoun.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Enigmatic and a little crazy but she's a great woman and a solid teacher. Her assignments can be vague and you might be confused but just talk to her and she'll explain it to you and if all else fails she does not grade that hard. She will get to know you and tease you if you're that person. Imagine a cool, relatable mom and you got her.

She is AMAZING, HELPFUL, and FUN! The class requires lots of reading, homework, and assignments, but she does allow revisions. She tries her hardest for you to get that A you deserve, but the slackers expecting the A for just showing up and paying the tuition hate work. Go to class, do your reading and you'll be fine.

Dr. North-Coleman has a lot of personality and brings her own teaching experience to bear in the course - including the crappy parts.  A lot of non-English students got irritated with the class because of its literacy focus, but it's called READING in the content areas - it's the state requirement not her.  Her expectations were vague at times.

I LOVED THIS TEACHER! Dr. North-Coleman is incredible.  She allows for re-writes on all assignments.  She gives a lot of work, but each assignment has a purpose and none of the assignments are difficult.  She is friendly and respectful to her students.  She wants her students to succeed and does everything she can to ensure they do!  She is awesome
She is cool! and hot!
Like the rest of the UMBC faculty, this person is terrible excuse for a college professor.  Do yourself a favor and get out of UMBC's education department.
This woman is a waste of space.
She's spastic, but I like her.  I thought she was always helpful on a one-on-one basis, but her classes did tailor to English majors.  Overall, I thought the class was worth it.

UGH! Only cares about English majors. Gives pointless yet time consuming assignments. She is a waste of your life but you can't escape her since she is the only one to teach this course and the second part of it. When you ask her questions she acts like you are an idiot & shouldnt be wasting her time with pitifulness. Worst EDU professor ever!
Good teacher but a lot of work in this class.  She lets you revise your assignments and that is good because it can be hard to know exactly what she wants.
She is funny,helping, charming, understanding and pretty.

This lady packs at least 6 major assignments in each week and gives very vague instructions on how things are to be done. Also, If you email her asking her for clarification, she acts like you are wasting her time. Unfortunatly you cant avoid her because she is the only one who teaches this course but I am just giving you a heads up.

LOVE HER! She is hysterical. And she may be goofy, but at least from what I hear she is more down to earth that the other teachers. She is willing to talk to you and take an interest in what you have to say!
Take her... you learn alot, and she doesn't sugarcoat the education profession. good class, good info, good person... and yea, definitely hilarious with the faces and hand gestures. classic.
She talks for most of each period or gives pointless group work.  She makes weird faces and hand gestures.
Great teacher, valuable class

DO THE READINGS. Prof Nolin teaches with the mind that you have done the reading. Powerpoints presented in class are basically bullet points of general ideas so come in with some type of understanding (he posts them on BB too).The group discussions are helpful! One group paper and presentation. Extra credit can be applied to the 4 quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Mr. Nolin tells you everything thats going to be on the quizzes, he gives a ton of extra credit, its hard not to get an A in this class. Each quiz has 10-12 questions, circle/ TF, fill in the blank. He's straightforward and wants you to learn the information. He tells his quiz questions verbally which is why you should come to class.

If you read the assigned articles and pay attention in class, it is easy to pass. Quiz questions come directly out of the discussions and readings. Prof. will explain everything thoroughly if not understood. Was not respected by students for not handing grades away, but he is a good professor.

Long lectures. No textbook but you do need to read the assigned reading or you won't pass the quizzes. 1 major group project so make sure you have a good one. If the students complain enough he will curve a quiz. You don't have many chances to up your grade so make sure you do well on all the quizzes and he drops the lowest one.

Quizzes (4) are fill in the blank with couple of TF. No papers to write but a group project that was pretty easy. The final is based off of everybody's presentations and doing a final on 17 presentations is not easy at all. If you love reading and have a good memory, you will do just fine. personally I will not take him again.

One of the worst sociology classes I have ever taken at UMBC. Nolin is okay as a person but as a professor he is unorganized, uninformative, and uninterested. He doesn't care about sociology or students. DONT TAKE THIS CLASS

This class was incredibly boring. It's called Issues in Healthcare and it's listed as a socy class, but it was quite clear that a) Nolin knows nothing about sociology and b) Nolin does not care about sociology. This class was basically a health policy class. Instructions were always unclear and he didn't seem to know what he was doing logistically.

Quizzes were fill in the blank and covered a lot of material.  No papers to write but a group project that was pretty easy.  The final is based off of everybody's presentations.  Again, too much material.  Final is fill in the blank and 20 -25% of grade.  Bad way to end a good course.

very boring lectures. 4 quizzes, a final and a group presentation. Quizzes are based on lecture material and readings. Final was based on all of the class presentations. Quizzes and exams can be tough, lots of information. He is pretty clear with what will be on exams. Easy presentation. Drops lowest quiz grade.

Be prepared to be bored in this class. He has no experience in health. 4 quizzes are taken from book (smallest examples used: memorize book you'll be fine) Final u can't prepare for. Presentation you have to research yourself and he offers little feedback. Don't take this class with him! Take with someone else! He's boring and grades reflect that!
super cool and gr88 in grading,,,..  very helpfull

Bruh, avoid this professor if you can. She is not a bad person but some days she will wake up and just seem to not care. reviews.comment: Professor Okoro is really easy going and the class itself is easy as well. She's always willing to extend deadlines and makes lectures pretty fun. Attendance is mandatory and the book is definitely necessary.

reviews.comment: Professor Okoro is such a great professor! She offers so much information on the history of Africa including her own experiences. Easy A Class! You must show up because she makes you sign in and gives you credit for attendance. Overall show up and do the work and you will pass!!

If you're looking for an easy class then take Okoro's African American history. If you're looking to learn then do not take her class. She uses lectures as nothing more than a supplement to the assigned textbook (you basically pay $2k to read a book and she does nothing). She is not a historian, so she should not be teaching a history course.
Really good professor. The class is easy by itself. So just keep up with the class work and do some reading you'll get A.

She is an awesome professor. Clearly sets out her syllables and makes it always in your favor.We had a take home final! Also the class discussion were awesome and very intellectual . The most exciting part was the group skit at the end of the semester on the book you read. It was a fun experience! take her! you'll learn a lot and get an easy A!
VERY NICE!

Professor Boakyewa is one of the best, more engaged professors I have ever had, the class was very interesting and fun. Lots of engaging discussions. Dr.Boakyewa is also very straight forward on her exams, her study guide do not lie! Overall, a wonderful, happy professor who truly loves what she does.

Solid professor. She has a wide breadth of knowledge; you can tell that Africana Studies is her passion. She's also very approachable, funny and friendly. Come to class, read the required text and you should be fine.
Very good professor. Engages students in class discussion and wants student to succeed in the class. Flexible and understanding.
Knowledgeable professor who knows her material well. Examples used in class were relevant and helpful. She is very willing to give extra guidance outside of class if required.

One of the most interesting teachers I ever had. If I had the opportunity, I would pick her brain. She is so knowledgeable in her field! I loved her class! To succeed, you need to come to class, participate and write everything down on the board. Everything you need to know for the exam is in her study guides. Don't let her catch you on the phone!

I just transferred to UMBC and was only taking the class for my degree requirements but in general I loved the class. She is very animated and energetic and funny. As long as you write what is on the board and actually study a but it is an easy A. Dont let her catch you on your phone either!

Always encourages dialogue from students which can add additional insight to subjects discussed in class. She's super straightforward when it comes to exams -- no trick questions whatsoever. Just show up, pay attention read the chapters, ask questions, and you're golden. Overall, she's approachable, helpful, and funny. Awesome class.

Great teacher! Passionate about the course study, easy to approach, very straight forward, and funny. I would definitely recommend her class! Attend class, participate, read, follow study guide & your guaranteed to pass.

Loved this teacher. She is animated, but it makes class more interesting. She definitely knows her stuff. She is very open minded and allows for class discussion. Write down everything she puts on the board and take detailed notes. Participation and attendance is emphasized, but they are important life skills anyway! Take one of her classes.

She is honestly an awesome teacher. No tricks on her test. No games. She is very smart and is open to different points of views. She will allow you to submit via email and is flexible. She is funny too. Take her you won't regret it.
I loved this class, the professor is amazing, she is so funny and definitely knows her stuff. By far my favorite class of the semester.

Enjoyed the class because I like learning about culture. Her tests were easy if you pay attention in class. Her study guides give you the answers. Didn't like this class or professor at all, she values her attendance and participation too much. If she sees a phone on a table she WILL give you an F for the day. Lots of reading and she is a tough grader. If you don't love African History etc, don't take her class.
Class was easy, if you showed up and did the work you got an A. She did assign two long papers that were a pain to do, but she offers so much help there's no reason not to get an A.
The class is ok.She is pretty chill and understanding.
IF you don't know about Africa, it can be challenging but lecture is very interesting.
She is interested in her students' well-being, academically.
Great teacher, she makes learning fun, just be prepared to do work.

She was very nice and encouraged class discussion. Her PowerPoints were very clear and included everything that would be on the exams. Learned a lot of new things from the class and the workload wasn't too overwelming for a upperlevel class. Would recommend taking.
She's a superb professor and genuinely cares for her students. Classes were mostly interactive and spontaneous and students learn a great deal. Take her class
She's a superb professor and genuinely cares for her students. Classes were mostly interactive and spontaneous and students learn a great deal. TAKE HER CLASS !

Great teacher made the class interesting. Class was very interactive. Professor was very knowledgeable and enthusiastic about teaching the material. Teacher is passive aggressive and she definitely has favorites. She has the class set up so weird and none of her rubrics are actually helpful. Prof Oliva has been one of my favorites so far. The way she has students engage with each other created a really collaborative environment and I even made a few friends from it. She was also just really funny in a sort of sarcastic way.
I enjoyed being a student in her class. She always tries to engage the class with activities and group work. Weekly quizzes from what we were covering in the textbook.

reviews.comment: I loved EDUC 601. Linda is really knowledgeable and I received practical knowledge and skills that'll be helpful for my career. It was a great introduction to the program. One of the easiest classes I've ever taken. She gives ample time to do work and grades relatively light. This is a great class to take if you are at all interested in teaching!
She's okay, but one sided. Has favorites. And she does like when you call her out on things. Heavy grader.

Professor Oliva is a really nice professor, but the class is very unorganized and confusing when it comes to assignments and their due dates and clarification. reviews.comment: Eh. She is definitely not great, she didn't seem to make the class a priority, and we often felt like she was apathetic and we never knew what was going on. But the teaching component was amazing

reviews.comment: Professor Oliva is actually really helpful. Her syllabus scared me at first because of how extensive it was, but she makes the projects and papers easy and clear. If you're looking for a professor that does not like to communicate with her students then she is the perfect professor for you. She gives students SO much projects that around due in the span of the last two weeks of class and if you're have a question about the project you will not be able to to get in contact with her.

Great personality, poor organizational skills. I didn't do most of the readings in this course, as they came from non-academic sources. She is very nice and helpful in and out of class. Gives a lot of work, but grades easy. I don't feel like I'm learning a whole lot tho, but the class is required for education certification.

reviews.comment: Really good professor. I loved taking classes with her. She is very helpful and will answer any question you have.

So useless

This Prof is isnt that bad honestly, Or more so her class wasnt super bad as you only have 3 essays to write. I did pretty good but the only thing I would say is that she is a tough grader, she will take meaningness points off, she would give you like a 9.9/10 or like  4.7/5 and the reasoning would just not make sense. Be sure to follow rubric.
Not bad of a professor. Harsh Grader tho.

This course only has 3 assignments that are essays. I'm not sure why this class is rated so poorly because I thought it was an okay class. She is very informative and will answer any questions you have on an assignment. She is a tough grader, but if you follow the rubric, it's not hard to get a high B or A on an essay.

She doesnt grade extremely hard but she wants things done her way. She also will not admit when she has done wrong by the students. Do not take this class with her.

Her class is very boring, not much effort into the course layout. Rinse and repeat of viewing different forms of essays outside of class and kind of chatting about them in class. As a pre-nursing major taking this class as a gen-ed, I really enjoyed this class! Overall a good teacher, would make students interact in groups. 3 Papers in a semester, had interesting topics you could choose for 2 of them.

Professor Olsen is an average professor. She treats the class as if everyone in it are 4th year English majors. Majority of us were IS students that just needed the englosh intensive credit. reviews.comment: English 291 can be an easy A. Five assignments, including the final. Each assignment takes a considerable amount of time. Fun materials, but the lectures could be better. Class drags on sometimes.

Super nice and she lets students shadow her at the hospital for extra credit!

Hands down, she has been one of my favorite professors here at UMBC. Easy and clear

She is such an amazing professor I would definitely recommend the class! It was the best thing in the world to be taught by my role model. If there is an option to take it again I will. Thank you Dr. Olmo for being there to all of us who need hand!!

the most understanding prof I have ever had.  very flexible with assignments and due dates.  he's got a lot of knowledge to offer his students.  don't be intimidated by c hour and all the assignments on the first day of class.  it really is simple!

This guys is awesome, ive had him for french 103 and arabic 102. hes real cool, is flexible with due dates. his quizes are easy. not a lot of work involved really. understands most situations. doesnt care too much if u miss class.

reviews.comment: Good lectures and she related chemistry to real life. Sometimes she overexplained very broad topics which confused me. Shes willing to break things down for you. Just make sure you read the chapter and practice the problems she recommends

reviews.comment: I loved her! The first time I took CHEM101 with Carpenter I got a D so I had to retake. I got a B with Olson. Her lectures are great and she tries to give as much extra credit as she can
I did not like the days when she taught. Everything she said went over my head and didn't make any sense. She seems nice but can be very rude at times.

Dr. Olson does an AMAZING job explaining the concepts. Lecture will be devoted to her going over practice problems; no clickers are needed. The exams were 5050; lecturesbook respectively. They weren't difficult IF you studied for them (cram night before  fail).  She's very amiable and will always be there when you need help.
Her exams were challenging.  Try to attended all classes because most her exams came from her lecture.  She is always available at he office all the time.
She's a great teacher. She has open office hours and is almost always available to her students. Olson has done a great job.

Great teacher. Very straight to the point and very good at what she does. Will not substitute her for any other general chemistry teacher. Made me fall in love with chemistry even though I hated it throughout high school. Just study and go to lecture and you will get an A for sure.

she makes an upper-level course sound like it's meant to be taught in high school, which is a good thing. she makes biochem user-friendly, essentially. exams are hard, but that's to be expected from biochem. exams don't try and trick you, and the homeworks are tedious. very competent professor, great personality, makes a 2 hour course bearable!

Overall, Dr. Olson is a nice teacher all around.  She goes through examples step by step.  She always answers questions to the best of her knowledge in class and bb.  All her tests were manageable as long as you can do fine on the practice tests and examples.  Also, she has a slight curve for the final grade, and the ACS final is very watered down.

Do a lot of work book problems and pay attention to some of the  example problems she puts on the slides. You sometimes see them on the exams. Don't be lazy about the HWs. Keep up with the readings! This class is easy if you try!

She's really nice and informative. Will answer your questions and help you during office hours if you need. Chemistry is never an easy subject but the work isn't too hard. She grades pretty easy but isn't afraid to take off points. Homework isn't a big deal, but counts for a lot of your grade, make sure you study for all exams.

I absolutely loved Dr. Olson during my Summer 2012 Chemistry 101 course at UMBC. She was kind and was very talented in taking information that could easily become far too complex and simplifying it into lay men's terms. I hadn't taken a Chemistry course in 7 years (since HS) and ended up with an A without much effort thanks to Dr. Olson.

I really liked Dr. Olson. It was my second time taking the class in prep for MCAT. She is personable and explains problems (and the math involved with the chemistry) very well. Her tests were reasonable and most problems were similar to those covered  in class. I would recommend her, especially if it is your first time taking chemistry.

This class wasn't as hard as I thought it would be. She provides you with all the information you'll need to pass the class and she's very clear. Anything you don't understand from class you can ask about afterwards and she's  glad to help. I wish she taught more chem classes because it gets much harder after this class. BE HAPPY TO HAVE HER.

Chemistry will be hard if you are not willing to put in the work needed. Olson did a great job making chem understandable and reviewed key problems in class. Her exams were fair and reflected what we needed to know. Overall, I had a great time in that class!

Out of a 300 Student class she never used a mic and wrote on the dainty chalkboard you could have never understood what she was doing at any given time great for 1 on 1 help but useless in a classroom setting
She is a really good teacher, ready to help. Though she may be about the bush, she teaches well. I recommend her to anyone, as long as you are ready to work
Tough professor, but obviously enjoys teaching.  You will learn a lot of you study hard.

Dr. Olson is demanding, but a very helpful teacher when you seek her out for help.  She posts slides ahead of time, which is nice.  The exams are hard, but if you put in the time, you can get an A or at least a B.  I'd recommend her, but you have to be willing to work hard!

Only reads off slides. Goes around in cirlces. Slides online are in PDF with no answers; useless. Discovery is never in sync with her class. Goes into depth confusing her students. Not straight forward. Goes through problems without thoroughly explaining. Not an easy class even if you do go to class with this teacher.
She is an alright teacher, but she just reads the powerpoint slides, kind of negating the point of going to class since all the slides are online.

i took AP chem in high school which helped me out TREMENDOUSLY, so for me the class was relatively easy. but for the students that are learning these concepts for the first time, i feel really sorry for them. she's a terrible teacher, reads off her slides, and not very helpful. tests/quizzes are reasonable, but you have to understand the concepts.

She is a horrible teacher. Only good thing she dis was let the class out early. She does not teach, all she does is read her slides which you can do yourself if you print it out. You have to either teach yourself or get a tutor. Take Allison Tracy for this course shes the best teacher for this course.

She is a bad teacher. She's nice but she cannot teach. She reads her slides. So basically you don't have to go to class. She FLIES through the practice problems. People get confused fast. I taught myself literally from the book and going to chem tutoring. If you don't have to take her as a teacher I suggest you dont.
her tests are ridiculous hard and she won't curve

She is not the best professor, but you have no other choice.  She is really specific about her exams that means you got to memorize word to word powerpoint slides and textbook.  You need extra memory cells when you are taking class with her.

She spends the whole class ranting. Those rants are usually what she tests you over, but they are so random that you don't know what is important and what isn't. She gives you a study guide for tests, but about 10% of it is actually on the test. Anything she writes down on the board is either really helpful or 100% useless.

Writes all of her notes on the board even though she was a power point. Notes often prove to be important and helpful when trying to figure out what to study. She co-taught this course which made it worse. Exams are terribly specific which proves to be disastrous because there is a ton of material to cover. Keep up with the reading daily.

Although I'm sure that going through this class during the summer didn't help things, I felt like we weren't sufficiently taught for most of the class.  I found myself relying on the book a bit too often to explain things that should've been covered in class.  Sadly, we ended up cramming some important topics into a single lecture...
No Comments

She is the only professor in the history of CHEM 102 at UMBC who doesnt curve! I got a 69 in the class and she gave me a D...the **** refused to curve up to a C. I think she only teaches at UMBC in the summer so unless you're one of those super geniuses, do not take her b/c your wasting your money youll end up retaking with a normal professor.

Dr. Oni is a fantastic example of how a professor should engage with their class. A very friendly and charismatic mentor who likes to engage in fun banter with his students to encourage participation. Labs/HW are constructive, and directly assist with exams, and Dr. Oni is very understanding with project progress. Prioritizes effort over grades.

This course isn't hard, but it's extremely time-consuming. Weekly labs take 3–5 hours each, plus quizzes and hw. Grades are slow to return, making all the effort feel pointless. You could learn the same content online faster. Overall, too much work hurts your other classes and your mental health. Do yourself a favor and don't take this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment:
Overall, not a bad professor. Pretty funny & usually ends class early.

However, one problem is almost every week, there's 1 or 2 labs assigned due in only 2-3 days, & each lab takes 3-4 hours on avg to finish. HWs are less time consuming & given 1+ week to complete. After 2 months, no grades back except 1 lab. 

TLDR: Not hard but lot of busy work

Professor Oni is a good professor, personally I've never had any issues with him and he does keep the lecture engaging. Yes there is coding homework, yes there are labs, and yes there are quizzes, but quizzes are online and labs have a specific due date. He does give extra credit and as long as you study for the exam you'll be fine.
She is very cool

reviews.comment: She's great. She tries to accomodate you as much as possible. She explains the material very well.

reviews.comment: She is very approchable. If you show up to class and do the asignments you should have an easy A in the class.
