reviews.comment: If you want to pass the class memorize each vocabulary term for the chapters you are tested on VERBATIM. Most of the exam questions are vocab definitions. In the beginning of class he will say that he will take attendance but he doesn't. Keep track of due dates because he will not send out reminders

Tim is a great professor! He keeps lecture interesting and is helpful with any questions. 4 multiple choice tests which carry your grade. Memorize the book! He has a few easy homework assignments, 2 short papers, and 1 group project. Final is not cumulative. Take him for 310!!
The professor is not that easy as others said.  There is no practice exam. We have 4 exams and a group project. A lots of questions for exams, at least 60 questions.

The professor is very reasonable. As long as you take the time to read the book, and do some programming example modifications on your own, you should be able to get an A on the test; not to be confused with an 'easy A'. The programming assignments placed an emphasis, extracting data from/to text files and manipulating them.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Individual quizzes are averaged with group quiz (taken with resources). Only a few hw/coding assignments. 2 exams: MC choice in class and coding take home are averaged for exam score. Nice prof and makes the class very reasonable.  Lectures are off ppt. Ends class early every time.

There were 4 exams and no final because the last exam was cumulative. There was a final on the syllabus. There was also a group project. Tended to get out pretty earlier, even though the schedule said 2.5 hour lecture. Exams were in class, do the practice exams on practice and you'll be fine.
easy class. dont need to read but it will help. practice tests are the tests. very few assignments. cool guy

He was an awesome professor!! I wish he teaches more classes. Really helpful and always clear on instructions. IS 247 is not an easy class for most of the students, but if you take this professor you will at least end up with a B. I loved taking his class and he is GREAT!!!

He definitely knows what he is talking about. He wants his students to do well in his class, so he is very lenient and open minded. His tests are easy if you do the practice tests. Lecture was really long but only met once a week, and he let us out early occasionally, so it's not bad.

Very nice professor. Always on time. Always prepared. Open to suggestions and works with students for their benefit. Lectures are long  but meet 1 a week. He isn't strict and tests are very easy. His tests come from a very large pool of questions. Class presentations and current events every class are easy points. gives good feedback on assignments

I fr would just go to class, sign in for attendace, and then leave because there was no actual point in his lectures. His slides aren't helpful, he himself is unhelpful because his teaching is insanely weak, and I had to teach myself everything instead. He will belittle you if you don't understand something right away, do not take this guy's class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Mathew is an okay professor. His lectures can be messy and hard to understand so you mainly have to use the online homework system to help you. The exams and quizzes are all multiple choice, so it's an all or nothing grading style. And sometimes grades these incorrectly. I went to his office hours about this and my grade went up 4 percent

this professor made me want to genuinely drop out of school. i took his class once before and failed, and now i am on my second semester of taking this class. i am being forced to teach MYSELF the material, because a) he has a thick accent that i cannot understand, and b) he does not go over things well enough. i'd never take his class again.

omg this was my most difficult class. you have to teach yourself the materials and during lectures, he doesnt really go over the material. he uses a secondary site for assignments and thats your best friend during this class. he seems sweet but im never taking him again

Although Dr. Mathew is a good stats 121 professor, his content can be very complicated. Especially since  he only uses google slides to present his lectures. This class isn't too bad.  Although for the most part  you will be teaching yourself on how to solve and understand the equations.

He is a really sweet professor and is very patient when you ask him for help.This class requires lots and lots of studying though, and throughout the semester it caused me to fall back on my other classes because this one took the most amount of my time. Make sure you study lots and utilize tophat and ace if you want to pass.
I spoke to multiple students who felt overwhelmed by the material and felt as if they were teaching themselves the material. Would not recommend taking him with this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This was perhaps the easiest 400 level STAT class I have taken. The HW and tests were based on slides which had the formulas and context behind them. The assessments were open note.  The work is very much 'plug-and-play' which is easy if you understand the formulas. Dr. Mathew is SUPER NICE about questions in class and responds to email quickly.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I regret giving him a good course evaluation. I don't know for other smart students, but he does not really care whether you work hard or not for this class. It's just getting a right answer or not, and if you didn't get it right, he will just take your points off. He won't really care if you cheated, so take that in mind:Just get a right answer.

Will be an easy pass if you already took AP stat and didn't get credit or take the exam. Dr. Mathew is nice and it's easy to ask questions/approach him.  Weekly quizzes make up a good portion of the grade so showing up to class for review is helpful if not necessary
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Doctor Mathew is a nice guy. He does discussions and lectures and the course is quiz heavy. Two midterms, one final. Everything is online and you kind of have to self-teach a lot of the subjects to yourself. Just follow the formulas and remember definitions.
Very nice and accessible outside of the class. His quizzes are easy only if you study TopHat, good luck!

Prof. Matthew is very clear, lectures are done very well with informative slide shows. Uses TopHat, a great system, which made it easy to learn. Quizzes worth 10% of your grade. Homework is worth more. If you study and try, you will pass. Attendance not mandatory, but you get points for attending and it will make it easier to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His class is lecture heavy however his lectures are very well done. I personally don't mind taking notes so I was okay, but he does have an Indian accent so if you are someone who can't understand those very well then get a diff professor. His quizzes are very straightforward and I aced those. He does use TopHat so you need to buy a subscription
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: His lecture is ok. But in his will take half of points or even sometimes all of the points off for little mistakes in the test making more than half of the class getting a grade lower than 70%.
A lot of material to cover in a relatively short amout of time.

Very nice, but cant teach. Jumps around a lot and is unorganized, doesn't cover units before exams, gets off topic 70% of the lecture, very vague and unpromising about homework. He'll say there's graded notes on videos, lectures, etc, but doesn't follow through. Exam questions are online and similar to HW.
Took over winter. Class overall was not that hard, it was just time consuming.
Do not take for winter. just dont do it, not worth the money or time

Hard to rate this "professor" as there isn't one. Completely async, Professor Thomas doesn't answer emails. 12 hws, 4 per month, each 60-80 questions so make sure to spread them out bc they take HOURS. 3-4 reallllly long exams, very hard, but just like the homework so if you study those, you'll be fine. One of those courses ya just gotta knock out.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He posts the lecture slides online so you don't have to attend class since attendance is not required. HW is 40 Questions, kinda tedious but you have 3 tries for each question. 3 exams that are 60% of the grade, but use the practice exams as their similar. EASY EXTRA CREDIT that is 3% grade points. Like 87% + Extra Credit is 90% so a mid B to a A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Class was asynch, but he does have combined lectures (not mandatory) that you can attend. Prof posted slides to teach yourself. 16 Homework Assignments with 40 questions each (40% of grade) and 3 Exams (60% of grade) - all on Pearson. Has practice exams that are very similar to exams. Would recommend as a passable 102, just very time-consuming.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Poor communication with students does not respond to emails and when he does respond he barely answers my question or seems condescending. HE ACTUALLY TOLD ME HE HAS MORE PRESSING ISSUES DO DEAL WITH THAN MY QUESTIONS WHEN MY QUESTIONS WERE LEGIT & HAD TO DO WITH MY GRADE/PASSING THE CLASS. If you take it online you have to basically teach yourself

If you have the chance to pick your Macro Prof. Don't choose Mark Thomas. All he does is read off the lecture PowerPoint, to which you have access any time. I essentially had to teach myself. And he is horrible at communication. He responds to emails very late and his responses are very vague. Don't Procrastinate the hw's are long.

The online synchronous classes werent really helpful at all so I stopped going after the first week. Homework is easy to complete but time consuming so dont wait till the last minute. Practice exams are super helpful since nearly half the exam questions are from the practice exams.

Would never recommend this class or professor, both are horrid. I had never seen this professor once, he doesn't hold any sort of lectures or have any videos. Of course, please take my opinions and thoughts with a grain of salt. And if you like a professor who doesn't really offer anything beyond a textbook, he might be your type of teacher.

this class was super easy, but since it was all online you had to teach yourself. You can email him with questions and he'll answer between 24-48 hours. He has everything laid out for you including when things are due!

I am international student, and all my professors gave myself more lectures or stuffs to self teach with than Dr Thomas. I feel like I was been robbed because I paid a lot of money to having professor teaching me.

reviews.comment: If you have an interest in blowing money and completing online courses literally less content filled than the free options online already, feel free to take this bozos class.

reviews.comment: Not only was there no single synchronous session for a class listed mandatory attendance, but he also failed to post any materials other than the name of the textbook and some bare bones slide shows. Considering that, he had an awful lot of attitude and ego in emails throughout the semester asking simple and logical questions about class. Whack

reviews.comment: An asynchronous class that has all work on Pearson my lab. Get the answers for those and you will get an easy A. He drops the lowest exam grade as well

It is basically teach yourself. He puts like lecture notes and it is asynchronously met. Everyone went to bb collab the very first day, but he was confused why everyone did. The 1st exam was easy since it is directly from the homeworks, but the 2nd exam was difficult since there was many parts to a question and some questions were on the hw.

Dr. Thomas is always a solid choice. All of his exams come directly from the homework, although it is a lot of work, so as long as you do the homework (AND TAKE LOTS OF NOTES) you will get an easy A. There are four exams during the semester but he will drop the lowest one. The class is very flexible and his group projects are very lenient.

The worst professor ever. Changed syllabus twice in the middle of class bc ppl stopped showing up. Had to do a mandatory play if we wanted an A in the class, regardless of how we did on the final 12 page paper since its WI. group presentations every class, super boring and a waste of time. take this class if you have to.

Professor Thomas is very funny and extremely knowledgable in regards to history of economic thought. Very reasonable guy! He bought our class pizza :) show you care and ultimately participate in group related work and you will be fine!

So it was an online class with him. The exams were a little difficult because some of the questions were confusing and you didn't have much time. It was nice that he did try to get feedback from students. Wished there were videos and not just textbook readings all semester. Cengage was used for homework, which didn't relate to the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Prof. Thomas knows what he's talking about and his lectures are very informative. That being said, he wasn't all that organized, and the class was often confused with regards to the grading scheme used. He knows what he's talking about... just take with caution.
One of the most inefficient human beings that I have ever had the misfortune of interacting with. Definitely would not take again.
Took the class during the winter semester, but doesnt post grades concurrently with class. However, he is easy to handle.  Not a tought course. Should get an A.

Very tough class, but great professor. 2 exams (both ridiculously long and hard), hw worksheets (on all chapters and fairly easily), final paper (get ready to seriously work hard), extra credit (none!). Mark Thomas is clear, but I felt  he added too much to the course, particularly the material on the 2008 financial crisis.
Mark is a very helpful. He is easy to talk to and willing to clarify. He's kinda funny and smiles a lot when you ask questions. Pretty cool guy.
Powerpoint slides are very clear and easy to understand.  Memorize and understand the slides well and you should get an A.

Easy to follow and very helpful in class. Outside of class, don't expect anything. Does not answer emails and hard to meet him after hours. Class material can be challenging. And you would either hate or love your group project. Exams are difficult but just study (as in REALLY study) the slides he posts on blackboard and you'll be fine.

One of the toughest econ classes. You can tell that he has a lot of knowledge about the material but class lectures can be boring. Grade is based on midterm (30%), group project (30%), and final (40%). All of the exams are unbelievably hard and you have to study your butt off. He is overall very helpful and knowledgeable.

He is such a funny guy. His sense of humor is different and I think he is a good professor. He can be confusing and I swear he trolls you sometimes but overall his class is easy to pass. Just do group assignments which are very easy and attendance is not mandatory but I recommend it because the online quizzes you take are difficult. He is awesome!

Probably the most boring class I have taken. All he does is reads his powerpoint that has been already been provided. Passing the class is not hard. Quizzes and tests(the only grades in the class) are on a 4.0 scale, not percentage. If you actually want to learn economics do not take this class, however, if you want to pass this is it.
Great professor, if you have questions he'll answer them. Pretty straight forward passionate about his work, not just teaches but utilizes what he knows.
Took as a winter course. Material wasn't hard and had no previous exposure to the subject. All quizzes were online and exams had questions based on the HW/quizzes.

Enjoyed taking his International Trade Theory class. He is very knowledgable and is very helpful if you do not understand something. Does trail off sometimes but pay attention in class, review the practice exams and you will receive a good grade. Would like to take another one of his classes.

His voice is so monotone you will fall asleep, just repeats powerpoints, has about 16 online quizzes and 4 exams. quizzes are pretty easy if you do them friends, and he drops the lowest exam. Just read the book before the exams and you will be good for the class. easy class not hard to get a B or A

Class is boring, most people on PCs. Some irrelevant stories such as Michael Jackson's dude ranch is actually important. Book is useless. Econ quizzes are semi-hard if you understand. Write down most of what he says.His voice trails off so you don't understand what he is saying. Only has one office hour a week.

His teaching abilities are limited the result? A harder than it should be micro class. It is impossible to pay attention to this guy he is hard to understand. Everyone i know thats taking this class has failed the online homework assignments which is 40% of the grade. If you need to take MICRO take it elsewhere.

He was passionate about life but he did not focus that energy into his class. He is an example of a teachers that should be replace by a computer 1) He was always late 2) He used pre-made material to teach this course 3)Aplia, lecture outlines & exams did not match teaching or grading style 4) He did not teach; he read only from the given material

I'm literally sitting in his class right now doing this because he just babbles. Luckily, the class is easy in and of itself, but he really doesn't contribute to you learning it. He posts all of his lectures online so if you have half a brain, you don't need to come to class; even in the winter semester, its not worth the effort.

The entire grade is based on 3 exams. These exams are graded on a 4.0 scale so if you get an 89 your grade is a 3.0. Final grade is .3(Ex1)+.3(Ex2)+.4(Fin). The exams are ridiculously hard and because he just copies and pastes from old exams the questions don't even make sense. Each exam has 'essays' that you have to recall material word for word.

Quizzes are issued via My Econ Lab. There are no HW assignments for leverage so grades are based on all (14 or more)quizzes, 2 midterms, and the departmental final. The online quizzes are difficult and are far fetched from what is taught in the classroom as well as in the book. Take another Prof. if you have the chance to.

His online quizzes were so different from what he taught from class.  It was as if I had to learn what he taught and learn what the textbook teaches you.  This was a definitely hard class; I would not recommend it unless it is a prerequisite.

No textbook offered for class....good-luck....you better take exceptional notes but would be best to just use Google for every question.....all I remember from the class is that he always manages to get chalk all over him...does he not notice wtf....I don't think he has a car either I saw him carrying his briefcase down 195 multiple times...very od
I wouldn't have gotten an A if it wasn't for his Curve
He's a bad professor, I worked hard for this class and still he gave me a D. Take him if you want a D or C on your transcript.
Easy class in a sense that all quizzes and exams are online. Final is not mandatory. Quizzes can get challenging! 2 quizzes due every sunday. Curves. Good teacher but the class gets kind of boring.

Homeworks are easy, you get 2 tries and each try 3 guesses! Quizzes were hard but if you went to class you could use the examples he gave. He was pretty boring but he cared for his class to do well. All exams, quizzes, and homeworks were online(MyEconLab). He gave worksheets that really helped with the final, but you had to be in class to get these

he's profoundly boring. his voice puts you to sleep. stopped going to class after his lame example involving his girlfriend (laura), himself, and smoothies. take another professor. oh yeah, myeconlab rapes you every sunday

took him during summer, and his class is not very easy, all though i got an A+ you have to memorize lots and lots of formulas, if you have an econ major, take him, he is funny, and come to class late, no need of book, he provides power point notes, the test questions are 90% from the notes

He defines concepts well but fails to illustrate the logic behind them.  Obviously, nothing will be taught in great detail.  However, students must understand how concepts work to apply them successfully.  Imagine he's teaching arithmetic.  He defines addition, gives answers to problems, but does not illustrate how addition operates.

Extremely easy class and you don't have to buy a textbook.  He types the notes for you and puts them on blackboard at the beginning of the year, then goes through them in class and adds a bit of material about current economic issues.  If you've had any upper level math, sci, or engineering, this class will be a joke, it's just interpreting graphs.

He's a little spacey, but he's a cool guy if you talk to him. He teaches straight from the powerpoints which can be boring but if you ask him for help he'll help you out. His exams can be kinda hard but he tests straight off the reviews/powerpoints so it's nothing unexpected. His grading system is very forgiving too.

Strange guy, wipes chalk all over himself while he's teaching. If you read the lecture notes you'll be okay, but he's not really a good teacher. It's more of a self taught course, honestly. No homework, only exams...but that can really screw people over if they mess up on one exam.

he's pretty boring, but he is helpful and understanding. he teaches straight from powerpoints, and gives them to you and the tests are directly from the powerpoints. Gives out extra credit too. study and you'll do fine
Good teacher. Gives you all the questions before the exam to assist you in studying. Trys his best to help. Sure he may be mono-tone and boring, but just go to class and you'll do really well.

I think the man is trying to get fired.  He rolls in to class late, complains that the projector is broken, reads off the slides, and takes a month to finish a chapter.  He also kinda has this really creepy stare. He understands econ very well though, but doesn't really care if you find it interesting or not.

Very easy professor. Teaches straight from his powerpoints, which is kinda of boring.  He only tests from the powerpoints and buying the book is a waste of money because he doesnt teach from it or refer to it.

Very easy class.  Yeah he is a little boring but the powerpoints are easy to follow and he only tests from the powerpoints.  dont waste money on the bood and go to every class and you get an extra half letter grade added.
The only grades in the class are  midterm, final, and a webpage. You're graded on the functionality of the site and not on Economics...

OMGOSH!!! He gives Ben Stein a run for his money. He's so boring that you'll end up sleeping ur semester away. I haven't made too many mistakes in my life.. . but taking his class was one of the biggest ones i've ever made. thomas = soul draining

I've taken him every semester because he has a style that is comfortable and easy to get used to. I don't know what everyone else is talking about- I NEVER used a textbook, in fact- don't waste the money. He tells you everything you need to know, just print out the lectures, read through them a day or two before and go to class everyday- def. easy

Terrible teacher...reads directly off of the powerpoint slides, BORING, most annoying voice I've ever heard. Don't need to go to class, just read over the online slides before the test and you will get an A
Good professor, attend class to get the extra credit.

What a BORING class. He talks monotone and makes lame jokes at the board which he laughs at himself. Struggled to stay awake in every class. Tests are hard and have to read the book. Stay away if you can.

omg...i have never had a more boring professor...i struggled to make it to class every day, and couldn't even find the strength to walk through the door sometimes...the class is easy if u like reading the notes...but other than that he is so fricking dry and irritating...he teaches the class so u dont want to go...but takes attendance everyday

Worst teacher ever! Monotone and laughs about his own jokes to himself. Very hard to keep interest and pay attention. Dry material and just not fun. Avoid if you can unless you like learning from the book.
This is an easy class to take. Professor Thomas is funny and friendly and he only teaches in the summer.  His grading is extremely easy, if you try you will pass.

He did not even create his own lecture he read another professors slides in a super boring monotone way that makes you pass out. He is very unorganized and was late for a midterm and the final exam because he had to go make copies... His grading system is hard to calculate on your own i would avoid him if possible... hes not bad for econ 102 though

The hardest part of the course was not falling asleep. He hands out big packets of lecture notes, which are pretty much all you need (the book was useless). We had two tests, both entirely multiple choice. He explains things well, but is very boring about it.

Don't listen to these people.  Yeah, he's boring as hell and deliberately creates tests that are difficult but there are only 2 tests all semester and their curved like hell. You really don't need to go to class anyway. He posts all the problem sets and notes on blackboard and doesn't care if you show up or not. The class is easy.

I thought that this class was difficult.  The prof. wasn't very organized.  This had been the first time he taught the class.  I didn't care for the book or slides (that came with the book).  Test was directly from HW.  Weekly HW was a little long.
The class was so boring.  I did not go to the class except the exams.  But I still passed with B grade.  No need to study at all.  Very easy teacher.
most boring professor i've had, period.  Monotone voice, can't pay attention, makes the course boring.  i keep falling asleep, and half the class is playing games while he is lecturing.
Confusing grading system, but the class is easy, and he really drives home the concepts he wants you to know.  I got an A without even trying...

First let me say i got a B in this class.  But this dude SUX! I hated this class.  This most boring man on the planet. Tests were not hard but the report we had to do came out to be 30+ pages long.  There are much better teachers, find a different one for ECON!
Good teacher, exams are easy if u study only multiple choice kinda boreing and just plain odd i think he may be a loser but he knows his stuff
One of the most boring lecturers I have had the experience of listining to.  If you can make it through his class without falling asleep you must have too much energy.
Very monotone lecturer, but go to class so you can get the problem sets which are crucial for his tests.  Don't even need to get the textbook, just download his lecture notes.
pretty good teacher, but the material is dry and he just makes it drier.  He tries to add humor, but it just doesnt work.  easy A tho, so suck it up and take him.
If you want an easy A this is the class to take.

He is a nice professor. He gives 2 tests and a final and he hands out problem sets, which are straight from lecture and his lectures are online. It is an easy class.  I got an A and you are not required to go to class.
Professor Downs really tries to make cybersecurity enjoyable.  He uses labs from time to time to keep things interesting and he really wants to help students understand what they like about cyber.
He's a piece of shit. Lazy person. You won't learn anything in his course. You'll be better off with another professor.

Super cool professor. Talks about real life experiences and is trying to help you find what path you want to take in Cyber. Exams are done through ISACA, as with the labs. If you do the labs and watch the lectures, youll get an A in the class. Highly recommend Frank.
Got students access to Virtual Labs for hands on experience. Clear requirements for papers and exams. Really wants to help the students with career specific advise.

Professor Downs will definitely keep you on your feet and I enjoyed going to his classes! He WILL go slow and make sure you understand the subject before you move forward. If you try, you will pass. His class differs from the other Intro Courses as he goes through the slides, but you do ACTUAL hands on labs. *I'm not a robot*
Frank is great! He is super enthusiastic, funny, and he is very understanding of everyones situation. I would to love to have him again!

Parrish Sensei is good-natured and wants her students to learn the language. Her classes are quite engaging, and the workload is not too different from 101/102. For her first semester, I would say she did quite well and kept the class up. Also, she always gave good feedback on work and was willing to work with students instead of against them.

The class was fun and I enjoyed my time. Parrish-sensei is a great professor. She's caring and open to improvement. Since this is her first semester, things may change, but we had a quiz every class. With projects presentations and quizzes taking most of the lecture, there was rarely time to teach the material. Be ready to learn most of it at home.

Really great Professor. She's really nice and cares about students. If you have issues or problems she's really easy to talk to and lenient about things. The lecture was a little bit messy due to it being her first semester here teaching 201 but still easy to follow. There is a kanji and/or vocab quizzes every class but it's not bad if you study.

This was Parrish-sensei's first semester at UMBC. There's room for improvement but she is a good professor and she keeps the energy up in the classroom. Expect 1-2 quizzes every class and utilize the Genki workbook! There were a lot of extra credit opportunities. Lots of participation and group work, but she encourages creativity and to have fun.

MANY quizzes, but overall not a bad class. Definitely your best option for 201. She's a pretty forgiving grader, and her lectures were fun. Some opportunity for extra credit. This was her first semester at UMBC, so I think her class will only improve with time.
Very understanding but there is a lot of work. Test almost every class but they often hold group study sessions.
He's just chill as f
He's an excellent professor! Not too much homework, only a few essays, and no textbooks! Would definitely recommend!
An absolute gem. Grading is easy, lectures are always interesting, and Tomlin is hilarious. A bit of reading but always more than enough time to get it done.

few group projects (all presentations were gallery walks). super organized and clear with assignments. very lenient with grading and clear on grading criteria. do good with assignments the first time as there is no extra credit (shouldn't need the extra credit). amazing and humorous professor overall! 11/10.
This was probably the most useful class I've ever taken at UMBC. Learned to write much better!

reviews.comment: Knows his stuff. Definitely taking again for future classes!

This guy pissed me off. He would ridicule his students for not paying attention and call them out by name but I was one of 5 people in his 40 person class to get a A. Highly polarized and takes every opportunity to share his political belief. Would not take again was actually just a mean person

I agree that Dr. Schaller can appear grouchy, but he is a very knowledgeable person! He's an excellent speaker and his lectures are engaging and funny. Very doable if you read carefully and pay attention. Attend class because there are pop quizzes. The only graded work is that and exams, so you have to study and perform well on tests.

reviews.comment: This class was way harder than necessary. He's also not very understanding and can be snarky. His quizzes and exams are extremely specific, so whatever is mentioned in lecture, will show up on your quizzes and exams. Also do your class readings!! But honestly, take this class with someone else if you could help it.
100% racist.
Terribly narcissistic approach.
Basically projects his white guilt on other students. Incredibly ignorant of the world outside of his small academic bubble. Lives in a safe suburban enclave but insists he is down for the struggle.

Dr. Schaller is a tribalist ideologue.  He spews class-hatred on the reg and lacks the sophistication of a respected professor/lecturer.  Which explains why he is at UMBC and not an esteemed academic institution.
He's racist
na

As others mentioned, the "Schaller Grading System" is not indicative of what a 100-level course should be. Test material was harsh and very reckless.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: the worst class I have ever taken, if you like a bad gpa take this class for sure, if you want to study for 8 hours a day for 6 days straight before the test to only receive a B or C go ahead, worst professor I have yet to lay my eyes upon. makes his content hard for no reason, tests are brutal 2 points will make or break your grade

As someone that was deeply interested in learning more about American politics, I have enjoyed Dr. Schaller's class so far. He does rant & go off topic a lot which consumes up class time. The quizzes aren't that bad as long as you do the readings & pay attention to the power points. The tests are okay, they have gotten easier since the first one.

prof is passionate so lecture is not that bad, but repetitive topics. grading categories are harsh. exams each 20% a piece; there are 4. pop quizzes, each worth 5 points (one a week = cummulative 20% quiz category). exams (100 points/exam) are a lot of recall + short answer, with explanations needed. study hard. B's on exams will wreck your grade
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I'm not sure how Professor Schaller has such a high rating on this website. He employs pop quizzes that are less based on the concepts of the course as much as specific names and terms. He also provides inconsistent instructions in class versus written instructions for assignments. I have not had a professor at UMBC I have disliked prior to this.
Best class I have taken! If you have a chance to take this course with Prof. Schaller DO IT!

Don't be scared by the tags. We had a total of 4 exams (each 20% of our grade), and a bunch of 5-question MC quizzes (the avg was 20% of our grade). Everything was taken from the readings or lecture. Pay attention to key concepts and data figures and you'll be fine. While called popquizzes, we generally knew when we would have them. Good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Schaller's teaching style. He had 4 exams and 12 quizzes (2 lowest dropped) Lots of reading. He doesn't put grades into BB so keep track yourself. He clearly knows a lot and is funny. He uses profanity a lot if that bothers you. I would take him again if there was less reading. Both exams + quizzes require you to read, not skim.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He is very passionate about teaching his class, everyone can tell he loves what he does. Expect a good amount of readings, weekly quizzes, and 4 exams. If you read and study the slides, you will do fine in this class. The only thing about the prof is that he shows a strong blue color when it comes to politics, and that could bother some students.

I wouldn't take Schaller again because his tests rely on heavy memorization of the exact phrasing of specific passages that you read. Was not very accommodating when I was having computer issues and couldn't access some of the readings. Seemed very full of himself
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took Poli 100 for a gen ed req. Professor Schaller knows what he is talking about. Weekly quizzes are simple and easy when you do the readings before class. Two papers and two exams give you the chance to really show your understanding. He has a good sense of humor and says it like it is. Great class and better professor.

Schaller is a great prof, if you need to take one of these poli classes for credit by all means PLEASE take a class with this man! Beware there are pop quizzes and you definitely need to be on top of the reading otherwise you'll run into trouble. But if you do the reading, try to participate every class, and are consistent you'll ace his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Tough grader on papers. He doesnt accept anything less than perfection, and the average grades were a 75%. Pop quizzes are common, but easy if you did the reading. Lastly, if you are coming into this class as a conservative youre going to have a bad time. Im a centrist though, so nothing bothered me.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Schaller is nice and enthusiastic. The material of his course is very substantive. However, he makes his personal bias and opinions clear, and they influence the way he teaches. If you have a different set of ideological leanings, you might feel uncomfortable in his class. Also, he is a very difficult and nitpicky grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is a tough teacher and wants to make sure that you come to class and pay attention. We had 5 question reading quizzes every Monday that were hard. I am a bad reader so it was difficult for me to get above a 3 or 4. The final exam was all written but he gave a good outline of what it was going to be which helped a lot for studying.

This is a very hard class. The books required are not textbooks, but actual books you would probably find in a local Barnes and Noble.  The class is based off of 3 tests and have to get at least a 91.5% to get an A.  The material is interesting, but I would not recommend taking this course with him

One of the hardest teachers I've ever had and to this day I regret taking his class.  He failed about 75% of the students in all three of his classes COMBINED, and these so-called 'textbooks' were more political statements than anything.  If your a Republican or moderate don't take this class he will hate you the minute he finds out.

I love Dr. Schaller. He is incredibly knowledgable about electoral politics & a fair grader. 100 is exams. 323 & 327 are quizzes and papers.  He assigns fantastic reading material and the paper topics are thought-provoking and fun to write. You leave his classes with solid understanding of political theory that you can apply to any course you take.
Profressor Schaller is an excellent instructor, lively and passionate. BUT be prepared to do the work and do not slack off, people often fail this class thinking it be easy and have to retake it.

He's very knowledgeable about politics and clearly shows it. He always keeps the class well entertained, though he gets off topic sometimes about personal stories & repeats himself from time to time. If you're willing to learn though, you should have no problem with his class. My grades amy not have reflected how much I learned, but I learned a lot

Take this class seriously! Study all the powerpoints before exams. You gotta memorize. Go to class and watch out for his hints! Be prepared to study!!! He's a great guy full of laughs but his class is tough!

He is super knowledgeable about what he is teaching, it is obviously something that he enjoys talking about. Offers lots of opportunity to get help. He's very funny and tries to be current. I would only recommend this class if you already know/are really interested in learning about government/politics...I was not.
Only take this class with him. He's super intelligent, clear, and personable (and occasionally hilarious.) I enjoyed going to class and got A's on everything.

Best class ever. He is very clear and his lectures are entertaining. His tests are essays of key concepts from his power points, with occasional terms from the book. He is very clear in his expectations. Many kids don't do well, but I don't understand why. I didn't take notes but sat and listened and read and I got an A

If you come to class, read the book and take notes you will get an A or a B. If you slack, or do not take notes in class/do not attend, be prepared to have your GPA ruined by this class. Schaller's class is not a joke, he is not afraid to fail you. To get an A in his class you must get a 92% or higher as your final grade.

How to get an A in this course: Each class he says 3-6 things that need to be memorized. AFTER EACH CLASS, PUT THESE THINGS ON NOTECARDS. The rest of the time is spent explaining these things. For the readings, just look at the "big picture" the author is trying to paint. Schaller will tell you anything more specific than that.

Schaller was one of the best teachers I've ever had. He is one of the reasons I decided to major in political science. His class is not easy, but he does not use textbooks, and assigns great reads. If you do the work, he is fair and you will get a good grade. Also very funny, and keeps you paying attention during his lectures.
His exams were easy as long as you put the effort into studying. Mostly just understanding examples or how things worked which he explains in vivid detail in class. Very funny and relaxed professor.
One of the best professors at UMBC! He expects a great deal from his students, but if you keep up it is well worth it. Take any class you can with him!

Awesome Teacher!! His lectures are very interesting and entertaining, and make me want to come to class! Hands out memos as key portion of notes which is really helpful. Reading is current non-fiction as opposed to textbooks, and is always relevant to current events. You will learn so much in this class it's insane. Take this class!!

He is an awesome professor and teaches the class so that you're not covering the same boring info you've go through your whole life about government. He was on the colbert report too. He has an attitude that makes him entertaining too. Highly recommended.
there it is.

He is great.  He tells it like it is! All of these other people giving him low ratings are doing so because they can't deal with the fact that government is the way it is.  He backs up all of his information with HARD facts.  He discusses race and hard poltical issues.  Read the texts because one or two questions are always taken from them on exams
AMAZING professor. he is my favorite professor of all time. I can't wait to take more of his classes

could be the most arrogant man ive ever met.  he is a pompous jerk.  classes are annoying because he jus talks about himself and useless things he knows but the test are based on the notes he hands outin class and classroom example.  they are still tough thou. mainly essays.  he is pretty hot until he opens his mouth.i wouldnt take him again thou
I thought he was a great teacher. VERY funny and VERY smart. Keeps you interested. It was my favorite class this semester.

awesome teacher, i absolutely loved going to class. tests are easy if you come to class (a must to pass) and if you read the text. hes a liberal but open to all opinions. best professor ive had so far and probably will be the best.DEF take him if youre taking poli 100

Awesome teacher. Hilarious anecdotes. He tries to scare you the first day saying it will be the hardest 100 class you will ever take. Partially true, but if you just read and study the handouts, you'll be fine. Useful class to get you ready for the rest of college.

Schaller is a smart guy, he's  somewhat of a jerk, but a cool guy if you're not a hardcore conservative. He likes to boast that his classes are not easy A's, and it's true. Still though, nice guy, funny, makes class interesting. Take the class if you don't mind having to study. His upperlevel classes are probably even more fun and interesting.

You learn so much in this class it's crazy. Schaller is amazing at teaching the material. Very understandable. He doesn't use traditional textbooks, rather current nonfiction. His tests are hard if you don't pay attention in class, easy if you do, and the curves are pretty high, depending. Also, the man is beautiful.

Absolutely the worst class I ever took. I had him for a seminar class several years ago. He wanted the students to write journal entires and graded them based on whether or not they agreed with his own opinion.  He took us on a field trip to the minimax downtown; the trip that they usually reserve for juvenile delinquents!
schaller rocks
I had him all four years at college. The man is awesome. If you do the homeowrk assinged and attend class you will do fine. Not to mention, I always enjoyed attending class.
He's the best ever. I love his classes!

schaller is great!  he knows his stuff and his classes are always a challenge.  take his interest groups and lobbyist class.  i disagree with the guy below, class never turing into a bush bashing session.  either way, schaller is a really fun professor!
No Comments

I like Schaller a lot, though i did find it hard at times to sit through his classes (The Presidency) because I am a conservative and the classes, more often than not, ended up being a Bush/Conservative bashing session.

Schaller is the MAN!! Great professor, the exams were a little tough, only three and 70% of them were essay questions with the other 30% being fill in the blank. But if you go to class and pay attention and get involved in the class discussions they aren't too hard, plus he sends out his power point presentations before the exams. Makes class fun

Awesome teacher!  Clear, Concise, open to all view points.  The 2nd best one I've had throughout my college career. His class was great. I can't find a bad word to say about the man, only praise.   6 pop quizzes, one test, and one term paper
VERY HARD CLASS but fun!  Not too hard on the eyes either.
Although the tests can be hard, this is an interesting class and Schaller is a great guy. If you have any interest in poli sci or american govt whatsoever take his class!

great lectures, but hard tests.  Only 3 exams, no exceptions.  Unless you are really political, this will be a hard class, you'll have to work to really hard to get an A.  btw, only 92.5% or above is an A.....hard hard hard.

Schaller has always been tough but he has gone a bit overboard this semester. 15 page paper this time, 6 pop quizzes drop the lowest grade, midterm w/ cheat sheet no final. I still really like him, but the paper is tough. Also seems to have too much on his plate this semester.

Tests are very tough but worth it, he weeds out the slackers fast. Told off Vorhees which I am still gloating over. Class goes by fast and is not your average slacker poli 100-- take it as a gateway to the minor or major, not as a GFR. --K
HARD TEACHER BUT VERY COOL AND AWESOME!!!! ALSO KINDA CUTE....HE MAKES THE CLASS GO BY QUICK
Love this professor, not the easiest in the world, but worth it. Classes fly by. And to the poster from 11/18, we do pay to sit in on his lectures silly.

His upper level courses are great.  While he does expect you to do a lot of reading (and those stupid pop quizzes), he tends to stay away from straight out textbooks.  Be prepared for something like two papers and a final exam.

Schaller is fantastic!  His classes are very interesting and the assigned readings are as well.  His test are difficult, but if you go to class and the read the assignments it is fine.  I looked forward to his class even though it was at 8:30 am.
great class.  I'm seriously considering majoring in Poli sci because of it.  but you have to pay attention in the class to pass.
He is awesome! He brings up relevant points and discusses factual statements. He is a staunch Democrat but is not afraid to say his party is wrong on somethings. He hates Bush too, which is nice.

I thought Poli 100 was going to be boring, but Schaller made it my favorite class, I don't miss a single session.  Even though his tests are kindda hard, you really learn a lot, and he has such a good sense of humor.  We should pay to sit in his lectures.

this guy is downright amazing. Not only was his class really current and his readings were interesting, he's very bright and eager to discuss up and coming topics with students. As a side note, he's not bad to look at either.

He's probably one of the coolest professors ever, and is a very effective teacher because he makes everything interesting.  He is extremely funny and often goes off on tangents, especially regarding his Italian pride.
His tests are tough, and he goes off on tangents a lot.  He is really funny, though, and makes the class interesting.
No Comments

really open and friendly guy. has a real passion for politics, and provides really interesting course material and insight. it is very difficult, and he expects a lot from his students, but he delivers a great class.
No Comments

Such a nice professor. I always look forward to taking her courses. Chooses cool readings and offers extra credit assignments. Loved the class structure. Make sure you follow the syllabus and use her feedback on your papers. I appreciate that she offered extensions and though participation mattered, she did not always penalize absences.

Really kind and an extremely understanding professor. She assigns a lot of discussion posts but provides many opportunities to improve your grade if you miss a few. She's lenient with attendance and class participation, and her lectures are easy to follow.

Amazing course! She let the class lead the course through discussions. Lots of texts but all from authors of color! She is very fair and understanding: lenient on deadlines when asking for extensions. She gives 4 unexcused absences to everyone to 'skip' at no penalty. Very good class, better professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: accommodating, kind, and amazing

I LOVED professor Tran's class. She is an absolute darling just as a human person, and as a teacher, she's one of the most truly, sincerely invested professors I've ever had. The group project she gave us was actually FUN, and she gave us detailed and supportive feedback. I would take any class she taught, honestly.

I love the way Tran asks open ended questions and allows the students to carry the conversation. Her grading requirements are clear and her feedback is detailed! I wish her style of teaching were the norm at UMBC for English classes.

I also took English 301 with her, and I loved both classes. She is a wonderful instructor and extremely knowledgeable. Her feedback on every essay is helpful and detailed, and she lets you submit revisions to improve your essay grade. The reading can be a little much as well as the discussion posts. Overall, she's great and very approachable.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Tran is an amazing professor! You do have to speak up in class as participation matters, but she is willing to accommodate if you are shy or afraid to speak up! She is organized, gives detailed feedback, and I would definitely take her again!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I've just signed up for my third class with Professor Tran because no matter what I take, she is one of the best professors around. She's full of energy and very knowledgable about her subject. Class discussions are part of participation, but she understands and always offers other involvement if you're not into talking in front of a group.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took Professor Tran for ENGL 360 and her class was a catalyst for shaping my Asian American identity. She does have high standards when it comes to papers, but I'm a strong writer so that was never an issue. Despite the fact I never participated in class, I still got an A (but this is bc I got above 95% on every major assignment). She's amazing!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: She is a really nice and caring professor overall. But there are a few paper and she is a tough grader. She allows a rewrite of paper to get a better grade. Get ready to have discussion every class based on what you read and have discussion posts due every class. Very TOUGH grader! You really have to try to get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Fantastic professor! Cares a lot about feedback and her students. Obviously puts a lot of effort in the class, and encourages class discussion. Class is largely participation based, so be prepared to talk, or write on the discussion boards a lot. Well chosen readings. Some of the topics seemed rather basic, but it is introductory English.

I had Prof. Tran for both ENGL369 and 469 and she is one of the best professors I've ever had. There is a lot of discussion/group based work, but she is open to feedback and gives very clear instructions for every assignment. She is knowledgeable and caring, and will work with you!

Tran is extremely knowledgeable and you can tell she likes what she is teaching, but I hated the class. Her format is not conducive for note taking, plus there is some kind of small group/partner discussion during EVERY. SINGLE. class and a major group project for your final.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: The class is mostly discussion based so participation does matter. There are two groups projects but they are manageable and fairly easy. Professor Tran is somewhat of a tough grader but she gives really detailed feedback and allows you to resubmit the papers. She was really nice and considerate.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I really like Prof. Tran. She's super nice and wants her students to succeed. She isn't always clear about her grading criteria and does allow rewrites. She leads great class discussions and values what everyone has to say.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Don't take his class if you want an easy A, but take him if you actually want to learn! His class is hard, you will need to work for it but you will leave satisfied. Go to class, use his office hours and you will succeed. He grades fair, it's just a lot. Highly recommend him if you want to go to graduate school, but expect to work for your grade!

Dr. Steiner expects a lot out of his students, probably too much. But if you want to be a researcher, you should take his class. You'll learn more in his class than you will in most of your other psych classes put together. But it was a lot of work and stressful (maybe more so due to COVID). You'll leave ready for grad school... but also exhausted.

Do not take this class with him if you can help it. He is relatively nice but his expectations are truly ridiculous. He grades really hard and has unclear expectations on assignments. VERY slow grader you will not know your grade until the very end of the semester. Brags a lot. Exams are LONG and pretty difficult. Feedback often unhelpful.

Overall, he is nice but, he doesn't really help students in ways that it counts. He is friendly in the lecture, but he takes way too long to grade is almost unreachable outside of regular lecture times. His policies are bizarre and he never gives you a clear idea of what is happening in his class. Take this class with anyone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Steiner is a very nice and kind person. He is very understanding and lenient with his students. This class is not a easy class and it requires a lot of your time. He doesn't seem to answer emails so i recommend going to office hours if you need help. He does take some time to grade assignments but i do recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Overall, this class is challenging and you will have to put in a lot of work. Would definitely recommend Prof. Steiner if you want to learn a variety of things and not just the basics of research methodology. Groups will be helpful make use of them and office hours. If you are confused its better to go to office hours over emailing.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is really fun with Troy as a professor. You can tell he's highly intelligent and wants students to feel the same way about themselves. Good articles and a very fair amount of work for a writing-intensive. I would definitely take him for this class again.

Dr. Steiner is an amazing professor. I went into this class not looking forward to it because history just bores me, but this class turned out to be the class I most looked forward to. Hes funny and really tries to get to know his students. If you need 405, I highly suggest taking it with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. S is a good Professor, but he expects too much from the students in his class. 312 is known for being a difficult class, but Dr. S, probably due to his new-ness as a professor, overestimates how smart + how much time students in his class have. You will spend the "expected" 8-10 hours per week on homework in this class. Plan accordingly.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Group projects

reviews.comment: Loved this class and Dr. Steiner! He is very kind, helpful, funny, and knowledgeable. He is always accessible after class or by email and he takes time to get to know all the students and interact with them. I didn't think I would particularly enjoy the subject of this class but he completely changed my mind about it. Would definitely recommend!!

He is an overall nice guy. But does not exceed UMBC expectations. Takes forever to grade, contradicts himself during lectures, assignments are thrown at students without clear instruction. If you want a "nice" professor, take him. If you want to get anything out of this class, go for someone else. You won't know your grade until last minute.

Dr. Steiner was a great professor all around. He really cares about you as a student and wants to get to know his students better. We were only graded by his papers, attendance, and participation. Few things I didn't like was he took a long time to grade papers, he's only accessible during office hours, and doesn't seem to respond to emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: Hes a really great professor! Its a really tough course so I strongly recommend going to his office hours when you dont understand something and form a study group. He stops during his lectures to allow for questions which I like. In the beginning of the semester he said attendance was not mandatory but I strongly suggest you go.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr Roy has a reputation for being hard and scary. However, he is very reachable & he allows passing, if you try, it's almost impossible to fail. Getting an A is extremely difficult. Prepare ahead of time, start doing and understanding the homework before the deadline, and make sure you ask questions, as the exams will get even harder.

He may seem scary at first but once you get to know him type he really is just a chill guy tryna teach a hard af subject. The material is hard but he will teach in a way where you will learn it. High key misunderstood prof. He is self aware that he is a demon. He embraces it. W manz when it comes to getting help.

It was a hard class but what class isn't hard at this point. His lectures are engaging so it is easy to pay attention but don't let that fool you, you still need to study a lot on your own time. If you put in the work you will be alright.

Grading criteria unclear. Varies from assignment to assignment. Did not provide breakdown for final except for "its cumulative". Uclear what he takes points off for. Quizes are not returned ( reviewed after in class, but paper not returned). This is not helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment:
Probably the toughest professor in the MECH-E departement, but if you put the work in you will learn a lot!
A grade a** hole, doesn't curve, very tough exams, getting an A is impossible, excellent lectures, excellent slides, excellent advice, you WILL cry from the HW so be ready!

Tricky exams, attitude towards students, yelled at students, not enough time during exams for most people, learning useless methods of linear algebra by hand which was not useful for further mechanical engineering classes. Too easy but too hard.

This professor is okay for me, in terms of lectures and homeworks.  The worst thing is he wouldn't allow you to use calculators during exams and they are tricky. So, during practice, try solving without it. I wouldn't recommend him, although he would turn out every other semester, which is somewhat sad.

Dr. Wu has a tough demeanor but is an incredible Lecturer. He teaches some of the hardest courses in ENME and does a great job of explaining the concepts in depth. He is very knowledgeable on the topics and cares about what he teaches. He can be a tough grader and gives many pop quizzes but is overall fair and consistent. It is manageable get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Probably my least favorite professor. Pain to deal with, obviously doesn't like engaging with students, and seems like he has a thorn in his you know what 99% of the time. It's plain to see he doesn't want to teach on top of being the Undergrad Program Director. I would say avoid him, but it's literally impossible for 303 and 482L. DO ALL EC!!!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment:
Not a good lecturer; somewhat rude. Makes people regardless attend with otherwise penalty. Lectures were a waste of time.
However, course material was well prepared. Grading was far, if not a little too easy. Had surveys to ensure everyone in group participated; this is good to instigate an even work load distribution in a group.

I had Dr. Wu for ENME 303 and 403. Make sure to do ALL bonus problems, they help create a good buffer. ENME 403 was a pretty intense course, but Dr. Wu made it easier by clearly explaining the concepts in class, and even if you don't understand at first, his slides are well made, and the textbook is always available to aid in understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Ok professor, pretty helpful if you go to office hours to ask HW questions. The exams had built in tricks to force you to analyze, but they still could've been toned down somewhat. Also just make sure to do every assignment and get as many points as possible (including bonus problems) because that was the only reason I was able to pass the course.

since i know you're reading this, what's up Dr Wu? he's a very particular man so be ready to pay attention to small details like naming convention of hw's, don't bother coming to class if you intend on doing other work. tests are designed to be tricky so if something is taking too long, its done intentionally, theres a more efficient way of solving
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He grades very harshly, you will lose 10-20% off of a HW for each simple mistake. Make sure you do ALL of the extra credit possible because exams are very tricky and difficult to complete in time. If you simply understand the content its not enough, you need to MASTER it. Otherwise, the course is straight forward. watch out for his trick questions.

Overall, a pretty good professor. Lecture and lab attendance are required but homework and reading are super light so overall not a huge time commitment. I disagree with people complaining that the exams are trick questions since he is very clear about what he is going to ask, but I do wish they were worth less of the grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Wu is not a bad lecturer, but I wouldn't recommend him. He's charismatic and engaging. But, the class ends up feeling like you vs him, he deliberately makes his exams overly complicated and tricky,doesn't give much time. Exams did not reflect the posted review problems very much(or HW), and were way harder.Can be rude when asked questions in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Wu is a decent lecturer. The content is pretty straightforward though he makes his exams much harder than they have to be. Also does not provide enough time for his exams. Do not recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Exams are not too hard but he gives little time to do them and it weighs more than 50% of overall grade
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I thought Dr. TseHuai was a decent professor. The class itself was fairly straight forward and easy. He let you bring a cheat sheet to the exams too. The exams were 50% ridiculously easy questions and 50% average difficulty questions. He often took a few minutes in class to tell a joke or two which lightened the mood.

Shaky explanations-made errors. Insists on attendance & pay attention each class, so if you know material, can't skip classes/study other material. I.e. doesn't make room for students who know material better -- very 'canned' method. Way too easy -- I wish it had more applications. class time waste of time. MATLAB useful though

She's fantastic, sweet, and willing to curve your grade if needed. Attendance isn't mandatory, but she will add a question on the final about what goes on in lectures to be sneaky. An easy class if you get along with your peers to help on exams/tests bc they're all online. Every point matters, not much to be graded, and is cumulative.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Definitely enjoyed CHEM 102 more than 101. She made it enjoyable although self-studying is a must. Barely attended lecture because there were no clickers.

I hated the subject chemistry but needed it for my major. Yet, I feel like Professor Tracy might be the best college professor I had yet. Always in a good happy mood that lighten up the room. Exam are pretty hard though, make sure you read.

After a horrible professor the last time I took Chem I was very pleased with Professor Tracy. She goes a little fast when it comes to explaining everything, yet the class is very manageable, and she is more than helpful. She always tried to make sure that the students were successful. Read over her lecture slides and do practice problems for an A/B

After the honestly terrible chemistry department I had to deal with at my previous school, Dr. Tracy was such a breath of fresh air. She's super nice, cares about her students' success, and is more than willing to help. Chemistry is a difficult subject, but she really tries to explain it well in a way students can understand.

Dr. Tracy is one of the best professors I have ever had!  She is kind, funny, and cares about each of her students.  She is always willing to help.   What she says in class is important, so take good notes.

Everyone loves Dr. Tracy! She is the sweetest professor and really tries to get to know her students. It is so obvious that she genuinely wants everyone to succeed, although her TAs are tough graders. Lab reports almost every week, one formal report, one research project with your lab partner, two quizzes, two exams. A lot of work, but not too bad.

One of the best professors I have ever had. She's awesome. She is more than willing to help her students. Her personality makes lecture easy to follow along. She makes you work but she will go above and beyond to make sure you are getting the help you need. I would take her again in a heart beat.

Dr. Tracy is the best chem professor i've ever had. I took CHEM 123 & 124 over the summer with her and it was so easy. I'm not good at chem at all but i got an A in the class. Her lectures are easy to follow and if you go to class and pay attention then you should have no problem passing. She is always willing to help her students.

She is an awesome teacher but her tests do not entirely reflect what she teaches in class. She throws in of random questions that she rarely/never mentioned and there is only thirty so your grade can plummet fast since tests are a huge part of your grade.
Nicest professor ever! She knows what she is talking about and will be really helpful if you dont understand something. Class is not easy but it is not too hard.

The best professor I've ever had! I haven been in Dr. Tracey's 123 lecture are she's much a great professor. She really knows the material and goes above and beyond for her students. She will make sure you understand the material. Go to SI sessions and utilize her office hours! Tests can be hard just study and you will be fine.

She is the best teacher in the world. I loved her, she really knows the subject and gets really into it. The class is hard, but having a study group, going to class, SI sessions helps alot. Make sure to take down alot of notes because those can be on her test.

She is such a great person. She has a great personality and is really interested in the subject. She tends to over explain everything which makes it hard to pay attention and can sometimes be confusing. I put barely any effort into studying and still ended up with an 86

Dr. Tracy is the best!  She is very clear and explains the subject matter in a way that is easily understood.  You have to go to class and pay attention but that pretty easy to do with Dr. Tracy.  I give her a very good rating and definately a chili pepper!

one of the most caring and awesome professors at UMBC. You are lucky if you have a chance to have her class. Lectures are clear and she will do everything in her power to make sure you get what she is teaching you. Very intelligent and funny. will recommend her in a heartbeat.

She is fun! Lectures are clear,simple,& easy. But you need to study every bit of it. This was the best lab I ever had. Learned alot and there was no pressure(unlike A-Chem lab) There are reports do weekly,2 formal reports & 1 presentation. Lots of writing and be prepared for lab.TA grades the reports. She gives about 8 A, so most likely no curve.

Tracy's an awesome professor! When you talk to her, she's extremely kind and helpful. Her lectures are extremely relevant to the exams, make sure you go to class and study! She curves exams sometimes depending on the class average.

Prof. Tracy is Great!! Class is..mediocre/hard. I found it alright, because i studied of course. Im not the kind of student thats constantly studying, but i managed to pull a B. I didnt open my book once. She uses powerpoint, and not all the nots are there, so classes are mandatory. Get to know Prof. Tracy. She'll be happy to write a letter of rec.

Dr. Tracy is one of the best (if not the best) professors I have ever had. I took both 123 and 124 with her. She takes material that is difficult and makes it easier to understand. Chemistry can be boring, but she makes it interesting and relevant. She is also a VERY fair grader. If she sees that you put in the effort she will curve your grade.

One of my favorate professors yet. Materials not easy, but if you attend class and study slides you will recieve A or B. There is a slight curve on each test, and at the end of the semester she curves. Very fair, and your grade reflects your studying. Makes it very understandable. Great Lady!!!
Very understanding prof...recomended!
She is a great prof.  Always helpful and goes at the pace the class sets, even if the class is getting behind, WONDERFUL TEACHER AND PERSON!!!!!
She's really nice and always smile. Feels like you're cared. Problem sets are so helpful and if you study enough, you should get an easy A. She even round your final grade.
Take Dr. Tracy. Excellent professor!

Amazing professor! Very helpful, clear with notes. Barely have to read the textbook because she goes through everything you need in class lectures. Tests are fair. Best professor I've had so far. Answers all questions, class is very organized. I look forward to taking chem 124 with her next semester.
The best!!!!
She spent time with students. She's always say positive things , and make you feel confident . Her lectures are simple ,and easy to understand. She's pretty , nice . Best wishes to her.
She's the best teacher i have had . She's nice , helpful, smart. Love to be her student. Highly recommended.
Dr. Tracy is one of the best professors I've had. She is very nice and explains everything thoroughly and clearly. Her exams are short, concise, and not hard.
She's great. Helpful, intelligent, funny, and very pretty. She makes lecture and lab very enjoyable.

This guy does not teach this class well at all. He spends nearly a whole period talking about 2 pages in the textbook that have nothing to do with what will be on exams. Homework is very difficult at times, and extremely frustrating. The only reason I got an A in the class was because the TA graded HW and exams very generously. Avoid if possible.

I've had him three times, and he is best at teaching this class. There are quizzes, individual/group homeworks, one midterm, and presentations. We had a take-home final exam that was nine questions and took FOREVER. Seriously, make sure you choose your group wisely, because you do EVERYTHING with your group in this class.

Everybody gangs up on him and likes to take advantage of him.  He isn't that bad of a professor.  However, if he learns your name, he will literally call on you every class.  Usually he learns the names of the students that either get As on his exams or Fs on his exams and always calls on them.  Just read his lecture notes at home and it's easy.

Probably the worst Prof at UMBC. Can't say enough bad things about his lack of organization, indifference towards class performance, random and slow grading, and overall below average performance in everything he teaches. Easily could've gotten a better grade with a competent Professor

Every lecture is done directly from book. If you ask him a question, he will not answer it well and ask for your name so he can call on you later. On more than 1 occasion went back on his word. He couldn't tie his tie right to save his life. Lucky he sometimes left copies of solutions stapled to our quizzes. Def my least favorite prof at UMBC

I've taken 3 classes with him, and he is not that bad! It's hard to pay attention to lectures, but if you do the examples are very helpful for quizzes/exams. He's a nice guy, and is very willing to help you.

Few issues with accent but a good and useful teacher. Don't mind the negative comments. From my past experience as an exchange student in Sweden, Americans students like to be fed in the mouth like small birds. No effort to go out of the box and read extra materials! He is a good teacher with an international background!

Yes, only positive reviewer, we don't understand the subject matter because Tshibangu doesn't do much of anything to explain it. If you have to take a class with this guy be prepared to effectively teach yourself the whole course.
He is a good teacher. Those whining probably don't understand the whole concept.

Lectures are straight out of the book. There is never any attempt to go beyond the derivations to explain the overall concept. HW was usually book problems. Test problems didn?t always reflect what was expected.  Grading is random. Assignments not returned in a timely manner. Definitely one of the worst teachers at UMBC.

Makes more mistakes than any other professor I've had so far. Poorly defined assignments, confusing schedule and while it seems like he might know the material he does not explain it well. I've been told he curves heavily to make up for his students not learning much from lectures.

This professor appeared to have absolutely no concept of the point of this class. His understanding of the textbook's material was poor. Assignments were very poorly defined and grading was unrealistically harsh. We were never given examples of correct responses to assignments and rarely had any idea why we lost points. Abysmal professor.

Dr. Twigg is an amazing professor! I wish I could have her for all of my nursing courses. Obviously Med Surg is one of the harder courses you will take in nursing school, so do the readings and if you do poorly on the first test, make sure you schedule an appt with Dr. Twigg and she will go over it with you and make a plan on how you can do better!

Regina is VERY fake. She will give you the impression she is trying to help you make it through, and behind your back, she will tell your clinical instructor to fail you. You can do well didactically in this class, just like Adult Health, but STILL fail, because of clinicals. If they don't like you, they will not stop until they get rid of you.
My favorite professor by far!!! Very knowledgeable, fair, and truly cares about student success. Goes above and beyond her duties as a professor. Loved her!!!

Regina is not only a great professor, but she is also what people should aspire to be like when they become nurses. She is  the most caring and knowledgeable professor in the SON. I only wish I could have had her for all of my courses.

Regina is very helpful. Email her if you're having trouble and she will be more than willing to help you out. I struggled with her exams cause they're NCLEX style. Practice, practice, practice! I enjoyed her lectures but some complain she doesn't teach the material well. There's a lot to the course (Lab, clinicals, etc), not a lot of time for rest.
Wonderful, big-hearted professor who will help you learn by hook or by crook. Nursing school is hard, but she makes it fun too. I would count her as one of my top 10 favorite professors of all time.
