Regina is wonderful! She is very interested in students and very encouraging and helping. Get to know her outside of the classroom, and she'll remember who you are and help you if she can. The class is hard, but Regina makes you feel like you can do it! I had her for lab for health assessment, she was very nice, laid back, and not a hard grader.
She does not care about students. Will fail you if she can. She has no interest in your learning. Try to get Judy HInes as lab instructor if you can, she is much better.

Material was kinda interesting. Students practically teach themselves. There is way too much reading and assignments/projects. Easy, but takes time away from other classes. There are no tests or quizzes just a lot of blackboard discussion posts. Readings are long but I just skimmed the relevant parts for my posts. No textbook though.

Rita Turner is super sweet! I feel like I could hang out with her outside of class as a friend! However, she assigns LOADS of reading, and weekly discussion questions/reflection writings. She also assigns THREE group projects, including volunteering with an organization, which is just too much. She really wants people to talk during class and share

Pretty positive experience with this professor. I work a real job, and there is a lot of writing homework every week on blackboard so it was hard keeping up. Taught primarily by students because we provide the discussion questions for the class. I ended up getting a B, but I could have gotten an A if I did all of the many blackboard assignments.
She is an excellent professor! She is very passionate about the course material and she provides all of the readings online so that you don't have to buy a textbook.

Seriously one of the most useless classes I have taken in a while. She isn't clear about what she wants but expects you to do a lot of independent work. The class is mostly taught by students which can be good or bad. I'm really mad this class didn't count as a writing intensive course. Only took it because it's required for my major.

Class is taught by students- not the professor which is good and bad. If you're not presenting you can be on your laptop doing nothing, but make it look like you're working so you get good participation points. She is really nice and seems genuinely interesting in media studies. MCS222 is a lot of online discussion boards- she is a tough grader
She's amazing, makes class fun and interesting and assignments are not overly challenging.
Great Prof. Exams are too easy if you study his Study guide. Group presentation was an easy A. The only down side to his class is the essay (8-10 pages)but overall everything else is EASY!!
He is great! Take Him! lectures are very interesting

He's really cool and I like his class.  He is kinda easy. If you come to most classes, participate in discussions and act like you care you'll get an A.  If you come to class late always or try handing stuff in late he'll shut you down. I'll take another class with him.
Great Proffesor.. I enjoyed his summer class a lot.. it was very easy to recieve an a.. take him if possible..
I liked his class a lot.  I'm taking him in the fall too.
Professor Tuer is a great! I really liked his class and might take him again.

All we had to do was a presentation, an outline, a paper &2 exams. He is really chills and likes a little discussion. You must complete the paper or you will fail. while attendance isn't mandatory, 1 day he gave extra points to the people in class because half the class is absent especially during his 8:30 sessions.Also, he lectures from the text.

Professor Tuer is AWESOME! He never tries to trick you or make things difficult. He has clear guidelines and standards. You either do them or you don't. As long as you make a reasonable effort, you'll get a great grade. He brings in the coolest guest speakers! The man has connections, and if you're smart, you'll make a lasting impression.

I have Professor Tuer for juvenile delinquency this semester (spring 2012) and the class has been great.  He knows his stuff, keeps it interesting and we had a couple of cool guest speakers. Iâ??m taking another one of his classes this fall and Iâ??d recommend his class any day.

Professor Tuer is absolutely amazing and a blessing to have at UMBC! Anyone who finds his classes to be anything less, should reconsider their major. Attendance is not mandatory but the man has more connections than a lego set. If you're smart, you'll come to class! He's extremely laid back and very easy to talk to.  HE'S THE MAN!

Professor Tuer was awesome for this Terrorism and Social Violence class.  He made good study guides, is laid back, had stellar guest speakers from the FBI and CIA.  Attendance was mandatory for the winter session.  He wants a lot of class participation.  He is strict on deadlines and arriving on time, but other than that he is really cool.

He was pretty cool and i'd take him again.  Being a retired X cop he adds a lot of street experience to the class.  Has some cool guest speakers also.  He had his FBI frind from the baltimore field office come talk to us one class.
Great class.

I thought the class was great.  He's very fair and easy to work with unless you're trying to get over.  If you're to get over, he'll shut you down pretty quick.  The work is easy, you're better off just doing it.

This professor is not helpful at all. He is lazy and he reads directly from the powerpoint which are copied from the textbook. He spits tobacco in class. All he talks about is his personal experiences, which were kind of fun to listen to. Overall, the class is easy, but he is not a professor to learn anything from.
He's pretty fair.  I liked his class overall.
Professor Tuer is awesome.  I really love his class!

This guy is lazy and talks about his personal experiences as a cop all the time which would be interesting if it were ever relevant to what he was talking about. Took two of his classes, he is offensive, spit tobacco in class, and is not friendly or helpful at all. An easy class to pass if you're looking for an easy A

What makes Prof Tuer a gr8 professor is that he is ex-law enforcement so his real-life experiences bring the material to life. He went a bit fast through the power points so I suggest bringing a laptop for notes. Changes this course: attendance is not mandatory (but perfect attendance gets an xtra 5 pts), no group presentation, & he posted PP to BB

What makes Prof Tuer a gr8 professor is that he is ex-law enforcement so his real-life experiences bring the material to life. He went a bit fast through the power points so I suggest bringing a laptop for notes. I highly recommend! 2 exams & a term paper. FYI: the group presentation was super EZ and 100 free points; those who complain r L-A-Z-Y!
good
I had him for Terrorism over the winter.  He's pretty laid back and had a cool guest speaker.

Professor Tuer was the best professor at UMBC that I had ? period!  He is one of those professors that can actually change your entire perspective.  I plan on taking more of his classes.  His police background really made the class not to mention, for a professor he?s kind of cute.  He regularly had guest speakers from the criminal justice field co

I thought it was a great class. He?s a retired detective and his police background really made it interesting.  He also has a lot of good speakers come in.  He knows cops and FBI agents all over because he was a cop.  The agent from the FBI was the best guest speaker we had.

I enjoyed going to this class a lot, espcially when he was actually teaching it! But overall, lots of really interesting perspectives because of his background and the guest speakers he brought in. The biggest problem I had was actually the amount of group projects that were done. Talk about boring!

He does not post ppt online you need to show up. Only 4 grades in the class 2 multiple choice exams, 1 presentation, and 1 term paper. He is very strict about deadlines, participation, and being on time. He has a lot of interesting speakers come in.

Prof Tuer is pretty cool and has the best guest speakers come in.  He's a retired cop and brings an interesting perspective to the class.  He does not take anything late though so turn your stuff in on time. This is the second class I've taken with him and I may take one more.

He reads directly from the powerpoints and goes through them too fast. DOES NOT post slides on blackboard and gives crappy study guides. Average lecturer. You'll be doing most of your learning from the text book.Class is not mandatory. But he does have really cool guest speakers come in.
I think Professor Tuer is an awesome lecturer.  His insight from actually working in law enforcement added to the class and his guest speakers were the best.  I love Professor Tuer!

Professor Tuer is a pretty average lecturer. He doesn't use any special techniques to aid in his teachings, just reads verbatim from Power Point slides and goes into a little detail about what the slide means. Class is not mandatory, he posts up the slides on Blackboard later on. He tells a few jokes here and there and has a few humorous stories.

Professor really knows her stuff. Inspired me to get my masters in African History. Great lecturer, makes the material interesting, easy class as long as you show up. Perfect class to take if you just need credit!

Do not take this class if you don't have to. This professor was never clear about her grading scale and failed to provide useful comments after an assignment was turned in. I did not learn much about Africana Studies and was often VERY sleepy in that class.

This professor is childish, sassy, too dramatic and rude. She has such an annoying attitude, and African Studies was not interesting to me because of this. Assignments, reading and workload were fine but the actual lectures were boring. You watch a lot of movies but that's not really a plus.

Ruined my interests in African Studies. Doesn't know what she's doing. She has to check the syllabus to even know what we're doing during any given class. Very rude and condescending. yet she can't even speak in proper grammar. Is never clear about what she wants, her rubrics are so vague and is bias in her grading. She sucks NEVER take her.

Honestly this class was a waste of time. all you do for the entire semester is watch movies in class and she has read books at home. She will take your phone if she sees you on it, and is very condescending and rude. She told us once that she would just give us all F's if she felt like. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: I wish I saw these comments & this rating before I took this course. I wouldn't have taken it otherwise.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The syllabus is very unclear about assignments and the professor went further by grading us differently than what little was listed as grading criteria. She assigns seemingly random grades, with comments that show she barely read our "reading briefs" that were supposed to be composed of many, at times unrelated, readings. Choose another professor.

Very condescending, any statement or answer you give in class is incorrect to her. Very unclear about what she wants in the writing assignments. Endless reading and all we did in class was watch movies. Worst of all, she is the SLOWWWWESTTT GRADER EVER!! Did a group presentation before spring break, and we still haven't received our grade!
Hard professor. Takes forever to grade
Very tough grader

Do not take this class. You will not learn anything. You sit around and watch movies and then are expected to have read 30 readings that week and come up with a very specific answer to her questions. Hint: you will not ever have the correct answer. Insane amount of writing for her "writing intensive class" that is not classified as such.

Unclear grading criteria. A lot of writing. Will arbitrarily assign grades depending on how cranky she is feeling that day (She literally said this to the class). Expects all students to have read the bible (not an assigned class reading).  We watch movies and then she waits for 20 minutes until someone says something about it so she can correct us

The professor knows the subject matter. However, the assignments she gives are either essays or group presentations. Most classes were spent watching films or listening to groups present their projects. Lectures were rare and not substantive. If she disagreed with your opinion, she would disregard what you said. Final is a big research paper.

Interesting subject matter, not a good professor.  Majority of class time spent watching movies and group presentations. Discussions are shallow and un-profound, if you don't say what she's thinking you're disregarded.  Bad grading criteria, papers assigned after every unit, and a 10 page final paper worth 40%  of your whole grade.
If taking 101 - great, easy teacher. Passionate about what she's  talking about and follows book pretty closely.

STAY AWAY!!!!!!!!!unless all your options are wasted,,,,then i would recomend, other than that...stay away!!!!!!!!! Is alot of WORK!!!!!QUIZZES S%*K. STAY AWAY!!! STAY AWAY!!! STAY AWAY!!! STAY AWAY!!! STAY AWAY!!!

Great teacher, difficult class. Expect to spend a fair amount of time reading for the weekly quizzes, which are annoying but useful for learning key concepts. She gives in depth study guides for the two exams, if you can answer those questions the exams are fairly easy. So as long as you know it will be difficult, I'd recommend Professor Z!

this class is hard...half of the class drop out...then from the remaining half....only a couple got A or B. i tell you what is better to take it with another profesor, but if u dont have no choice,,,,just remenber that u have to work really hard to get an A. then again this is a university,,,so i guess that u r suppose to work hard.the quiz suck

she's a passionate professor who knows her stuff. only downside is that she gets off topic and that some of her exam questions are from left field (straight random facts you have to remember from the textbook). but if you study, READ THE BOOK, and do the in class assignments, you'll get an a. basically, be a good student and this class is easy.

She is a good teacher overall. She is nice and tells stories a lot (although to the point where she repeats some stories multiple times). Go to class because there are random in class worksheets that are super easy because you go over it before turning it in. Don't talk while she is though because that's one of her pet peeves and she calls you out.

The class was fine. You don't need to go to class to understand the material but attendance was mandatory. For her powerpoints, she copied the notes and diagrams from the textbook verbatim. I got an A in the class just by reading the book. Weekly quizzes were annoying but there were only two tests and she gave study guides for both of them.

Very nice professor, I've had her before, but the class was tedious. Weekly quizzes on the reading so don't skip class or forget to read, two tests which she gives detailed study guides for. Big projects, but you work in groups so its not awful. If you have to take SOCY 300, she's the best.

Great teacher. Difficult class. Tests are okay, but some of the assignments are difficult unless you're really into sociology stuff. Dr. Z is really cool and passionate about what she teaches but a lot of the concepts are complicated, and you HAVE to read the textbook...if you don't wanna read, then don't take the class.
terrible. exams go too in depth for someone who cannot grasp sociology concepts. even when reading the book, the tests were too difficult. do not recommend her.

Dr. Z is extremely straightforward and passionate about what she teaches. She doesn't care whether or not you show up as long as you don't distract her or anyone else. She tells some entertaining stories, but what I will remember most is her talking about global problems - really thoughtful and provocative. Highly recommend.

Pretty cool teacher, young and interesting. I didn't like how the class is in a huge lecture hall but she showed some cool videos and the tests weren't hard as long as you paid attention and read from the textbook (easy reading, too). Some jocks did badly but only because they paid absolutely zero attention to anything but their friends. Take her!

Dr. Z is great herself, but not for teaching.  She reads directly off of the powerpoint slides, which come directly from the textbook.  BORING.  Exams are all written, no mulitple choice; however, as long as you understand the general concepts, then you should get an A. Lots of writing and group work (lots!).

Dr. Z overall is a good teacher. She is easy to understand and the assignments are reasonable. I did find her somewhat unapprochable. She directs everything to her TA. This semester she had Katelyn as  TA and she was great so it was not an issue.
Her name is so complicated lol..although there was one thing I like about her class and that was that the final was optional! woohoo!

The class pretty much sucked! she is an OK teacher...but mainly the TA sucked.. she was horrible and no help at all..she always looked mad for some reason ahhah..overall the class was pretty boring and it was kind of hard as well. Wouldn't recommend lol

She has a strong passion about what she is teaching, but she gets very irresponsible sometimes. Students are required to contact her by email through her TA, but the thing is that you'll never get an email back. Maybe it was because that I really suck at social sciences, that I think that class was hard too.
BEST OF THE BEST FOR SOCIOLOGY!!! Keep it up Dr. Z!!

So easy! Material is interesting. Read the book for your own good. It's all common sense anyway. She does everything in her power to make sure everyone gets a good grade, so I don't know how everyone didn't get an A. If u get below a B, u need to go back to elementary school.
great teacher, would take her again. she does have a slight accent, which might be a problem for some. I managed to get an A though. final is optional.

You can just read textbook for the tests, but you have to go to the class to do the in class assignments, which is 25% of your grade. She was irresponsible towards the end of semester. Tests for too specific names and details in the book. I wouldn't take her again.
Great teacher. I look forward to her classes and find them very interesting. As long as you go to class and take notes(she uses power point so its not hard) you can basically skip the readings.

Man, is this a great class!  So much fun!  It is completely possible to do well and not try too terribly hard. She is understanding and fills the grades with simple worksheets (go to class!) and a drop-your-lowest-test (or don't take the final) policy. Try to actually READ the book, its not just dribble.  She has stories and passion for the subject
very good teacher

Easy class. Apparently the class average was a 61? Wow that sucks I wonder if that's with all the 0's for people who didn't drop or whatever. Teacher is decent, very interested in material, fairly nice too. I recommend this class.

A feminist...don't take the class if you expect it to be easy, just read the textbook and you'll be fine...The classes aren't mandatory but she gives out assignments that are worth points so basically you'll have to go to class...

The text is a very easy read (unlike most class).  As long as you make sure you either 1. take notes on everything she says in class or 2. read the book you should do great.  She allows you to drop one of her exams, so if you do well on the first 3 you dont have to take the last one.  Overall I recommend this class.
Great Prof! Always has fun stories related to the material. Shows interesting videos. Exams are fair.
So boring. No point in going to class. Has an accent and is really hard to understand. Doesn't teach fluidly, jumps from point to point.

Great class, made me consider a socy major. Cool videos, I learned a lot. You must pay attention in class though. The teacher is funny and engaging so the class goes easily. The textbook is very easy. Tests are so-so.
Fun class, but don't be fooled by the seeming ease of the subject b/c you gotta work for the grade. Prof helpful and nice. Take it if the topic interests you and you will enjoy it.

Her class is easy but that is the only good thing about it. She is boring and notes come straight from the text. She spends the whole class reading the notes. The worst thing is that she is generally not helpful or even friendly. Likes to call out students in front of the whole class for little things, it's incredibly irritating, just like her!

Her class is really easy as long as you show up and then study for the exams FROM THE TEXTBOOK. Almost everything is straight from the book, give or take a few random things she says in class. In class assignments are a gimmie as long as you turn them in. If you do well on the first three tests, you can drop the final! I ended up with a 93%.

A very easy class... but to earn an A you MUST attend as many classes as much possible! Studying is very easy for it. And at the end of the course theres a nice little curve (i think i got 8%, maybe extra credit?). STUDY for the first 3 exams and skip the final. SLEEP during every class if you are going to study from the book later. WAKE UP to do in-class assignments.

Easy class. Didn't learn much from lecture but attendance was kind of mandatory because she gave random in class activities that are like 30% of your total grade. Exams are easy as long as you read the textbook. She drops one out of 4 exams, you don't have to take the final.

Not a bad class, overall. You need to study for the tests, though. The lectures and notes are necessary to do well on the tests. She drops your two lowest in-class assignments and one test grade, so you don't have to take the final if your satisfied with your grade! I liked her, but the material was boring to me.  I found it hard to pay attention.

Okay, this teacher is a joke---very very easy class, but prepare to get some sleep in during class! She simply said what was in the book, so it is very easy. However, you do have to go to class---it is vital. But besides that very easy, SIMPLE A!
She looooves to start discussions on touchy issues.  The class was very fun.  The exams aren't exactly easy but they are fair.  If you study you'll do well.

I took her class in the fall.  Her lectures aren't very helpful.  Don't use class notes.  If you read the book right before the test, you will do fine on the exams.  They are all multiple choice.  Overall, very nice teacher and easy class to pass.
Great teacher!!! The key is to STUDY!!!!!!!! DO NOT let the easyness get to you or your grades will suffer. Read the other comments under mine.

Tufecki is very interesting to listen to and I got a lot out of her class. Her exams aren't hard as long as you study the material. I didn't have to take the last exam because I already had a 94% in the class. Very easy professor.

Very cute, fun to listen to and makes a general course less painful.  Easy classes, interesting (usually) lectures, little homework.  Tests can be rather confusing but dont hesitate to go the TA and argue answers I found a mismarked scantron answer sheet.  Pretty cool class, made me think of having a SOCY minor.

Very good professor, clear, and interesting lectures.  Uses powerpoint in class but not so that you are bogged down.  4 tests including final, she only counts the 3 highest grades--do well on the first 3, omit the final!  Went to 2/3 of the classes and just missed an A.

Do not use lecture notes for the test. They are useless. Read book. All tests count equal, if okay with grade do not have to take final. Easy lectures and in class assignment but difficult tests. Hard to get in touch with teacher unless in class.
Great proffesor, Easy and interesting class, Mrs.T is a very interesting and intelligent professor with a very interesting background. I actually regret missing lectures.
The class is easy, but the teacher is useless. A monkey could teach the class just as well.
class is easy if you just read the book
She is a very enjoyable teacher, cute accent but also very intelligent and very open to questions and discussions. Watch a lot of very interesting movies.

she is very very helpful individual.  She will even assist you with getting books if need be.  However, she can be a bit evasive to the material, and yes she does have great discussion.  Overall, if you read the material and understand what you are reading, then you will be white on rice with an "A".  Watch the movies no matter how boring they are because that enhances that "A".
she's very nice; easy exams; easy to get an A - just go to class. you watch a lot of movies.  she doesn't finish sentences and i would suggest reading the book rather than paying attention in class

She is an alright professor, exams are pretty easy, multi. choice and t/f.  She sometimes lets class disscusions get a little out of control so that all of a sudden you are way out in left feild from what you are supposed to be learning.  But overall a pretty easy class.

She's a new Turkish teacher. Very sweet and kind with a cute accent. She basically has 3 tests and a final exam plus a few miscellaneus hw write ups which is BS. Basically she lectures during class from chapters of text. Tests all mult choice. i suck at mult. Shes not very good at teaching though

Dr.V is a good professor who cares about her students doing well, as long as you are willing to put in the work and be active in asking for help then she will help you with most things. The point of the grading system is to resubmit many, many times so if you approach assignments knowing that it will take many attempts the class will go smoother.

Going to lectures explain ahead of time what to prepare for labs. I didn't like we had to print out papers for lab procedures. Read the procedures ahead of time and study a bit so you know what to do in lab that day. TA's are the teachers in the lab, & there's always a quiz at the beginning of lab from the lecture! Attendance is mandatory for lab!

A bit stern. You better hope and pray you have a good lab partner, otherwise you might be lost on some things. the final can either boost or kill your grade. the lab procedures were very fun, try to have fun with it. She is not actively in the lab, most of it directed by TA who is usually overstimulated by all the questions. Hard to fail though.

TA does most of your grading for this class. they just float through labs and lecture not mandatory but helpful for quizzes. study slides for the lab quizzes. final was lot of memorization from topics throughout whole semester, pretty okay though. prof seemed chill and available outside of class.

Dr. V did not actually do anything; my TA did everything. The quizzes each Friday got harder each week. If you have a good lab partner, you'll be good. Lecture not necessary. I ended with a B because Dr. V. gave out extra credit due on a Saturday at 4pm randomly and I missed it and she refused to reopen it. Alison Tracy had hers open for a week...
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. V does NOT teach! They have said in class that they expect students to teach other. They leave the class and we are left with a TA who often doesn't know much more than us. They give out tokens to use on lab reports as we are expected to redo them since "we learn by failing." They speak in a demeaning tone to students and is unapproachable.

Horrific experience in their class. The professor seems to enjoy watching students struggle. It's ironic how they claim to be an educational researcher, but were one of the meanest, most demeaning, awful teachers I had in my life. They do not teach and are rarely present in the lab. AVOID this professor at all costs.

This professor comes across as a bully. They refuse to explain anything and see it as the student's responsibility to figure it out themselves or teach each other. Genuinely will just sit with their feet on the bench ignoring students. They seem to thrive on making students feel less than. Aims to remind undergrads they are incapable.

They mostly do the lecture part of the lab the TAs are with you when you are inside the lab but when it comes to lectures they are great. They make sure everyone understands and encourages questions. During the lab they do walk around to make sure everything is alright and you are free to ask them questions and help.

Pretty easy class don't even need to go to the Monday prelab lectures but the quizzes before each lab could be kinda hard. The professor didn't do a whole lot it was mostly the tas that taught us what to do and stayed with us all class.

All things are graded by your TA besides the final. The TAs are very sweet but can grade a bit harshly because Dr. V doesn't want everyone getting full marks that easily. Your grade will heavily depend on "video exams" and your lab reports so do well on them to get an easy A, if you don't do great you'll fall behind to a B.

Dr. V was nice and passionate about chemistry. Her lead off lectures on mondays were not mandatory but there was a lot of work you had to do for the lab so it would be hard to make up if you missed one. The TA taught most of the lab but Dr. V was around sometimes. She gives you all the information you need to succeed though!
Insanely unclear instructions, likes to make students feel dumb. It's in the classroom and doesn't answer questions.
Dr. V is easily the best professor in the chemistry department when it comes to being interdisciplinary, motivating actual passion for learning and applicability in terms of real life

One of the best chem Professor at UMBC. She is super understanding! She told us we can submit late work and no pints would be taken off. Theres lots of lab reports but they are pretty easy, they mainly come from the lab manual, 3 quizzes, and no exam ( I took it in the summer so no exam). The class is super flexible in the summer! I Recommend her.

Dr. V is super engaging, and goes out of her way to make sure you're keeping your head above water (this class is a lot of writing). She does a fantastic job of facilitating discussions between class members, helps students find internships and build their resumes, and made what would have been another isolating remote class feel connected.

Professor Andalib does a great job explaining the material then solves problems with us so that we apply what we learn. Also, he regularly checks in with students and makes sure we understand before he moves on to the next thing. He and his TA Mr Azizi provided us with all the resources we need to prepare for the exam (do the practice questions!)

lectures were just screenshots from the textbook and he read over them so lectures were useless. you can tell he is a nice person but does not know how to teach. Many formulas to memorize that go with word problems.
his lectures are extremely boring. he doesn't really prepare us well for the exams. there's a lack of resources in this class; it's really hard to get the help we need when there's limited help.

He is such a smart person! extremely knowledgeable. he went out of his way to make sure everyone understood the lectures/lessons and what to expect for assignments and exams. I really hope that he will teach more classes next semester, I would love to take any class that he teaches! Also, he is very patient and caring towards students. ������

Very passionate and knows what he's talking about, although it is occasionally difficult to understand him. Gives great feedback on things to improve in sound. Sometimes will show videos/movies that are super interesting. Super valuable class for anyone doing film/animation/music. For assignments, make something experimental and weird! It's fun :)

Taught us almost nothing himself, assigning tons of Lynda and YouTube vids instead. Got no feedback on my assignments other than my grade, though when we had critiques he was overly critical imo. I found him very condescending when he addressed the class in general. Assignments weren't graded equally- the final proj was worth 40% of grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You can tell he is knowledgeable and enthusiastic about his profession; he knows what he's talking about and willing to answer your questions and assist you as needed. He cares about his students, even if it takes him a little longer to respond to your email. He has roughly 5 projects, all of which are doable if you pay attention in class.
Do yourself a favor and don't take any of his classes if you can.

Christian has a NOTICEABLY DEEP passion for what he does- and it makes you care about the things you learn and produce, too (even if you go into it either down on or indifferent to the subject matter). If nothing else, you will leave his class with a strong understanding of some POWERFUL software that can be used for the rest of your life. 11/10.

Christian is just a great dude who really loves sound. While a lot of stuff you end up teaching yourself, he's more than willing to help you anytime you go to see him. He has a lot of energy but understood that the 2.5 hour classes start to feel long, so he let us go early a lot. Very nice guy, definitely a good class to take.

You know you're an autistic student when you don't see anything wrong with his social skills. I appreciated his straightforward critique, and while it could come across harsh, he made sure to make it clear that he didn't intend to be mean. He's distractible, but loves this class, and wants you to learn. Did show a migraine-inducing movie, though.

Intelligent, humorous, patient, and overall a real nice guy who knows what he's doing. My class only met once a week, so you CANNOT skip it, but he's pretty cool about waiving you as long as you have a note.
Christian's the best. Take his sound design, it's something he really cares about and you will learn lots from!

d His class has been one of my favorites at this university. a Very informative, really focused on the technical aspects of sound design. d Patient with student progress. d Sees the best in whatever work we do present. y All while providing constructive critique. a Will definitely take a class with him again. f
A rather charming individual.
What a great great man

He is such a sweet guy. If you need help with your video assignments and the software, he tries his best to help you. He also gives you extensions on your assignment if you need one. His class is also so much fun to do.

A great teacher, when he actually teaches. Often shows movie examples instead of teaching. If you are having trouble though, asking a question and getting his help and you will be set. Grades projects easily, but tests are very nit-picky and difficult.

Christian's a really good professor. He's fun and very passionate about what he does. You really see that passion during critiques, where he can be a bit straightforward and a bit harsh with you. But he's easy to talk to and eager to help. :) I'd take a class with him again.

Fun and informed. Very fair in grading takes many factors into account for final grade, offers extra credit and re-do opportunities if you are having a hard time. Looks for very specific things for homework, so pay attention. Will critique your work in front of everyone - like any art class - so get used to it. Harsh if you don't show any effort.

He's a decent teacher, but he's also incredibly awkward to talk to. He doesn't seem to know how to be social. If you don't follow his assignments to the letter, then he'll seem flustered and will awkwardly confront you in front of the whole class. Overall, he's worth having, but it will be weird at times.
nice guy, fairly easy course if you do the work. mostly just shows movie clips, which actually results in many pointless classes.

Prof. Kastrel emphasized speaking and grammar in this course in a very understanding way. She knows that to get better in a language you have to make mistakes, so don't be too worried about that. There are a couple cultural projects and exams were open book. Show effort and take time to do the homework, and you will enjoy this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She is a very kind and caring professor who did a good job for her first semester of teaching. There is a fair amount of work since it is a language class and constant practice is something that is needed to learn a language, though it is very manageable. She is flexible with due dates and gives solid feedback. Overall a great professor.

New professor, adapting good to an environment with American students and heritage students. She'll print out HWs you submit on Bb and mark it up for direct feedback, you can always ask questions/help. Dynamic and uses different teaching styles, and you will become a big fan of the kids worksheets. Seems like she's receptive when students struggle.

Frankly if you can get another teacher, I would strongly reccommend it. This statement however only pertains to those who actually want to learn. This class isn't exceedingly difficult if you're willing to do the reading, however you will simply be reguritating facts all class. If you dare ask him a question to learn you will promptly be shot down.

Dr. King-Meadows is a great professor who has dedicated his life to teaching political science thoroughly. If dislike learning, then his courses are not for you. You leave his classes smarter, with your money's worth of instruction. I recommend taking at least one of his classes before graduation. Lastly,open minds are suggested.

If you are into poli sci you will enjoy this class. If dont want to waste your time and money not learning anything this is the guy for you, its a very involved class and he will test your knowledge. Have fun!

Best Prof. I've ever taken at UMBC. Everyone talks about how hard he is but he just gives you the maximum amount of info he can. I paid a lot for this class and expect teachers to actually teach. You will leave his class an expert in the topic and he makes sure of it. Great Prof., and I thank you for the semester.

Knew what he was talking about but did not explain his requirements for assignments.  Also was not responsive to e-mails.  I did not like him at all. He knows what he's talking about and lectures were interesting but not very good if you like to talk with your teacher about assignments.  Especially the library assignment.

This was by far the most interesting and exciting class I have had at UMBC. Dr. King-Meadows is passionate about the topics, which makes lectures fun. Some say he grades hard, but honestly EVERYTHING comes from the book,(or online material) on the exams! He has a fair grading system, too, just work hard to get full credit. TAKE THE CLASS!

This teacher is amazing. You do have to keep up with the readings and assignments online but it only helps you better understand the material. & he should get better ratings he is a really helpful and intelligent political science teacher. I'm glad I took POLI 100 with him and not another teacher. He also grades on a point system. Just go to class!

Best professor I have had at the university.  It is a difficult class, but keep up with the readings and try to understand concepts and you will be fine.  I learned alot from this class and professor and it was an all-around great experience.

Took for a Gen-ed and was lost. Felt like I was in a 300 level class. Is helpful outside of class but doesnt answer your questions during class. Don't take unless you have a strong background in Poly-sci

Awesome professor, if you don't know how to apply concepts then don't take the class (or be a polisci major). His lectures are incredible, one of the smartest people I have met at UMBC. The only bad thing was the "library assignment"
OK professor, but some of his assignments are unfair.

Amazing teacher.  He gives you the information in an objective manner and lets you make your decisions.  A lot of reading, but well worth it.  The best part of the class were his lectures.  Not for you if you want an easy A, and are lazy.

This guy makes it difficult for most to learn. It's as if he is trying to show you what he knows,not teach you. Reading the book was fine...I understood it...only to get in his class and hear his lecture and wonder did I buy the wrong book. I am an A, B student. Had to drop this class to keep it that way. I am a junior.

Dr. KM scared me at first. He really knows his stuff, and if you come off as not knowing your stuff, he will call you out on it. His lectures are a little too fast and confusing, w/ no powerpoints to help you follow, but I eventually got used to it. He's extremely fair about grading. One of the best classes I've ever taken. I really learned a lot.
Who hired this guy? Definitely avoid. Listening to this guy will make you stupid.

Difficult, but if you are in it for learning rather than just the grade, he's the teacher for it.  Lots of reading and intimate knowledge is required- he'll tire you out.  Probably a little too hard for your typical 100 level, but you'll be better for it later.  The other problem is that he is an intimidating person.
Great teacher!

I had Pol 100. He is a very intresting teacher and you do learn alot in his class. It's not an easy class though there are alot of readings in two books. This class is taught like a 300 level course you have to apply the information and you should read the chapters and ask questions. If you take class you must study if not you wont do well.Good Luc

For serious students only!  The spring '07 class went from 44 to 12 students.  I learned alot and this guy is the King.  If you stick it out you will be greatly rewarded with a lot of knowledge.  He tends to ease up around mid semester.

One of the best POLISCI profs. Extremely difficult, extremely. But if you're interested in the subject, take the class. I learned so much from him, it was unbelievable. Upper-level classes are a cinch now, because of the great content in his class. Come prepared for alot of tests, debates, and quizzes, and you'll do fine. Study hard, though.
He is one of the hardest teachers you will ever get but he is so beneficial in the end especially if you are a political science major!
DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS!!!!!

King meadow is not an easy teacher, but he defenetly knows his stuff. Personall, i think he shud be teaching in law school or grad school because his just too pumping with political science. His not an easy A teacher at all, he gives pop quizzes, uses the text to core.. but hey.. he'ld make you learn, that is qa must with him.
No Comments

There are no 2 ways about it: this guy is the KING. He knows his stuff. Inside and outside. If you are a POLI SCI major TAKE THIS GUY. IT IS NOT EASY THOUGH. He knows it and he expects you 2 as well. But, when you get through the class, YOU KNOW THE MATERIAL. Great teacher, great guy (class might not be for non-POLI majors).

DO NOT TAKE THIS FOR A GFR! You will regret it, he expects way too much for a 100 level course. Be ready to read from 2 textbooks, roughly 120 pages a week. Exams are super hard and the essays are harder. Requires intimate knowledge of the political system, as well as views and opinions from dozens of authors. Don't make the same mistake I did!

This class is hard. You must read. You must go to class. there are pop quizzes... like 3 or 4 i think. so you must read every night. and reading are like 150 pages a week. I got a B in it, but i have never worked so hard for anything in my life! i learned a lot... but i doubt i will be taking a class with him anytime soon.
high expectations are reasonable in an upper level course!  material was presented in ways that encourage students to think! (not everyone likes that)

very difficult at the beginning of the semester, but the class gets easier. Have to go to lectures, his tests are based on a mix of the text and lecture. I only skimmed the chapters and I did ok in the class. Only 2 papers, tests are hard! he has debates which are ok, and pop quizzes, also very hard

Some may find him harder than others. Basis the course heavily on the text, often going over the same material in the lectures, albeit in a different approach. Grade was heavily dependant on papers; as long as you answer each question on the paper outline, you'll do fine. Just don't be intimidated.

Dont even bother.  He is passionate about what the subject but cannot convey it well.  I read the book, understood it then went to class only to be confused and turned around.  Not helpful, answers questions with questions.  He needs to be reminded that this is a 100 level course and treat it as an introduction, not an upper level course with upper

I can say without question, I am a better student having taken Poli 100 with Dr. King-Meadows.  Some will burn me for it, but it really taught me the value of working hard to reach my goals.  If you are truely passionate about Political Science, take him.  If not, don't take him.

If you are a student athlete or just a nice person DO NOT take this class.  He is not helpful at all and enjoys giving students poor grades.  Throughout the semester he makes you feel like you are stupid since he wears a power suit and huge intimidating man.  He is TERRIBLE.  Attended EVERY class and earned worst grade of any universiry course.

What people need to understand, is that he is unbelievably passionate about what he teaches.  It's refreshing to see, because teachers should be excited to teach.  If you want an easy A, don't take his class.  But, if you want to be challenged then take his class.
i came into this as a poli major, i quickly came out no longer a major. I did get a B in this course but I worked harder for it then ive worked in any course  ever as im now a senior this says a lot.

This man is an excellent professor, if you have the ability to commit to serious reading and thinking. Clear, concise, and open to most opinions, Professor King-Meadows is not afraid to challenge to norm, constantly confronting us with ideas that are frequently contrary to our preconceived notions.

extremely hard, very boring, and not all that helpful.  had him for poli 100 and it almost made me change my major...if its a topic that you're really interested in and you can motivate your self (and be a self-teacher), then you'll probably get something
He was a great teacher; he doesn't force feed you his opinions.  It was a lot of work, but I'm switching majors now because of everything I learned in this class.

Do not expect an easy 'A'.  Don't take his class just to fill a GFR.  It's a lot of work, with a lot of texts.  Tests are absurdly hard.  Lectures are long and difficult to keep up with.  The class is very informative and I learned a lot, however it was stressful.  He ended up rounding a lot and giving EC to my section.
I hate him!!!!!!! He sucks as a teacher!!!!! Never take this class! Avoid him at all cost. He Is a very unhelpful teacher and only seems to want to fail students not teach them. Again, HE SUCKS!

Very hard teacher, expects A LOT out of you. If you have a profound interest in the topic, take him..you will learn a ton. Expect to do the reading and read it well, because his quizzes are very in depth. He expects a lot out of his students. But I did learn a lot and it makde me work hard!

I had him for just a week or two and couldn't stand him! He's very unhelpful, very rude and contemptuous to students and he generally treats people like idiots. Don't take him! He's not worth the stress!

Difficult grader, uses really BIG words in lecture (makes it hard to follow), very rude to students.  If you like reading three textbooks cover to cover, all the more power to you.  If you are not a poli sci major, DON'T TAKE HIM!!!
A quiz every other week, and only 3 exams, a whole lot of reading, but really not that bad once you figure out how he works the class.
boring.. quiz given durning every class
Very informative teacher, but he hands out his quizes usually BEFORE class starts.  Get there early EVERYDAY.
When he says there  might  be a quizx every day, he means there  WILL  be a quiz every day. I hated this class, but it was fairly informative.
Awesome teacher! Awesome class! He made me want to change the world! He makes poli sci interesting and engaging!
this teacher pushes you but its well worth the effort. he's assigns a lot but grades easily. take any class with him, it will be worth you time.
nice guy, very objective, fun class, BUT very hard.  I had to work my butt off to get an A.  Be prepared to read 80 pages a night, and have a quiz everyday

I LOVED this class. I was really scared the first day when I only understood about 60-70% of what she was saying since in 202 we didn't speak French a ton. But she just took some getting used to and even though I got sick and missed a lot of class, I got an A. Really fun, sweet, and interesting.

Such a wonderful lady. She is from Paris and just speaks french in class but answers all questions so well. If you have problems speaking, she will help you, drag it out of you if she has to. Such a funny quirky little lady, one of my favorites.

She is adorable! Love this woman, very easy, tests are meant to help you, not to screw you over. Very informative, actually is French so very knowledgeable, and loves her class. There's a lot of homework but it's all review and clarification of prior things we knew.

She's very nice and always helpful. We watched several  of movies and had a lot of in-class discussions, and the assignments and quizzes were usually easy. There were times when we weren't sure what was going on in terms of due dates, etc. but that's not her fault--that's just the UMBC French department. Overall she's a wonderful teacher.

Best teacher ever! She is the sweetest, most helpful teacher and the nicest person, plus she makes class fun and quizzes and tests extremely manageable.  I got a D in high school french and got an A+ in both 101 and 102 with her! Take this class! I actually ENJOY french now!
great teacher. knowledgeable and very into what she is teaching. she's french so that is very helpful with the peonunciation.tests/quizes are not hard if you study beforehand.

She is so adorable! She calls you her babies and makes you feel like your class is the best class she has ever taught and she loves all of you. She is fair and understanding about schedules and illness. Test can be difficult if you do not put time into learning the material or if you don't care about what you are learning. over all amazing teacher!
VERY helpful.  Says the cutest things too.
Dr. de Verneil is very helpful. She also has very interesting insights on things.
Mme Deverneil is an awesome teacher. She's very helpful and easy to talk to. You should definetly take one of her classes. Plus, her son is awesome too.
N/A

I took Da Silva last spring semester and failed.  Not a good teacher. One day she wrote something on the board, ppl asked what it was and she said "oh, its portugese, I'll come back with the translation later." Cannot understand her very well, cannot hear her unless in first row, and not an wasy class. I agree with the others in studying the text!

SO DISORGANIZED! She is never prepared and even when she is she's not clear enough for you to understand what she's trying to say. Getting past the accent itself is a huge hurdle. She NEVER responds to emails, so dont even bother.  Also, the TAs suck and the lab reports/paper analyses are graded unfairly. Take the afternoon section, it's less work.

Dr. DaSilva makes your life hell when you take biochem lab. The sylabus is 16 pages long with redundant information while the protocol does not have enough information. Sometimes she doesn't answer your questions and you end up do things wrong which is going to hurt you in your lab report. Tons of work in this course and the grading scheme is crazy

Da Silva doesn't know how to teach. She rambles about nothing and writes scribbles on the board and calls them notes. If you want to pass you should ignore everything she says and read the book. Overall I would consider her a horrible teacher and advise you to get used to teaching yourself.

Goes really fast during lectures and skips around a lot.  I found I did better in the class when I stopped paying attention to her lectures and read the text on my own.  Go to lectures tho, sometimes she has extra credit.  Allows students to drop an exam and 2 quizzes.

Lovely professor. I am not a native Russian speaker and I took this class because it appeared interesting and I already enjoyed learning new languages. She is a vibrant, intelligent teacher and wants you to succeed. Would a million times over take her class again!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Zhdanovych is an amazing professor! As a senior, I've been through the entire Russian program at UMBC. I see some people are saying that there is a lot of homework, I think that's the case for most language courses and in my experience Vira has always been really forgiving on grading and getting in assignments at the end of the semester.
Wants you to succeed, helps you.
Vira is consistently unprepared to teach. My suggestion--not warning--is that she find another career path.
She had to teach too many classes this year which was really reflected in terms of her demeanor and preparation for class.

One of the romance languages will be easier if you're a native english speaker and you just want your language credit. But, if you are actually interested in the language and culture than I'd say they're worth it. A lot of hw, but that's to be expected when you're learning a language. You need the repetition. Overall I'd definitely recommend them.

Russian is a tough language but she knows how to teach it in a way that her students can understand. She gives a lot of homework but it's a good way to practice your skills, so don't skip it! She's funny and conversational and you can tell she cares about all of her students individually. If you want to take Russian, take it with professor Vira.

Lots of homework, yes, but it's all on a schedule and she follows a pattern. Learn the pattern and then it's simply time management. That being said, don't skip class. It's a language course and if you miss class, you're not passing unless you're a native speaker. Almost done with 102, and it's the same, but with more vocab and cases to memorize.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The class is ok, but idk if you can get another Russian prof in this school. I sent her multiple emails and she has not responded to any of them. She gives an insane amount of homework for a 101 class. It's like she teaches the class as we all know Russian. The class moves fast but no matter what all you'll be doing is Russian with the work given.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Vira is one of the best professors I have ever had, she always makes an effort to engage all of her students. I have already taken 3 courses with Vira, and plan to take courses with her until I graduate. I started taking Russian originally to fill my general education requirements, but Vira made it so enjoyable that I decided to make it my minor.

If you thought 301 would be the same homework amount as the previous classes, get ready for more! I don't know why I have to do so much but an awesome teacher! Seriously though there is an insanely ridiculous amount of homework, you will be constantly doing Russian.
Awesome professor, very knowledgeable and gives great feedback! There is so much practice, this should be expected, but be ready for an astronomical number of homework to do. Extremely Funny!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Literally I am a russian native speaker that got an A+ and this course was so annoying. Russian is not difficult, but she makes it. the work loads are insane on non-native students. I know the language so it wasn't hard for me but she centers the course around people like me and not anyone else, she teaches people to hate russian, not love it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: As a native Russian speaker I thought that Vera would be more tougher on me, and while there's nothing wrong with that, she treated me the same as everyone else, which was fantastic. Coming from Inna, I was kinda intimidated by Vera at first, but once you have a class with her, you realize she's an amazing teacher and cares about your learning
Russian is a very hard language. Luckily, she is the best around. Lot of work but that is where you learn it all from.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: She is a fantastic teacher who is always enthusiastic in class. Make sure you go to class and if you make sure she knows who you are (in a good way) and you make the effort you'll most likely get a B or higher
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor, very difficult class but she teaches well. Grades pretty hard, do your homework and you'll get bonus points at the end
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Hilarious

reviews.comment: She is the coolest professor on campus. I'm a biology major and added a Russian Studies certificate just because I enjoy her class so much. She makes is easy to learn and her exams are extremely fair. She gives you plenty of time, and for quizzes she gives you a clear idea of what will be on them. The projects are really fun too.

Vira is so nice and she obviously cares about the class and about the way she cares about learning Russian. She has us translate current news, and uses current media. She keeps the class interesting and I love her teaching style. Just stay on top of the course work and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I've had Vira for a year and a half, 101-201. She is amazing, but very intimidating at first. She makes you work for it, but when she knows you work hard, she respects it. She gives excellent feedback on your homework. REVIEW THEM! She treats the students like her kids, and wants you to do well. Don't be afraid to ask questions. Join Russian club!

She's OKAY. Her class moves too fast for non native speakers. I feel as though more than half the class knows Russian fully and she makes the class around them rather then around people that actually dont know the language. Shes lenient on some things which is great but overall just know that this class is NOT an easy A for non native speakers.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I love Vira. She is an amazing Russian professor, and she will help you out whenever you need it. Be sure to ask questions, she will elaborate and help everyone. Tells great stories too. Beware of her quizzes- they can be brutal and sometimes unexpected. Russian is not easy, so dont expect to pass without doing the homework. Study a lot.

Vira is the best. It saddens me that I am going to have Rusinko next semester. I will miss how engaging and explanatory her lectures are. Hers is definitely a worth while language course to take. Participation d reing at home is  you really need to pass.
Vira is a great professor. She gives students plenty of help when learning new material, and she tells great stories about Russia. Her teaching methods are effective and she's easy to talk to.

Definitely one of my favorite professors. She is very organized and very helpful. Great sense of humor. Do the homework and study a lot for exams. Quizzes are really easy but exams can be challenging. Worth taking the class though
She's an amazing professor! She has a lot of great stories about Russia, too. Just show up to class on time... or she'll send you to Siberia.

A great teacher.  Definitely one of the most balanced professors at UMBC.  Great sense of humor, but very sophisticated demeanor.  One of the most patriotic, pro-American professors at UMBC.  Subject matter is not easy, but she will do her best and grade kindly as long as you reciprocate with hard work.  Stingy with Extra credit though.  Great Prof
Vera is awesome. She seems intimidating at first but she has has a great sense of humor and understanding. Just show up on time!

Great teacher, knows how to have a sense of humor and when to be serious. Great if you go to her office hours for help. Very understanding if you work hard. Just work hard and you will be fine. Very important though, more than just because attendance is mandatory. Show up to class! If your attendance is great she will be much nicer to you.

Passionate but unfortunately ineffective. His lectures jump into things without you knowing how to do them and he has a hard time seeing from students' perspectives. He tries to be nice but its not enough to rate him high. His exams are hard if you don't cheat but everyone does so he thinks people understand more than they do.

Vick is terrible. It's easy enough to do well on his exams and quizzes, but the homework assignments were a joke. He graded all of them after we took the final, so we had no feedback all semester. He's the only programming professor who will give you a decent grade for minimal work though, so take him if you want to learn nothing.

Great guy, makes not-funny jokes that actually make you laugh. Class is boring as hell, he knows a lot and is an expert but he's bad at teaching, really. Projects can be way complicated compared to other sections but he's reasonable when grading and also giving online quizes and exams.

If you (like me) don't care about programming (Java) and dont want to be one, he's the easiest professor. No problem getting a B or A. If you do want to be a programmer and learn more advanced Java, I'd suggest to take a better professor. Although he knows a lot and has vast experience, he is bad on teaching, very bad.

He is a horrible teacher. He doesn't care about being there. He gives take home quizzes, which is probably the only reason why I passed. He doesn't explain anything and just reads off of the books PowerPoints, he is so lazy and he doesn't give timely feedback--still waiting on grades from before the midterm and classes are over.

Professor Vick is a pretty cool teacher in general, his exams are fairly easy (simple questions from slides/book), and he is very lenient with deadlines. However, in terms of teaching, he's not very clear and his writing on the board is almost incomprehensible. He requires peer programming for projects, my suggestion don't pick a crappy partner.

I'm not sure if I should suggest Vick or tell you to run away. I ended up getting an A in his class but I can't say it was easy. He's not very clear on assignments and seems to have a strange grading system. We did peer programming which was both a blessing and a curse. Helpful tip: Pick a good partner and you'll be fine. Exams are easy as all hell

Prof. Vick is probably the best option for ANY IS major taking IS247. He assigns problems from the book but gives plenty of time to do them just don't wait. Start early, and you can code with a buddy (He favors Peer Programming highly). He's funny and jokes with you during lecture. Beware of his doctor's handwriting on the dry erase board.

I haven't received any grades yet but feel compelled to say AWESOME PROF! He falls way behind in lectures but always offers help. Very friendly. Grading might be somewhat harsh but gives plenty of time to do assignments. Has a sense of humor and classes are not stressful. He is in total favor of Peer-Programming (ie: with a buddy) on projects.
As said before, very lenient and fun to talk to, but is not great at actually teaching the material at hand. Get in groups.

Unfortunately the majority of the previous comments are true but they do leave out some things I personally encountered.  In addition to being poor in teaching and class organization, he blatantly lied about how a project would be graded.  Later, he changed how the grades would be weighted in the course.  Best to avoid, adivse others to do same

No No No No No No No No No No No No No No No No No No No No No. Vick is very nice and funny, but in my top 3 of worst professors ever. Doesn't explain things well, makes everything overly cryptic. 3 quizes, a take home mdtrm, 3 prjts, final exam. Sounds okay, but is waayy to hard, considering his teaching ability. Get in groups.

The nicest, most lenient prof you'll meet. The worst teacher you can take. 331 is not supposed to be difficult but Vick turns it into intro to compiler theory. Cannot explain anything clearly, even after numerous tries. Seems to enjoy making subject overly cryptic. Likes to call on ppl when it's clear they have no clue. 3/4 of the class was lost.
WAYYYY too hard. expects you to know every single thing he teaches. STAY AWAY!

This professor is a lot better than everyone thinks. People who can't be expected to take "take home" exams seriously should not register in his course. Once you try, you will realize how easy his classes are. True, he could be a bit more explainitory, but if you're not understanding his lectures, chances are others aren't either. Curves favorably!

Vick knows a lot about computer science, and you can learn a ton from him if you want to.  His assigned readings are there for a reason, and lecture is a supplement to those. If you read the reading, and follow along in class, the class is great; if you rely on lecture alone, you will fail.  He is more concerned with learning than grades.

Ah fun times with Vick. So I had to repeat this God aweful class, took him the first time only person available the second. Fun Times. :P. I oounted a total of 6 graded materials. Midterm and Final are takehome, prepare to be amazed at how hard something you have all week to do is
He's probably a follower of Socrates because all he'd do is ask the class questions.

Vick is the ultimate double-edged sword of professors. On one side he's funny, approachable, and interacts a lot with the class. On the other side though he's probably the least effective lecturer i've ever had. He's liberal with curves but even with them you will likely struggle to get B's. If you study his powerpoints outside class, you'll do ok.

It's very difficult to adjust to his teaching style, but once you do, you will realize that the course is easy.  Do NOT rely on lectures alone.  The only reason I got an A was because I met with a group and we studied together 2x / week.  Lectures are useless, but grades are curved off of the highest grade.  Take home exams.  Put time into them!!

Avoid this teacher at all costs. He is almost always late to class. He "scolded" us for leaving early once because he was over 20 minutes late. Wikipedia explains the covered topics better then he does. His exams will always have material he expects you to "find" and "learn" on your own. By far the worst professor I've had at UMBC.
No Comments
professor has friendly attitude, is kind and interacts with the class, which makes the class interesting and unusual

If you like having a teacher to interact with and thinking, then Vick is a teacher for you.  The students that I have seen that haven't done well with him tended to want him to hold their hand the whole way through their projects.
lots of java. not too many actual lectures. its easier than some other 400 level cs courses

He teaches some really useful stuff, but it's mostly a continuation of his 331 class. Still lots of Java, which annoyed me since he mentions a number of other languages. He easily allows the class to become behind, whether by clumsy lecturing or lack of student understanding. However, I think that Java is a good language to teach OO principles with

Very boring and extremely biased towards Java and his own superiority.  He reads from powerpoint notes, so no real benefit to attending the class.  Don't try to correct him when he's wrong or you'll pay for it all semester long as he continually tries to embarass you during class.
Very entertaining in lectures, occasionally disorganized. Overall a great proffesor to take.

The most entertaining class I've ever taken at UMBC. Vick is a fantastic teacher, but for all the wrong reasons. He's far too lenient with due dates, frankly, so anyone reasonably compitent should find the class fairly easy. Expect to learn lots of Java (supposably, we'll be learning ML soon).
One of the best CMSC professors at BC.  I had him for 3 classes and cannot put into words how much I learned from him.  He's a very liberal grader and doesn't mind giving extensions.
He is very good and easy, he is a Java nut ie if it can be done in java he will have u do it in java, if u need uperlevel credit take is summer class

He's fun... and thats it. Gets off subject during lecture. falls ridiculously behind in lectures. We were supposed to have 4 projects by now, we've had 1. Project assignments unclear as far as material and requirements go. Grades harshly, makes mistakes

Has a good sense of houmor and is willing to work with the students.  He is not well organized and course is not well mapped out in the beginning.  He does know the subject but sometimes comes off as scatter brained.

Bring an eyelid prop. Better yet, download the PowerPoints, find out when the tests are, and don't come to class. He doesn't teach; he reads his PowerPoint presentations in a monotonous drone. If you have a demonstrable clue, he'll like you.

He only gives 4 exams and that is the only grades you receive. he talks to only one side of the class and he is horrible at teaching. Ive never done so bad in a class, he doesn't help, nor answer emails. he is stuck up and overall and awful teacher.
our only grades were a midterm and final, which he didn't grade until the semester was over. I fluked an A but You will not learn anything. He also never responded to a single email.

The worst professor I have ever had. He is so unorganized and won't give grades on time. The worst part is that if your a working student he is often your only option(good luck) due to class times. He is bad a teaching and unhelpful. Hard to get answers by e-mail in a timely manner. His grading is unclear. There just is nothing good to say.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Guys gotta go. So unbelievably unclear on everything he says and does, teaching and grading.
Loved having professor Cobb. Fair grading system with 6-8 assignments and the lowest one is dropped. Final is pass fail and he is very much so straightforward with what the correct answer is and why.
Its impossible to keep up with what he is teaching. He does not ask for questions or if the class understands, he just keeps moving on in a fast paced style. Very stuck up.

A&P is already hard but he just makes it even harder. Especially when he is so boring. He talks so fast and when he tries to explain things, he'll zoom through the material as if we aren't writing this stuff down. I highly recommend that you do not take his class because he makes learning about the material even harder,
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Incredibly boring lecturer, and each test counts as 25% of your final grade for the class. The average for each exam we had was in the 60s. Really challenging class anyways and he didn't make it any better.

I would want to give a 2 for him just because he seemed like a nice guy but he was just unacceptable as a teacher. He never responded to any emails, wrote the class notes on a chalkboard which was hard to follow, and was extremely confusing with grades. He went off script from the syllabus and just made up his own grading system along the way.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This professor is very nice and knows his subject. With just 5 homework's, a midterm and final exam, Couldn't complain about that. He is VERY late with grading and answering emails. Students started to drop this class after 2 weeks. I wish I did the same and had to self teach myself this course just to survive. I do not recommend this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Nice guy, but a terrible professor. Late with grades, instructions and expectations were unclear. Not hard to get a decent grade with the extra credit he provides. Tends to drone on in lectures, and it can be hard to focus.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: By far the worst possible Professor to ever teach. Grading didn't make sense, accessibility outside the classroom setting was close to impossible and was always confused when Students had questions about their grades. Never gave direct,clear instructions. Was very confused from both a student and professor standpoint.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Yoon was a great. I recommend getting the textbook but she also gives notes that come right from the book. She is very quick emailing back her students. She once got on Zoom at 10pm to help my team on our code that we were stuck on. She truly cares for all her student.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Somewhat unclear, and not very helpful. Unsure whether or not she really knows the material. Take someone else if you can
She is a very caring professor . She will ensure that all her students understand the subject matter
Very good teacher, makes the material very clear and will not leave you behind... the class project is very helpful as well
I was able to understand databases thoroughly. She ensures that each student in the class understands what she is talking about. Great Professor !

Her accent was really thick and hard to understand. you pretty much had to write whole programs on the tests and her questions were tricky. her assignments were okay at the beginning but then it just got more confusing as the class went on
difficult to understand (accent) and not very helpful.  unclear on requirements and exams.  much material is not useful and class time is wasted.  if you can, take someone else.
She was very clear and set course expectations from the beginning. I feel she was hard but fair and I learned a lot - hers was the best class I have taken at UMBC so far

She's not a good teacher. Her explanations are unclear, and they've gotten worse as the course has gone on. The amount knowledge obtained in class is rarely the amount of knowledge required to do the textbook assignments. I would recommend someone else.

I struggled to understand her the first few classes. Her english is really bad. Besides that I would say she is a good teacher and she will be more than willing to help anytime. Her tests are a bit hard and there is a big database project you need to do as well. I liked the class though, i felt like i learned a lot about databases.

Very good professor, and yes she does not speak the clearest but I had no problem understanding her. I enjoyed her class and the special topic material was Knowledge Management, which I found interesting.

This teacher is extremely hard to understand, when she says textbook it sounds more like, "testabool".  You can get used to it, but it does add an extra bit of an obstacle.  She has a hard time answering students questions.  I would recommend another teacher if the opportunity presents.

Very stubborn and not helpful at times.  If you see her in office hours about homework she won't help very much and she won't clarify test questions.   She also won't tell you the format of her exams or help clarify her badly-written test questions.  She's good at teaching, but very frustrating to deal with.

She is very hard to understand, I'm not being prejudice but it is helpful to have a teacher that speaks clear English.  No help on exams, she will tell you that she never gives multiple choice exams only to get 100 fill in the blank and multiple choice questions on the day of the exam.  Try to find someone else if you get the opportunity.
She speaks broken English but after a few weeks you can overcome the barrier.  She is very helpful.  We had a class project and she guided us throughout the assignment.
Just memorize Oracle 8i guidebook and you might get an A
Amazing professor taken multiple classes with her. Always very understanding and helpful. Highly recommend.

She's my first good history teacher so I'm not sure how to compare her to other history teachers. What I can say for sure is that she is flexible, helpful, and knowledgeable. She relies on readings and discussions a lot. Lectures are fairly straight forward and if you enjoy the topic you'll enjoy the lecture. Tests aren't particularly hard.

Soviet History with Professor Voerkelius was a great class. If you're interested in the topic and don't mind a few papers the class is fairly easy, and at least online only requires weekly discussion posts and a paper and timeline at the end of each unit. The only real time consuming part is the final paper, which is around 10-15 pages.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--So many papers

reviews.comment: His expectations are unreasonable. Lectures were heavily based on abstract theory. Unable to solve a problem himself. HW?s were ridiculous. I was forced to turn most of them in unfinished. Grading was harsh. Basically, this class was taught from a mathematician?s perspective.

Professor is extremely bright and knowledgeable, but has a hard time passing that on. He teaches this class like one geared towards math majors: heavy theory with specific definitions and very few examples. Read his book very slowly and make sure you understand it well or you'll be suffering the whole semester.

The class is difficult because his lectures focus on linear algebra theory. He prefers not to do example problems in class. There is not enough partial credit on exams, causing averages to be 50-60%. 25 people (30%) got a D or E. However, the final exams was easy and he will answer your questions but most are afraid to ask.

This guy is old school.  He has his lectures prepared in advance and he basically has the whole semester planned out before you take your seat on day one. Sometimes he has his own book, which is not very good. Supplement by talking to him.  He gets annoyed if you ask too many questions, but will answer the good ones if he thinks it will help others

Imagine if your grandfather taught a class. That is exactly what a class with Von Kerczek is like. He is not always clear, however his exams are easy and he is always will to help, though his explanations could use some work. For ENME462, the exams were take-home, which was great! He is worth taking as long as you know what you're getting into.
