Very thick australian accent. Unapproachable and short when you ask him any questions. His TA's have no clear grading method. Tests are hard, and often have no warning to what will be on them. Does not seem to care about what grade his students earn.

Dr. Zweck rocks!  By far one of my favorite math professors at UMBC.  Some students don't like him because he seems difficult, but if you put in the work, he is very supportive and an all around great teacher.  I recommend him to any math major.

Pretty good at explaining things usually, although he tends to try use analogies and examples that confuse more than help. Often makes you feel like you aren't worth his time. Not approachable at all. He told us one class that he was a great teacher and that we were lucky to have him and his teaching seems to go by that opinion.

NO EASY A. He does a lot of proofs, and asks for 1 every exam he gives. The matlab projects were very hard. If you do all the work he asks of you, and you actually spend time studying and going to him for help, you should come out with an A or B because he curves. Definately take him if you want to learn something.

Dr. Zweck is a very good teacher. He likes to emphasize the theory and concepts behind the material that is being taught so he puts theory questions on tests which some students can have difficulty with.  Dr. Zweck knows math very well and certainly loves the subject. He is good at explaining the concepts. He is also helpful if you have questions.

1st off, u can't give a bad rating cuz hes hard.  His lectures are well prepared & tries to figure out what is going on in the minds of the students when teaching.  He always says "you gotta hassle me! I should be sick of seeing your face by the end of the semester".  His tests are hard and the amount of homework he gives is WAY OVER THE TOP.

Zweck's lectures generally follow what's going to be on the exam, but he makes them VERY hard.  The curve is something like a 55% for a C, and still a lot of the class got below that.  Annoyed when you ask questions, but insists you ask them anyway.  I did not find him very approachable. Lots of work and not always clear, try to take someone else.

I did every single homework and practically lived at the LRC.  I didn't pass the class due to some of my quiz/test grades.  I put so much effort into this class and still did not pass.  I definitely recommend a different calc teacher.

Very boring. Unapproachable teacher who seems to be irritated when students ask questions. Gives WAY too much homework and has very hard exams. Be careful his TA's don't grade the homework fairly and he doesnt really care about that

This prof. is really good teacher. He's hard though during exams and loads you up with a lot of homework. If you go to his lectures they are useful but they seem to be 10x then they are. I don't recommend you this prof. if u want a easy "A"

Worst math professor I had. Actually, worst professor period. He gives a large numer of completely pointless homework assignments, gives a pointless project and also grades unfairly. He pretty much decides at the beginning of the semester what grade you will get. He is also not particularly helpful or approachable.
A boring professor.
Very good teacher. Explains material clearly and is very well prepared for his lectures. He actually says that the more you bug him about homework questions, the more he will like you...

Very good professor, keeps class interesting, and is willing to help you outside of class.  Do not mistake good as being easy.  This was one of the most difficult classes I have taken, his exams are tough, but he is willing to evaluate your final grade on an individual basis.

He's a bright and clear math teacher teaching math. If you are a math major taking an upper-level class, I recommend him. If you're taking him for a lower level class though, like Calculus or Linear Algebra, you will probably learn a lot but I imagine it's difficult.
Hands down one of the greatest/hardest professors i've ever had, will bend over backwards for you to learn material, lectures seem to be 4x longer than usual, fairly humorous, good teacher
By far the most hardest professor I've had, in math, in a while.  Very nitpicky with every problem but overall one of the best prof. I've had.
Heavy work load, explain the material clearly, tests can be trickey.

VERY CLEAR in teaching, you will learn far more in his class than in a regular calc class, but his work load is a lot and his projects are very difficult (tests are fair).  He is a difficult teacher, but it is worth taking him.  And I believe he really wants you to succeed in his class.
He's a great professor. Likes to keep class interesting. Exams aren't tricky, if you know your stuff you will do well. The material is time consuiming, but that is independent of the professor.
I think this was because he was teaching an honors course, but he gave us way too much extra work.  I didn't have enough time to do all of it.

He's okay, but I did not personally like him.  Many students liked his teaching style and enjoyed class.  As an honors class, most students were bright and thus did well.  This subject can be difficult for some people, and may not be aided enough by him.
